papers.title: NeurOWL: An LLM-Based Neural-symbolic Framework for Incomplete OWL Ontology Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: OWL ontologies provide a formal knowledge representation framework that enables semantic reasoning, and have been widely adopted across domains such as healthcare and bioinformatics. In practice, however, real-world ontologies are often incomplete, which pose challenges for reasoning. In this work, we focus on a fundamental subsumption reasoning problem: given an incomplete ontology and a candidate (non-entailed) subsumption, determine whether the subsumption is semantically plausible and, if so, providing a logically sound explanation containing potential missing axioms. This task unifies subsumption verification with ontology abduction, and generalizes the latter by removing the need for a predefined candidate set of missing axioms. To address this subsumption reasoning problem, we propose NeurOWL, an end-to-end neuro-symbolic framework that jointly performs verification and abduction, leveraging both formally defined semantics and textual semantics through Large Language Models and ontology embeddings. We evaluate NeurOWL on real-world ontologies across multiple domains, demonstrating strong and robust performance across different domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NeurOWL，一个基于LLM的神经符号框架，用于处理不完整OWL本体的包含推理问题。该框架联合进行包含验证和溯因，利用大语言模型和本体嵌入同时捕捉形式语义和文本语义，在多个领域的真实本体上取得稳健性能。
Motivation: 现实世界的OWL本体常常不完整，导致传统语义推理面临挑战，亟需一种能够处理不完整知识并生成逻辑解释的方法。

Result: 在多个领域的真实不完整本体上，该框架表现出强且鲁棒的包含推理和溯因性能。

papers.title: AquaAugmentor: A Novel Feature Augmentation Algorithm for Water Potability Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Access to potable water is crucial for health, economic development, and sustainability. However, accurately classifying water quality remains a significant challenge due to the complexity and variability of water source data. This paper addresses the challenge of predicting water potability through machine learning and deep learning algorithms. It introduces a novel feature augmentation algorithm, AquaAugmentor, to enhance the predictive performance of these models for low-dimensional datasets. Utilizing a dataset that includes chemical attributes of water, such as pH, hardness, solids, chloramines, sulfate, and others. This study evaluates the performance of the models with and without AquaAugmentor. Each model applied to classify water as potable or non-potable and its performance is then evaluated and compared based on test accuracy and AUC score. The results highlight the strengths and limitations of our proposed algorithm, providing insights into the most effective techniques for improving the predictive performance of water quality classification. This study contributes to the broader efforts of ensuring safe water access and serves as a framework for employing machine learning in environmental quality assessments. The findings aim to assist researchers, policymakers, and public health officials in making informed decisions based on reliable machine learning predictions.

papers.title: Scaling Time Series Classification via XAI-Driven Data Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Explainable AI (XAI) for time series has seen significant algorithmic growth, but its utility in providing measurable performance gains for downstream tasks remains under-explored. This paper bridges this gap by introducing drXAI, a novel methodology that repurposes XAI attribution methods for effective data reduction in Time Series Classification (TSC). The core challenge in modern TSC is scalability; state-of-the-art models, such as Transformers, exhibit quadratic complexity relative to sequence length and linear complexity relative to the number of channels. This renders them computationally prohibitive for massive datasets. drXAI addresses this by using a fast, GPU-accelerated classifier (Hydra) to generate local attributions. We aggregate these into global feature importance scores and employ an automated elbow-cut heuristic to select the most salient features without requiring manual thresholds. We evaluate our approach on both synthetic and real-world univariate and multivariate datasets. On synthetic benchmarks, drXAI successfully recovers ground-truth features where traditional baselines fail. On real-world data, drXAI achieves between 80% and 90% data reduction while maintaining classification accuracy comparable to models trained on the full dataset. Most importantly, we show that drXAI allows resource-intensive models like ConvTran to scale to datasets that were previously inaccessible due to memory constraints. Our results show the benefits of using XAI not just for interpretability, but as a robust tool for feature selection and scalability in time series analysis. All our code and data are openly available.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出drXAI，一种利用XAI归因方法进行时间序列分类数据有效缩减的方法。通过快速GPU加速分类器Hydra生成局部归因，聚合为全局特征重要性，并使用自动肘部裁剪启发式选择最显著特征。在合成和真实数据集上，实现了80%-90%的数据缩减，同时保持分类精度，并使资源密集型模型如ConvTran能够扩展到之前因内存限制不可达的数据集。
Motivation: 现代时间序列分类模型（如Transformer）扩展性受限，对序列长度二次复杂度，对通道数线性复杂度，导致大规模数据集计算昂贵。XAI方法在提供下游任务性能提升方面未被充分利用。
Method: 引入drXAI，使用快速GPU加速的Hydra分类器生成局部归因，聚合为全局特征重要性，通过自动肘部裁剪启发式选择最显著特征，无需手动阈值。随后可在缩减后的特征上训练资源密集型模型。
Result: 在合成基准上成功恢复地面真值特征；在真实数据集上实现80%-90%数据缩减，同时保持与全数据训练相当的分类精度。使ConvTran等模型能够扩展到之前因内存不可访问的数据集。
Conclusion: 研究表明XAI不仅用于可解释性，还可作为时间序列分析中特征选择和扩展性的有力工具。所有代码和数据公开。

papers.title: From Diffusion to Reaction-Diffusion: A Dynamical-Systems View of Oversmoothing in Hypergraph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Higher-order couplings enhance the expressive power of hypergraph neural networks (HGNNs), but they also intensify representation collapse in deep propagation due to strong multi-way feature mixing. This work investigates hypergraph oversmoothing from a dynamical-systems perspective and develops a reaction--diffusion framework for depth-resistant hypergraph learning. By defining hypergraph gradient and divergence operators, we interpret message passing as an incidence-level diffusion process. The analysis of pure diffusion shows that its continuous semiflow exponentially contracts the null-mode-free component of node representations and drives the Dirichlet energy to zero, revealing hypergraph oversmoothing as an intrinsic transverse-energy dissipation phenomenon. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Hypergraph Neural Reaction--Diffusion (HNRD), which introduces a reaction mechanism acting on the transverse component to compensate diffusion-induced dissipation and stabilize discriminative variations. We establish global well-posedness of the proposed dynamics and prove that the null-mode-free Dirichlet energy remains bounded away from zero. A forward-Euler discretization provides a practical HNRD layer with a stability condition for deep propagation. Experiments on benchmark and synthetic heterophilic hypergraphs demonstrate that HNRD consistently improves over representative hypergraph baselines. Depth, robustness, and efficiency analyses further show that HNRD preserves stable performance and nonzero Dirichlet energy under deep propagation and perturbations. These results provide a principled dynamical framework for designing deep hypergraph architectures that maintain higher-order expressiveness without representation collapse.

Motivation: 高阶耦合增强超图神经网络表达能力，但也因强多路特征混合导致深层传播中的表示崩溃（过平滑）。

Conclusion: 提出原则性的动力学框架用于设计深度超图架构，在不导致表示崩溃的情况下维持高阶表达能力。

papers.title: SlotMem: Character-Addressable Internal Memory for Narrative Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining recurring character identities across scene transitions and long temporal gaps is a central challenge in narrative long video generation. Methods targeting global consistency often retrieve memory using cues that are not aligned with character identity preservation, while recent character-centric variants still rely on coarse frame-level kv memory that entangles identity with incidental visual factors and lacks a continuous update mechanism under limited memory capacity. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{SlotMem}, a character-addressable internal memory framework for multi-character narrative long video generation. Specifically, SlotMem uses a Character-Semantic Probe to localize character-relevant visual tokens from cross-attention responses, and a Memory Encoder to compress DiT tokens into compact role-wise slot memory. As generation proceeds, a Memory Writer conservatively updates each character's memory with new observations, while Character-Wise Cross-Attention retrieves the role memory and injects it only into localized tokens of the same character. Experiments on multiple narrative long video generation benchmarks show that SlotMem improves long-range character consistency over existing baselines, while maintaining comparable video quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/YilaiLiu-HKU/SlotMem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SlotMem框架，一种角色可寻址的内部记忆机制，用于多角色叙事长视频生成。通过角色语义探针定位跨注意力响应中的角色相关视觉标记，记忆编码器将DiT令牌压缩为紧凑的角色槽记忆，记忆写入器保守更新记忆，角色级跨注意力仅将记忆注入同角色的局部令牌。在多个叙事长视频生成基准上，SlotMem改善了长程角色一致性，同时保持视频质量。
Motivation: 现有长视频生成方法在跨场景和时间间隔中保持角色身份一致性方面存在不足，粗粒度的帧级键值记忆将身份与偶然视觉因素纠缠，且缺乏有限记忆容量下的连续更新机制。
Method: 提出SlotMem框架，包含角色语义探针、记忆编码器、记忆写入器和角色级跨注意力模块。角色语义探针从跨注意力响应中定位角色相关视觉令牌，记忆编码器压缩DiT令牌为紧凑的角色槽记忆，记忆写入器保守地更新每个角色的记忆，角色级跨注意力将角色记忆仅注入同角色的局部令牌。
Result: 在多个叙事长视频生成基准上，SlotMem改善了长程角色一致性，同时保持与现有基线相当的视频质量。
Conclusion: SlotMem通过角色可寻址的内部记忆机制有效提升了长视频生成中的角色一致性，为叙事视频生成提供了新的思路。

papers.title: GeoChrono: Benchmarking and Rethinking Long-Term Temporal Understanding in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing offers an unparalleled vantage point for observing the Earth's long-term surface evolution, yet it demands that a model not only perceive land cover at isolated moments, but also track changes, memorize evolution histories, and reason across time and space. However, existing studies lack a systematic evaluation that dissects these distinct competencies. To fill this gap, we introduce ChronoBench, a multidimensional benchmark that decomposes this task into four progressive cognitive levels (i.e., Land Cover Perception, Temporal Recognition, Long-Term Memory, and Spatio-Temporal Reasoning). The ChronoBench comprises 12 sub-tasks and 17,689 rigorously validated QA (Question-Answer) pairs. Extensive evaluations reveal that mainstream MLLMs fall drastically behind human experts, with Long-Term Memory emerging as the most critical bottleneck. Motivated by this finding, we further propose GeoChrono, an MLLM with enhanced capabilities for tracing, memorizing, and reasoning about long-term geographic evolution. Leveraging the physical prior that geographic parcels remain spatially fixed while their semantics evolve, we design a Temporal Trajectory Encoder~(TempEnc) that constructs per-location temporal trajectories for dedicated land cover evolution modeling, and we introduce a Coarse-to-Fine Token Compressor~(C2FComp) that adaptively preserves dynamic regions while compressing the static background. To support training, we also construct ChronoInstruct, a 104K-sample instruction-tuning dataset spanning all competency levels for training. GeoChrono achieves state-of-the-art performance on ChronoBench, surpassing the leading commercial MLLMs by over 20%, while C2FComp reduces visual tokens by over 56% while retaining GeoChrono's 94.6% performance. The code and data will be available at https://github.com/IntelliSensing/GeoChrono

Method: 提出 ChronoBench 基准和 GeoChrono 模型，后者包含 Temporal Trajectory Encoder 建模每个位置的时间轨迹，以及 Coarse-to-Fine Token Compressor 自适应保留动态区域并压缩静态背景。
Result: GeoChrono 在 ChronoBench 上超越领先商业 MLLM 超过20%，C2FComp 减少视觉标记56%以上且保留94.6%性能。
Conclusion: 长期记忆是遥感时间理解的关键瓶颈，GeoChrono 通过编码时间轨迹和自适应压缩有效提升性能。

papers.title: AuEmoChat: Authentic Emotion Understanding and Rendering for Conversational Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Conversational Speech Synthesis (CSS) aims to synthesize speech with human-like emotional expression and contextual consistency in user-agent interactions. Existing CSS methods struggle to render authentic human emotions due to limited predefined emotion label spaces (e.g., seven emotion categories), while redundant multimodal tokens in multi-turn dialogue history interfere with context understanding. To address these issues, we propose AuEmoChat, a CSS framework for authentic emotion understanding and rendering. First, we develop AuEmoCodec, which learns a discrete authentic emotion token space from large-scale emotional speech via finite scalar quantization, enabling a more authentic emotion representation than limited basic emotion categories. We further propose AuEmoToMe, an authentic-emotion-guided token merging algorithm that merges redundant tokens in multimodal dialogue history while preserving emotion-relevant context. We integrate it into an autoregressive text-speech model to predict the target authentic emotion token and speech tokens. Finally, we propose Authentic Emotion Flow Matching, which renders speech by jointly conditioning on merged dialogue context, target authentic emotion, and acoustic priors. Extensive experiments on the NCSSD-EmCap dataset demonstrate that AuEmoChat outperforms state-of-the-art CSS baselines and generates more expressive and authentic emotional speech.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AuEmoChat 是一个用于对话语音合成 (CSS) 的框架，旨在生成更真实的情感语音。它通过 AuEmoCodec 学习离散的真实情感 token 空间，通过 AuEmoToMe 算法合并多模态对话历史中的冗余 token 并保留情感相关上下文，最后使用 Authentic Emotion Flow Matching 生成语音。实验表明在 NCSSD-EmCap 数据集上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有 CSS 方法受限于预定义情感标签（如七类基本情感）和冗余的多模态 token，导致情感表达不真实且上下文理解受干扰。
Method: 提出 AuEmoChat 框架，包括：1) AuEmoCodec：通过有限标量量化从大规模情感语音中学习离散真实情感 token 空间；2) AuEmoToMe：真实情感引导的 token 合并算法，保留情感相关上下文；3) Authentic Emotion Flow Matching：基于合并的对话上下文、目标真实情感和声学先验生成语音。
Result: 在 NCSSD-EmCap 数据集上的实验表明，AuEmoChat 优于现有 CSS 基线，生成更具表现力且更真实的情感语音。
Conclusion: 所提出的方法通过离散真实情感表示和 token 合并实现了更自然的情感语音合成，但具体数值比较和局限性需进一步阅读。

papers.title: CoG-Guided Weight Correction for Fault-Tolerant Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) used in safety-critical applications are vulnerable to hardware and memory faults that corrupt network weights and degrade reliability. In this paper, we propose a Center of Gravity (CoG) guided weight correction method that restores faulty weights based on their spatial characteristics within each layer. The proposed approach detects and corrects weight faults using distance-aware correction rules, eliminating the need for retraining or architectural modification. The effectiveness of the proposed method in terms of the capability of tolerating hardware faults has been evaluated through performing fault injection at different Bit Error Rates (BERs). Experiments on safety-critical LSTM-based Networks, including StageNet for disease progression tracking and MTFNet for cardiac anomaly detection, demonstrate fault tolerance improvements of up to 230x and 6.41x, respectively, at a BER of 10^{-3}, with negligible accuracy loss. When extended to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), the method achieves up to 49.55x and 20.79x improvements under comparable fault conditions on ResNet-18 and VGG-16, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to apply the CoG concept to neural network weight tensors for enhancing model reliability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对安全关键应用中深度神经网络（DNN）易受硬件和内存故障影响的问题，本文提出一种基于重心（CoG）的权重修正方法，利用每层权重的空间特征通过距离感知规则检测和修正故障，无需重训练或架构修改。在LSTM网络（StageNet和MTFNet）上，该方法在比特错误率10^{-3}下实现了高达230倍和6.41倍的容错提升，在CNN网络（ResNet-18和VGG-16）上分别实现了49.55倍和20.79倍的提升。这是首次将CoG概念应用于神经网络权重张量以增强模型可靠性。
Motivation: 安全关键应用中的DNN易受硬件和内存故障影响，导致权重损坏和可靠性下降，现有方法往往需要重训练或修改架构。
Method: 提出CoG引导的权重修正方法，基于每层权重的空间特征，采用距离感知修正规则检测并纠正故障权重，无需重训练或架构修改。
Result: 在LSTM网络上，StageNet和MTFNet分别获得高达230倍和6.41倍的容错提升；在CNN网络上，ResNet-18和VGG-16分别获得49.55倍和20.79倍的提升（BER=10^{-3}），且精度损失可忽略。
Conclusion: 所提方法首次将CoG概念用于神经网络权重张量，有效提升了模型对硬件故障的容忍能力，且无需额外训练或架构调整。

papers.title: Personalized Image Aesthetic Assessment via Preference-rich Sample Mining and Cohort Merging
papers.abstract_en: Personalized Image Aesthetic Assessment (PIAA) aims to predict aesthetic ratings of images that vary across individuals. The aesthetic preferences manifest to different extents across distinct visual stimuli and exhibit cohort-specific patterns. Motivated by the above fact, this paper presents a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based approach, which models individual aesthetic preferences by Preference-Rich sample mining and Aesthetically-resonant Cohort merging (PRAC). Specifically, PRAC first identifies preference-rich samples by analyzing both Collective Controversy and Personalized Deviation of images, maximizing the utility of limited user data. Based upon the preference-rich samples, cross-user preference similarities are measured by comparing preference embeddings. Then, a cohort-based model merging strategy, is proposed by aggregating preference patterns from aesthetically-resonant users, which further enhances the personalization for the target individual. Extensive experiments and comparisons on four benchmark PIAA databases demonstrate the superiority of the proposed PRAC model over the state-of-the-arts. The code and model will be public at https://github.com/yzc-ippl/PRAC.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted by ACM MM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的个性化图像美学评估方法PRAC，通过偏好丰富样本挖掘和用户群体合并来建模个体审美偏好。在四个标准数据库上的实验表明，该方法优于现有技术。
Motivation: 现有个性化图像美学评估（PIAA）方法未能充分利用有限的用户数据，也未考虑不同用户间在审美偏好上的共鸣模式，导致个性化效果受限。
Method: PRAC首先通过分析图像的集体争议度和个人偏离度来识别偏好丰富样本，最大化有限用户数据的效用。然后基于偏好嵌入测量跨用户相似性，并提出一种基于群体的模型合并策略，聚合美学共鸣用户的偏好模式，增强目标个体的个性化。
Result: 在四个标准PIAA数据库上的大量实验表明，PRAC模型在性能上超越了现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 通过挖掘偏好丰富样本和合并美学共鸣用户的偏好模式，可以有效提升个性化图像美学评估的性能。

papers.title: Trainable Spline Representations for Physics-Informed Learning
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces Physics-Informed Splines (PI-Splines), a structured spline-based architecture for physics-informed learning. Instead of representing the solution of a differential equation with a neural network, PI-Splines directly parametrize the unknown field through a tensor-product B-spline expansion with trainable control coefficients. This formulation preserves the residual-based training paradigm of Physics-Informed Neural Networks while providing compact support, explicit smoothness control, analytical derivatives, and a direct geometric interpretation of the trainable parameters. When compatible with the spline representation, boundary conditions can be imposed strongly by fixing suitable boundary control coefficients. The proposed method is evaluated on several benchmark problems of increasing difficulty and compared with standard physics-informed frameworks under matched governing equations, collocation sets, loss terms, and optimization procedures, so as to isolate the effect of the approximation architecture. Numerical experiments show that PI-Splines provide a competitive and stable alternative to neural physics-informed architectures, particularly in settings where structured representations, locality, and parameter efficiency are desirable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physics-Informed Splines (PI-Splines)，一种基于张量积 B 样条 (tensor-product B-spline) 展开的可训练样条架构用于物理信息学习。该方法用可训练控制系数直接参数化微分方程的未知场，保留了物理信息神经网络的残差训练范式，同时提供紧支撑、显式平滑控制、解析导数及参数几何解释。在与标准物理信息框架的对比实验中，PI-Splines 在多个基准问题上表现出竞争性和稳定性，尤其适用于结构化表示、局部性和参数效率重要的场景。
Motivation: 物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 虽广泛应用，但存在训练不稳定、可解释性差、参数缺乏几何意义等问题。本文旨在通过结构化样条表示来克服这些局限。
Method: 提出 PI-Splines 架构，使用张量积 B 样条展开，控制系数作为可训练参数。边界条件可通过固定边界控制系数强施加。训练采用与 PINNs 相同的残差损失和优化流程。
Result: 在多个难度递增的基准问题上，PI-Splines 在匹配的方程、配置点、损失和优化设置下，相比标准物理信息框架提供竞争性和稳定的替代方案。
Conclusion: PI-Splines 是神经网络架构的有力替代，在需要结构化、局部性和参数效率时表现突出，但当前评估限于与 PINNs 的对比。

papers.title: Learning Faster without Deeper Networks: A*-Inspired Batch Selection for Efficient CNN Training
papers.abstract_en: Common practice when training Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is to use randomly shuffled mini-batches. This creates two limitations: slower convergence, and a diminishing learning signal, since many samples are quickly classified as easy during training. We address these inefficiencies with A*-Inspired Batch Selection (A*-BS), a lightweight, model-agnostic strategy that formulates mini-batch scheduling as a heuristic search problem. Each batch is treated as a node in a search space and ranked using an A*-like score combining a loss-based difficulty measure with a reuse penalty. This encourages informative gradient updates and batch diversity throughout training, without modifying network architectures or optimization algorithms, so it integrates seamlessly into existing pipelines. We evaluate A*-BS on the twelve 2D classification tasks of the MedMNIST-v2 benchmark, using a deliberately simple architecture of approximately 2.25x10^5 parameters, compared against the ResNet-18 and ResNet-50 baselines reported by the benchmark. On half of these tasks, the lightweight model with A*-BS reaches higher accuracy and AUC than both ResNet baselines, with relative gains of up to 15%. An ablation under identical architecture and hyperparameters shows A*-BS outperforms random batch shuffling on all twelve tasks. Wall-clock measurements further show the lightweight CNN with A*-BS trains substantially faster than ResNet-18 and ResNet-50 on identical hardware. These results indicate that intelligent batch ordering can partially compensate for reduced architectural complexity, offering a computationally efficient alternative to deeper models, with reliability reinforced by strong performance even against deeper, more sophisticated architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级、与模型无关的批次选择策略A*-BS，将小批次调度视为启发式搜索问题，用A*风格的得分（结合损失难度和重用惩罚）来排序批次，以鼓励信息性梯度更新和批次多样性，从而加速CNN训练。在MedMNIST-v2的12个2D分类任务上，使用约2.25×10^5参数的简单网络，A*-BS在6个任务上达到比ResNet-18/50更高的准确率和AUC（提升最高15%），且所有任务上优于随机洗牌。
Motivation: 常规随机洗牌小批次导致收敛慢和训练信号衰减（易样本很快被分类正确），需要一种不修改网络结构或优化器的训练加速方法。
Method: A*-Inspired Batch Selection (A*-BS)：将每个批次视为搜索空间中的节点，用类似A*的得分（基于损失难度和重用惩罚的加权和）对批次排序，选择得分最高的批次用于当前训练步骤，从而保持梯度信息性和批次多样性。
Result: 在MedMNIST-v2基准上，简单CNN + A*-BS在6/12个任务上超过ResNet-18和ResNet-50的准确率和AUC（相对提升最高15%）；在相同架构和超参数下，A*-BS在所有12个任务上优于随机批次洗牌；且训练速度显著快于ResNet-18/50。
Conclusion: 智能批次排序可以部分补偿架构复杂度的降低，提供一种计算高效的深层网络替代方案。

summary_sections.motivation: 常规随机洗牌小批次导致收敛慢和训练信号衰减（易样本很快被分类正确），需要一种不修改网络结构或优化器的训练加速方法。
summary_sections.method: A*-Inspired Batch Selection (A*-BS)：将每个批次视为搜索空间中的节点，用类似A*的得分（基于损失难度和重用惩罚的加权和）对批次排序，选择得分最高的批次用于当前训练步骤，从而保持梯度信息性和批次多样性。
summary_sections.result: 在MedMNIST-v2基准上，简单CNN + A*-BS在6/12个任务上超过ResNet-18和ResNet-50的准确率和AUC（相对提升最高15%）；在相同架构和超参数下，A*-BS在所有12个任务上优于随机批次洗牌；且训练速度显著快于ResNet-18/50。
summary_sections.conclusion: 智能批次排序可以部分补偿架构复杂度的降低，提供一种计算高效的深层网络替代方案。

papers.title: Debiasing Text-to-Image Evaluation via Implicit Cultural Alignment Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: As Text-to-Image (T2I) systems rapidly advance, evaluating the cultural authenticity of synthesized content has become increasingly important for fair and trustworthy generative AI. Existing T2I evaluation metrics and multimodal judges often rely on visual-semantic representations that underrepresent implicit cultural norms, leading to biased preference judgments and the omission of fine-grained cultural cues. In addition, visual question answering (VQA)-based evaluators typically depend on autoregressive text generation, which limits their scalability for real-time reward modeling. To address these limitations, we introduce an Implicit Cultural Alignment Reward Model built upon a lightweight 4.2-billion-parameter Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). Our framework integrates an Implicit Cultural Probe with a Skip-connection Cross-Attention (SkipCA) mechanism, enabling late-stage semantic features to directly attend to early-stage visual representations and better preserve culturally salient details. Evaluations on 3,323 challenging and carefully curated image pairs from the CulturalFrames benchmark show that our approach achieves 80.54% pairwise accuracy, with Pearson and Kendall correlation coefficients of 0.546 and 0.377, respectively, outperforming representative vision-language metrics and MLLM-based evaluators. Moreover, by bypassing autoregressive text generation, our model processes each evaluation in 0.21 seconds under our local inference setup, achieving a $10\times$ speedup over standard VQA-based evaluators. These results suggest that the proposed reward model can provide an efficient and culturally aware scalar signal for preference optimization pipelines such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback and Direct Preference Optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对文本到图像（T2I）评估中隐性文化规范被忽略导致的偏差问题，提出一个基于4.2B参数多模态大语言模型的隐式文化对齐奖励模型。该模型通过隐式文化探针和跳跃连接交叉注意力机制保留文化细节，在CulturalFrames基准的3323对图像上达到80.54%成对准确率，推理速度比标准VQA评估器快10倍。
Motivation: 现有T2I评估指标和VQA评估器往往忽略隐性文化规范，导致偏好偏差；且VQA评估器依赖自回归文本生成，可扩展性差，难以用于实时奖励建模。
Method: 构建轻量级4.2B MLLM奖励模型，集成隐式文化探针（Implicit Cultural Probe）和跳跃连接交叉注意力（SkipCA），使晚期语义特征直接关注早期视觉表示，增强文化细节保留。
Result: 在CulturalFrames基准的3323对图像上达到80.54%成对准确率，Pearson相关系数0.546，Kendall相关系数0.377；推理时间0.21秒，比标准VQA评估器快10倍。
Conclusion: 该奖励模型可为偏好优化流程（如RLHF和DPO）提供高效、文化感知的标量信号，平衡评估效率与文化真实性。

papers.title: The Third Competition on Document Forgery Detection on ID-Cards and Passports
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the results from the Third International Competition on Document Forgery Detection on ID-Cards and Passports, which was held across two distinct tracks. Track 1 evaluates a synthetic-data-based ID-PAD system under controlled but diverse conditions, where the winning team, \textit{Incode}, achieves an $AV_{Rank}$ of 27.82%, confirming consistent performance across metrics and highlighting the importance of a balanced, generalizable design. In Track 2, the challenge intensifies with heterogeneous attack scenarios across different domains, where \textit{Incode} again achieved the top position with an $AV_{Rank}$ of 68.71% across thresholds, outperforming some baselines and established methods. These results demonstrate that PAD effectiveness requires not only high accuracy but also consistency across diverse attack types and imaging conditions. The success of this initiative across both tracks underscores the value of collaboration between companies and academic teams. This year, more than \textit{63 teams} were registered, and more than \textit{100 submission models} were evaluated. This competition has evolved into a leading benchmark state-of-the-art in PAD on ID documents, setting the standard for performance, reproducibility, and real-world applicability in secure identity verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了第三届国际证件伪造检测竞赛的结果，分为两个赛道：Track 1基于合成数据评估ID-PAD系统，Track 2在异构攻击场景下测试。获胜团队Incode在两个赛道均取得第一，AV_Rank分别为27.82%和68.71%。竞赛吸引了63支队伍、超过100个模型，成为证件伪造检测领域的基准。
Motivation: 证件伪造检测对安全身份验证至关重要，但现有方法在不同攻击和成像条件下的一致性不足，竞赛旨在推动该领域的研究与评估。
Method: 竞赛设置两个赛道：Track 1使用合成数据评估ID-PAD系统，Track 2包含跨领域的异构攻击场景。采用AV_Rank作为综合性能指标。
Result: Incode团队在Track 1取得AV_Rank 27.82%，在Track 2取得68.71%，均优于基线方法，展示了平衡且泛化的设计。
Conclusion: PAD系统不仅需要高准确率，还需在不同攻击类型和成像条件下保持一致性。该竞赛已成为证件伪造检测的领先基准。

papers.title: IoUPD: IoU-Aware Privileged Distillation for Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding with multimodal large language models is commonly formulated as autoregressive coordinate generation, where a model outputs bounding-box coordinates as text given an image and a referring-expression prompt. While this interface is simple and compatible with instruction following, it introduces a mismatch between training and evaluation: training optimizes token-level likelihood over coordinate strings, whereas grounding quality is measured by geometric overlap. We propose IoUPD, an IoU-aware privileged distillation method for coordinate-generating multimodal large language models. IoUPD uses ground-truth boxes not only as coordinate targets, but also as privileged training-time guidance. During training, the student receives the original image and prompt, while a frozen teacher receives a box-marked image and an augmented prompt that indicates the marked region. The student is trained with a supervised fine-tuning anchor and a privileged distillation loss whose token weights reflect both geometric importance and teacher reliability. At inference time, IoUPD requires no box overlay, privileged hint, teacher branch, or additional prediction module. Experiments on standard referring-expression grounding benchmarks show consistent region-level improvements over strong coordinate-generating baselines, demonstrating that ground-truth boxes can provide useful privileged guidance beyond serving as coordinate labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在视觉定位任务中训练与评估目标不一致的问题（训练优化坐标文本似然，评估指标为几何重叠度），提出 IoU 感知的特权蒸馏方法 IoUPD。利用真实边界框在训练时作为特权信息，通过冻结教师模型处理边界框标注图像和增强提示，引导学生模型，推理时不需额外模块。在标准指向表达定位基准上，该方法在区域级指标上持续优于强坐标生成基线。
Motivation: 当前坐标生成式视觉定位模型在训练时优化 token 级别坐标文本似然，而评估标准是边界框的几何重叠度（如 IoU），导致训练与评估目标不匹配，影响定位精度。
Method: 提出 IoUPD 框架：学生模型接收原图和提示，冻结教师模型接收边界框标注图像和增强提示；通过有监督微调锚点损失和特权蒸馏损失训练学生，蒸馏损失的 token 权重同时反映几何重要性和教师可靠性；推理时无需边界框叠加、特权提示、教师分支或额外预测模块。
Result: 在标准指向表达定位基准上，IoUPD 在区域级指标上持续优于强坐标生成基线，验证了真实边界框作为特权引导的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文表明真实边界框不仅能作为坐标标签，还能通过特权蒸馏提供有价值的训练引导，提升视觉定位性能，且不增加推理复杂度。

papers.title: Event3R: Asynchronous-to-Global 3D Reconstruction from Event Camera via Spatial-Temporal Feature Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Robust 3D reconstruction is essential for robotics and embodied perception. Recent feed-forward approaches such as DUSt3R have demonstrated impressive progress in dense 3D reconstruction from RGB images, achieving global geometric consistency and strong generalization. However, extending such dense 3D reconstruction to event cameras remains challenging due to their asynchronous, sparse, and highly dynamic nature, as well as the lack of large-scale, well-labeled datasets. In this work, we introduce Event3R, a feed-forward framework that directly maps asynchronous event streams to globally consistent 3D point clouds. Event3R represents incoming events as spatial-temporal voxels, enabling time-aware feature integration through a temporal attention module that enhances the module's temporal feature learning. To further strengthen temporal representation learning and reduce reliance on labeled data, we propose a Masked Bin Modeling (MBM) strategy for self-supervised pre-training, enabling robust temporal representation learning with minimal labeled data, and retain it as an auxiliary fine-tuning objective. In addition, contrastive alignment and consistency regularization losses are incorporated during fine-tuning to reinforce structural correspondence and temporal coherence across views. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that Event3R achieves robust, temporally consistent, and globally aligned 3D reconstructions, significantly outperforming existing event-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Event3R，一个前馈框架，将异步事件流直接映射为全局一致的三维点云。通过时空体素表示、时序注意力模块和掩码箱建模（MBM）自监督预训练，结合对比对齐和一致性正则化损失，在合成和真实基准上实现了鲁棒、时间一致且全局对齐的3D重建，显著优于现有基于事件的方法。
Motivation: 事件相机具有异步、稀疏和高动态特性，且缺乏大规模标注数据集，使得现有基于RGB图像的前馈密集3D重建方法难以直接迁移到事件相机。
Method: 提出Event3D框架：将事件流表示为时空体素，使用时序注意力模块增强时间特征学习；提出掩码箱建模（MBM）策略进行自监督预训练，减少对标注数据依赖；在微调中引入对比对齐和一致性正则化损失以增强结构对应和时间一致性。
Result: 在合成和真实基准上，Event3R实现了鲁棒、时间一致且全局对齐的3D重建，显著优于现有基于事件的方法。
Conclusion: Event3R为事件相机提供了一种无需依赖RGB图像的前馈式密集3D重建方案，通过自监督预训练和时序建模克服了数据稀缺和动态挑战。

papers.title: Natural Backdoor Attacks on Speech Recognition Models
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of deep learning, its vulnerability has gradually emerged in recent years. This work focuses on backdoor attacks on speech recognition systems. We adopt sounds that are ordinary in nature or in our daily life as triggers for natural backdoor attacks. We conduct experiments on two datasets and three models to validate the performance of natural backdoor attacks and explore the effects of poisoning rate, trigger duration and blend ratio on the performance of natural backdoor attacks. Our results show that natural backdoor attacks have a high attack success rate without compromising model performance on benign samples, even with short or low-amplitude triggers. It requires only 5% of poisoned samples to achieve a near 100% attack success rate. In addition, the backdoor will be automatically activated by the corresponding sound in nature, which is not easy to be detected and will bring severer harm.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语音识别系统中的自然后门攻击，使用自然界或日常生活中常见的声音作为触发器。实验表明，仅需5%的毒化样本即可达到近乎100%的攻击成功率，且不损害良性样本性能，即使触发器时间短或幅度低，攻击也能自动被相应自然声音激活，难以检测，危害严重。
Motivation: 深度学习模型存在脆弱性，尤其是后门攻击对语音识别系统构成威胁。现有后门攻击常使用人工设计的触发器，容易被防御机制识别。本文旨在探索使用自然声音作为触发器，实现更隐蔽、更危险的后门攻击。
Method: 本文提出自然后门攻击方法，采用自然界或日常生活中的普通声音作为触发器。在两种数据集和三种模型上进行实验，评估投毒率、触发器持续时间和混合比例对攻击性能的影响。
Result: 自然后门攻击在保持良性样本性能的同时实现高攻击成功率。仅需5%的毒化样本即可达到接近100%的成功率，即使使用短时或低幅度触发器也能有效攻击。
Conclusion: 自然后门攻击利用自然声音作为触发器，难以被检测，且自动由环境声音激活，带来严重安全威胁。该研究揭示了语音识别系统面临的新型安全风险。

papers.title: CardioMeta: Calibrated Multi-Task Prediction of Diabetes, Hypertension, and Cardiovascular Disease Across Population and EHR Data
papers.abstract_en: Cardiometabolic diseases remain among the most persistent drivers of preventable morbidity because diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease frequently co-occur and share metabolic, vascular, demographic, and behavioral determinants. Existing machine learning studies for chronic disease prediction often emphasize discrimination on a single dataset, while underreporting label leakage, calibration, temporal robustness, external transportability, and subgroup reliability. This paper presents CardioMeta, a calibrated multi-task framework for joint prediction of diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease across population survey and electronic health record (EHR) data. The study uses NHANES for population-level model development and temporal validation, and MIMIC-IV for EHR-domain evaluation under substantial distribution shift. To reduce circular label reconstruction, the primary analysis excludes disease-defining variables from the corresponding prediction heads, while a full-clinical feature setting is retained only as sensitivity analysis. CardioMeta combines a shared cardiometabolic encoder with disease-specific gated heads and post-hoc probability calibration. In the leakage-reduced temporal validation setting, the model achieved a macro-AUROC of 0.839, macro-AUPRC of 0.536, macro-F1 of 0.614, and expected calibration error of 0.024, with modest but consistent improvements over strong gradient-boosting and neural tabular baselines. External evaluation on MIMIC-IV showed clear degradation under domain shift, while limited fine-tuning partially recovered performance. The findings indicate that the principal value of multi-task cardiometabolic modeling lies not in inflated accuracy, but in reproducible leakage control, calibrated probabilities, and transparent reliability reporting across heterogeneous healthcare data sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CardioMeta，一个校准的多任务框架，用于联合预测糖尿病、高血压和心血管疾病，使用NHANES和MIMIC-IV数据。在减少标签泄漏的设置下，宏AUROC为0.839，校准误差0.024。外部评估显示域迁移下的性能下降，但微调可部分恢复。
Motivation: 现有模型强调单一数据集上的判别能力，但未充分报告标签泄漏、校准、时间稳健性、外部可迁移性和子组可靠性。
Method: CardioMeta结合共享的心血管代谢编码器、疾病特定门控头和后验概率校准。主要分析排除疾病定义变量以避免循环标签重构。
Result: 在泄漏减少的时间验证中，宏AUROC为0.839，宏AUPRC为0.536，宏F1为0.614，校准误差0.024，优于基线。
Conclusion: 多任务心血管代谢建模的主要价值不在于提高准确率，而在于可重复的泄漏控制、校准概率和跨异构数据源的透明可靠性报告。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Per-Stroke Temporal Control for Text-to-Motion via Action Units and Action-Detection Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion models are competent at the action a prompt names but unreliable at when each stroke lands: four punches alternating left and right rarely return four separable strokes. We introduce typed temporal events called Action Units (AUs) that make the individual stroke -- its body track, action class, time window, and impact timing -- an explicit conditioning signal. We ground a frozen text-to-motion backbone on the AU set through a lightweight gated adapter injecting two streams (per-stroke tokens and a per-frame phase channel), and at inference close residual timing errors with a training-free classifier gradient from a frozen frame-level detector. We measure per-stroke control on StrokeBench, whose prompts specify count, ordering, track, and core-frame placement, paired with an audited stroke corpus. AU grounding markedly raises the rate of correctly placed single strokes over the strongest prior interface, at the best motion quality among text-, interval-, and frame-level baselines. The prompted core frame emerges as a further steerable axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将动作单元（Action Units, AUs）作为显式条件信号，用于文本到运动生成中的逐拍时间控制。通过轻量级门控适配器将冻结的文本到运动主干网络与AU集合结合，并在推理时使用无训练的分类器梯度来修正时间误差。在StrokeBench上测试，AU grounding显著提高了单动作的正确放置率，并达到了最佳的生成质量。
Motivation: 现有文本到运动模型能根据提示生成动作，但无法精确控制每个动作的时间点（如左右交替出拳的四个单独动作），导致时间控制不可靠。
Method: 引入动作单元（AU）作为显式时间事件，包含身体轨迹、动作类别、时间窗口和冲击时间。通过轻量级门控适配器注入双流（逐拍token和逐帧相位通道）到冻结的主干网络中，并在推理时使用冻结的逐帧检测器的分类器梯度进行无训练的时间误差修正。
Result: 在StrokeBench上，AU grounding相比最强的先前接口显著提高了单动作的正确放置率，并且在文本级、间隔级和帧级基线中达到了最佳的运动质量。
Conclusion: 提示的核心帧可以作为一个额外的可调节轴。方法有效提升了逐拍时间控制能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Behavioral Controllability of Agentic Models for Information Extraction: From Fixed Workflows to Reflective Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for complex information-extraction tasks, yet it remains unclear whether agentic components such as reflection and memory lead to observable and controllable improvements over fixed LLM workflows. We study this question through conference-paper dataset extraction, where a system must identify datasets mentioned in scholarly PDFs and produce structured records. We compare a fixed workflow baseline with reflective agent variants and specify an optimized agent condition (S2) that extends the same task with richer PDF tools and dynamic tool selection. Our evaluation emphasizes process-level behavior--including tool execution, retries, reflection, memory use, runtime, and failure recovery--while treating extraction coverage and field completeness as secondary outcome measures. The paper characterizes when agentic mechanisms change system behavior, whether these changes improve task completion, and how the observed failure modes motivate an optimized agent design under the same evaluation harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型代理在信息抽取任务中的行为可控性，通过会议论文数据集抽取实验，比较固定工作流与反思型代理变体，并评估行为级指标如工具执行、重试、反思、内存使用等。
Motivation: 尽管LLM代理越来越多用于复杂信息抽取，但代理组件（如反思和记忆）是否带来可观察和可控的改进尚不明确。
Method: 基于会议论文数据集，设计固定工作流基线、反思型代理变体及优化代理条件（S2），使用更丰富的PDF工具和动态工具选择，评估过程级行为和抽取覆盖率。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但强调过程级行为评估和失败模式分析，并指出优化代理设计。
Conclusion: 论文定性说明代理机制何时改变系统行为、是否改进任务完成，以及失败模式如何驱动优化设计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Map as a Prompt: Learning Multi-Modal Spatial-Signal Foundation Models for Cross-scenario Wireless Localization
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and robust wireless localization is a critical enabler for emerging 5G/6G applications, including autonomous driving, extended reality, and smart manufacturing. Despite its importance, achieving precise localization across diverse environments remains challenging due to the complex nature of wireless signals and their sensitivity to environmental changes. Existing data-driven approaches often suffer from limited generalization capability, requiring extensive labeled data and struggling to adapt to new scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose SigMap, a multimodal foundation model that introduces two key innovations: (1) A cycle-adaptive masking strategy that dynamically adjusts masking patterns based on channel periodicity characteristics to learn robust wireless representations; (2) A novel "map-as-prompt" framework that integrates 3D geographic information through lightweight soft prompts for effective cross-scenario adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple localization tasks while exhibiting strong zero-shot generalization in unseen environments, significantly outperforming both supervised and self-supervised baselines by considerable margins.
papers.comment: 17pages, 9 figures, poster in International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SigMap，一种用于跨场景无线定位的多模态基础模型，包含周期自适应掩码策略和“地图即提示”框架。实验表明在多种定位任务上达到最先进性能，并在未见环境中展现强零样本泛化能力，显著优于有监督和自监督基线。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动无线定位方法泛化能力有限，需要大量标注数据，且难以适应新场景。
Method: 提出周期自适应掩码（cycle-adaptive masking）利用信道周期性学习鲁棒表示，以及“地图即提示”框架通过轻量软提示整合3D地理信息实现跨场景适应。
Result: 在多个定位任务上取得最先进性能，并在未见环境中零样本泛化显著优于有监督和自监督基线。
Conclusion: SigMap 有效提升跨场景无线定位的泛化能力，尤其零样本泛化表现突出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Difficulty-Aware Dynamic Routing for Diffusion-Based Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based methods have achieved impressive performance in real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) by leveraging large pre-trained stable diffusion (SD) models as powerful generative priors. However, these methods still face two key limitations. First, existing SD-based one-step and multi-step Real-ISR approaches adopt a unified processing paradigm for all input samples, ignoring the varying restoration difficulty across images. Second, the aggressive resolution reduction of the VAE in SD models (e.g., 8x downsampling) leads to irreversible loss of fine-scale details, which cannot be recovered by the subsequent diffusion process. To address these limitations, we propose a Difficulty-aware Dynamic Routing (DDR) strategy that overcomes the rigid, one-size-fits-all processing paradigm. Specifically, we first design a difficulty estimator to predict the restoration cost of each input image, enabling automatic assignment to a network of appropriate capacity. Then, we construct a set of Real-ISR networks with varying model capacities by modulating the spatial downsampling ratio of the VAE in the SD backbone, thereby preserving more high-frequency information for challenging cases while maintaining efficiency for simpler inputs. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the superior efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed model compared to recent state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出难度感知动态路由（DDR）策略，解决扩散模型在真实图像超分辨率中统一处理所有样本、忽略难度差异以及VAE下采样导致细节丢失的问题。通过难度估计器分配不同容量网络，并调节SD中VAE的空间下采样率以保留高频信息。实验表明在效率和效果上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散超分辨率方法对所有输入采用统一处理，忽略图像恢复难度的差异；同时SD中VAE的激进下采样导致不可逆的细节丢失。
Method: 设计难度估计器预测每张图像的恢复成本，自动分配适当容量的网络；通过调节SD骨干中VAE的空间下采样率构建不同容量的Real-ISR网络，在困难样本中保留更多高频信息，简单样本保持高效。
Result: 实验证明所提模型在效率和效果上均优于近期最先进方法。
Conclusion: 动态路由策略有效打破了扩散超分辨率中刚性统一处理的局限，兼顾质量与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Benchmark for Electrical Load Forecasting Across Grid Levels: Time-Series Transformers Outperform Established Methods
papers.abstract_en: Accurate load forecasting at multiple grid levels is essential for future smart grids, ranging from aggregated control area forecasts for balancing supply and demand to forecasts of individual end-consumer loads for demand-side management and energy management systems. We present a comprehensive benchmark for load forecasting across grid levels, comprising three datasets that represent a transmission system operator control area, low-voltage grid feeders, and individual end consumers. We evaluate ten methods for short-term load forecasting and find that Transformer-based approaches consistently outperform established methods, reducing forecast error by 6.6-10.7 %. To analyze the impact of architectural design, we introduce YAformer, a flexible Transformer architecture that integrates modifications from prior work and is optimized via hyperparameter optimization. However, the standard Transformer achieves superior performance, suggesting that these architectural modifications are not required for accurate load forecasting. We further evaluate the Transformer-based time-series foundation model Chronos-2, which demonstrates competitive zero-shot performance on two datasets but fails to accurately capture special events in the TSO data. Detailed analyses reveal model-specific strengths and weaknesses, and ablation studies highlight the importance of long input contexts, covariates and continuous retraining - aspects that are often overlooked in the time-series forecasting literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向多电网层级（输电系统运营商控制区域、低压电网馈线、终端用户）的短期电力负荷预测基准，包含三个数据集。评估了十种方法，发现基于Transformer的方法一致优于传统方法，将预测误差降低了6.6-10.7%。作者还介绍了YAformer架构，但标准Transformer表现更好。此外，时间序列基础模型Chronos-2在零样本场景下表现有竞争力，但在处理TSO数据的特殊事件时失败。消融研究强调了长输入上下文、协变量和持续重训练的重要性。
Motivation: 准确的跨电网层级负荷预测对未来智能电网至关重要，现有方法缺乏统一的跨层级基准比较。
Method: 构建包含三个不同电网层级数据集的基准，评估十种短期负荷预测方法，包括标准Transformer、YAformer（集成前期改进的灵活架构）和时间序列基础模型Chronos-2。
Result: Transformer方法较传统方法降低6.6-10.7%的预测误差；标准Transformer优于YAformer；Chronos-2在零样本下对两个数据集有竞争力，但无法准确捕捉TSO数据的特殊事件。
Conclusion: 基准表明Transformer在负荷预测中优于传统方法，且标准架构已足够；未来工作应关注长输入上下文、协变量和持续重训练。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Statistical Formulation Gap for Nonlinear Multiscale Physics-Informed Learning
papers.abstract_en: We prove a finite-sample formulation gap for physics-informed learning of nonlinear multiscale elliptic equations. For a uniformly monotone divergence-form class with coefficients oscillating at scale $ε$, we derive a finite-width, finite-sample, and finite-iteration error bound for a boundary-compatible variational neural solver. Its stability, sampling, and optimization constants are independent of $ε$, while all unresolved scale dependence is isolated in the best-approximation error. We then construct a minimal obstruction witness for a one-dimensional periodic diffusion equation with cubic reaction. Already on the one-parameter family $v_c(x)=cx(1-x)$, the empirical Rademacher complexity of the strong residual is bounded below by a constant multiple of $(ε\sqrt{N})^{-1}$, while that of the squared strong-residual loss is bounded below by a constant multiple of $(ε^2\sqrt{N})^{-1}$. These are optimizer-independent properties of the sampled residual and loss classes, rather than neural-tangent-kernel conditioning statements. The corresponding variational energy complexity is bounded above by a constant multiple of $N^{-1/2}$ uniformly in $ε$. A tensor-product construction shows that the same obstruction rates persist in every spatial dimension. Numerical evaluation gives fitted exponents $0.9971$, $1.9860$, and $-0.0028$ for the strong residual, squared strong loss, and variational energy, respectively. Thus, differentiating the microscopic coefficient creates finite-sample statistical ill-conditioning. The variational formulation removes this statistical penalty but does not remove the separate multiscale approximation problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了非线性多尺度椭圆方程物理信息学习的有限样本公式差距。对于均匀单调散度形式类，系数在ε尺度振荡，推导了边界相容变分神经求解器的有限宽度、有限样本和有限迭代误差界。稳定性和优化常数与ε无关，未解决的尺度依赖性孤立在最佳逼近误差中。对于一维周期扩散方程，证明了强残差的经验Rademacher复杂度下界为常数乘以(ε√N)^{-1}，平方强残差损失下界为常数乘以(ε^2√N)^{-1}。变分能量复杂度上界为常数乘以N^{-1/2}且与ε一致。数值结果拟合指数分别为0.9971, 1.9860, -0.0028。得出结论：微观系数求导导致有限样本统计病态；变分公式消除了统计惩罚但不消除多尺度逼近问题。
Motivation: 物理信息学习中非线性多尺度问题存在公式差距（formulation gap），需要理论分析不同损失函数（强残差 vs 变分能量）的统计复杂度和采样效率。
Method: 采用变分神经求解器，推导有限样本误差界，利用Rademacher复杂度分析强残差、平方强残差损失和变分能量复杂度的下界和上界。
Result: 强残差和平方强残差损失的样本复杂度与ε成反比（指数≈1和2），而变分能量复杂度与ε无关且为N^{-1/2}。数值拟合验证理论预测。
Conclusion: 变分公式避免了由于微观系数导数引起的统计病态，但无法解决多尺度逼近问题本身。

papers.title: GoStop: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Temporal Aggregation in Event-Based Feature Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Feature tracking plays a fundamental role in understanding scene motion and supports various downstream tasks. Event cameras, with their high temporal resolution and asynchronous sensing, enable low-latency and motion-robust perception, making them well-suited for feature tracking under fast and non-linear motion. However, existing event-based feature tracking methods rely on fixed heuristic rules based on hand-tuning for event accumulation. Such strategies fail to adapt to diverse motion dynamics, leading to degraded performance under abrupt motion changes or low-motion scenarios. In this paper, we model event accumulation as a sequential decision-making problem and introduce reinforcement learning (RL) framework to adaptively control the accumulation process for online event-based feature tracking. Our approach trains a RL agent that decides whether to continue accumulating events or to perform tracking inference based on motion cues. The proposed adaptive temporal agent enables dynamic adaptation to varying motion patterns without relying on hand-crafted rules. Furthermore, we introduce a Dynamic Event-based Tracking (DEFT) dataset with dynamic motion distributions to evaluate the robustness of the feature tracking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that integrating our plug-and-play framework to existing feature tracking methods consistently outperforms heuristic-based approaches, improving robustness under dynamic motion while offering a better balance between tracking accuracy and efficiency. Our project codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/kmax2001/GoSTOP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习（RL）的自适应事件累积框架 GoStop，用于事件相机特征跟踪。将事件累积建模为序贯决策问题，训练RL代理根据运动线索决定继续累积还是执行跟踪，从而动态适应不同运动模式。作者还引入动态事件跟踪数据集DEFT评估鲁棒性。实验表明该即插即用框架一致优于手工启发式方法，在动态运动中提升鲁棒性并平衡精度与效率。
Motivation: 现有事件相机特征跟踪方法依赖固定启发式规则进行事件累积，无法适应多样化的运动动态，在突然运动变化或低运动场景下性能下降。
Method: 将事件累积过程建模为序贯决策问题，使用强化学习训练一个代理，该代理根据运动线索决定是继续累积事件还是执行跟踪推理，实现无需手工规则的自适应时间聚合。
Result: 在动态运动数据集DEFT上，将所提框架集成到现有特征跟踪方法中，一致优于基于启发式的基线方法，在动态运动中提升鲁棒性，同时更好平衡跟踪精度与效率。
Conclusion: 自适应时间聚合可有效替代手工规则，提升事件相机特征跟踪在复杂运动场景下的适应性和性能。

papers.title: Hierarchical Specialised Ensembles for Classification of Zebrafish Phenotypes Using the Selected Image Recognition Methods
papers.abstract_en: We propose and evaluate three hierarchical ensemble setups for zebrafish phenotype classification from embryo images. In all setups, stage 1 uses a single four-class classifier to assign images to one of the exclusive phenotypes: Normal, Chorion, Dead, or Other. Images classified as Other are then processed in stage 2, where the ensemble design differs across setups: a single multi-label classifier, two specialized multi-label classifiers, or an ensemble of binary classifiers. We compare these setups using three backbone architectures: ResNet18, ViT, and ConvNeXt. Overall, ConvNeXt achieves the best performance across setups, while the specialized hierarchical ensemble in setup 2 provides the best balance in terms of F1-score. The results show that the proposed specialised hierarchical ensembles are effective for zebrafish phenotype recognition, and suggest that ConvNeXt is particularly useful backbone model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并评估三种层次化集成设置，用于斑马鱼胚胎图像的表型分类。第一阶段使用单一四类分类器将图像分为正常、绒毛膜、死亡或其他；第二阶段对标记为其他的图像采用不同的集成设计。使用ResNet18、ViT和ConvNeXt三种骨干架构比较，ConvNeXt在所有设置中表现最好，而设置2的专用层次化集成在F1分数上达到最佳平衡。结果表明专用层次化集成对斑马鱼表型识别有效，且ConvNeXt是特别有用的骨干模型。
Motivation: 斑马鱼表型分类在生物学研究中重要，但现有方法可能不够精确或鲁棒，需要更有效的分类策略。
Method: 提出三种层次化集成设置：设置1使用单一多标签分类器，设置2使用两个专用多标签分类器，设置3使用二进制分类器集成。所有设置第一阶段共享一个四类分类器。
Result: ConvNeXt在所有设置中性能最佳；设置2的专用层次化集成在F1分数上平衡最好。
Conclusion: 专用层次化集成对斑马鱼表型识别有效，ConvNeXt是推荐骨干模型。

papers.title: SpeechGuard: Online Defense against Backdoor Attacks on Speech Recognition Models
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks pose a critical threat to neural network models, allowing attackers to implant a backdoor during the training phase by manipulating a small portion of the training data. In security-sensitive applications such as voice interaction for autonomous driving, the presence of backdoor attacks introduces substantial security risks. This study focuses on implementing backdoor defense measures for speech recognition models in run-time, taking into account the characteristics of audio signals. We propose SpeechGuard, the first online backdoor defense pipeline designed to identify and purify poisoned audio samples. Specifically, we improve STRIP method to perform adaptive perturbation injection to detect and filter poisoned samples, named as S-STRIP. More importantly, we further consider the purification of poisoned samples. We utilize time-frequency (T-F) masking to suppress the expression of trigger signals and autonomously generate masks based on an autoencoder. The two-stage processing prevents the backdoor in the model from being triggered, and even input speech carrying triggers can be accurately predicted. Extensive experimental demonstrate that SpeechGuard can accurately filter out poisoned samples. Through purification, it can significantly mitigate the backdoor threat while maintaining a certain prediction accuracy.
papers.journal_ref: 2024 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN), pp. 1-8, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpeechGuard，首个针对语音识别模型的在线后门防御流水线，通过两阶段处理（S-STRIP自适应扰动注入检测和基于自编码器的时频掩码净化）来识别并净化带有后门触发的音频样本。实验表明该方法能有效过滤毒化样本并保持预测精度。
Motivation: 后门攻击对语音识别模型构成严重安全威胁，尤其是在自动驾驶等安全敏感场景中，现有防御缺乏针对音频信号的在线运行时防御机制。
Method: 提出SpeechGuard在线防御流水线：第一阶段改进STRIP方法为S-STRIP，通过自适应扰动注入检测毒化样本；第二阶段利用自编码器自动生成时频掩码，抑制触发信号表达，实现毒化样本的净化。
Result: 大量实验表明SpeechGuard能准确过滤毒化样本，并通过净化显著减轻后门威胁，同时保持一定的预测精度。
Conclusion: SpeechGuard作为首个在线后门防御方案，有效兼顾了毒化样本的检测与净化，适用于实时语音识别场景。

papers.title: Toward a mechanistic understanding of inference in visual cortex and diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: We describe a model of perceptual inference in primary visual cortex (V1) equivalent to a minimal diffusion model whose function can be readily understood from its parameters. The model is based on sparse coding with a non-factorial prior over latent variables in the form of an unconstrained, pairwise interaction matrix, extending standard sparse coding inference to a general recurrent dynamical system. We efficiently train these recurrent dynamics using a denoising score-matching objective and implicit differentiation. After training on natural images, the learned interaction matrix mirrors the structure of horizontal connections in superficial layers of V1 that link neurons of similar orientation tuning. This model exhibits exceptionally good denoising performance, restoring image features such as extended contours amid extreme visual ambiguity, nearly matching the behavior of standard, black-box diffusion architectures in generalization regime. Owing to the model's simplicity, the network's Jacobian can be decomposed directly in terms of the interaction matrix between latent variables, revealing mechanistically how the recurrent dynamics assign high probability over a continuous family of natural structural deformations. Intriguingly, within this circuit, a large fraction of latent variables learn to disconnect from visual input altogether, essentially forming a hierarchical representation that appears to enforce global consistency among image features. Together, the model and results bridge two distinct domains: for neuroscience, it generates concrete, testable hypotheses regarding functional connectivity in recurrent neural circuits during perceptual inference tasks; for machine learning, it elucidates the internal mechanisms learned by diffusion models that allow them to generate infinitely many novel images from a finite training set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个等效于最小扩散模型的原视觉皮层（V1）感知推理模型，基于稀疏编码和成对相互作用矩阵的非因子先验，通过去噪分数匹配和隐式微分训练。在自然图像上训练后，学习到的相互作用矩阵反映了V1浅层水平连接的结构。该模型在去噪性能上接近标准黑盒扩散架构，并能通过雅可比矩阵分解揭示递归动力学如何赋予自然结构变形以高概率。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在生成能力上表现出色，但其内部机制尚不明确；同时，视觉皮层的感知推理机制也有待深入理解。本文旨在通过一个简化的模型桥接这两个领域，为两者提供可解释的机制。
Method: 将稀疏编码扩展为具有成对相互作用矩阵的非因子先验，形成递归动力学系统，并使用去噪分数匹配目标（denoising score-matching objective）和隐式微分（implicit differentiation）高效训练该递归模型。
Result: 模型在自然图像上学习到的相互作用矩阵与V1浅层水平连接结构一致；去噪性能优异，能在严重视觉模糊下恢复延伸轮廓等特征，泛化行为接近标准黑盒扩散模型。此外，模型雅可比矩阵可分解为相互作用矩阵，揭示了递归动力学如何为连续自然结构变形赋予高概率。
Conclusion: 该模型为神经科学提供了关于感知推理中递归神经回路功能连接的具体可检验假设，为机器学习揭示了扩散模型内部学习到的机制，使其能通过有限训练集生成无限多样图像。

papers.title: Efficient Frame Selection for Long Videos at Test Time with Attention-Based MLLM Selectors
papers.abstract_en: Understanding long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires selecting a compact set of frames from thousands of candidates, yet identifying the right frames seemingly requires understanding the video first. We resolve this circular dependency with a simple observation: cross-modal attention at validation-selected extraction layers in MLLMs already provides query-relevant frame evidence without requiring autoregressive generation. We exploit this property to build DAFS (Dynamic Attention-based Budget-aware Frame Selection), a training-free frame selector. A lightweight MLLM selector, even with only 2B parameters, can extract frame-level evidence by converting selected-layer attention into relevance scores through query-conditioned aggregation. This enables cross-frame comparison without autoregressive decoding. To handle the selector's own context constraint, we formulate the joint allocation of candidate pool size and per-frame token budget as a discrete optimization problem solved by dynamic programming. Under a 32-frame budget, our selector improves over uniform sampling by up to 6.4 points on Video-MME and outperforms prior training-based selectors under matched frame budgets, while generalizing across selector and answerer backbones, and across tasks, without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAFS（Dynamic Attention-based Budget-aware Frame Selection），一种无需训练的帧选择方法，利用MLLM中验证选定的提取层的交叉注意力，将注意力转化为帧级相关性分数，通过动态规划优化候选池大小和每帧令牌预算，在32帧预算下比均匀采样提升最多6.4分，并超越先前基于训练的选择器。
Motivation: 长视频理解需要从大量候选帧中选取紧凑子集，但识别正确帧似乎需要先理解视频。现有方法存在循环依赖或需训练。
Method: DAFS：使用轻量级MLLM（如2B参数）作为选择器，提取验证层注意力，通过查询条件聚合得到帧级相关性分数，无需自回归解码；并将候选池大小和每帧令牌预算的联合分配建模为离散优化问题，用动态规划求解。
Result: 在32帧预算下，DAFS在Video-MME上比均匀采样提升6.4分，且在不重新训练的情况下泛化到不同选择器、回答器骨干和任务。
Conclusion: 利用MLLM已有的交叉注意力可高效实现训练无关的帧选择，并可通过预算分配进一步优化性能。

papers.title: Toward Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Models: A Topology-Aware Multimodal Alignment Framework
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), whose nodes carry modalities such as images and text alongside topological structure, now pervade applications including social platforms, e-commerce, and biomedical networks, offering richer semantic signals than single-modality graphs. In practice, such graphs are fragmented across privacy-restricted silos owned by different platforms and institutions, so learning a broadly transferable model over them demands collaborative training that never exposes raw data. This places the task at the intersection of multimodal graph learning and federated learning, yet existing methods cover only one side of it. To address the challenges from these two perspectives, we propose FedGAMMA, casting federated multimodal graph foundation learning as a two-stage semantic-structural alignment problem of federated pre-training and prompt-based fine-tuning. During pre-training, a shared-private semantic enhancer disentangles cross-modal commonality from modality-specific information, aligning it through optimal transport, a topology-aware graph fusion module decouples semantic and structural views via semantic residual graphs and dual positional encodings, and a dual-channel affinity-aware aggregation mechanism estimates client similarity from feature and graph centroids without exposing raw data. During fine-tuning, FedGAMMA adapts the pretrained encoder through lightweight graph-aware prompts, a shared prompt pool with controlled exploration, and channel-wise prompt synchronization. Experiments on twelve multimodal graph datasets show FedGAMMA consistently surpassing a broad range of baselines across downstream tasks, with gains of up to 12.96%. FedGAMMA further outperforms competitive baselines accross multi-domain datasets on multiple tasks with up to 5.71% under few-shot learning scenario.

TL;DR: 本文提出FedGAMMA，一个面向联邦多模态图基础模型的拓扑感知多模态对齐框架。该框架采用两阶段语义-结构对齐：预训练阶段通过共享-私有语义增强器、拓扑感知图融合模块和双通道亲和力感知聚合机制；微调阶段通过轻量级图感知提示（prompt）和提示池同步。在12个多模态图数据集上，FedGAMMA在多项下游任务中一致超越基线，最高提升12.96%，少样本场景下提升5.71%。
Motivation: 实际中的多模态属性图（MAGs）分布在多个隐私受限的数据孤岛中，现有方法仅关注多模态图学习或联邦学习之一，未能同时解决两种挑战。需要一种联邦多模态图基础模型框架，实现无需暴露原始数据的协作训练。

Result: 在12个多模态图数据集上，FedGAMMA在多项下游任务中一致超越基线，最高提升12.96%。在少样本学习场景下，跨多领域数据集上多个任务提升达5.71%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明FedGAMMA有效解决了联邦多模态图学习中的语义-结构对齐挑战，实验结果证明了其优越性，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: S1-Omni: A Unified Multimodal Reasoning Model for Scientific Understanding, Prediction, and Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present S1-Omni, a unified multimodal reasoning model for scientific understanding, prediction, and generation. AI for Science (AI4S) has advanced significantly through domain-specific models, tool-augmented LLMs, and scientific language models. However, model capabilities remain highly fragmented, limiting the joint modeling of heterogeneous data, scientific laws, and expert knowledge. S1-Omni addresses this gap by consolidating these capabilities into a single, coherent scientific reasoning model. The architecture of S1-Omni is built upon three core components: unified representation of scientific data, natural-world knowledge alignment, and decoding for domain-specific tasks. First, S1-Omni maps natural-language instructions and scientific objects, including CIF, SMILES, protein sequences, spectra, and scientific images, into a shared representation space. Second, it incorporates scientific laws and expert knowledge into data construction and training, enabling the model to reason from scientific evidence. Third, it performs task-specific decoding to support a broad range of applications, including property prediction, spectrum-to-molecular generation, protein site and structure prediction, and scientific image generation and editing. S1-Omni is trained on S1-Omni-Corpus, which covers 200 scientific tasks and contains millions of reasoning samples, and is evaluated on over 60 scientific benchmarks. It outperforms GPT-5.5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro on most benchmarks and matches or surpasses domain-specific models on several benchmarks. Overall, S1-Omni provides a practical path toward unified scientific modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S1-Omni 是一个统一的科学多模态推理模型，将科学数据（CIF、SMILES、蛋白质序列、光谱、科学图像）映射到共享表示空间，结合科学定律和专家知识，支持预测、生成和编辑等多种科学任务。在 200 个科学任务的 S1-Omni-Corpus 上训练，在 60 多个科学基准上评估，性能优于 GPT-5.5 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro，并匹配或超越领域专用模型。
Motivation: 现有 AI for Science 模型能力高度碎片化，缺乏对异构数据、科学定律和专家知识的联合建模，限制了对科学问题的统一推理。
Method: 提出三组件架构：统一科学数据表示（将自然语言指令与 CIF、SMILES、蛋白质序列、光谱、图像等映射到共享空间）、自然世界知识对齐（在数据构建和训练中融入科学定律与专家知识）、领域特定任务解码（支持性质预测、光谱到分子生成、蛋白质位点与结构预测、科学图像生成与编辑）。
Result: 在 60 多个科学基准上评估，S1-Omni 在大多数基准上超越 GPT-5.5 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro，并在若干基准上匹配或超越领域专用模型。
Conclusion: S1-Omni 为统一的科学建模提供了一条实用路径，整合了理解、预测和生成能力。

papers.title: Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for Corrected Boltzmann Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from an unnormalized Boltzmann density requires proposals that move probability mass globally while retaining enough path-probability information for statistical correction. We introduce Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (NHMC), a train-then-correct learned Hamiltonian sampler. Starting from a tractable base distribution, NHMC learns stochastic Hamiltonian-style paths toward the target. Once training is complete, the learned proposal parameters are fixed; the proposal then generates complete paths and endpoint configurations, which are statistically corrected using the recorded non-equilibrium work. This dimensionless generalized work is determined by the probability ratio between the forward proposal path and a reverse reference path. During training, minimizing its mean reduces a path-space KL divergence and controls an upper bound on endpoint mismatch. During evaluation, the same quantity defines weights for self-normalized importance sampling on paths (path-SNIS), estimates normalizing constants or free-energy differences, and gives the acceptance ratio for path-space independent Metropolis-Hastings (path-IMH). The same forward-reverse laws also define a shared-bridge round-trip Metropolis kernel that acts directly on configurations and preserves the Boltzmann target. On double-well and finite-volume lattice $φ^4$ targets, the NHMC construction gives corrected estimates when path overlap is sufficient; when overlap is poor, weight degeneracy, low acceptance, and long autocorrelation expose proposal failure. We additionally report a molecular internal-coordinate feasibility study using an MD prior and learned-force path proposal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经非平衡哈密顿蒙特卡洛 (NHMC) 方法，通过学习随机哈密顿路径对未归一化的玻尔兹曼密度进行采样，并通过记录的非平衡功进行统计校正。该方法在双阱势和有限体积格点φ⁴场论目标上验证了有效性，能够估计归一化常数和自由能差异。
Motivation: 从未归一化分布采样时，传统方法需要全局移动且保留路径概率信息。当前方法在复杂多峰分布上存在效率问题，需要一种可训练且可校正的采样方案。
Method: NHMC 从可处理基分布出发，学习随机哈密顿路径向目标分布；训练后固定提议参数，通过前向与反向路径概率比定义广义非平衡功，用于路径空间自归一化重要性采样 (path-SNIS) 和路径空间独立 Metropolis-Hastings (path-IMH)，并引入共享桥往返 Metropolis 核。
Result: 在双阱势和有限体积格点φ⁴模型上，当路径重叠足够时，NHMC 给出校正估计；路径重叠不足时，权重退化、接受率低和长自相关暴露了提议失败。还报告了分子内坐标的可行性研究。
Conclusion: NHMC 通过训练-校正框架实现了对玻尔兹曼密度的修正采样，但其性能依赖于路径重叠，存在重要性采样退化的局限性。

papers.title: Green-Roof Energy Performance in New Zealand's Present and Future Climate Condition (2050)
papers.abstract_en: Green roofs are increasingly promoted as nature-based measures for reducing building energy demand, yet their performance in New Zealand's oceanic climates and under future weather remains insufficiently quantified. This condensed study compares an extensive green roof with a conventional bare roof on a standardized single-storey dwelling in Auckland, Christchurch, and Wellington. Dynamic annual simulations were conducted in DesignBuilder/EnergyPlus using present-day EnergyPlus Weather files and 2050 weather files generated with CCWorldWeatherGen. All non-roof building parameters were held constant so that differences in total fuel consumption (TFC) for heating and cooling could be attributed to the roof system. Under present weather, annual TFC decreased by approximately 3.1% in Auckland, 2.3% in Christchurch, and 1.5% in Wellington. Under 2050 weather, the corresponding reductions were 3.3%, 2.6%, and 1.1%. Summer benefits were larger in Auckland and Christchurch, reaching about 9.0% and 5.6%, respectively, in 2050, but remained marginal in Wellington. The findings show that green roofs can provide modest annual energy savings in oceanic climates, with stronger value as a summer heat-mitigation measure in warmer locations. Performance is strongly climate-dependent and should not be generalized without local simulation or field validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过DesignBuilder/EnergyPlus模拟，比较了新西兰奥克兰、基督城和惠灵顿三个城市当前及2050年气候条件下绿色屋顶与普通屋顶对单层住宅总燃料消耗（TFC）的影响。当前气候下，年TFC降低约1.5%-3.1%；2050年气候下降幅为1.1%-3.3%。夏季冷却效益在温暖地区（如奥克兰和基督城）更显著，分别达9.0%和5.6%，但在惠灵顿不明显。研究强调绿色屋顶的节能效果高度依赖当地气候，需通过本地模拟验证。
Motivation: 绿色屋顶作为自然解决方案可降低建筑能耗，但在新西兰海洋性气候及未来气候条件下的量化性能数据不足。
Method: 采用DesignBuilder/EnergyPlus对标准化单层住宅进行动态年模拟，使用当前EnergyPlus天气文件和CCWorldWeatherGen生成的2050年天气文件，保持非屋顶参数不变，通过总燃料消耗差异评估绿色屋顶效果。
Result: 当前气候下年TFC降幅：奥克兰3.1%，基督城2.3%，惠灵顿1.5%；2050年降幅：奥克兰3.3%，基督城2.6%，惠灵顿1.1%。夏季冷却效益在奥克兰和基督城分别达9.0%和5.6%，惠灵顿仅边际。
Conclusion: 绿色屋顶在海洋性气候下能提供适度的年节能，尤其在温暖地区夏季热缓解方面更有价值，但性能受气候强烈影响，不可不加验证地推广。

papers.title: PE-Field 4D: Video Generation Models as Canvas
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers have recently achieved strong performance in video generation, yet controlling scene geometry under viewpoint changes and camera motion remains challenging. In this work, we revisit the role of positional encoding in video diffusion transformers and show that it provides a useful spatial bias for geometry-aware control. Specifically, if reference tokens are encoded according to their projected locations in the target view, the denoising model is encouraged to retrieve content from position aligned regions of the input video. Building on this observation, we introduce a geometry-aware cross-attention mechanism that enables target video latent tokens to attend to structured context tokens derived from reference images or frames. To establish correspondence between the reference content and the target camera trajectory, we equip the context tokens with a projected positional encoding scheme that combines target-view 2D reprojection with depth-aware disambiguation. At the same time, we preserve the original spatiotemporal positional encoding of the generated video latent, allowing geometric guidance to be injected while maintaining consistency with the video model's native latent structure. The resulting framework provides a simple and effective approach for controllable video generation. It improves spatial controllability in viewpoint-dependent editing tasks, including camera re-trajectory, novel-view video synthesis, and geometry-aware video editing, while preserving the generative prior of the underlying video diffusion model. The code is available at: https://github.com/MTLab/PE-Field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于位置编码的几何感知交叉注意力机制，用于可控视频生成，支持视角相关编辑任务。通过将参考token按其在目标视图中的投影位置进行编码，并结合深度感知消歧，使去噪模型能够从输入视频中位置对齐的区域检索内容。该方法在相机重轨迹、新视角视频合成和几何感知视频编辑等任务中提升了空间可控性。
Motivation: 现有扩散Transformer在视频生成中难以控制场景几何以适应视角变化和相机运动，缺乏有效的几何感知控制机制。
Method: 引入几何感知交叉注意力机制，为目标视频潜在token提供结构化上下文token，通过结合目标视图2D重投影和深度感知消歧的投影位置编码方案建立对应关系，同时保留原始时空位置编码以保证一致性。
Result: 在相机重轨迹、新视角视频合成和几何感知视频编辑等视角依赖编辑任务中改善了空间可控性，且保留了视频扩散模型的生成先验。
Conclusion: 该方法简单有效，通过注入几何引导而不干扰视频模型的原生潜在结构，为可控视频生成提供了可行的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model Merging for Medical LVLMs: A Benchmark and a Winner-Take-All Approach
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can be adapted to specialized medical imaging tasks via parameter-efficient fine-tuning approaches such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA), leading to a growing ecosystem of expert models tailored to specific imaging modalities and clinical scenarios. However, deploying multiple expert LVLMs in practice incurs substantial computational and operational overhead. Model merging provides a promising solution by consolidating multiple experts into a single model without retraining, yet it remains largely unexplored in the medical domain. In this work, we present the first systematic study of model merging for medical LVLMs. We introduce MergeMedBench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning eight imaging modalities and diverse clinical task types, comprising 16 LoRA fine-tuned models built upon two mainstream architectures. We conduct an extensive evaluation of existing merging methods and further propose winner-take-all, a simple and hyperparameter-free approach that retains only the most dominant parameters across expert models. By preserving the critical parameters that govern model behavior and discarding weaker ones, our method avoids the information dilution inherent in averaging- or alignment-based strategies. Despite its simplicity, winner-take-all consistently outperforms existing approaches, offering both a new perspective on LoRA merging and a strong practical baseline for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究医学大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的模型合并问题，提出了MergeMedBench基准，涵盖8种成像模态和16个LoRA微调模型。并提出了winner-take-all方法，一种无超参数的合并策略，通过保留各专家模型中的主导参数、丢弃弱参数，避免信息稀释，在多个任务上超越现有合并方法。
Motivation: 医学LVLM通过LoRA微调产生了大量针对特定模态和临床场景的专家模型，但实际部署多个专家模型计算开销大。模型合并有望将多个专家合并为单一模型而无需重训练，但在医学领域尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出Winner-Take-All合并方法：对于每个参数位置，从所有专家模型中选择数值最大的参数（即最主导的参数）保留，其余丢弃。该方法无需超参数，避免了平均或对齐策略导致的信息稀释。同时构建了包含16个LoRA微调模型和8种成像模态的MergeMedBench基准。
Result: 在MergeMedBench上，winner-take-all方法在多个医学成像任务上一致优于现有的模型合并方法（如平均合并、TA合并等），并且保持简单高效。
Conclusion: Winner-Take-All为LoRA合并提供了一个新的视角和强基线，其简单性使其易于推广，但仅在医学LVLM领域评估，在其他领域（如气象）的适用性未知。

papers.title: ToolVerse: Unlocking Massive Environments and Long-Horizon Tasks for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: While LLM agents demonstrate strong reasoning abilities in compact and well-defined scenarios, they struggle to maintain robustness and effectiveness when faced with large-scale, diverse, and dynamic real-world environments that demand seamless tool integration. To address this gap, we introduce ToolVerse, a comprehensive framework that scales up agentic RL environments and enables agents to perform complex long-horizon reasoning in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) tasks. First, ToolVerse automatically builds the massive executable agent training environments from nearly 400 real-world Model Context Protocols (MCPs) that contain about 4500 tools. Second, we propose a task design strategy based on a tool dependency graph, utilizing Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm to generate long-horizon tasks, and produce GUST (Graph Unlocking Sampling Tasks) dataset. Third, to alleviate the credit assigment problem in long-horizon agentic RL, we propose a fine-grained Turn-Aware Relative Advantage algorithm. We conduct extensive Agentic RL training using ToolVerse and evaluate our framework on serveral agentic benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly strengthens LLMs' capabilities in long-horizon tool use, achieving a marked performance boost and showcasing robust reasoning within dynamic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToolVerse是一个用于提升LLM代理在工具集成推理任务中性能的框架。它从近400个真实世界MCP自动构建包含约4500个工具的大规模可执行训练环境，提出基于工具依赖图的任务设计策略和动态解锁采样算法生成长期任务，并引入细粒度回合感知相对优势算法解决长期信用分配问题。实验表明该框架显著增强了LLM在长期工具使用中的能力。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在紧凑明确场景中表现良好，但在需要无缝集成工具的大规模、多样化的动态真实环境中难以保持鲁棒性和有效性。
Method: 提出ToolVerse框架：1) 从近400个MCP自动构建包含约4500个工具的可执行环境；2) 基于工具依赖图设计任务，使用动态解锁采样算法生成长期任务（GUST数据集）；3) 提出细粒度Turn-Aware Relative Advantage算法缓解长期信用分配问题。
Result: 在多个代理基准上进行强化学习训练，实验表明框架显著提升了LLM在长期工具使用中的能力，实现了性能提升并在动态环境中展现出鲁棒推理。
Conclusion: ToolVerse通过大规模环境构建和任务设计策略，有效增强了LLM代理在工具集成推理任务中的表现，特别是长期任务中的信用分配问题得到缓解。

papers.title: Do Agents Dream of False Memories? Black-box Visual Attacks on Long-term Memory in Multimodal AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal AI agents increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory to ground generation in past visual and textual episodes. We show that unconditional trust in visual data creates a critical vulnerability. We propose Lucid, a black-box adversarial framework that compromises multimodal memory pipelines under a strictly image-bounded threat model, requiring no access to the target MLLM, target retrieval encoder, or the text channel. Lucid crafts imperceptible perturbations to enable two distinct failure modes based on the availability of historical context: (1) Memory poisoning, an in-context attack where the adversarial image replaces a benign one whose content is reinforced by prior textual context, reliably corrupting visual recall and steering the agent toward attacker-chosen narratives; (2) Memory injection, an out-of-context attack where the adversarial image replaces a benign one in a conversation turn devoid of prior textual grounding, causing the agent to generate attacker-influenced responses with no corrective signal from memory. We evaluate Lucid across various conversation domains and five black-box memory architectures, including graph-structured, LLM-summarized, and commercially deployed systems. Lucid achieves 61.6% ASR on poisoning and 58.4% ASR on injection, exposing a structural vulnerability in multimodal memory pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Lucid，一种黑盒对抗攻击框架，针对多模态AI代理的长期记忆系统（如图结构、LLM摘要和商业部署系统）。通过在图像上施加不可感知的扰动，Lucid实现了两种攻击模式：内存中毒（in-context）和内存注入（out-of-context），在无目标模型、检索编码器或文本通道访问权的严格图像受限威胁模型下，分别达到61.6%和58.4%的攻击成功率。实验揭示了多模态记忆管线在视觉数据无条件信任下的结构脆弱性。
Motivation: 多模态AI代理依赖持久长期记忆来增强生成，但对视觉数据的无条件信任构成了安全漏洞，现有研究缺乏对此类记忆管线的黑盒攻击分析。
Method: 提出Lucid框架，在黑盒设置下仅通过图像扰动攻击多模态记忆管线。威胁模型严格限制在图像通道，无需访问目标MLLM、检索编码器或文本内容。攻击分为两种：内存中毒（有历史上下文时替换良性图像）和内存注入（无上下文时注入新图像），均通过优化微小扰动实现。
Result: 在包括图结构、LLM摘要和商业系统的五类黑盒记忆架构上，Lucid达到61.6%的中毒攻击成功率（ASR）和58.4%的注入攻击成功率。
Conclusion: 该工作首次系统性地暴露出多模态AI代理记忆管线中的结构性安全漏洞，表明当前记忆系统对视觉输入缺乏足够的鲁棒性验证。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Step Lookahead Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel text generation by iteratively refining masked tokens, offering a promising alternative to autoregressive decoding. Recent lookahead-based decoding methods improve the accuracy--efficiency trade-off by exploring future decoding states before committing token updates. However, existing approaches mainly rely on shallow one-step lookahead, which optimizes immediate information gain but can be suboptimal for longer-horizon decoding trajectories. Meanwhile, we find that a naive extension for deeper lookahead is also ineffective, as fixed-depth rollout introduces additional computation and cannot adapt to heterogeneous intermediate decoding states. Thus, in this work, we propose AdaLook, an adaptive lookahead framework for DLM decoding. AdaLook dynamically determines whether to continue rollout based on candidate-score variance and further enables branch expansion when intermediate rollout states require additional exploration. This design avoids unnecessary deep rollout while allowing the decoder to re-trigger lookahead from informative intermediate states. Experiments on various benchmarks and models demonstrate that AdaLook achieves a better accuracy--decoding steps trade-off than existing one-step lookahead decoding methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对掩码扩散语言模型解码中现有一步前瞻（one-step lookahead）方法对长距离解码轨迹优化不足、固定深度前瞻适应性差的问题，提出自适应多步前瞻解码框架 AdaLook。该方法根据候选分数方差动态决定是否继续扩展前瞻路径，并允许从中间状态分支探索，在多个基准和模型上实现了更优的精度-步数权衡。
Motivation: 现有前瞻解码方法多采用浅层一步前瞻，虽能立即获取信息增益，但长期解码轨迹次优；简单增加前瞻深度（固定深度rollout）会引入额外计算且无法适应中间状态的异质性。
Method: 提出 AdaLook 框架，在解码时根据候选分数方差（candidate-score variance）自适应判断是否继续向前展开，并在中间状态需要更多探索时允许分支扩展，避免不必要的深层展开，同时允许从信息丰富的中间状态重新触发前瞻。
Result: 在多个基准和模型上的实验表明，AdaLook 相比已有一步前瞻解码方法实现了更好的精度与解码步数之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 自适应多步前瞻策略能有效提升扩散语言模型的解码效率与准确性，避免了固定深度前瞻的不足。

papers.title: CSS-BA: Gate-Guided Column Space Search for Bundle Adjustment
papers.abstract_en: Bundle adjustment (BA) remains a critical refinement module for image-based 3D reconstruction and continues to improve geometric accuracy even in learning-based pipelines. However, in low-parallax and near-rotational regimes, classical Schur-based Levenberg--Marquardt (LM) often becomes ill-conditioned and yields unreliable pose and calibration estimates. We propose Gate-Guided CSS-BA, a solver-side modification of Schur-LM that preserves the classical BA objective and trust-region framework while constraining each update to a geometrically informed low-dimensional subspace. By integrating Column Space Search (CSS) with geometry-aware gating, the method stabilizes the Schur-LM update without altering the estimation problem. In contrast to keyframe or state-selection approaches, all camera and point parameters remain in the optimization problem; only the update direction is restricted. The method serves as a drop-in replacement for existing BA pipelines. Experiments on both generic and challenging weak-geometry scenarios show more stable optimization, improved relative pose accuracy, and competitive calibration behavior while maintaining reprojection quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gate-Guided CSS-BA，一种对 Schur-Levenberg-Marquardt 算法的求解器侧改进，通过几何感知门控约束更新方向到低维子空间，以稳定低视差和近旋转场景下的光束法平差（BA）优化。该方法不改变 BA 目标和问题设定，仅限制更新方向，可作为现有 BA 管道的直接替换。实验表明在弱几何场景下优化更稳定，相对位姿精度更高，标定行为有竞争力。
Motivation: 经典 Schur-LM 算法在低视差和近旋转场景下易病态，导致位姿和标定估计不可靠。
Method: 将列空间搜索（CSS）与几何感知门控结合，在保持 BA 目标和信赖域框架的同时，将每次更新约束到一个几何信息指导的低维子空间。所有相机和点参数仍参与优化，仅限制更新方向。
Result: 在通用和挑战性弱几何场景下，优化更稳定，相对位姿精度提升，标定行为有竞争力，且重投影质量不变。
Conclusion: 该方法作为现有 BA 管道的即插即用组件，能有效改善低视差情况下的 BA 性能。
