summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Gate-Guided CSS-BA，一种对 Schur-Levenberg-Marquardt 算法的求解器侧改进，通过几何感知门控约束更新方向到低维子空间，以稳定低视差和近旋转场景下的光束法平差（BA）优化。该方法不改变 BA 目标和问题设定，仅限制更新方向，可作为现有 BA 管道的直接替换。实验表明在弱几何场景下优化更稳定，相对位姿精度更高，标定行为有竞争力。
summary_sections.motivation: 经典 Schur-LM 算法在低视差和近旋转场景下易病态，导致位姿和标定估计不可靠。
summary_sections.method: 将列空间搜索（CSS）与几何感知门控结合，在保持 BA 目标和信赖域框架的同时，将每次更新约束到一个几何信息指导的低维子空间。所有相机和点参数仍参与优化，仅限制更新方向。
summary_sections.result: 在通用和挑战性弱几何场景下，优化更稳定，相对位姿精度提升，标定行为有竞争力，且重投影质量不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法作为现有 BA 管道的即插即用组件，能有效改善低视差情况下的 BA 性能。

papers.title: DiTango: Cost-Effective Parallel Diffusion Generation with Selective Attention State Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-generated content have driven widespread adoption of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for high-resolution, long-duration content generation. While parallelization techniques accelerate diffusion inference, they face significant scalability challenges due to excessive communication overhead in multi-node environments. We observe that sequence partitions in Context Parallelism (CP) exhibit distinct heterogeneity: spatially proximate partitions contribute more significantly to attention computation results. By mapping this heterogeneous pattern to hierarchical communication topology, we can access high-contribution partitions with reduced communication cost. This insight motivates our novel selective attention state mechanism that strategically balances partial attention computation and historical result reuse across denoising steps. We present DiTango, an efficient parallel framework for DiT generation. DiTango features an anchor-guided state selection planner that optimizes computation-reuse decisions for each partition, complemented by a runtime that orchestrates efficient state-centric operations. This design achieves superior system efficiency while preserving generation quality. Experimental evaluation on popular diffusion models demonstrates that DiTango achieves up to 1.9x end-to-end and 3.2x attention speedup with near-linear scaling in multi-node settings, while maintaining generation quality comparable to state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.journal_ref: The 35th International Symposium on High-Performance Parallel and Distributed Computing (HPDC'26), July 13--16, 2026, Cleveland, OH, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiTango，一个针对扩散Transformer（DiT）的高效并行生成框架。通过观察上下文并行中序列分区的异质性，提出选择性注意力状态机制，在去噪步骤间平衡部分注意力计算和历史结果重用。DiTango包含锚点引导的状态选择规划器和运行时系统，在多节点环境下实现近线性加速，同时保持生成质量。实验表明，在流行扩散模型上获得最高1.9倍端到端和3.2倍注意力加速。
Motivation: 现有并行化技术加速扩散推理时，多节点环境下通信开销过大，限制了可扩展性。需要一种成本效益更高的方法减少通信开销。
Method: 提出选择性注意力状态机制，利用上下文并行中序列分区的异质性（空间邻近分区贡献更大），通过锚点引导的状态选择规划器优化每个分区的计算-重用决策，并由运行时协调高效的状态操作。
Result: 实验显示，DiTango在多种扩散模型上取得最高1.9倍端到端加速和3.2倍注意力加速，多节点环境下接近线性扩展，生成质量与最先进方法相当。
Conclusion: DiTango通过选择性注意力状态重用有效降低通信开销，在分布式环境中实现高效并行扩散生成，且不牺牲质量。

papers.title: On the Structure of Address in Multi-Party Dialogue: From Discrete Labels to Continuous Levels
papers.abstract_en: In multi-party dialogues between a dialogue system and multiple users, identifying to whom an utterance is addressed is a key challenge. Prior work has typically treated addressee detection as a multi-class classification task, selecting a single label representing an individual participant or the group. This formulation assumes that address is inherently discrete and has primarily been used for predicting turn-taking. In this paper, we revisit this assumption by analyzing address as a continuous phenomenon. Using a multi-party human dialogue corpus annotated by multiple annotators, we construct both binary address labels derived from majority-vote addressee labels and continuous address levels inferred from annotator judgments using a latent-variable model. We then examine how these representations relate to turn-taking as well as listener behaviors, including gaze and backchannels. Our results show that, in addition to turn-taking, both gaze and backchannels are associated with address. Furthermore, models using continuous address levels achieve better predictive fit than those using discrete labels, suggesting that address may exhibit graded structure. Finally, we discuss the future directions of addressee detection research based on the findings of this study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视多方对话中地址检测的离散标签假设，通过多标注者语料构建二进制标签和连续等级，分析其与轮流说话、注视和反馈行为的关系。结果表明连续等级模型拟合更优，地址可能具有梯度结构。
Motivation: 传统方法将地址检测视为离散多类分类，主要面向轮流说话预测，本文质疑该假设并探索地址的连续性质。
Method: 使用多方人类对话语料，由多位标注者标注，通过多数投票得到二进制地址标签，并利用潜变量模型推断连续地址等级，然后分析这些表示与轮流说话、注视和反馈行为的关联。
Result: 结果显示注视和反馈也与地址相关，且使用连续地址等级的模型预测拟合优于离散标签模型，表明地址可能具有梯度结构。
Conclusion: 基于发现讨论了未来地址检测研究的方向。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for LEED compliance: Document-Centric Benchmarking, Deterministic Numeric Checking, and When Multimodal Hurts
authors: Juliana Felkner (1) ((1) The University of Texas at Austin)
papers.abstract_en: LEED v4.1 BD+C certification remains a document-intensive process that requires reviewers to read hundreds of pages of project evidence and apply credit-specific threshold logic by hand. This paper investigates whether small, locally deployed language models can perform meaningful screening of LEED documentation and how deterministic symbolic components should share that work. A neuro-symbolic pipeline is introduced that aligns project PDFs to LEED credit sections, retrieves evidence with credit-aware keyword signatures, verifies compliance with a locally hosted 4-billion-parameter language model, and applies a LEED-specific numeric checker to quantitative thresholds. Experiments on four university buildings (484 PDFs, 153 credit-level decisions) show that a 4-billion-parameter model (gemma3:4b) is the strongest text-only core verifier, achieving 67.3% accuracy and outperforming a larger 8-billion-parameter model (llama3.1:8b) in this task. The deterministic numeric checker corrects arithmetic errors on key quantitative credits, moving EA-p2 from 50% to 100% accuracy and improving several other credits when required values are reliably extracted. At the same time, the full neuro-symbolic configuration achieves 61.6% overall accuracy, trailing the best text-only baseline due to extraction failures and conservative behavior on qualitative categories. Systematic ablations show that adding low-resolution drawing images (150-300 dpi) consistently reduces accuracy, and that prompt effectiveness depends on the building's ground-truth PASS rate: rubric prompts perform best on documentation-rich projects, while chain-of-thought prompts perform best on documentation-lean projects. Within the specific scope of LEED v4.1 BD+C compliance verification over raw project documentation, this pipeline and its baselines provide an initial reproducible reference point for both accuracy and failure modes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号（neuro-symbolic）管道用于LEED v4.1 BD+C合规性筛选，结合小规模语言模型（4B参数）和确定性数值检查器。在四个大学建筑（484份PDF，153个信用决策）上实验，最佳文本验证器gemma3:4b达到67.3%准确率，完整神经符号系统为61.6%，并发现添加低分辨率图像会降低准确率。
Motivation: LEED认证过程文档密集，需要人工阅读数百页项目证据并应用信用特定阈值逻辑，效率低且易出错。
Method: 提出神经符号管道：将项目PDF对齐到LEED信用章节，用信用感知关键词签名检索证据，用本地部署的4B参数语言模型验证合规性，并应用LEED特定的数值检查器处理定量阈值。
Result: 4B模型（gemma3:4b）在文本验证中准确率67.3%，优于8B模型；确定性数值检查器纠正算术错误，将EA-p2从50%提升至100%准确率；完整神经符号系统准确率61.6%，低于最佳文本基线；添加低分辨率图像（150-300 dpi）持续降低准确率。
Conclusion: 本管道和基线为LEED v4.1 BD+C合规性验证提供了可重复的准确率和失败模式参考点，但完整神经符号配置因提取失败和对定性类别的保守行为而受限。

papers.title: Testing Distributions Against Bounded Distinguishers
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the challenge of testing distributions over high-dimensional or continuous domains, we study distribution testing with respect to bounded classes of distinguishers. A representative task is to use samples from an unknown distribution $P$ over a very large domain to decide between two cases: $P = P_{\mathsf{ref}}$ for a fixed reference distribution $P_{\mathsf{ref}}$, or there exists a distinguisher $f$ in a bounded class $\mathcal{F}$ which witnesses the separation $|\mathbf{E}_P[f] - \mathbf{E}_{P_{\mathsf{ref}}}[f]| > ε$. This is the task of identity testing with respect to fooling distance, a name inspired by the conceptual connection with pseudorandomness. (Formally, our model instantiates integral probability metrics from Boolean classes of bounded expressivity.) We show that testing with respect to fooling distance is not only a natural computational problem that admits sample-efficient algorithms even in high-dimensional settings, but also one that reveals and underlies connections between three seemingly unrelated areas of study: testable learning, verification of learning algorithms, and testing of structured distributions (whose "$\mathcal{A}_k$-testing" model our framework extends). These connections yield new results for all of these models, including: 1. Testable proper learners using membership queries for halfspaces and decision trees. 2. A lower bound for testable PAC verification in terms of Rademacher complexity, and a distribution-free verification protocol for disjoint unions of $k$ multidimensional rectangles. 3. Identity testers (with respect to total variation distance) for decision tree distributions and distributions with low-degree polynomial densities, over Boolean and continuous hypercube domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了针对有界区分器类的分布测试问题，提出了一种基于愚弄距离（fooling distance）的身份测试框架。该框架将测试性学习、学习算法验证和结构化分布测试三个领域联系起来，并推导出新的结果，包括基于成员查询的半空间和决策树的可测试正确学习器、基于Rademacher复杂度的可测试PAC验证下界，以及布尔和连续超立方体上决策树分布和低次多项式密度分布的身份测试器。
Motivation: 在具有高维或连续域的情况下测试分布是一个挑战。现有方法往往难以处理大规模或连续域，而通过有界区分器类来定义测试距离可以更自然地适应高维设置，并揭示不同研究领域之间的联系。
Method: 提出以愚弄距离（fooling distance）为核心的分布测试模型，该模型实例化来自有界表达性布尔类的积分概率度量（integral probability metrics）。通过该框架，统一了测试性学习、学习算法验证和结构化分布测试等方法。
Result: 得到了三类结果：1）使用成员查询的半空间和决策树的可测试正确学习器；2）基于Rademacher复杂度的可测试PAC验证下界，以及k个多维矩形不相交并的分布无关验证协议；3）在布尔和连续超立方体上，针对决策树分布和低次多项式密度分布的身份测试器（基于全变分距离）。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了分布测试与伪随机性等概念的内在联系，并为多个相关领域提供了新的理论工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IMBench: A Benchmark for Intuitive Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Humans combine reasoning and motor control to solve complex manipulation tasks under diverse constraints. They build an understanding of the physical world that helps them convert reasoning into actions and quickly adapt to new scenes, tasks, and rules. We refer to this capability as intuitive manipulation. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this integration: they evaluate physical reasoning in isolation from execution, or measure policy performance without requiring explicit reasoning. We introduce IMBENCH, a benchmark designed to evaluate intuitive manipulation as an integrated capability spanning perception, physical reasoning, action generation, and iterative execution. Our tasks require models to infer task-relevant physical structure and generate feasible action sequences under explicit constraints, including contact-rich manipulation, tool use, and multi-stage dependencies. We introduce a benchmark of 35 tasks, 14K filtered trajectories, and scalable tools for generating diverse scenarios. Experiments reveal a consistent gap: vision language models show partial physical reasoning ability but fail to produce executable plans, while state-of-the-art vision-language-action models struggle to satisfy task constraints and generalize across scenarios. These results identify intuitive manipulation as a missing axis in current foundation models and generalist robot policies, and position IMBENCH as a step toward evaluating and enabling more integrated, adaptive physical intelligence.
papers.comment: Accepted to SemRob Workshop, RSS 2026. Project Website: https://imbench.org/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IMBENCH 是一个评估机器人直觉操作能力的基准测试，涵盖感知、物理推理、动作生成和迭代执行。包含35个任务和1.4万条轨迹，实验表明现有视觉语言模型和视觉-语言-动作模型在满足任务约束和场景泛化方面存在显著差距。
Motivation: 现有基准要么将物理推理与执行分离评估，要么仅测量策略性能而不要求显式推理，未能捕捉人类在操作中整合推理与运动控制的能力。
Method: 设计35个接触丰富操作、工具使用和多阶段依赖的任务，提供14K过滤轨迹和可扩展场景生成工具，用于评估模型的直觉操作能力。
Result: 视觉语言模型能进行部分物理推理但无法生成可执行计划；最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型难以满足任务约束并泛化到新场景。
Conclusion: 直觉操作是当前基础模型和通用机器人策略的缺失维度，IMBENCH 旨在推动更集成、自适应的物理智能评估。

papers.title: BCG-Former: Toward Pareto-Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification via Band-Contextual Gating
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification systems are increasingly deployed on platforms with strict computational budgets, such as UAVs and small spaceborne sensors. In these settings, accuracy alone is not enough; the model must also run within tight latency and memory constraints. Most recent HSI classifiers, however, focus on accuracy and pay relatively little attention to these constraints. We propose BCG-Former, a lightweight CNN-Transformer hybrid that targets this trade-off. The model introduces three innovations: (1) Band-Contextual Gating (BCG) for adaptive spectral recalibration using local inter-band context and learnable temperature sharpening, (2) a spectral summary token that bridges spectral and spatial features, and (3) single-pass Band-RoPE combined with linear attention for efficient joint representation learning. Evaluated on classical airborne (Pavia University, Salinas, Indian Pines, Houston 2013/2018) and UAV-borne benchmark datasets (WHU-Hi-LongKou, HongHu, and HanChuan), BCG-Former achieves over-all accuracy ranging from 91.51% on Houston 2018 to 99.49% on Houston 2013, while maintaining sub-millisecond inference latency (0.91-0.95ms) and using only 0.10-0.23M parameters. Across all eight benchmarks, BCG-Former consistently resides on or near the Pareto frontier of accuracy versus latency, outperforming or matching recent CNN-, Transformer-, and Mamba-based methods at a fraction of their computational cost. Ablation studies confirm that all three components are complementary, with BCG providing the largest individual contribution. These results establish BCG-Former as a strong accuracy-efficiency Pareto candidate for real-time and large-scale remote sensing applications.

papers.title: STSBench: A Large-Scale Dataset for Modeling Neuronal Activity in the Dorsal Stream of Primate Visual Cortex
papers.abstract_en: The primate visual system is typically divided into two streams - the ventral stream, responsible for object recognition, and the dorsal stream, responsible for encoding spatial relations and motion. Recent studies have shown that convolutional neural networks (CNNs) pretrained on object recognition tasks are remarkably effective at predicting neuronal responses in the ventral stream, shedding light on the neural mechanisms underlying object recognition. However, similar models of the dorsal stream remain underdeveloped due to the lack of large scale datasets encompassing dorsal stream areas. To address this gap, we present STSBench, a dataset of large-scale, single neuron recordings from over 2,000 neurons in the superior temporal sulcus (STS), a nearly 50-fold increase over existing dorsal stream datasets, collected while Rhesus macaques viewed thousands of unique, natural videos. We show that our dataset can be used for benchmarking encoding models of dorsal stream neuronal responses and reconstructing visual input from neural activity.

papers.title: A cubical formalisation of topos causal models: intervention, sheaf gluing, and the intuitionistic do-calculus
papers.abstract_en: Topos causal models recast causal inference inside a topos: a causal world is a presheaf, an intervention is a characteristic map into the subobject classifier, and reasoning is carried out in the intuitionistic internal language. We give the first machine-checked account of this 1-topos core, in Cubical Agda, over a previously verified probability monad and do-calculus. We build the classifier of sieves and realise the intervention $\mathrm{do}(X := x_0)$ as a characteristic map with its classification theorem; prove the sheaf gluing of independent mechanisms, which the source asserts but never proves; and machine-check the Kripke-Joyal forcing clauses of the internal language. In the modal layer we find and repair a gap: the three standard Lawvere-Tierney axioms do not force a closure operator. With the missing law restored, we exhibit the double-negation topology as a concrete instance and show that interventions and Pearl's rules are stable under every topology. Transportability of a counterfactual across a cover of regimes then coincides with this $j$-stability, understood as invariance across the cover. We further add a phenomenon the programme does not consider: a machine-checked contextuality obstruction, where pairwise-consistent local data admit no global model. The development assumes no axioms and typechecks under Agda's --safe flag, with the ordered field discharged concretely at $\mathbb{Q}$; the scope is the presheaf (1-topos) fragment, with type-level sheafification and the directed lift left to future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Cubical Agda中首次对topos因果模型的核心部分进行了机器验证的形式化。作者构造了筛子分类器并将干预$\mathrm{do}(X := x_0)$实现为特征映射，证明了独立机制的层粘合（sheaf gluing）以及内部语言的Kripke-Joyal强制子句。在模态层中修复了一个缺失的闭合算子公理，并展示了双否定拓扑作为实例，证明干预和Pearl规则在每个拓扑下稳定。此外还添加了机器验证的上下文性障碍，其中局部两两一致的数据不存在全局模型。所有代码在Agda的--safe标志下通过类型检查，使用有理数域。
Motivation: 现有的topos因果模型理论缺乏机器验证的形式化基础，且原始文献中声称的某些结果（如层粘合）并未给出证明；此外，标准Lawvere-Tierney拓扑公理存在缺陷，未能强制闭合算子。
Method: 在Cubical Agda中，基于先前验证的概率单子和do-calculus，构建筛子分类器，将干预实现为特征映射并证明分类定理；证明Kripke-Joyal强制子句；修复拓扑公理并展示双否定拓扑实例；添加上下文性障碍的机器验证。
Result: 成功机器验证了topos因果模型的核心定理，包括干预的分类定理、独立机制的层粘合、内部语言语义；修复了拓扑公理中的缺口并证明干预和Pearl规则在任意拓扑下稳定；发现了局部一致数据无全局模型的上下文性障碍。
Conclusion: 本文提供了topos因果模型在1-topos片段上的机器验证基础，但仅限于presheaf层次，类型层sheafification和directed lift留待未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retraining Seeks Stable Signals
papers.abstract_en: Predictive models deployed at scale influence future data, a phenomenon called performativity. And there is always one way to cope: Train the model on new data, deploy it again, and repeat. This process, called retraining or repeated risk minimization, creates a feedback loop between model and data that real-world learning systems can't avoid. Results on performative prediction shed light on this dynamic: If the model's influence on the data is small, retraining reaches a fixed point. What remains open is why fixed points should naturally exist, and what governs retraining when the model's influence is strong. In this work we develop a new perspective on retraining -- the stable signal principle -- that addresses these questions. We start from the assumption that the prediction target has at least some small model-independent component, a stable signal, such as the intrinsic quality of an item. We prove that when a nonzero stable signal exists, repeated risk minimization, suitably regularized, converges geometrically to the direction of this stable signal. This is true even if the model's influence on the target is arbitrarily large relative to the stable signal. Regularization emerges naturally as a force to control performativity, rather than to promote generalization, revealing a new facet of an old concept. We extend the analysis to a broad family of affine retraining operators under arbitrary model-induced feature changes, heterogeneous time-varying effects, and nonlinear responses. The stable signal perspective also applies to data feedback loops in language modeling, providing new explanations for the stability of language model training from model-generated data.
papers.comment: Companion article to an invited contribution to the Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians (ICM), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出稳定信号原理解释重训练（repeated risk minimization）在预测模型与数据反馈循环中的收敛行为。证明当存在非零的模型无关稳定信号（stable signal）时，带正则化的重训练会几何收敛到该信号方向，即使模型影响远大于稳定信号也成立。正则化在此主要控制性能效应（performativity）而非泛化。该视角还适用于语言模型中来自模型生成数据的数据反馈循环。
Motivation: 现有关于性能预测（performative prediction）的结果仅能解释当模型影响较小时重训练达到不动点，但未解释不动点为何自然存在，以及当模型影响强时重训练的行为。
Method: 提出稳定信号原则：假设预测目标包含至少一个微小的模型无关成分（稳定信号）。证明通过适当正则化的重复风险最小化，模型参数会几何收敛到该稳定信号方向，并扩展至仿射重训练算子、任意特征变化、异质时变效应和非线性响应。
Result: 证明即使模型对目标的影响远大于稳定信号，正则化重训练仍能收敛到稳定信号方向。正则化在此起到控制性能效应的作用，而非促进泛化。
Conclusion: 稳定信号视角为重训练的收敛性提供了新解释，并适用于语言模型中模型生成数据的反馈循环。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Think at 5 Hz, Act at 20 Hz: Asynchronous Fast-Slow Vision-Language-Action Inference for Closed-Loop Driving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models bring instruction following and scene reasoning to end-to-end driving, but their inference latency collides with the control rate a vehicle requires. Existing closed-loop agents hide this gap by invoking the model on alternate simulation ticks and replaying the previous command in between, so half of all control outputs ignore the newest observations. We present a fast-slow architecture that removes this compromise. A frozen 7B vision-language backbone acts as the slow system, digesting navigation instructions and visual history at low frequency while exposing its per-layer key-value cache as a standing representation of the scene. A lightweight action expert acts as the fast system, attending to this cache and to the current camera frame at every simulation tick to regress waypoints in a single forward pass. Since the cache lags behind the world at deployment, we train the expert under randomized staleness, aligning training with asynchronous execution. On LangAuto-Short routes in CARLA, our system produces fresh control at every 50 ms simulation tick and lifts route completion from 37.0 to 94.0 over the frame-skipping baseline. A frame-skip ablation with the same expert separates the two factors at work: the expert raises the driving score on its own, while per-tick freshness raises completion from 82.1 to 94.0 and cuts red-light violations by a third. Trained on a single town, the expert transfers zero-shot to two unseen towns, holding 84-94% route completion where the baseline reaches 31-41%. It reduces open-loop waypoint error by nearly a factor of four compared to the backbone's own action head, at a per-tick model cost of 32 ms that is independent of history length on a single consumer GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种异步快慢架构，用于闭环驾驶中的视觉-语言-动作推理。一个冻结的7B视觉-语言模型作为慢系统，以低频率消化导航指令和视觉历史，并暴露逐层键值缓存作为场景表示；一个轻量动作专家作为快系统，在每个仿真时间步（50 ms）通过注意力机制访问该缓存和当前相机帧以回归路径点。由于缓存滞后于现实世界，训练时对专家施加随机陈旧度对齐。在CARLA的LangAuto-Short路线中，该架构在每50 ms生成新鲜控制，将路线完成率从37.0提升至94.0（对比跳帧基线），并将红灯违规减少三分之一。
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型依赖大型语言模型进行指令跟随和场景推理，但推理延迟与车辆所需的控制速率冲突。现有闭环智能体通过在仿真刻度间交替调用模型并重放上一指令来隐藏延迟，导致一半控制输出忽略最新观测，降低安全性和性能。
Method: 提出异步快慢架构：慢系统为冻结的7B视觉-语言模型，低频处理指令和视觉历史并生成逐层键值缓存；快系统为轻量动作专家，每个仿真时间步（50 ms）通过交叉注意力访问缓存和当前帧，单次前向回归路径点。训练时随机化缓存陈旧度以匹配部署时的异步性。
Result: 在CARLA的LangAuto-Short路线中，方法实现每50 ms生成新鲜控制，路线完成率从37.0提升至94.0（vs 跳帧基线）。消融实验显示：专家自身提升驾驶得分，而每步新鲜度将完成率从82.1提升至94.0并减少红灯违规三分之一。在单一城镇训练的专家零样本迁移至两个未见城镇，完成率84-94%（基线31-41%）。开放循环路径点误差相比骨干网络的自身动作头降低近四倍，每步模型成本32 ms且独立于历史长度（单消费级GPU）。
Conclusion: 异步快慢架构有效解耦了复杂场景理解与实时控制，通过训练时随机陈旧度对齐实现部署时每步新鲜控制，显著提升闭环驾驶的安全性和完成率。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出异步快慢架构：慢系统为冻结的7B视觉-语言模型，低频处理指令和视觉历史并生成逐层键值缓存；快系统为轻量动作专家，每个仿真时间步（50 ms）通过交叉注意力访问缓存和当前帧，单次前向回归路径点。训练时随机化缓存陈旧度以匹配部署时的异步性。
summary_sections.result: 在CARLA的LangAuto-Short路线中，方法实现每50 ms生成新鲜控制，路线完成率从37.0提升至94.0（vs 跳帧基线）。消融实验显示：专家自身提升驾驶得分，而每步新鲜度将完成率从82.1提升至94.0并减少红灯违规三分之一。在单一城镇训练的专家零样本迁移至两个未见城镇，完成率84-94%（基线31-41%）。开放循环路径点误差相比骨干网络的自身动作头降低近四倍，每步模型成本32 ms且独立于历史长度（单消费级GPU）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 异步快慢架构有效解耦了复杂场景理解与实时控制，通过训练时随机陈旧度对齐实现部署时每步新鲜控制，显著提升闭环驾驶的安全性和完成率。

papers.title: AEGIS: Assay-Aware Protocol Validation and Runtime Monitoring for Open-Source Liquid Handling Robots
papers.abstract_en: Self-driving laboratories increasingly rely on low-cost liquid handlers such as the Opentrons OT-2, which ship without the pressure-based aspiration monitoring of Hamilton or Tecan systems and are typically run open-loop. Two failure modes go undetected: protocols that are syntactically valid but violate assay-specific invariants (e.g., tip reuse between a PCR template and a no-template control), and physical execution failures (partial dispense, air bubbles, missing tips) at runtime. We present AEGIS, a two-layer guardian for both. Layer 1 pairs a curated machine-readable assay rule database with an LLM that reasons over OT-2 Python code, reaching an adjusted F1 of 0.97 on a 24-protocol benchmark across five assay families and beating rules-only and LLM-only ablations across five backends; a free open-weight model ties the best proprietary one, so no paid API is required. Layer 2 fits a PCA world model to YOLO-cropped four-frame pipette trajectories; under a leakage-free leave-one-plate-out evaluation it reaches average precision 0.89 and operating-point F1 0.71 (AUROC 0.80), a deployment-faithful number that matches the live demonstration, and we characterize the small-pipette (p20) resolution limit (F1 0.47). A live demonstration on a physical OT-2 (five replicates per condition) catches planted no-tip failures deterministically and partial dispense on coloured dyes, with an always-VLM self-vote gate lifting partial-dispense recall to 5/5; transparent water is a principled limit of any front-view-only monitor, which AEGIS surfaces as low-confidence VLM reasoning rather than a wrong verdict. Cascade triage holds VLM cost near $1.63 per plate versus $10.33 for an always-VLM baseline. AEGIS is open source and, to our knowledge, the first system to unify pre-flight assay-aware validation with runtime visual monitoring for an open-source liquid handler.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AEGIS系统，为开源液体处理机器人Opentrons OT-2提供两层防护：第一层通过LLM结合化验规则库验证协议是否违反化验特异性不变量，在五个化验家族的24个协议基准上达到调整F1=0.97；第二层使用PCA世界模型监控移液轨迹，在留一板评估下平均精度0.89，操作点F1=0.71。实物演示中，系统可靠地检测到无吸头故障和部分分液错误，并采用级联门控将VLM成本从每板10.33美元降至1.63美元。
Motivation: 开源液体处理器（如Opentrons OT-2）缺乏压力监测，常在开环下运行，导致两类未被检测的故障：协议语法正确但违反化验特异性不变量（如PCR模板与无模板对照间重复使用吸头），以及运行时物理执行失败（部分分液、气泡、缺吸头）。
Method: AEGIS由两层组成：第一层将人工整理的机器可读化验规则库与LLM结合，对OT-2 Python代码进行推理；第二层将YOLO裁剪的四帧移液轨迹拟合到PCA世界模型，并通过级联VLM门控进行实时监控。
Result: 第一层在24个协议基准上达到调整F1=0.97，开放权重模型性能与最佳专有模型相当；第二层在留一板评估下平均精度0.89，操作点F1=0.71（AUROC 0.80），p20移液器分辨极限F1=0.47。实物演示中，系统确定性捕捉到植入的无吸头故障，对染色液部分分液召回率提升至5/5，透明水为前视监控的根本限制。级联门控将VLM成本降至$1.63每板。
Conclusion: AEGIS是首个为开源液体处理器统一预飞行化验验证与运行时视觉监控的系统，开源可用。摘要指出透明水等物理限制导致前视监控的固有局限，系统以低置信度VLM推理而非错误判定暴露此问题。

papers.title: StructGen: Disambiguating Multi-Reference Image Generation via Structured Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Multi-reference image generation aims to synthesize images by integrating attributes from multiple reference images under textual instructions. As the number of references increases, the task necessitates complex semantic comprehension, such as correctly associating attributes with the intended subjects and planing out coherent spatial arrangement between subjects and their environments. Existing approaches, which rely solely on natural language instruction, often fail to capture these complex intentions precisely, leading to semantic misalignment and inconsistent generation. We identify two key factors behind these limitations: natural language instructions are often verbose and ambiguous, and high-quality multi-reference data is scarce. To address these issues, we propose StructGen, which employs a structured, dictionary-like format to encode multiple reference images, thereby enabling explicit and unambiguous specification of generation intentions. To support this design, we construct a structured dataset based on high-quality real images and develop a corresponding training framework, along with a dedicated benchmark for challenging multi-reference scenarios. Extensive experiments on both public benchmarks and our proposed benchmark demonstrate that StructGen consistently outperforms existing methods on both semantic alignment and detailed reference-generation consistency, especially under complex instructions with multiple references. The code is available at \href{https://jianingpeng0382.github.io/StructGen/}{https://jianingpeng0382.github.io/StructGen/}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StructGen，使用结构化的字典格式编码多个参考图像，以解决多参考图像生成中的语义歧义和不一致问题。通过构建高质量结构化数据集和训练框架，在公开和自定义基准上，StructGen 在语义对齐和参考一致性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖自然语言指令，难以精确捕捉多参考图像的复杂语义，导致属性与主体关联错误、空间布局混乱；同时，自然语言冗余歧义且高质量多参考数据稀缺。
Method: 采用结构化的字典格式替代自然语言编码多个参考图像，实现明确无歧义的生成意图指定；并构建对应的结构化数据集、训练框架和专用基准。
Result: 在公开基准和自定义基准上，StructGen 在语义对齐和参考一致性上持续优于现有方法，尤其对于多参考的复杂指令。
Conclusion: 结构化上下文建模能有效解决多参考图像生成中的语义歧义问题，为多参考生成提供了新范式。

papers.title: Region-Grounded Vision-Language Learning for Detection-Guided Mammographic Lesion Classification
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models trained with contrastive objectives have shown promise in medical image analysis. However, conventional global image-text alignment is ill-suited for mammography, where diagnostically relevant lesions are spatially localized and occupy only a small fraction of the image. Subtle morphological cues critical for malignancy assessment can be diluted when representations are learned at the whole-image level. In this work, we propose a novel region-grounded vision-language learning method for detection-guided mammographic lesion classification. The method mirrors radiologists' diagnostic paradigm. First, a region-text contrastive pretraining stage aligns lesion-specific features with structured clinical descriptors derived from radiology metadata. To mitigate semantic collapse and background bias in low-vocabulary settings, we introduce a multi-component objective incorporating positive alignment, fine-grained semantic hard negatives, and background suppression. Second, an auxiliary lesion detection head is jointly optimized with contrastive classification to preserve spatial sensitivity and enable localization-aware malignancy classification. Extensive experiments on two independent datasets, CBIS-DDSM and VinDr-Mammo, show superior performance of our method compared to related methods under in-domain, cross-dataset, and transfer learning settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种区域基础的视觉-语言学习方法，用于检测引导的乳腺病变分类。通过区域-文本对比预训练和辅助检测头，在CBIS-DDSM和VinDr-Mammo数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 传统全局图像-文本对齐不适用于乳腺摄影，因为病变区域小且局部，全局对齐会稀释关键形态学线索。
Method: 提出区域-文本对比预训练，使用多组件目标函数（正对齐、细粒度语义负样本、背景抑制），并联合优化辅助病变检测头。
Result: 在CBIS-DDSM和VinDr-Mammo数据集上，在域内、跨数据集和迁移学习设置下均优于相关方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过模仿放射科医生诊断范式，结合区域对齐和检测头，提升了病变分类的空间敏感性和准确性。

papers.title: Process Reward Informed Tree Rollout for Effective Multi-Turn RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key approach for training LLM agents, yet popular methods such as GRPO/RLOO rely on multiple independently sampled complete trajectories for advantage estimation. In long-horizon agentic tasks, such a uniform rollout strategy can waste budget on uninformative dead-end attempts, while promising intermediate states do not receive sufficient exploration. The multi-turn structure of agentic trajectories, with interleaved actions and observations, naturally supports organizing a trajectory group as a tree, where each turn serves as a decision point for exploration. This perspective reframes effective exploration as the problem of deciding where to branch. We propose Process-Scorer Guided Adaptive Tree Rollout (PATR), a quality-aware rollout framework for multi-turn agent RL. PATR uses task-appropriate process feedback to score partial trajectories, selectively branches from promising states, reuses shared prefixes, and conservatively stops degenerate paths to reduce wasted sampling. The resulting rollout groups remain compatible with standard policy optimization while providing more efficient exploration under the same training budget. We evaluate PATR on FrozenLake and the challenging SWE-Bench, which is largely unexplored by prior tree-rollout agent RL methods. Experiments show that PATR improves performance by up to +5.0 points on SWE-Bench and +9.3 points on FrozenLake, highlighting process-guided tree rollouts as an effective strategy for scalable multi-turn RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出过程奖励引导的自适应树展开框架（PATR），用于多轮强化学习中的智能体训练。通过过程评分对部分轨迹打分，选择性从有希望的状态进行分支、重用共享前缀并停止退化路径，从而在相同训练预算下实现更高效的探索。在FrozenLake和SWE-Bench上的实验表明，该方法分别提升+9.3和+5.0个点。
Motivation: 现有方法如GRPO/RLOO依赖独立采样的完整轨迹进行优势估计，在长时域智能体任务中容易将预算浪费在无信息的死胡同尝试上，而中间状态缺乏充分探索。
Method: PATR利用任务适用的过程反馈对部分轨迹评分，自适应地构建树状展开组，选择性分支于有希望的状态，复用共享前缀，并保守地终止退化路径，减少无效采样。
Result: 在SWE-Bench上提升+5.0个点，在FrozenLake上提升+9.3个点。
Conclusion: 过程引导的树展开是一种有效的多轮强化学习策略，能够在不增加训练预算的情况下提升探索效率。

papers.title: ASK-NN: An Asymmetric Nearest-Neighbor Test that detects Distribution Drifts in Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations and artificial text in LLM-generated outputs often appear as distributional deviations between prompt and response hidden-state distributions. Since prompts or retrieved contexts typically serve as reference samples and responses as query samples, with major differences in length, these asymmetries motivate the use of change test statistics that treat the two samples differently. We consider an asymmetric two-sample test ASK-NN based on the directed k-nearest-neighbor graph. Our statistic counts reference points whose nearest neighbor in the pooled sample is also a reference point. Under the permutation null, it admits an exact finite-sample conditional mean and variance; we further establish asymptotic normality and consistency under fixed alternatives. ASK-NN is computationally effective and easy to implement. Empirically, it is competitive with kernel and graph-based baselines on synthetic benchmarks, artificial-text detection, and LLM hallucination detection from token-level hidden states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASK-NN是一种基于有向k近邻图的非对称双样本检验，用于检测自然语言中的分布漂移，尤其适用于LLM输出中的幻觉检测。该方法通过统计参考点中最近邻也为参考点的数量来构建统计量，在置换零假设下具有精确的有限样本条件均值和方差，并证明了渐近正态性和一致性。实验表明，ASK-NN在合成基准、人工文本检测和LLM幻觉检测上具有竞争力。
Motivation: LLM生成的输出常出现幻觉，表现为提示和响应隐藏状态分布之间的漂移。由于参考样本（提示或检索上下文）和查询样本（响应）在长度上存在显著不对称性，需要一种非对称的检验统计量来有效检测这种分布漂移。
Method: 提出ASK-NN统计量，基于有向k近邻图，计数参考点中其最近邻（在合并样本中）也是参考点的数量。在置换零假设下，导出了该统计量的精确有限样本条件均值和方差，并建立了渐近正态性和在固定备择假设下的一致性。该方法计算高效且易于实现。
Result: 在合成基准测试中，ASK-NN与基于核和图的基线方法表现相当；在人工文本检测和基于token级隐藏状态的LLM幻觉检测任务中，ASK-NN展现出竞争力。
Conclusion: ASK-NN是一种有效的非对称双样本检验工具，特别适用于处理样本长度不对称的分布漂移检测问题，在LLM相关应用中具有潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Generative Models Keep Time? A Time-Aware Evaluation of Synthetic Sequential Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic sequential tabular data are increasingly used for privacy-preserving data sharing, yet a generator can reproduce every marginal and every foreign-key relationship while emitting timestamps that run backwards or repeat, and while sending entities along paths that no real entity followed. Conventional tabular evaluation, which pools records into static distributions, is blind to such failures. We present a taxonomy-guided evaluation protocol for temporal fidelity, in which the applicable measurements are determined by the data rather than fixed in advance. Each dataset is first characterized along four properties: how time is represented, whether observations are regularly sampled, whether trajectories are mutually dependent, and how the schema links entities to their histories. These properties determine which evaluation dimensions are meaningful. The protocol then measures timestamp validity, cross-sectional structure at aligned time points, within-entity dynamics, and time-varying relational structure, and recasts utility and privacy evaluation over trajectories rather than isolated rows. We apply the protocol to eight generative models across thirteen datasets spanning six domains. Rankings under conventional evaluation disagree substantially with those obtained under temporal evaluation, and the resulting failures are architecture-coherent rather than random. Temporal fidelity must therefore be measured on the time axis itself, rather than inferred from pooled record distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于数据特性的时间保真度评估协议，用于评估合成时序表格数据的时间一致性。协议先根据时间表示、采样规律性、轨迹依赖性和模式链接四个属性对数据集分类，再测量时间戳有效性、截面对齐结构、实体内部动态和时变关系结构，并将效用和隐私评估扩展到轨迹层面。在八个生成模型和十三个数据集上的实验表明，传统静态评估与时间评估的排名差异显著，且失败模式与架构相关，表明时间保真度必须在时间轴上直接测量。
Motivation: 现有合成时序表格数据评估仅考虑静态分布，无法检测时间戳逆序、重复或实体轨迹不连贯等时间失效问题，需要专门的时间保真度评估方法。
Method: 提出一个分两步的评估协议：首先根据四个数据属性（时间表示、采样规律、轨迹依赖、模式链接）确定评估维度，然后测量时间戳有效性、截面对齐结构、实体内部动态和时变关系结构，并基于轨迹而非孤立行评估效用和隐私。
Result: 在八个生成模型和十三个数据集上，传统评估与时间评估得出的排名显著不同，且时间失效模式与生成模型的架构一致，而非随机。
Conclusion: 合成时序表格数据的时间保真度必须在时间轴上直接测量，不能从静态分布推断；作者呼吁将时间评估纳入标准惯例。

papers.title: Benchmarking MRI Representations for Deep Learning-Based Focal Cortical Dysplasia Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Focal cortical dysplasia (FCD) is one of the leading structural causes of drug-resistant focal epilepsy, yet its subtle and heterogeneous imaging characteristics make accurate identification and delineation challenging on conventional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Although T1-weighted (T1w) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) images are routinely acquired for presurgical evaluation, the contribution of different MRI representations to deep learning-based FCD segmentation remains poorly understood. In this study, we present a systematic benchmark of MRI representations for automated FCD segmentation using the nnU-Net framework. A publicly available presurgical MRI dataset comprising 85 FCD subjects and 25 healthy controls was used to evaluate eight input configurations, including conventional MRI contrasts (T1w and FLAIR), ratio-derived representations, and their multimodal combinations. To isolate the effect of MRI representation, all experiments employed identical preprocessing, network architecture, optimization strategy, and five-fold cross-validation. Among the evaluated single-modality representations, FLAIR achieved the strongest overall performance, whereas ratio-derived representations alone were insufficient for reliable identification of subtle FCD. Incorporating ratio-derived representations with conventional T1w and FLAIR images consistently improved lesion delineation, with the four-channel multimodal configuration achieving the highest overall Dice score (0.376), representing a 5.0% relative improvement over the conventional T1w+FLAIR representation. These findings demonstrate that MRI representation design is an important yet underexplored component of deep learning-based FCD segmentation and should be optimized alongside network architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统基准测试了不同MRI表示（包括T1w、FLAIR、比率推导及其多模态组合）在基于nnU-Net的局灶性皮质发育不良（FCD）分割中的表现。85例FCD和25例健康对照数据集上，四通道多模态配置（T1w+FLAIR+比率）取得最高Dice分数0.376，较传统T1w+FLAIR相对提升5.0%。
Motivation: FCD是药物难治性癫痫的主要结构性病因，但其在常规MRI上影像特征细微且异质，自动分割困难；不同MRI表示对深度学习分割的贡献尚不明确。
Method: 采用nnU-Net框架，评估八种输入配置（单模态T1w、FLAIR、比率推导及多模态组合），所有实验使用相同预处理、网络架构、优化策略和五折交叉验证。
Result: 单模态中FLAIR性能最优，比率推导表示不足；四通道多模态组合（T1w+FLAIR+比率）达到最高Dice 0.376，相对提升5.0%。
Conclusion: MRI表示设计是深度学习FCD分割中重要但被低估的环节，应与网络架构协同优化。

papers.title: WREN: Low Light Image Enhancement Using Retinex theory-based Double U-Net-like Structures
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a neural network for low light image enhancement (LLIE) based on retinex theory to make LLIE robust for various dynamic range scenes. The retinex theory is an image formulation model inspired by a human color perception hypothesis, where a low light image is decomposed into intrinsic color context (i.e., reflectance map) and scene-dependent illumination (i.e., illumination map). Due to non-uniqueness of its decomposition, existing retinex-based LLIE methods often fail to achieve stable decomposition, which lead to over-enhancement. Typically, they are sensitive to the dynamic ranges that vary in different lighting conditions. To tackle this issue, we propose WREN: An LLIE neural network with double U-Net-like structures. WREN consists of two U-Net-like sub-networks. The first network has one encoder and two decoders that decompose an input image into the reflectance and illumination maps. The second network with a customized Transformer block between an encoder and a decoder only enhances the illumination map obtained from the first network: This completely follows the assumption of the retinex theory. Finally, the enhanced illumination map is recombined with the reflectance map. The network is trained end-to-end with a scale-invariant loss function, which gives robustness against the illumination scaling. Numerical results show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance across multiple datasets. Our code is available online.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WREN，一种基于Retinex理论的双U-Net结构神经网络用于低光图像增强。网络由两个子网组成：第一个分解反射率和照度图，第二个用Transformer增强照度图，最后重组。采用尺度不变损失函数端到端训练，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有Retinex方法对动态范围敏感，分解不稳定导致过增强。
Method: 双U-Net结构：第一网络一编码器两解码器分解反射率和照度；第二网络用Transformer块增强照度；尺度不变损失。
Result: 多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 该方法遵循Retinex理论假设，鲁棒处理不同动态范围场景。

papers.title: Geometric Distillation from Rectified Stereo: Leveraging Epipolar Cues for Monocular Depth
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth foundation models have demonstrated remarkable generalization capabilities across diverse environments. However, they continue to struggle with metric depth estimation in diverse environments. This limitation stems from the inherent scale ambiguity of single-view inference, leading to misaligned scale predictions even when the relative geometry is accurate. Conversely, recent multi-view foundation models leverage cross-view cues to learn robust scene-level geometry and consistent scale. Yet, these benefits typically vanish during single-image inference, as the absence of explicit geometric constraints causes performance to degrade. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel framework that transfers the scale-aware geometric priors of multi-view models into monocular depth foundation models. Specifically, we introduce an Epipolar Distillation (EpiDistill), an approach utilizing Rectified Stereo Tokens, which enables the single-view prediction model to retain epipolar attention patterns and maintain geometric consistency without requiring multi-view inputs at inference. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves zero-shot metric depth estimation, particularly on challenging datasets like ETH3D and DIODE where scale alignment is critical. Furthermore, our approach is model-agnostic, consistently boosting the performance of state-of-the-art ViT-based models, including UniDepthV2 and DepthPro.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将多视图几何先验蒸馏到单目深度基础模型的方法。通过引入极线蒸馏（EpiDistill）和矫正立体标记（Rectified Stereo Tokens），使单视图预测模型无需多视图输入即可保持极线注意力模式和几何一致性。实验表明该方法显著提升零样本度量深度估计性能，尤其在ETH3D和DIODE等数据集上改善尺度对齐。
Motivation: 单目深度基础模型在多样环境中表现优异，但受限于单视图固有的尺度模糊性，导致度量深度估计时尺度预测不准。多视图模型虽能利用跨视图线索学习一致尺度，但在单图像推理时因缺乏几何约束而性能下降。
Method: 提出EpiDistill框架，利用矫正立体标记将多视图模型的尺度感知几何先验转移到单目深度基础模型。通过蒸馏使单视图预测模型保留极线注意力模式，无需多视图输入即可维持几何一致性。
Result: 零样本度量深度估计性能显著提升，尤其在ETH3D和DIODE等尺度对齐关键的挑战性数据集上。方法具有模型无关性，能持续提升UniDepthV2和DepthPro等基于ViT的最先进模型。
Conclusion: 本文展示了多视图几何先验可以有效蒸馏到单目深度模型，弥补了单视图尺度模糊的缺陷，且所提方法可泛化到不同骨干网络。

papers.title: Scalable LLM Agent Tool Access in the Cloud
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on tool calling to act on external systems, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has quickly become its de facto interface. Operating MCP at cloud scale, however, becomes difficult. On the tool provider side, legacy services are not directly callable through MCP; the rapid protocol development also creates ongoing compatibility cost. On the agent side, the number of accessible tool is limited by the LLM context window and inference overhead; mounting a large tool set increases token usage and inference latency and can reduce task success rate. Moreover, for stateful MCP backends with multiple replicas, preserving session affinity increases client-side complexity. We present a cloud-scale gateway system for MCP service. It breaks the direct-connect model on the data plane and offloads legacy service integration, consolidating incompatible MCP variants, access control, tool recommendation, and session-aware routing to the gateway. Hybrid retrieval sustains 98% Top-15 recall; it scales agent tool access to 3,000+ with high tool selection accuracy, and reduces tool selection time by $8.9\times$ and token usage by $23.8\times$, with low per-call overhead, stable under scale-out. Finally, we share the lessons learned from deploying the gateway system in production.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM agent在云环境中使用Model Context Protocol (MCP)调用工具时面临的集成困难、兼容性成本、上下文窗口限制及状态保持等问题，提出一个云规模网关系统。该系统在数据平面上打破直接连接模型，将遗留服务集成、协议变体合并、访问控制、工具推荐和会话感知路由卸载至网关。摘要报告混合检索达到98% Top-15召回，支持3000+工具，工具选择时间降低8.9倍，token使用量降低23.8倍，且开销低、扩展稳定。
Motivation: 现有MCP在云规模部署困难：传统服务无法直接通过MCP调用，协议快速演进带来持续兼容成本；agent端可访问工具数量受限于LLM上下文窗口和推理开销，大量工具增加token使用和延迟并可能降低任务成功率；有状态MCP后端多副本时保持会话亲和性增加客户端复杂度。
Method: 提出云规模网关系统，在数据平面消除直接连接，将遗留服务集成、不兼容MCP变体合并、访问控制、工具推荐和会话感知路由等功能卸载到网关。工具推荐采用混合检索（hybrid retrieval）方法。
Result: 混合检索达到98% Top-15召回；扩展agent工具访问至3000+且保持高选择精度；工具选择时间降低8.9倍，token使用量降低23.8倍；每次调用开销低，在扩展时保持稳定。
Conclusion: 分享在生产中部署该网关系统的经验教训，表明网关架构可有效解决MCP云规模部署中的多维度问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MGDT: MLLM-Guided Diffusion Transformer with Relation-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion (MKGC) requires inferring missing entities from structural, textual, and visual cues. Existing diffusion-based MKGC methods usually denoise directly on raw multimodal features. Such a design forces the denoiser to simultaneously perform relation-dependent cue selection, cross-modal semantic alignment, and structure-aware entity generation, which introduces noisy and semantically inconsistent conditions for diffusion and consequently leads to suboptimal completion performance. To address this limitation, we propose MGDT: MLLM-Guided Diffusion Transformer with Relation-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MGDT), a novel MKGC framework built on an align-then-diffuse paradigm. MGDT first employs a Relation-Adaptive Semantic Routing Mixture-of-Experts (RASR-MoE) module to select relation-relevant multimodal semantic transformation paths and suppress irrelevant modality interference. MGDT then uses a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as a semantic anchor to align the routed multimodal representations into a unified latent space and reduce cross-modal semantic heterogeneity. Finally, a Knowledge Graph Diffusion Transformer (KGDT) performs graph-conditioned denoising generation in the aligned space to produce the missing entity representation. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that MGDT consistently outperforms strong baselines.

TL;DR: 本文针对多模态知识图谱补全任务，提出MGDT框架，采用'先对齐再扩散'的范式，通过关系自适应语义路由MoE模块选择关系相关模态特征，利用冻结的多模态大语言模型对齐语义，最后用知识图谱扩散Transformer生成缺失实体。实验表明在三个基准数据集上优于现有方法。

papers.title: Field-Aware RankMixer with Dual-Stream Bilinear Fusion for the Tencent UNI-REC Challenge
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents our solution to the KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UNIREC Challenge. The task requires joint modeling of multi-domain user behavior sequences and non-sequential multi-field features for target-ad pCVR prediction. We develop a Field-Aware RankMixer (FA-RankMixer) with dual-stream bilinear fusion. The model first applies target-aware DIN modules to extract user interests from multiple behavior domains. It also models recent and earlier interests separately for the longest behavior sequence. The model then forms semantic tokens based on feature fields and behavior domains and uses RankMixer blocks for cross-token interaction. A shallow MLP stream complements the deep RankMixer stream, and a group-wise bilinear module fuses their representations. Our final solution ranks ninth on the official leaderboard. Our code is available at https://github.com/PixelCookie-zyf/TAAC-2026-SeRankMixer.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UNIREC Challenge

papers.title: MemoGuard: An Adaptive Runtime for Guarding Against Memory Traps in Communication-Limited Robot Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Communication-limited robots in mission-critical scenarios such as disaster inspection and search-and-rescue must make reliable onboard decisions without access to remote operators or high-capacity reasoning services. Episodic memory reuse is an attractive low-cost fallback, but retrieval similarity does not guarantee execution validity, i.e., a retrieved action may match the current context yet be unsafe due to changed topology, insufficient battery margin, or unreliable prior outcomes. We call such high-similarity but execution-invalid episodes memory traps. This creates a safety-efficiency design space where similarity only reuse minimizes fallback cost but can be unsafe, while always invoking local reasoning improves safety at high computational and energy cost. This paper presents MemoGuard, a lightweight adaptive runtime that validates episodic memories against topology, resource, and outcome contracts before reuse, invoking fallback only when validation fails. In a graph-based corridor-inspection simulator, MemoGuard reduces battery safety violations by 76.6% over similarity-only top-1 reuse while reducing fallback calls by 21.4% over always reasoning. On an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier with local llama3.2:3b fallback reasoning, this corresponds to 3.67 s and 36.97 J of avoided fallback-reasoning overhead per trial. We open-source MemoGuard at https://github.com/hetheiin/memoguard.
papers.comment: Paper accepted at IEEE/ACM ESWEEK (CODES) 2026. Authors' version posted for personal use and not for redistribution. The definitive version of the paper will appear in IEEE Embedded Systems Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对通信受限机器人在关键任务导航中因重用旧记忆而导致的安全问题，提出了一种轻量级自适应运行时 MemGuard。通过验证记忆是否符合拓扑、资源和结果合约，MemGuard 在保证安全性的同时降低了回退（fallback）调用次数，在走廊巡检仿真中电池安全违规减少 76.6%，回退开销降低 21.4%。
Motivation: 在通信受限的机器人任务（如灾难巡检、搜救）中，直接重用高相似度的历史记忆可能导致不安全行为（内存陷阱）。现有方法要么全部重用（不安全），要么全部调用本地推理（高能耗），缺乏安全与效率的平衡。
Method: 提出 MemGuard，一种在重用记忆前检查拓扑、资源和结果合约的轻量级自适应运行时，仅当验证失败时调用回退推理（fallback reasoning）。
Result: 在走廊巡检仿真器中，与仅基于相似度的 top-1 重用相比，MemGuard 将电池安全违规减少 76.6%，同时回退调用次数比始终推理方案减少 21.4%；在 Jetson AGX Xavier 上每次试验节省 3.67 秒和 36.97 焦耳的开销。
Conclusion: MemGuard 通过引入合约验证机制，有效降低了记忆重用的安全风险，同时保持了较低的计算开销，适用于资源受限的机器人导航场景。

papers.title: Rethinking Transfer in Continual Learning: A Replay-Based Realisation
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning studies how deployed language models can continually acquire new tasks without expensive retraining from scratch. Existing methods, whether rehearsal-based (replaying stored past data) or rehearsal-free (regularising or isolating parameters), overwhelmingly target one objective: preventing catastrophic forgetting. Forward transfer, the past helping the future, has meanwhile been pursued almost exclusively through parameter reuse, with no explicit account of when transfer should be expected at all. We begin one step earlier: before designing a transfer mechanism, we ask when transfer should exist at all. We answer with a framework of three measurable conditions: the target task must leave room for improvement beyond its own limited supervision, transferable information must survive continued optimisation, and replay must come from compatible previous tasks. We instantiate this view as Transfer-Selective Replay (TSR), which selects replay data predicted to benefit the incoming task rather than replaying past examples indiscriminately. Selection is guided by a zero-training task signature, while distillation preserves stability on previous tasks. Under the standard continual learning protocol in the low-budget regime, TSR consistently improves forward transfer while maintaining stability, outperforming existing replay baselines across heterogeneous and homogeneous task streams. More broadly, the results argue for treating transfer as a first-class objective of continual learning, to be understood before it is engineered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨持续学习中前向迁移（forward transfer）的条件与机制，提出一个基于三个可测量条件的框架，并实例化为迁移选择性回放（TSR）方法。TSR通过零训练任务签名选择有益于新任务的回放数据，并在低预算持续学习协议下提升前向迁移同时保持稳定性。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要聚焦于防止灾难性遗忘，而对前向迁移（过去任务帮助未来任务）的研究较少，且缺乏明确的迁移条件分析。
Method: 提出三个可测量的迁移条件：目标任务在自身监督之外仍有改进空间、可迁移信息在持续优化中存活、回放数据来自兼容的先前任务。基于此设计TSR方法，使用零训练任务签名指导回放数据选择，通过蒸馏保持旧任务稳定性。
Result: 在标准持续学习协议的低预算设置下，TSR在异构和同构任务流中均优于现有回放基线，一致提升前向迁移并保持稳定性。
Conclusion: 论文主张将迁移视为持续学习的一级目标，应先理解迁移条件再设计机制。

papers.title: Information-Directed Sampling for Causal Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Causal bandits exploit structural relationships among variables to share information across interventions and accelerate the identification of high-reward decisions. In many applications, however, some variables cannot be directly manipulated, even though they influence the reward and provide useful information about the underlying causal system. We study contextual causal bandits with non-manipulable variables, where context variables are observed before action selection and additional variables are observed after each intervention. Assuming a known causal graph without latent confounding, we adopt a Bayesian formulation in which the conditional probability tables of the observational distribution constitute the unknown parameter. This representation allows observations collected under one intervention to update reward estimates for other interventions through their shared causal mechanisms. We develop causal variants of Thompson Sampling and Information-Directed Sampling (IDS) for this setting. For Thompson Sampling, we establish an entropy-dependent sublinear Bayesian regret bound. For IDS, we derive an entropy-dependent regret bound that explicitly quantifies the additional error introduced by Monte Carlo approximation of the expected regret and information gain; when these quantities are available exactly, the bound recovers the standard sublinear IDS rate. We further provide high-probability confidence bounds for the Monte Carlo estimates used by the algorithm. Experiments on several synthetic causal bandit tasks show that the proposed methods outperform causal and non-causal baselines by more effectively exploiting information shared across interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带不可操纵变量的因果多臂老虎机（causal bandits），其中上下文变量在动作选择前观测，其余变量在干预后观测。假设已知无隐变量因果图，采用贝叶斯方法将观测分布的条件概率表作为未知参数，使得不同干预下的观测可以通过共享因果机制更新彼此奖励估计。作者提出了Thompson Sampling和Information-Directed Sampling（IDS）的因果变体，并给出了贝叶斯遗憾界。
Motivation: 实际应用中某些变量不可直接操纵，但影响奖励并提供因果信息，现有因果老虎机方法未充分考虑此类非可操纵变量。
Method: 采用贝叶斯框架，以观测分布的条件概率表为未知参数；提出Thompson Sampling和IDS的因果版本；对IDS，推导了蒙特卡洛近似误差的遗憾界。
Result: 在合成因果老虎机任务上，所提方法优于因果和非因果基线，更有效利用跨干预共享的信息。理论方面给出了熵依赖的亚线性贝叶斯遗憾界。
Conclusion: 摘要强调方法有效利用因果结构共享信息，对IDS的蒙特卡洛近似提供了置信界。

papers.title: Ask Twice, Look Twice: Prompt Echoing Resolves the Question-First Paradox in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Where should the question go in a vision-language model (VLM) prompt: before the image or after it? Intuition says before: knowing what is asked should tell the model where to look. Yet across visual question answering benchmarks, question-first prompting consistently underperforms the image-first ordering recommended for frontier VLMs, a phenomenon we term the question-first paradox. We trace the paradox to a conflict between two stages of VLM computation. Logit-lens and attention probes show the intuition is half right: a question placed before the image genuinely steers perception, moving image patch representations toward question-relevant concepts. The failure lies downstream. Stranded behind hundreds of image tokens, the question is barely attended by the answer token, which instead commits to image-driven (often wrong) answers; a causal attention knockout confirms that the answer reads the question only when the question follows the image. The diagnosis yields a training-free fix: question echoing, restating the question on both sides of the image so that one copy steers perception while the other is read out at answer time. The same division of labor appears in a fifty-year-old finding on human ``adjunct questions'', where repeating a question before and after a passage aids comprehension more than either position alone. Echoing the image as well brings further gains, restoring the whole-image view a causal decoder otherwise loses. The paradox holds across five open VLMs, costing up to 17.5 group-accuracy points. Echoed prompts close it and surpass the best single-pass ordering on NaturalBench, POPE, Winoground, and open-ended VQAv2, by up to 19 Winoground group-accuracy points, with no training, fine-tuning, or architecture change. The paradox reveals a trade-off between steering perception and preserving question access; echoing resolves it through prompt design alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了视觉语言模型（VLM）中的一个悖论：直觉上问题放在图像之前应有助于引导视觉感知，但实际效果反而更差，称为“问题优先悖论”（question-first paradox）。作者通过logit-lens和注意力探针分析发现，问题前置确实能引导图像块表示向问题相关概念移动，但答案token由于被大量图像令牌隔离，几乎不关注前置问题，而是依赖图像驱动（常错误）的答案。为此提出无需训练的“提示回声”（prompt echoing）技巧：在图像前后各重复一次问题，使一份副本引导感知，另一份在答案时被读取。该技巧在五个开源VLM上消除了悖论，并在NaturalBench、POPE、Winoground和开放式VQAv2基准上超越最佳单次顺序，最高提升19个Winoground群体准确率点。
Motivation: 现有VLM提示中，问题前置（question-first）直觉上应优于图像前置（image-first），实际却持续表现更差，形成一个悖论。理解其根源对于优化VLM提示设计至关重要。
Method: 提出“提示回声”（prompt echoing）：构造形如“[问题] [图像] [问题]”的输入序列，使得第一部分问题引导感知，第二部分问题在答案生成时被读取。同时，对图像也进行回声可进一步恢复因果解码器丢失的全图视角。
Result: 问题优先序在五个开源VLM上造成高达17.5个群体准确率点的损失；回声提示（echoed prompts）消除该损失，并在NaturalBench、POPE、Winoground和开放VQAv2上超越所有单次顺序，最高提升19个Winoground群体准确率点。
Conclusion: 悖论本质是引导感知与保持问题可访问性之间的权衡；通过简单的提示设计（回声）即可解决，无需训练或架构变更。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文揭示了视觉语言模型（VLM）中的一个悖论：直觉上问题放在图像之前应有助于引导视觉感知，但实际效果反而更差，称为“问题优先悖论”（question-first paradox）。作者通过logit-lens和注意力探针分析发现，问题前置确实能引导图像块表示向问题相关概念移动，但答案token由于被大量图像令牌隔离，几乎不关注前置问题，而是依赖图像驱动（常错误）的答案。为此提出无需训练的“提示回声”（prompt echoing）技巧：在图像前后各重复一次问题，使一份副本引导感知，另一份在答案时被读取。该技巧在五个开源VLM上消除了悖论，并在NaturalBench、POPE、Winoground和开放式VQAv2基准上超越最佳单次顺序，最高提升19个Winoground群体准确率点。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有VLM提示中，问题前置（question-first）直觉上应优于图像前置（image-first），实际却持续表现更差，形成一个悖论。理解其根源对于优化VLM提示设计至关重要。
summary_sections.method: 提出“提示回声”（prompt echoing）：构造形如“[问题] [图像] [问题]”的输入序列，使得第一部分问题引导感知，第二部分问题在答案生成时被读取。同时，对图像也进行回声可进一步恢复因果解码器丢失的全图视角。
summary_sections.result: 问题优先序在五个开源VLM上造成高达17.5个群体准确率点的损失；回声提示（echoed prompts）消除该损失，并在NaturalBench、POPE、Winoground和开放VQAv2上超越所有单次顺序，最高提升19个Winoground群体准确率点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 悖论本质是引导感知与保持问题可访问性之间的权衡；通过简单的提示设计（回声）即可解决，无需训练或架构变更。

papers.title: Are All Tokens Necessary for Visual Place Recognition? An Empirical Study of Token Reduction for Efficient Inference
papers.abstract_en: Recent visual place recognition (VPR) methods based on vision transformers, particularly foundation models, have achieved remarkable recognition performance. However, these models process all visual tokens throughout the entire network, resulting in substantial computational overhead, which hinders their deployment in real-time and resource-constrained scenarios. A natural question thus arises: are all visual tokens necessary for VPR? To answer this question, we present the first systematic benchmark of token reduction for efficient visual place recognition. Our benchmark comprehensively evaluates representative token pruning, token merging, and hybrid pruning-merging methods across multiple state-of-the-art VPR models and diverse benchmark datasets covering urban, suburban, and natural environments. We further investigate token reduction from multiple perspectives, including recognition performance under different reduction configurations, computational complexity, inference speed, qualitative visualization, and deployment efficiency on edge devices. Through extensive experiments and in-depth analysis, our benchmark reveals multiple important characteristics of token reduction in VPR and provides several practical insights into the trade-offs between accuracy and inference efficiency. For example, token reduction can reduce computational cost by up to 29\% and improve throughput by up to 44\%, while incurring less than 1\% degradation in recognition accuracy. Overall, this work establishes a comprehensive foundation for future research on token-efficient VPR and efficient visual retrieval systems. Our codes and models will be available at https://github.com/Tong-Jin01/TokenReduction4VPR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地研究了视觉位置识别（VPR）中token reduction方法的有效性，比较了token剪枝、合并及混合方法在多种VPR模型和数据集上的表现。实验表明，token reduction可在保持识别精度下降小于1%的情况下，降低最多29%的计算量并提升44%的吞吐量。
Motivation: 基于视觉Transformer的VPR方法虽然性能优异，但处理所有视觉token导致计算开销大，限制了其在实时和资源受限场景下的部署。因此需要探究是否所有token都是必要的。
Method: 构建了一个系统性的token reduction基准，涵盖token剪枝、token合并以及剪枝-合并混合方法，在多个VPR模型和涵盖城市、郊区、自然环境的多样化数据集上进行评测，并从识别性能、计算复杂度、推理速度、可视化和边缘设备部署效率等多角度分析。
Result: token reduction可减少最多29%的计算成本，提升最多44%的吞吐量，同时识别精度下降不超过1%。
Conclusion: 该工作为token高效的VPR和高效视觉检索系统建立了基础，并提供了精度与推理效率之间权衡的实用洞察。

papers.title: Hard Rules, Soft Preferences: Bridging Reasoning, Learning, and Optimization for Personalized Packing Checklist Generation
papers.abstract_en: Packing for air travel is recurring and error-prone: the checklist must be personal and context-aware, yet feasible under safety rules, item dependencies, and luggage limits. Existing packing assistants are template-driven and generic, or recommendation-driven but unconstrained, leaving users to manually patch regulatory and capacity violations. We propose a reasoning-guided learning framework with three stages: (1) a symbolic engine that generates a regulation-aware seed checklist with explicit dependency structure, (2) a two-stage preference learner that estimates inclusion and priority utilities from user add and remove actions while mitigating survivorship bias, and (3) a CP-SAT optimizer that selects a compact, compliant subset. The architecture instantiates a general pattern for constrained personalization, applicable wherever hard feasibility coexists with sparse preference signals. On 604 labeled trip scenarios, comprising 29K inclusion labels and 343K pairwise comparisons, the symbolic engine attains 99.7% recall and 0.96 rubric validity, compared with 0.78 to 0.81 for frontier LLMs. Gradient-boosted trees and LambdaMART reach an AUC-ROC of 0.943 and an NDCG@5 of 0.923. CP-SAT attains 100% constraint satisfaction, compared with 28% for greedy selection and 10% for random selection. Deployment in FlyEnJoy, a production iOS travel app, doubled checklist completions and reduced editing and completion time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种推理引导的学习框架，用于生成个性化且符合旅行安全规则的打包清单。该框架包含三个部分：符号引擎生成合规种子清单、两阶段偏好学习器从用户操作中估计偏好、CP-SAT优化器选择合规子集。在604个带标签旅行场景上，符号引擎召回率99.7%，有效性0.96；偏好学习器AUC-ROC 0.943，NDCG@5 0.923；优化器100%满足约束。部署到生产应用后，清单完成率翻倍。
Motivation: 现有打包助手要么基于模板缺乏个性化，要么推荐但忽略约束，用户需手动修补违规问题。需要一种方法在硬约束（安全规则、行李限制）和软偏好（用户个性化需求）之间取得平衡。
Method: 三阶段框架：符号引擎（基于规则生成合规种子清单）→ 两阶段偏好学习器（先估计包含偏好，再估计优先偏好，缓解幸存者偏差）→ CP-SAT优化器（选择紧凑合规子集）。
Result: 符号引擎召回率99.7%，有效性0.96（GPT-4等LLM为0.78-0.81）；偏好学习器AUC-ROC 0.943，NDCG@5 0.923；CP-SAT约束满足率100%（贪心28%，随机10%）。部署后清单完成次数翻倍，编辑和完成时间减少。
Conclusion: 该架构适用于任何既有硬约束又有稀疏偏好信号的个性化场景，展示了推理、学习与优化结合的有效性。

papers.title: Evolutionary Algorithm-Guided LLMs for Physics-Informed Neural Network Design
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are unusually sensitive to interacting choices of architecture, activation, loss weighting, collocation, optimization, and constraint enforcement. Large language models (LLMs) can propose these choices, but independent recommendations do not accumulate experience from previously trained PINNs. We propose a closed-loop evolutionary algorithm that guides an LLM to generate complete, executable PINN configurations across generations, using measured training outcomes to determine subsequent search decisions. The algorithm maintains an evaluated population and lineage, applies parent-conditioned mutation and crossover, preserves elite and diverse solutions, rejects effective duplicates, and converts parent-relative successes and failures into the next-generation context supplied to the LLM. Every proposed configuration is executed directly under an exact optimizer-step budget. On a one-dimensional multiscale wave equation, two independent ten-generation runs trained 60 PINNs for 600,000 optimizer steps. In both runs, the best configuration appeared in the final generation, with best mean-squared error reduced by 2.97\% and 95.38\% relative to the initial population. The stronger run validated residual connections and increased depth on separate branches, combined them in a later generation, and then refined width and collocation density. It also revealed that low solution error can coexist with a high PDE residual. These results demonstrate the feasibility of evolutionary-algorithm-guided LLMs for PINN design on a controlled PDE while motivating broader, physics-aware evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种闭环进化算法，引导大语言模型（LLM）生成完整的物理信息神经网络（PINN）配置，并通过训练结果反馈指导后续搜索。在一维多尺度波动方程上，两轮十代进化共训练60个PINN，最佳配置出现在最后一代，均方误差相比初始群体降低2.97%和95.38%。实验表明该方法可行，并揭示了低解误差可与高PDE残差共存。
Motivation: PINN对架构、激活函数、损失权重等众多选择异常敏感，LLM虽能独立推荐这些选择，但无法累积先前训练经验，导致搜索效率低。
Method: 设计闭环进化算法：维护已评估的种群和谱系，使用父代条件变异和交叉，保留精英和多样化解，拒绝有效重复，并将父代相对成功/失败转化为下一代上下文输入LLM；每个配置在精确优化步预算下直接执行。
Result: 在一维多尺度波动方程上，两轮10代进化各训练60个PINN（共600,000优化步），最优配置均出现在末代，最佳MSE相对初始群体分别降低2.97%和95.38%；较优运行验证了残差连接和分支加深，并在后续代中组合优化宽度和配点密度。
Conclusion: 该方法在受控PDE上验证了进化算法引导LLM设计PINN的可行性，但需要更广泛的物理感知评估。

papers.title: When Can Test-Time Adaptation Help Zero-Shot CT Vision-Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: 3D CT vision-language models (VLMs) classify abnormalities from text prompts in a zero-shot manner, enabling cross-institution deployment where labels are scarce and clinical tasks shift faster than supervised models can be retrained. A real CT scan, however, typically contains several co-occurring abnormalities, and the reliability of zero-shot multi-label prediction under distribution shift remains poorly understood. Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a model on unlabeled target scans without source data or target annotations, yet existing TTA methods target multi-class softmax prediction on natural images or 2D medical segmentation, and none addresses unsupervised multi-label adaptation for zero-shot 3D CT VLMs. We study when TTA helps zero-shot 3D CT VLMs. A controlled diagnostic analysis shows that TTA is conditional: the volumetric input must preserve the encoder's depth structure, and the base representation must transfer to the target cohort, with depth reduction alone lowering internal AUROC by more than 0.12. We then focus on the regime where the base model already separates present from absent abnormalities. We introduce CARVE (Cardinality-Aware Retained-View Entropy), the first TTA method for this setting. CARVE estimates a sample-specific positive-label cardinality $\hat{k}$, optimizes a top-$\hat{k}$ objective to preserve co-occurring abnormalities, and performs memory-efficient multi-view adaptation by scoring weak 3D views without gradients before updating on a retained subset. Across contrastive CT-CLIP and anatomy-aware fVLM, CARVE provides the most consistent improvements across multi-label, three-class, and binary CT tasks when the base model is already discriminative. These results establish multi-label TTA for zero-shot 3D CT VLMs as a distinct problem and CARVE as a cardinality-aware solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试时自适应（TTA）能否帮助零样本3D CT视觉语言模型（VLM）进行多标签异常分类。通过诊断分析发现TTA的有效性有条件：输入需保留编码器深度结构且基表征需迁移到目标队列。作者提出CARVE方法，利用基数感知保留视图熵，在基模型已能区分异常时提供最一致的改进。
Motivation: 现有TTA方法针对自然图像的多类softmax预测或2D医学分割，未解决零样本3D CT VLM的无监督多标签自适应问题，而真实CT扫描常包含多种共存异常，分布偏移下零样本多标签预测的可靠性不明确。
Method: 提出CARVE（Cardinality-Aware Retained-View Entropy），估计样本特定正标签基数k，优化top-k目标以保留共存异常，通过无梯度评分弱3D视图后更新保留子集实现内存高效多视图自适应。
Result: 在对比CT-CLIP和解剖感知fVLM上，当基模型已具判别性时，CARVE在多标签、三分类和二分类CT任务中提供最一致的性能提升。
Conclusion: 确立了多标签TTA作为零样本3D CT VLM的独立问题，并证明CARVE作为基数感知解决方案的有效性。

papers.title: From Feasibility to Desirability: Plan, Learn, Adapt (PLA) Framework for Personalized On-Device Itinerary Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating personalized trip itineraries is a complex planning task and involves a tension between hard combinatorial feasibility and soft latent desirability. Classical optimization enforces constraints but fails to capture subjective traveler preferences. While learning-based approaches model preferences, they cannot guarantee feasibility. Mobile deployment imposes additional resource constraints on both. To address this, we propose Plan, Learn, Adapt (PLA), a three-stage framework for personalized on-device itinerary generation. The Plan stage builds a heterogeneous ensemble of lightweight planners that produces structurally diverse feasible candidates. From pairwise itinerary comparisons, Learn fits a compact Bradley-Terry reward model that captures emergent schedule properties such as pacing, geographic coherence, and day balance, which per-POI signals miss. Finally, Adapt applies feasibility-preserving local refinement within a device-aware compute budget; every intermediate state is feasible by construction. On 2,519 pairwise human comparisons across more than 100 U.S. cities, the reward-guided ensemble achieves a 67.8% win rate, 11.2 percentage points above the best single planner, with 100% feasibility. Three frontier LLMs, GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.5, and Gemini 3 Pro, achieve 0% feasibility under the same constraints. The reward model generalizes across held-out cities, with a 67.6% mean leave-one-city-out accuracy. In production deployment within FlyEnJoy, PLA increased itinerary completion rates by 91%, with 109.9 ms average on-device latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLA（Plan, Learn, Adapt）三阶段框架，用于在设备端生成个性化旅行行程。Plan阶段构建异质轻量规划器集成产生多样可行候选；Learn阶段通过成对比较拟合Bradley-Terry奖励模型，捕捉步调、地理一致性等涌现属性；Adapt阶段在设备感知预算内进行保持可行性的局部细化。在2519个成对人类比较中，奖励引导集成达到67.8%胜率（超过最佳单规划器11.2个百分点），且100%可行；GPT-5等前沿LLM在同一约束下可行性为0%。在FlyEnJoy产品部署中，行程完成率提高91%，平均延迟109.9毫秒。
Motivation: 个性化行程生成需要在硬组合可行性（hard combinatorial feasibility）和软潜在偏好（soft latent desirability）之间权衡。经典优化无法捕捉主观偏好，学习模型不能保证可行性，移动设备还施加额外资源约束。
Method: 提出PLA三阶段框架：1) Plan阶段：轻量规划器异质集成，生成结构多样且可行的候选行程；2) Learn阶段：从成对行程比较中拟合紧凑Bradley-Terry奖励模型，捕捉单个POI信号无法体现的涌现属性（如步调、地理一致性、日平衡）；3) Adapt阶段：在设备感知计算预算内进行保持可行性的局部细化，确保每个中间状态均可行。
Result: 在2519个成对人类比较（覆盖100+美国城市）中，奖励引导集成胜率67.8%，比最佳单规划器高11.2个百分点，且100%可行。GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.5、Gemini 3 Pro在相同约束下可行性为0%。奖励模型在留一城市验证中平均准确率67.6%。在FlyEnJoy产品部署中，行程完成率提升91%，平均设备端延迟109.9毫秒。

papers.title: SeerGuard: A Safety Framework for Mobile GUI Agents via World Model Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in automating complex tasks, yet they introduce critical safety risks where a single erroneous action can lead to irreversible consequences. Existing safety mechanisms are primarily reactive, lacking the ability to assess risks before execution. In this paper, we introduce SeerGuard, a consequence-aware safety framework designed to mitigate these risks through pre-execution instruction-level screening and action-level risk assessment. Specifically, the action-level assessment analyzes agent-proposed actions within current GUI states, anticipating likely outcomes to identify risks before they are executed. To enable these capabilities, we construct a unified safety-augmented world model (SAWM) via multi-task learning, integrating semantic next-state prediction with safety risk assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SeerGuard generalizes effectively across diverse mobile GUI agents. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, it increases the safety-utility score from $0.191$ to $0.596$ at $ω=0.8$ and reduces the risk-cost score from $0.347$ to $0.130$ at $α=0.8$. Further analyses on our SAWM validate the effectiveness of the instruction-level screening, alongside the capability of action risk assessment and next-state prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeerGuard 是一个面向移动 GUI 代理的安全框架，通过预执行指令级筛查和动作级风险评估来预防危险动作。它构建了统一的安全增强世界模型（SAWM），利用多任务学习同时进行语义下一状态预测和安全风险评估。实验表明，在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，SeerGuard 将安全效用分数从 0.191 提升至 0.596（ω=0.8），风险成本分数从 0.347 降至 0.130（α=0.8）。
Motivation: 现有移动 GUI 代理的安全机制主要为反应式，缺乏执行前评估风险的能力，可能导致单一错误动作引发不可逆后果。
Method: 提出 SeerGuard 框架，包含指令级筛查和动作级风险评估；通过多任务学习构建安全增强世界模型（SAWM），集成语义下一状态预测与安全风险评估。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，安全效用分数从 0.191 提升至 0.596（ω=0.8），风险成本分数从 0.347 降至 0.130（α=0.8），并验证了指令级筛查和动作风险预测的有效性。
Conclusion: SeerGuard 能够有效提升移动 GUI 代理的安全性，且具有良好的跨代理泛化能力。

papers.title: CoWeaver: A Bi-directional, Learnable and Explainable Matching Engine for Mixed Human-Agent Science Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents excel at writing articles, coding and information retrieval. However, they fail to form strong collaborations within the scientific community due to the bidirectional, dynamic nature of the problem and a high demand of decision interpretability. We proposed COWEAVER, a bidirectional, learnable and explainable algorithm to match scientists and form strong collaborations within a human-agent network. COWEAVER matches candidates and requesters through filling capability gaps and filters candidates through a two-stage ranking step. Finally, the model explores newcomers by maintaining uncertainty-aware capability estimates and updating them through requester's feedback. We show that the selection mechanism of combining both exploration (UCB) and greedy of COWEAVER exceeds the greedy-only mechanism - the analytical best solution - on 6 out of the 20 tasks and performed on par with the greedy-only mechanism in terms of selecting the best candidate. We compared COWEAVER baselines in terms of matching quality and efficiency. COWEAVER outperforms baselines on all metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoWeaver，一个双向、可学习且可解释的匹配算法，用于在混合人类-智能体网络中形成协作。算法通过填补能力缺口匹配候选者与需求者，使用两阶段排序过滤候选者，并通过不确定性估计与反馈探索新成员。实验表明结合探索与贪婪的机制在20个任务中的6个上优于纯贪婪机制，并在所有指标上超越基线。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体在科学协作中无法形成强合作，因为问题具有双向动态性且需要决策可解释性。
Method: 提出CoWeaver，包含三个关键部分：通过能力缺口匹配候选者与需求者；两阶段排序筛选；以及不确定性感知的探索（UCB）与贪婪结合，并通过需求者反馈更新能力估计。
Result: 在20个任务中，结合探索与贪婪的机制在6个任务上优于纯贪婪（解析最优解），其余任务上表现相当；在所有评估指标上CoWeaver优于基线。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了在混合人类-智能体网络中通过可学习的匹配和探索机制提升协作质量的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ImprovedVBGS: Real-time Continual Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: On-the-fly reconstruction is a key requirement for many applications in robotics and autonomous navigation. Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) enables continual learning without replay buffers using Coordinate Ascent Variational Inference (CAVI), but its per-frame iterations over all observed points make it too slow for real-time use with strict memory and latency requirements. We present ImprovedVBGS, an accelerated framework for on-the-fly continual reconstruction. This is achieved primarily through (i) spatially truncated variational inference, and (ii) improved reassignment that uses forwarding, truncation and eliminates wasteful dynamic recompilation. On the NeRF synthetic dataset, we reduce mean per-frame latency from ~84.0 s to ~0.050 s on an RTX 3070 Ti, a 1680x speed-up while maintaining reconstruction quality.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figure. Technical Report. This work introduces ImprovedVBGS, accelerated continual learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting based Reconstruction. Code available at [https://github.com/damanimc/ImprovedVBGS](https://github.com/damanimc/ImprovedVBGS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ImprovedVBGS，一种加速的实时持续变分贝叶斯高斯泼溅（VBGS）框架，用于在线三维重建。通过空间截断变分推断和改进的重分配策略，在NeRF合成数据集上将平均每帧延迟从约84秒降低到约0.05秒，实现1680倍加速，且保持重建质量。
Motivation: 现有VBGS方法在持续学习中无需回放缓冲区，但每帧对所有观测点进行迭代，导致延迟过高，无法满足实时应用的严格内存和延迟要求。
Method: 提出两种加速技术：(i) 空间截断变分推断，仅更新局部高斯参数； (ii) 改进的重分配，使用前向传播、截断并消除浪费的动态重新编译。
Result: 在NeRF合成数据集上，在RTX 3070 Ti上实现平均每帧延迟从约84.0秒降至约0.050秒，加速比达1680倍，同时保持重建质量。
Conclusion: ImprovedVBGS通过空间截断和高效重分配实现了实时持续重建，适用于机器人自主导航等场景。

papers.title: E3DGS: Unified Geometric-Photometric Equivariance for 3D Gaussian Splatting via Color-as-Geometry Embedding
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) captures scenes by coupling explicit geometry (position, covariance) with view-dependent photometry (Spherical Harmonics). However, building $\mathrm{SE}(3)$-equivariant architectures on these primitives presents a fundamental representation bottleneck. Color has been treated as a signal rather than a geometric entity, making it nontrivial to unify symmetry across geometry and appearance as the camera frame changes. While translations are handled by relative coordinates, rotations act heterogeneously across attributes: $μ\mapsto Rμ$, $Σ\mapsto RΣR^\top$, and $f_\ell\mapsto D^\ell(R)f_\ell$. This mismatch complicates strict equivariance, leading existing methods to either discard or flatten SH coefficients, thereby breaking symmetry. We propose a unified solution rooted in representation theory: for SH degrees $\ell\le2$, photometry is algebraically isomorphic to a rank-2 geometric tensor. We prove that the Wigner-$D$ action on these SH coefficients can be exactly reformulated as the conjugation action on $3\times3$ matrices. Leveraging this, we introduce the Unified Matrix Embedding, a lifting that maps all Gaussian attributes into a unified carrier space, $\mathfrak{gl}(3)$. Building on the "Color-as-Geometry" formulation, we present E3DGS, a rigid-body ($\mathrm{SE}(3)$) equivariant architecture that processes 3D Gaussians without Clebsch-Gordan tensor products. Evaluations on object vision and action-conditioned Gaussian world modeling demonstrate that our unified approach yields strong robustness under camera-frame changes and improved data efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出E3DGS，一种基于SE(3)等变性的3D高斯飞溅框架。通过将颜色（球谐系数）嵌入为几何张量，统一了高斯属性的几何变换与光度变换，避免了传统方法中丢弃或展平球谐系数导致的对称性破坏。实验表明该方法在物体级视觉和动作条件高斯世界建模任务上对相机视角变化具有强鲁棒性，并提升了数据效率。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯飞溅架构难以实现严格的SE(3)等变性，因为颜色（球谐系数）与几何属性（位置、协方差）在旋转下变换方式不同，导致表示瓶颈。
Method: 基于表示理论，证明对于ℓ≤2的球谐系数，其Wigner-D作用可等价为3×3矩阵的共轭作用；提出统一矩阵嵌入，将高斯属性映射到gl(3)空间，构建无需Clebsch-Gordan张量积的SE(3)等变架构。
Result: 在物体级视觉和动作条件高斯世界建模任务上，E3DGS在相机视角变化下展现出强鲁棒性，并相比现有方法具有更高的数据效率。
Conclusion: 该工作通过颜色-几何统一嵌入解决了3D高斯飞溅中的等变性瓶颈，为场景表示学习提供了更对称的框架。

papers.title: Logic, Optimization, and Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Logic and optimization can, in combination, make valuable contributions to rule-based AI. Logic is the obvious medium for encoding a rule base and drawing inferences from it, while optimization provides a powerful technology for computing inferences. Their combination has taken on new relevance amid a growing concern for transparency in AI. which is important for reproducibility, explainability, trustworthiness, and fairness. Rule-based AI provides a natural solution to transparency that is becoming increasingly practical due to today's highly advanced optimization methods. This article surveys several areas of logic-optimization partnership, including probabilistic logic, Bayesian logic, belief logics and Dempster-Shafer theory, nonmonotonic (default) logic, many-valued logics, and inference of logical formulas from noisy data based on Boolean regression. It shows how to compute projections, the fundamental problem of both logic and optimization, using decision diagrams and logic-based Benders decomposition. It describes the use of postoptimality analysis to explain how conclusions are reached, further enhancing transparency, as well as the role of optimization in answer set programming modulo theories. The paper concludes by suggesting possible future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了逻辑与优化在规则型人工智能中的结合应用，涵盖概率逻辑、贝叶斯逻辑、信念逻辑、Dempster-Shafer理论、非单调逻辑、多值逻辑以及基于布尔回归的逻辑公式推断等方向。文章展示了如何利用决策图和基于逻辑的Benders分解来计算投影（逻辑与优化的基本问题），并讨论了后最优性分析在增强透明度中的作用，以及优化在回答集编程模理论中的角色。最后提出了未来研究方向。
Motivation: 随着对AI透明性（可重复性、可解释性、可信赖性和公平性）的日益关注，规则型AI因其天然透明性而重新受到重视。逻辑适合编码规则库和进行推理，而优化技术则能高效计算推理结果，二者的结合具有重要价值。
Method: 本文采用综述方法，系统梳理了逻辑与优化在多个子领域的合作框架，包括概率逻辑、贝叶斯逻辑、信念逻辑等，并介绍了决策图、逻辑Benders分解、后最优性分析等技术手段。
Result: 文章指出，现代优化方法使得规则型AI的透明性解决方案越来越实用，并展示了如何通过投影计算和解释机制增强推理的可解释性。
Conclusion: 逻辑与优化的结合是提升规则型AI透明性的有效途径，未来可进一步探索更复杂的推理结构和优化算法。
