papers.title: Analysis of Semi-Supervised Learning on Hypergraphs
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraphs provide a natural framework for modeling multiway interactions. We analyze a class of variational semi-supervised learning problems posed on random geometric hypergraphs and establish asymptotic consistency in the large-data limit. In particular, we identify scaling regimes that ensure well-posedness--yielding nontrivial label propagation rather than collapse to a constant labeling--and show that discrete minimizers converge, in the continuum, to solutions of a density-weighted p-Laplacian equation. We also propose Higher-Order Hypergraph Learning (HOHL), a multiscale regularization scheme based on powers of Laplacians associated with hypergraph-induced subgraphs. For geometric point clouds, we analyze an efficient multiscale Laplacian surrogate for HOHL and prove convergence to a higher-order Sobolev-type seminorm. Numerical experiments on standard benchmarks support the practical utility of the resulting higher-order regularization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了随机几何超图上半监督变分学习问题的渐近一致性，识别了确保适定性的缩放机制，并提出了高阶超图学习（HOHL）多尺度正则化方案，数值实验支持其有效性。
Motivation: 超图建模多元交互，但半监督学习的理论保证不足，尤其是大数据极限下的行为。
Method: 分析变分半监督学习问题的渐近一致性，识别缩放机制；提出HOHL多尺度正则化，基于超图诱导子图的拉普拉斯算子幂，并分析其几何点云上的高效多尺度拉普拉斯替代。
Result: 理论表明离散极小化子收敛到密度加权p-Laplacian方程的解；提出的HOHL收敛到高阶Sobolev型半范数，数值实验支持实用性。
Conclusion: 论文为超图上半监督学习提供了理论一致性，并展示了高阶正则化的实际价值。

papers.title: Human-Inspired Neuro-Symbolic World Modeling and Logic Reasoning for Interpretable Safe UAV Landing Site Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Reliable assessment of safe landing sites in unstructured environments is essential for deploying Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in real-world applications such as delivery, inspection, and surveillance. Existing learning-based approaches often degrade under covariate shift and offer limited transparency, making their decisions difficult to interpret and validate on resource-constrained platforms. We present NeuroSymLand, a neuro-symbolic framework for marker-free UAV landing site safety assessment that explicitly separates perception-driven world modeling from logic-based safety reasoning. A lightweight segmentation model incrementally constructs a probabilistic semantic scene graph encoding objects, attributes, and spatial relations. Symbolic safety rules, synthesized offline via large language models with human-in-the-loop refinement, are executed directly over this world model at runtime to perform white-box reasoning, producing ranked landing candidates with human-readable explanations of the underlying safety constraints. Across 72 simulated and hardware-in-the-loop landing scenarios, NeuroSymLand achieves 61 successful assessments, outperforming four competitive baselines, which achieve between 37 and 57 successes. Qualitative analysis highlights its superior interpretability and transparent reasoning, while deployment incurs negligible edge overhead. Our results suggest that combining explicit world modeling with symbolic reasoning can support accurate, interpretable, and edge-deployable safety assessment in mobile systems, as demonstrated through UAV landing site assessment.
papers.comment: The paper has a major update, which is uploaded to https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02277
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NeuroSymLand，一种神经符号框架，用于无人机着陆场地安全评估。框架将感知驱动的世界建模（增量构建概率语义场景图）与基于符号逻辑的安全推理分离，通过大语言模型离线合成符号安全规则并在线执行白盒推理，生成可解释的着陆候选排序。在72个模拟和硬件在环场景中实现61次成功评估，优于四个基线方法（37-57次成功），且边缘部署开销可忽略。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的方法在协变量偏移下性能下降，且决策缺乏透明度，难以在资源受限平台上解释和验证，亟需可解释且可靠的着陆场地评估方法。
Method: 提出NeuroSymLand框架：轻量分割模型增量构建概率语义场景图（含对象、属性、空间关系）；通过大语言模型离线合成符号安全规则并经人工细化，在运行时直接对场景图执行逻辑推理，输出带有人可读解释的着陆候选排序。
Result: 在72个场景中完成61次成功评估，优于四个基线（37-57次成功）；定性分析显示框架具有优越的可解释性和透明推理，边缘部署额外开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 结合显式世界建模与符号推理能支持准确、可解释且可边缘部署的安全评估，无人机着陆场地评估验证了该方法的有效性。

papers.title: Mixing Configurations for Downstream Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Clustering-based features are widely used in machine learning, but most methods must choose a resolution -- a choice that is global, fixed, and ad hoc. Recent work shows that varying the resolution parameter produces only a finite set of structurally stable partitions, known as configurations. Based on this, we introduce Configuration-Mixed Prediction (CMP), a setting where models learn to adaptively weight these configurations per sample for downstream prediction. We propose MixConfig, a plug-and-play feature augmentation module that extracts configurations from any frozen embedding and learns energy-aware mixing weights via a novel selector that jointly reasons about sample context, cluster assignments, and stability statistics. Experiments across tabular, molecular, vision, and text domains demonstrate consistent improvements over single-resolution and static baselines across diverse predictor architectures, with gains particularly pronounced in low-data regimes.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026. Equal contribution: Juntang Wang, Hao Wu, Yihan Wang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出配置混合预测（CMP）框架，通过自适应加权聚类配置（configurations）提升下游预测性能。MixConfig模块可从任意冻结的嵌入中提取配置，并学习能量感知的混合权重。在表格、分子、视觉和文本领域，该方法在多种预测器架构上持续优于单分辨率和静态基线，尤其在低数据场景下提升显著。
Motivation: 现有基于聚类的特征方法需要全局固定且临时的分辨率选择，限制了性能。
Method: 提出MixConfig模块，从冻结嵌入中提取聚类配置，并通过联合考虑样本上下文、聚类分配和稳定性统计的选择器学习能量感知的混合权重。
Result: 在表格、分子、视觉和文本领域，与单分辨率和静态基线相比，CMP在多种预测器架构上持续改进，低数据场景下收益尤为突出。
Conclusion: 自适应加权聚类配置可作为一种即插即用的特征增强模块，无需重新训练嵌入即可提升下游预测，且在不同领域具有通用性。

papers.title: Manifold Dimension Estimation via Local Graph Structure
papers.abstract_en: Most existing manifold dimension estimators rely on the assumption that the underlying manifold is locally flat within the neighborhoods under consideration. More recently, curvature-adjusted principal component analysis (CA-PCA) has emerged as a powerful alternative by explicitly accounting for the manifold's curvature. Motivated by these ideas, we propose a manifold dimension estimation framework that captures the local graph structure of the manifold through regression on local PCA coordinates. Within this framework, we introduce two representative estimators: quadratic embedding (QE) and total least squares (TLS). Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that these methods perform competitively with, and often outperform, state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于局部图结构的流形维度估计框架，通过回归局部PCA坐标来捕捉流形几何信息，并介绍了二次嵌入（QE）和总体最小二乘（TLS）两种代表性估计器。实验表明，这些方法在合成和真实数据集上与现有最先进方法性能相当或更优。
Motivation: 现有流形维度估计器大多假设流形局部平坦，而曲率调整PCA（CA-PCA）虽考虑了曲率，但仍有改进空间。本文旨在提出更通用的框架，利用局部图结构提升估计准确性。
Method: 提出一个流形维度估计框架，通过对局部PCA坐标进行回归来捕获流形的局部图结构；具体实现包括二次嵌入（QE）和总体最小二乘（TLS）两种估计器。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，所提方法（QE和TLS）与现有最先进方法相比，性能具有竞争力且经常更优。
Conclusion: 该框架通过利用局部图结构，有效提升了流形维度估计的准确性，尤其适用于非平坦流形场景。

papers.title: Analysing Moral Bias in Finetuned LLMs through Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to internalize human-like biases during finetuning, yet the mechanisms by which these biases manifest remain unclear. In this work, we investigated whether the well-known Knobe effect, a moral bias in intentionality judgements, emerges in finetuned LLMs and whether it can be traced back to specific components of the model. We conducted a Layer-Patching analysis across 3 open-weights LLMs and demonstrated that the bias is not only learned during finetuning but also localized in a specific set of layers. Surprisingly, we found that patching activations from the corresponding pretrained model into just a few critical layers is sufficient to eliminate the effect. Our findings offer new evidence that social biases in LLMs can be interpreted, localized, and mitigated through targeted interventions, without the need for model retraining.

TL;DR: 本文通过机制可解释性方法研究微调后大语言模型中的道德偏见。作者发现 Knobe 效应（意图判断中的道德偏见）在微调模型中出现，并定位到特定层；通过将预训练模型的激活值修补到这些关键层，可以消除该效应，而无需重新训练模型。
Motivation: 大语言模型在微调过程中会内化类人偏见，但偏见产生的机制尚不明确。本文旨在探究 Knobe 效应是否出现在微调模型中，并定位其神经基础。
Method: 采用层修补（Layer-Patching）分析，在三个开源大语言模型上定位与 Knobe 效应相关的关键层，并通过将预训练模型的激活值注入这些层来验证因果作用。
Result: Knobe 效应在微调模型中被习得，且集中于少数特定层；将对应层的预训练激活值修补进去即可消除该效应。
Conclusion: 社会偏见可以通过有针对性的干预被解释、定位和缓解，无需重新训练模型，为可解释性驱动的偏见修正提供了新证据。

papers.title: Are Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks Truly Effective for Node Classification? A Causal Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable success in node classification. Building on this progress, heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs) integrate relation types and node and edge semantics to leverage heterogeneous information. Causal analysis for HGNNs is advancing rapidly, aiming to separate genuine causal effects from spurious correlations. However, whether HGNNs are intrinsically effective for node classification remains underexamined, and most studies implicitly assume rather than establish this effectiveness. In this work, we examine HGNNs for node classification from two perspectives: model architecture and heterogeneous information. We conduct a systematic reproduction across 21 datasets and 20 baselines, complemented by comprehensive hyperparameter retuning. To further disentangle the source of performance gains, we develop a causal mediation analysis framework that treats the introduction of heterogeneous relation information as the treatment, candidate structural properties as mediators, and node classification performance as the outcome. This framework first screens candidate mediators according to their treatment-induced changes and their associations with performance improvement, and then decomposes the total effect into mediated and direct effects. Our results lead to two conclusions. First, model architecture and complexity have no causal effect on node classification performance. Second, heterogeneous information exerts a positive causal effect primarily through increasing homophily and local-global distribution discrepancy, which makes node classes more distinguishable. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/YXNTU/CausalHGNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从因果视角系统检验了异构图神经网络（HGNN）在节点分类中的真正有效性。通过在21个数据集和20个基线上进行复现，并引入因果中介分析框架，发现模型架构和复杂度对性能无因果效应，而异质信息通过提升同质性和局部-全局分布差异产生正向因果效应。
Motivation: 现有研究默认HGNN对节点分类有效，但缺乏严格验证；论文旨在从因果推断角度区分真实因果效应与虚假相关，揭示HGNN性能提升的真正来源。
Method: 采用系统复现（21数据集、20基线）结合因果中介分析，将异质关系引入作为treatment，候选结构属性作为mediators，节点分类性能作为outcome，分解总效应为间接（通过mediator）和直接效应。
Result: 模型架构和复杂度对节点分类性能无因果效应；异质信息通过增加同质性和局部-全局分布差异（使类别更可区分）产生正向因果效应。
Conclusion: HGNN在节点分类中的有效性主要源于异质信息对图结构属性的改善，而非模型架构的复杂性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Be Tangential to Manifold: Discovering Riemannian Metric for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are powerful deep generative models, but unlike classical models, they lack an explicit low-dimensional latent space that parameterizes the data manifold. This absence makes it difficult to perform manifold-aware operations, such as geometrically faithful interpolation or conditional guidance that respects the learned manifold. We propose a training-free Riemannian metric on the noise space, derived from the Jacobian of the score function. The key insight is that the spectral structure of this Jacobian separates tangent and normal directions of the data manifold; our metric leverages this separation to encourage paths to stay tangential to the manifold rather than drift toward high-density regions. To validate that our metric faithfully captures the manifold geometry, we examine it from two complementary angles. First, geodesics under our metric yield perceptually more natural interpolations than existing methods on synthetic, image, and video frame datasets. Second, the tangent-normal decomposition induced by our metric prevents classifier-free guidance from deviating off the manifold, improving generation quality while preserving text-image alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的黎曼度量（Riemannian metric），基于得分函数的Jacobian矩阵谱结构分离数据流形的切向和法向，使扩散模型路径保持切向于流形，从而实现更自然的插值和改进的无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）。在合成、图像和视频帧数据集上验证了该方法。
Motivation: 扩散模型缺乏显式低维潜在空间，无法进行流形感知的操作如几何插值和条件引导，现有方法易偏离数据流形。
Method: 利用得分函数的Jacobian矩阵的谱结构，构造噪声空间上的黎曼度量，通过切向-法向分解鼓励路径沿流形切向前进。
Result: 在该度量下的测地线生成更自然的插值结果；切向-法向分解防止无分类器引导偏离流形，提升了生成质量并保持文本-图像对齐。
Conclusion: 所提度量能忠实捕捉流形几何，且无需额外训练，可即插即用于现有扩散模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictively Oriented Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: We advocate for a new statistical principle that combines the most desirable aspects of both parameter inference and density estimation. This leads us to the predictively oriented (PrO) posterior, which expresses uncertainty as a consequence of predictive ability. We show that these posteriors converge to the predictively optimal model average and predictively dominate both classical and generalised Bayes posterior predictive distributions. Further, PrO posteriors adapt to the level of model misspecification: while they concentrate around the true model in the same way as classical and generalised Bayesian strategies if the model can recover the data-generating distribution, they do not concentrate around a single model in the presence of non-trivial forms of model misspecification. Instead, they stabilise towards a non-degenerate predictively optimal posterior distribution that represents a form of irreducible uncertainty due to model misspecification. We put forward a sampling algorithm for PrO posteriors based on mean field Langevin dynamics, and verify the practical significance of our theoretical developments on a number of numerical examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的统计原则——预测导向后验（PrO后验），它结合了参数推断和密度估计的优点，将不确定性表达为预测能力的结果。理论表明PrO后验收敛到预测最优模型平均，并在预测性能上优于经典和广义贝叶斯后验。PrO后验能自适应模型误设定程度：当模型正确时集中于真实模型，当存在误设定时稳定于一个非退化的预测最优后验分布，表示由模型误设定导致的不可约不确定性。文中还给出了基于平均场朗之万动力学的采样算法。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯推断方法在参数推断和密度估计之间需要权衡：经典后验在模型误设定下预测性能差，而广义贝叶斯方法虽能改善预测但损失了参数推断的明确性。本文旨在同时获得两者的优势。
Method: 定义预测导向后验（PrO后验），将后验权重通过预测似然（而非标准似然）与预测性能直接挂钩。理论分析PrO后验的收敛性质，并设计基于平均场朗之万动力学的采样算法。
Result: PrO后验预测分布从预测角度优于经典后验和广义贝叶斯后验；当模型正确时，PrO后验以相同方式集中于真实模型；当模型误设定时，不集中于单个模型而是稳定于一个非退化的分布。数值实验验证了理论。
Conclusion: PrO后验提供了一种新的统计原则，能够根据模型误设定程度自适应地表达不确定性，并具有理论保证和实用算法。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Multi-marginal temporal Schrödinger Bridge Matching from unpaired data
papers.abstract_en: Many natural dynamic processes -- such as in vivo cellular differentiation or disease progression -- can only be observed through the lens of static sample snapshots. While challenging, reconstructing their temporal evolution to decipher underlying dynamic properties is of major interest to scientific research. Existing approaches enable data transport along a temporal axis but are poorly scalable in high dimension and require restrictive assumptions to be met. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Marginal temporal Schrödinger Bridge Matching (MMtSBM) from unpaired data, extending the theoretical guarantees and empirical efficiency of Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching (arXiv:2303.16852) by deriving the Iterative Markovian Fitting algorithm to multiple marginals in a novel factorized fashion. Experiments show that MMtSBM retains theoretical properties on toy examples, achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world datasets such as transcriptomic trajectory inference in 100 dimensions, and, for the first time, recovers couplings and dynamics in very high-dimensional image settings. Our work establishes multi-marginal Schrödinger bridges as a practical and principled approach for recovering hidden dynamics from static data.
papers.comment: ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/tgravier/MMDSBM-pytorch . Additional experimental materials available at https://mmdsbm.notion.site
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多边缘时间Schrödinger桥匹配（MMtSBM），从非配对静态快照数据重建高维动态过程。该方法将扩散Schrödinger桥匹配扩展至多个时间边缘，通过因子化的迭代马尔可夫拟合算法实现，在转录组轨迹推断（100维）和极高高维图像数据上取得最优性能，并首次恢复图像中的耦合与动力学。
Motivation: 许多自然动态过程（如细胞分化、疾病进展）只能通过静态快照观测，现有时间传输方法在高维下可扩展性差且需严格假设。
Method: 基于扩散Schrödinger桥匹配，推导迭代马尔可夫拟合法至多边缘场景，通过新颖的因子化方式处理多个时间边缘，实现从非配对数据中学习时间演化。
Result: 在玩具示例上保持理论性质，在真实转录组轨迹推断（100维）上达到最优，并首次在高维图像设置中恢复耦合与动力学。
Conclusion: 将多边缘Schrödinger桥建立为从静态数据恢复隐藏动力学的实用且严谨方法。

papers.title: A Systematic Study of Large Language Models for Task and Motion Planning With PDDLStream
papers.abstract_en: While we know that large language models (LLMs) can solve some planning problems, we do not understand the extent of these capabilities for robotics. One promising direction is to integrate the semantic knowledge of LLMs with the formal reasoning of task and motion planning (TAMP). However, designing such systems is complicated by the myriad of choices for how to integrate LLMs within TAMP. We develop 16 algorithms that use LLMs to substitute key TAMP components. Our zero-shot experiments across 13750 evaluations and three domains reveal that LLM-based planners exhibit lower success rates and higher planning times than engineered systems. Providing geometric details increases the number of task-planning errors compared to pure PDDL descriptions, and (faster) direct LLM variants outperform (slower) reasoning variants in most cases. Code and results are available at https://github.com/jorge-a-mendez/llm-pddlstream.
papers.comment: 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). 8 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在PDDLStream框架下的任务与运动规划（TAMP）中的应用。作者开发了16种算法，用LLM替代TAMP的关键组件，并在13750次零样本实验中发现，基于LLM的规划器成功率较低且规划时间更长，提供几何细节反而导致更多任务规划错误，直接LLM变体通常优于推理变体。
Motivation: LLM在部分规划问题中展现出能力，但其在机器人TAMP中的适用范围尚不明确，且如何将LLM集成到TAMP中存在多种设计选择，缺乏系统性比较。
Method: 将LLM作为TAMP组件的替代品，设计了16种算法（包括不同的LLM提示方式和推理策略），在三个领域进行零样本实验，共13750次评估。
Result: 基于LLM的规划器成功率低于传统工程系统，且规划时间更长；提供几何细节反而增加任务规划错误；直接LLM变体（较快）在多数情况下优于推理变体（较慢）。
Conclusion: 当前LLM在TAMP中的直接应用效果不如传统方法，且几何信息的引入可能带来负面影响，直接LLM方法更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Poison to Detect: Detection of Targeted Overfitting in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training among clients without centralising data, making it a widely adopted privacy-enhancing technology (PET). Despite its privacy benefits, FL remains vulnerable to orchestrator-driven privacy attacks. In this paper, we study an underexplored threat in which a dishonest orchestrator intentionally manipulates the aggregation process to induce targeted overfitting in local models of specific clients. Although prior work focuses on reducing information leakage during training, we emphasise early client-side detection of targeted overfitting, allowing clients to disengage before significant harm occurs. To this end, we propose three detection techniques -- label flipping, backdoor trigger injection, and model fingerprinting -- which enable clients to verify the integrity of the global aggregation. We evaluated our methods across multiple datasets and attack scenarios. In single-client attacks, all three methods detect orchestrator-induced overfitting within 1-2 training rounds with F1 scores up to 0.7. Scalability experiments further show that detection effectiveness is influenced by cohort composition and method parameters. These results demonstrate that client-side integrity testing can provide early, effective, and scalable detection, supporting safer deployment of FL systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习中不诚实的协调者通过操纵聚合过程诱导特定客户端局部模型产生目标过拟合（targeted overfitting）的威胁，并提出了三种客户端侧检测方法：标签翻转（label flipping）、后门触发器注入（backdoor trigger injection）和模型指纹（model fingerprinting）。实验表明，在单客户端攻击场景下，这三种方法能在1-2轮训练内以F1分数高达0.7检测协调者诱导的过拟合，且检测效果受参与客户端组成和方法参数影响。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注减少训练过程中的信息泄漏，但忽略了客户端侧早期检测目标过拟合的重要性。本文旨在使客户端在遭受显著伤害前就能主动检测协调者操纵引起的过拟合，从而安全退出。
Method: 提出三种基于客户端的检测技术：标签翻转（客户端对本地数据添加扰动后观察聚合模型的行为变化）、后门触发器注入（在本地数据中嵌入后门并检测全局模型的后门有效性）、模型指纹（通过预定义的指纹样本检测模型过拟合特征）。
Result: 在多个数据集和攻击场景下，三种方法在单客户端攻击中均能在1-2轮训练内达到最高0.7的F1得分；扩展性实验表明检测效果受客户端组成和参数影响。
Conclusion: 客户端侧完整性测试能提供早期、有效且可扩展的检测，有助于联邦学习系统的更安全部署。

papers.title: Discovering Generalizable Governing Equations for Graph Dynamical Systems with Interpretable Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The discovery of symbolic governing equations is a central goal in science; yet, it remains challenging particularly for graph dynamical systems, where the network topology further shapes the system behavior. While artificial intelligence offers powerful tools for modeling these dynamics, the field lacks a rigorous comparative benchmark to assess the true scientific utility of the discovered laws. To address this challenge, this work proposes a novel evaluation pipeline designed to rigorously assess state-of-the-art symbolic regression models for graph equation discovery. Moving beyond simple fitting metrics, this framework evaluates discovered laws based on their long-term trajectory stability and, critically, their out-of-distribution generalization to unseen graph topologies. We benchmark established methods, including sparse regression and MLP-based architectures, and introduce the Graph Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-ODE (GKAN-ODE) model, a novel adaptation of KANs explicitly tailored for this domain, augmented by hyperparameter-free multiplicative nodes and a new Spline-Wise symbolic regression algorithm. Across a suite of synthetic and real-world graph dynamical systems, we numerically demonstrate through extensive experiments that neural-based approaches, particularly the GKAN-ODE model, recover exact ground-truth equations and achieve trajectory errors up to two orders of magnitude lower than the baseline methods on out-of-distribution test graphs.
papers.comment: Published on Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图动力系统（graph dynamical systems）的符号方程发现缺乏严格比较基准的问题，提出一套评估流程，并引入Graph Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-ODE（GKAN-ODE）模型。该模型结合KAN、无超参数乘法节点和Spline-Wise符号回归算法。在合成和真实图动力系统上，神经方法（尤其是GKAN-ODE）能够恢复真实方程，并在分布外测试图上实现比基线低两个数量级的轨迹误差。
Motivation: 图动力系统的符号方程发现是科学目标，但现有方法缺乏评估其科学实用性的比较基准，尤其是对分布外图拓扑的泛化能力。
Method: 提出一个评估管道，用于严格评估符号回归模型的图方程发现能力；并设计GKAN-ODE模型，通过无超参数乘法节点和Spline-Wise符号回归算法增强KAN的适应性。
Result: 在多个合成和真实图动力系统上，GKAN-ODE恢复真实方程，并在分布外测试图上获得比稀疏回归和MLP基线低两个数量级的轨迹误差。
Conclusion: 神经方法（如GKAN-ODE）在图方程发现中优于传统方法，提出的框架可用于评估发现定律的科学实用性。

papers.title: Human-Aligned Procedural Level Generation Reinforcement Learning via Text-Level-Sketch Shared Representation
papers.abstract_en: Human-aligned AI is a critical component of co-creativity, as it enables models to accurately interpret human intent and generate controllable outputs that align with design goals in collaborative content creation. This direction is especially relevant in procedural content generation via reinforcement learning (PCGRL), which is intended to serve as a tool for human designers. However, existing systems often fall short of exhibiting human-centered behavior, limiting the practical utility of AI-driven generation tools in real-world design workflows. In this paper, we propose VIPCGRL (Vision-Instruction PCGRL), a novel deep reinforcement learning framework that incorporates three modalities-text, level, and sketches-to extend control modality and enhance human-likeness. We introduce a shared embedding space trained via quadruple contrastive learning across modalities and human-AI styles, and align the policy using an auxiliary reward based on embedding similarity. Experimental results show that VIPCGRL outperforms existing baselines in human-likeness, as validated by both quantitative metrics and human evaluations. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/bic4907/VIPCGRL.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 tables, 3 figures; Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Games
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIPCGRL 框架，通过四元对比学习 (quadruple contrastive learning) 在文本、关卡和草图三种模态间构建共享嵌入空间，并利用嵌入相似性作为辅助奖励来对齐强化学习策略，使程序化关卡生成更符合人类意图。实验表明该方法在人类相似性指标上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有程序化内容生成强化学习 (PCGRL) 系统缺乏以人为本的行为，难以准确解释设计师意图并生成可控输出，限制了 AI 生成工具在实际设计工作流中的实用性。
Method: 提出 VIPCGRL，一个深度强化学习框架，同时处理文本、关卡和草图三种模态；通过四元对比学习训练跨模态和跨人机风格的共享嵌入空间，并引入基于嵌入相似度的辅助奖励来对齐策略。
Result: 定量指标和人类评估均显示 VIPCGRL 在人类相似性上优于现有基线。代码和数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 多模态共享表示和基于嵌入相似度的奖励能有效提升 PCGRL 系统的人类对齐程度，使生成内容更符合设计师意图。

papers.title: Latent Fusion Jailbreak: Blending Harmful and Harmless Representations to Elicit Unsafe LLM Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned large language models can still be manipulated through white-box interventions that modify their internal representations. We introduce Latent Fusion Jailbreak (LFJ), which works by pairing a harmful query with a structurally similar but benign counterpart, then interpolating their hidden states at carefully selected layers and token positions. Refusal-loss gradients determine exactly where to intervene, and we optimise layer-wise mixing coefficients using token-normalised compliance and refusal-suppression objectives. The edited prompt states propagate sequentially through the remaining transformer blocks. Across four safety benchmarks and five open-weight target models, LFJ reaches a macro-averaged attack success rate (ASR) of 94.13% under the white-box protocol we describe. Because LFJ directly accesses internal states, comparisons with prompt-only attacks serve as a descriptive reference rather than a matched evaluation. Dropping rejection sampling lowers ASR to 86.72%, whereas replacing the structured harmful-benign pairing with random pairing causes it to fall to 27.45%. We also design an LFJ-specific latent adversarial training procedure that, when the attack is re-optimised against the defended model, reduces ASR from 94.13% to 12.37%. This defence evaluation does not cover transfer to other attack types or preservation of benign utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Latent Fusion Jailbreak (LFJ) 是一种针对安全对齐的大型语言模型的白盒越狱方法，通过将有害查询与结构相似的无害查询在选定层和位置的隐状态进行插值，从而诱导不安全输出。在四个安全基准和五个开源模型上，LFJ 的平均攻击成功率达到 94.13%。论文还提出了一种基于潜对抗训练的防御方法，将攻击成功率降低到 12.37%。
Motivation: 现有的安全对齐模型仍可能通过修改内部表示的白盒干预被操纵，需要研究这种风险并探索有效防御。
Method: LFJ 将有害查询与无害查询配对，利用拒绝损失梯度确定干预位置，并优化层间混合系数，使编辑后的提示状态顺序通过剩余 Transformer 模块。
Result: 在四个安全基准和五个开源模型上，LFJ 实现宏平均攻击成功率 94.13%；去除拒绝采样后降至 86.72%；随机配对降至 27.45%；所提潜对抗训练将攻击成功率降至 12.37%。
Conclusion: LFJ 展示了通过隐状态操控实现越狱的有效性，但其防御评估未覆盖其他攻击类型或保留良性效用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Deep Learning for Inverse Problems in Computed Tomography
papers.abstract_en: Assume you encounter an inverse problem that shall be solved for a large number of data, but no ground-truth data is available. To emulate this, in this study we assume it is unknown how to solve the imaging problem of Computed Tomography. We introduce an unsupervised deep learning framework that leverages the inherent similarities between iterative reconstruction, Deep Image Prior (DIP), and unrolled optimization schemes. Our specific contribution is a training framework for amortized reconstruction: After training on a dataset without any image-domain ground truth, reconstruction of an unseen scan reduces to a single network forward pass. We demonstrate the feasibility of reconstructing images from measurement data by pure network inference, without additional gradient steps for unseen samples. Our method is evaluated on the two-dimensional 2DeteCT dataset. Within a controlled, geometry-matched benchmark, our reconstructions are competitive with, or better than, filtered back-projection, maximum-likelihood reconstruction, and a supervised network of identical architecture. Compared to a per-image DIP baseline, our method reaches similar quality while replacing the costly per-instance optimization with a single forward pass, yielding a speed-up of about four orders of magnitude. This makes it a promising candidate for time-critical imaging applications. Future work will address multi-dataset adaptability, counter-measures against over-smoothing, advanced uncertainty quantification, and further medical-imaging inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CT逆问题中缺乏真实图像数据的情况，提出一种无监督深度学习框架，融合迭代重建、Deep Image Prior (DIP) 和展开优化 (unrolled optimization) 的思想。该框架在无图像域真实数据的数据集上训练后，对未见样本仅需一次网络前向传播即可完成重建，无需额外的梯度步骤。在2DeteCT二维数据集上的实验表明，其重建质量与滤波反投影、最大似然重建以及相同架构的有监督网络相当或更优；相比逐图像优化的DIP基线，质量接近而速度提升约四个数量级。
Motivation: 在实际CT成像中，大量数据缺乏真实图像作为监督信号，传统无监督方法（如逐图像DIP）虽有效但计算成本高。本文旨在探索一种无需真实图像、且可摊销计算成本的无监督重建方案。
Method: 提出无监督训练框架，核心是结合迭代重建的物理模型、DIP的隐式先验以及展开优化的可学习步长，构建端到端网络。训练时仅使用测量数据，无图像域真实值；推理时直接进行单次前向传播得到重建图像。
Result: 在2DeteCT数据集上，该方法在重建质量上与滤波反投影、最大似然重建及有监督网络持平或更优；与逐图像DIP相比，质量相似但单次前向传播代替了每张图像的梯度优化，实现约四个数量级的速度提升。
Conclusion: 该无监督框架为时间关键型CT成像应用提供了可行方案。未来需解决多数据集适应性、过平滑抑制、不确定性量化及扩展到其他医学成像逆问题。

papers.title: Frugal, Flexible, Faithful: Causal Data Simulation via Frengression
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning has revitalized causal inference by combining flexible models and principled estimators, yet robust benchmarking and evaluation remain challenging with real-world data. In this work, we introduce frengression, a deep generative realization of the frugal parameterization that models the joint distribution of covariates, treatments and outcomes around the causal margin of interest. Frengression provides accurate estimation and flexible, faithful simulation of multivariate, time-varying data; it also enables direct sampling from user-specified interventional distributions. Model consistency and extrapolation guarantees are established, with validation on real-world clinical trial data demonstrating frengression's practical utility. We envision this framework sparking new research into generative approaches for causal margin modelling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 frengression，一种基于节俭参数化 (frugal parameterization) 的深度生成方法，用于因果数据模拟。该方法能够对多变量、时变数据进行准确估计和忠实模拟，并支持从用户指定的干预分布中直接采样。理论证明了模型一致性和外推保证，并在真实临床试验数据上验证了实用性。
Motivation: 机器学习虽结合灵活模型和原则性估计器振兴了因果推断，但在真实数据上进行鲁棒基准测试和评估仍具挑战性。
Method: 提出 frengression，一种深度生成方法，通过节俭参数化对协变量、处理和结果的联合分布进行建模，并直接围绕因果边际进行采样。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在模拟和真实临床试验数据上实现了准确估计和灵活、忠实的多变量时变数据生成，并提供了模型一致性和外推保证。
Conclusion: 该框架有望促进因果边际建模的生成方法研究，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Acoustic Imaging for UAV Detection: Dense Beamformed Energy Maps and U-Net SELD
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a U-net model for 360° acoustic source localization formulated as a spherical semantic segmentation task. Rather than regressing discrete direction-of-arrival (DoA) angles, our model segments beamformed audio maps (azimuth & elevation) into regions of active sound presence. Using delay-and-sum (DAS) beamforming on a custom 24-microphone array, we generate signals aligned with drone GPS telemetry to create binary supervision masks. A modified U-Net, trained on frequency-domain representations of these maps, learns to identify spatially distributed source regions while addressing class imbalance via the Tversky loss. Because the network operates on beamformed energy maps, the approach is inherently array-independent and can adapt to different microphone configurations and can be transferred to different microphone configurations with minimal adaptation. The segmentation outputs are post-processed by computing centroids over activated regions, enabling robust DoA estimates. Our dataset includes real-world open-field recordings of a DJI Air 3 drone, synchronized with 360° video and flight logs across multiple dates and locations. Experimental results show that U-net generalizes across environments, providing improved angular precision, offering a new paradigm for dense spatial audio understanding beyond traditional Sound Source Localization (SSL). We additionally validate the same beamforming-plus-segmentation formulation on the DCASE 2019 TAU Spatial Sound Events benchmark, showing that the approach generalizes beyond drone acoustics to multiclass Sound Event Localization and Detection (SELD) scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将360°声源定位建模为球面语义分割任务，使用U-Net对延迟求和波束成形生成的音频能量图进行分割，以识别空间分布声源区域。通过计算分割掩码的质心得到方向估计，在真实无人机录音和DCASE 2019基准上验证了方法的有效性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 传统声源定位通常回归离散到达角，难以处理空间分布声源，且对阵列配置变化敏感。本文旨在通过分割框架实现更鲁棒、阵列无关的密集空间声学理解。
Method: 使用24麦克风阵列的延迟求和波束成形生成波束形成能量图（方位角与俯仰角），以频域表示输入改进的U-Net，采用Tversky损失处理类别不平衡，输出分割掩码，最终通过计算激活区域质心获得方向估计。
Result: 在真实DJI Air 3无人机录音数据集上，U-Net在不同环境下泛化良好，角精度优于传统方法；在DCASE 2019 TAU Spatial Sound Events基准上，该方法同样适用于多类声学事件定位与检测，验证了框架的通用性。
Conclusion: 基于波束形成能量图和U-Net分割的声源定位范式具有阵列独立性，可适应不同麦克风配置，为密集空间声学理解提供了新思路。

papers.title: Label-Free Concept Drift Assessment for Reliable AI in Emerging Wireless Applications
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models deployed in non-stationary environments degrade silently, since as the input distribution drifts their accuracy decays without an error signal and without labels to reveal it. Sustaining reliable AI therefore requires a concept-drift detector that acts as an external observer of the deployed model, monitoring it using unlabeled operational data alone, so that an MLOps actuator triggers retraining and redeployment only when it is warranted. This paper contributes two concept drift detectors, namely Confidence-Filtered Pseudo-Label Transfer (CFPT) and TabAutoDrift, which combine representation learning with statistical testing to compute an expected utility score that signals whether a deployed model should be retrained, without requiring ground-truth labels after deployment. The detectors are evaluated on two emerging, label-scarce wireless application domains in which post deployment ground truth is effectively unavailable, namely outdoor fingerprinting-based localization and link-anomaly detection. They outperform the classical detectors ADWIN, DDM, and CUSUM, attaining a drift-detection F1-score between 0.88 and 0.94 in the fingerprinting use case and between 0.80 and 1.00 in the link-anomaly use case, up to 0.24 higher than the strongest classical detector. Interpreted as reliability decisions, this precision indicates that the proposed detectors signal retraining more dependably.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对部署在非平稳环境中的机器学习模型因输入分布漂移而性能下降的问题，提出两种无标签概念漂移检测器：CFPT和TabAutoDrift。它们结合表示学习与统计检验，仅使用未标记操作数据计算期望效用分数，以判断是否需要触发模型重训练。在指纹定位和链路异常检测两个标签稀缺的无线应用场景中评估，漂移检测F1分数达0.88-1.00，比ADWIN、DDM和CUSUM等经典检测器高出最多0.24。
Motivation: 已部署的机器学习模型在无标签的非平稳环境中会无声退化，需要一种无需真实标签即可监测概念漂移的外部检测器，以便仅在必要时触发重训练，维持AI的可靠性。
Method: 提出CFPT（Confidence-Filtered Pseudo-Label Transfer）和TabAutoDrift两种检测器，通过表示学习与统计检验结合，计算期望效用分数来指示是否需要重训练，完全依赖部署后的无标签数据。
Result: 在室外指纹定位用例中，漂移检测F1达0.88-0.94；在链路异常检测用例中，F1达0.80-1.00，比最强经典检测器（ADWIN、DDM、CUSUM）高出最多0.24。
Conclusion: 所提检测器作为可靠性决策，能更可靠地发出重训练信号，适用于真实标签不可用的新兴无线应用。

papers.title: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Probabilistic Reasoning on Graph Data
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at predictive tasks on graph-structured data but often lack the ability to incorporate symbolic domain knowledge and perform general reasoning. Relational Bayesian Networks (RBNs), in contrast, enable fully generative probabilistic modeling over graph-like structures and support rich symbolic knowledge and probabilistic inference. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic framework that seamlessly integrates GNNs into RBNs, combining the learning strength of GNNs with the flexible reasoning capabilities of RBNs. We develop two implementations of this integration: one compiles GNNs directly into the native RBN language, while the other maintains the GNN as an external component. Both approaches preserve the semantics and computational properties of GNNs while fully aligning with the RBN modeling paradigm. We also propose a maximum a posteriori (MAP) inference method for these neuro-symbolic models. To demonstrate the framework's versatility, we apply it to two distinct problems. First, we transform a GNN for node classification into a collective classification model that explicitly models homo- and heterophilic label patterns, substantially improving accuracy on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Second, we introduce a multi-objective network optimization problem in environmental planning, where MAP inference and continuous numeric relaxation support a complex decision-making task. Both applications include new publicly available benchmark datasets. This work introduces a powerful and coherent neuro-symbolic approach to graph data, bridging learning and reasoning in ways that enable novel applications and improved performance across diverse tasks.
papers.comment: Submitted to the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research (JAIR); under revision. 43 pages, 10 figures. Code available at https://github.com/raffaelepojer/NeSy-for-graph-data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号框架，将图神经网络（GNN）集成到关系贝叶斯网络（RBN）中，结合GNN的学习能力与RBN的推理能力。通过两种实现方式（编译入RBN或作为外部组件），并提出了最大后验（MAP）推理方法。在节点分类（显式建模同/异配标签模式）和多目标网络优化（环境规划）两个任务上验证有效性，提供了新基准数据集。
Motivation: 图神经网络在预测任务上表现优异但缺乏符号知识整合与通用推理能力，而关系贝叶斯网络支持生成式概率建模和推理但学习能力有限。
Method: 提出神经符号框架：一种是将GNN编译为RBN原生语言，另一种是保持GNN为外部组件。两种方法均保留GNN语义和计算特性，并开发了MAP推理方法。
Result: 在节点分类任务中，模型通过显式建模同/异配模式显著提升合成和真实数据集上的准确率；在多目标网络优化任务中，MAP推理和连续数值松弛支持复杂决策。
Conclusion: 该框架桥接了图数据上的学习与推理，为新应用和性能提升提供了统一的神经符号方法，并发布了公开基准数据集。

papers.title: A Standardized Benchmark for Skeleton-Based Rehabilitation Assessment Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Automated assessment of human motion plays a vital role in rehabilitation, enabling objective evaluation of patient performance and progress. Unlike general human activity recognition, rehabilitation motion assessment focuses on analyzing the quality of movement within the same action class, requiring the detection of subtle deviations from ideal motion. Recent advances in deep learning and video-based skeleton extraction have opened new possibilities for accessible, scalable motion assessment using affordable devices such as smartphones or webcams. However, the field lacks standardized benchmarks, consistent evaluation protocols, and reproducible methodologies, limiting progress and comparability across studies. In this work, we address these gaps by (i) aggregating existing rehabilitation datasets into a unified archive called Rehab-Pile, (ii) proposing a general benchmarking framework for evaluating deep learning methods in this domain, and (iii) conducting extensive benchmarking of multiple architectures across classification and regression tasks. All datasets and implementations are released to the community to support transparency and reproducibility. This paper aims to establish a solid foundation for future research in automated rehabilitation assessment and foster the development of reliable, accessible, and personalized rehabilitation solutions. The datasets, source-code and results of this article are all publicly available.

TL;DR: 本文针对基于骨骼的康复评估领域缺乏标准化基准和可重复方法的问题，聚合现有数据集形成Rehab-Pile，提出通用基准框架，并对多种深度学习架构进行了分类和回归任务的广泛基准测试。所有数据和代码已公开。
Motivation: 康复运动评估需要分析同一动作类内的运动质量，现有研究因缺乏标准化基准、一致评估协议和可重复方法而难以比较和进展。
Method: 聚合现有康复数据集为统一档案Rehab-Pile，提出通用基准框架，在分类和回归任务上对多种深度学习架构进行基准测试。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的定量结果，但强调进行了广泛基准测试并公开了所有数据和代码。
Conclusion: 旨在为自动化康复评估研究建立坚实基础，促进可靠、可访问和个性化的康复解决方案的开发。

papers.title: Boosted Enhanced Quantile Regression Neural Networks with Spatiotemporal Permutation Entropy for Complex System Prognostics
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an integrative prognostic framework that combines Spatiotemporal Permutation Entropy (STPE), Boosted Enhanced Quantile Regression Neural Networks (B-EQRNNs), Gated Temporal Attention, a Spiking Neural Network (SNN) refinement stage, and a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) classifier. The motivation is long-horizon fault prediction in distributed industrial electronic systems, where single-sensor or point-estimate models can miss weak spatially propagating degradation signatures and provide limited uncertainty information. The proposed pipeline first converts 70-channel sensor streams into multiscale STPE descriptors, then learns conditional quantile representations and attention-weighted temporal context before final Normal/Abnormal classification. Evaluation is reported on a nine-system industrial electronic-sensor dataset with 48-, 90-, and 168-hour prediction horizons. The comparison includes a tree-based LightGBM baseline and modern sequence baselines available under the same preprocessing protocol, including LSTM, Autoformer, and TCN models. The full pipeline reaches 81.17% accuracy at the 168-hour horizon and is evaluated with component ablations, computational-cost analysis, and an explicit reproducibility protocol. The contribution is therefore framed as a validated hybrid architecture for uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal prognostics rather than as a new standalone learning theory.
papers.comment: Preliminary version of a predictive maintenance framework using spiking neural networks and entropy-based analysis. To be expanded in future publications with hardware implementations and real-time drift detection modules. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2501.05087
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合时空置换熵（STPE）、增强型分位数回归神经网络（B-EQRNN）、门控时序注意力、脉冲神经网络（SNN）精炼阶段和时序融合Transformer（TFT）分类器的预测框架，用于分布式工业电子系统的长期故障预测。在9系统工业电子传感器数据集上，168小时预测时域达到81.17%的准确率，并进行了组件消融和计算成本分析。
Motivation: 现有单传感器或点估计模型难以捕捉弱空间传播退化信号，且缺乏不确定性量化，无法满足分布式工业电子系统长期故障预测的需求。
Method: 将70通道传感器数据转换为多尺度STPE描述符，通过B-EQRNN学习条件分位数表示，结合门控时序注意力加权上下文，经SNN精炼后由TFT分类器输出正常/异常分类。
Result: 在9系统电子传感器数据集上，168小时预测时域准确率为81.17%，优于LightGBM、LSTM、Autoformer和TCN基线，且通过消融实验验证了各组件贡献。
Conclusion: 该框架是一个验证有效的混合架构，专注于不确定性感知的时空预测，而非提出新的学习理论，但当前仅为初步版本，未来将扩展至硬件实现和实时漂移检测。

papers.title: Nutation Damping from Core-Mantle Boundary Topography
papers.abstract_en: Periodic gravitational forcing by the Moon and Sun produces small oscillations in Earth's rotation known as nutations. Nutations are amplified by a resonance with a natural motion of the liquid core called the Free Core Nutation, whose amplitude is limited by friction-like processes at the core--mantle boundary. Previous studies have attributed this damping to the dissipation of electric currents induced in the lower conducting mantle, but, given current knowledge of the lower mantle, electromagnetic coupling appears insufficient to fully account for the observed lag. We show that additional dissipation arises from the interaction of the tidal flow inside the core with the topography of the core--mantle boundary, which excites internal waves that extract energy and momentum from the flow. Adapting a theory originally developed for tides over seafloor topography, we find that the observed damping can be fully accounted for by a topography of typical amplitude $\sim$5~km dominated by features of wavelength $\sim$1500~km. The dissipation is highest when the upper core is neutrally buoyant. Such amplitudes are larger than typical inferences from global seismic studies but are not ruled out, given regional seismic evidence for kilometer-scale features and the sparse constraints at these scales.

TL;DR: 本文研究地球章动（nutation）的阻尼机制，认为核幔边界地形引起的内部波耗散可解释观测到的章动滞后，而电磁耦合不足以完全解释。通过改编海底地形潮汐理论，发现典型振幅约5 km、波长约1500 km的地形可完全解释阻尼，当上地核中性浮力时耗散最大。该振幅大于全球地震学推断，但区域地震证据允许。
Motivation: 现有电磁耦合机制不足以完全解释核幔边界摩擦导致的章动阻尼，需要寻找额外耗散来源。
Method: 改编原用于海底地形上潮汐的理论，分析核幔边界地形与内部流动相互作用激发的内部波如何提取能量和动量。
Result: 发现典型振幅约5 km、波长约1500 km的地形可完全解释观测到的章动阻尼，中性浮力条件下耗散最大。
Conclusion: 核幔边界地形引起的内部波耗散是章动阻尼的重要机制，与现有观测一致；地形振幅虽大于全球地震学平均但未被排除。

papers.title: Interpretable Role-Based Clustering in Multi-Layer Financial Networks
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the functional roles of financial institutions within interconnected markets is critical for effective supervision, systemic risk assessment, and resolution planning. We propose an interpretable role-based clustering approach for multi-layer financial networks, designed to identify the functional positions of institutions across different market segments. Our method follows a general clustering framework defined by proximity measures, cluster evaluation criteria, and algorithm selection. We construct explainable node embeddings based on egonet features that capture both direct and indirect trading relationships within and across market layers. Using transaction-level data from the ECB's Money Market Statistical Reporting (MMSR), we demonstrate how the approach uncovers heterogeneous institutional roles such as market intermediaries, cross-segment connectors, and peripheral lenders or borrowers. The results highlight the flexibility and practical value of role-based clustering in analyzing financial networks and understanding institutional behavior in complex market structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的角色聚类方法用于多层金融网络，通过基于egonet特征的可解释节点嵌入来捕捉机构在层内和跨层的交易关系。在ECB的MMSR交易数据上，该方法成功识别出市场中介、跨段连接者、外围贷方/借方等不同功能角色，展示了角色聚类在金融网络分析中的实用价值。
Motivation: 理解金融机构在互联市场中的功能角色对于有效监管、系统性风险评估和处置计划至关重要，现有方法缺乏可解释性和跨层分析能力。
Method: 提出一个通用的聚类框架，基于egonet特征构建可解释的节点嵌入，捕捉直接和间接交易关系（包括层内和跨层），然后应用聚类算法。
Result: 在ECB的MMSR交易级数据上，该方法揭示了异质机构角色，如市场中介、跨段连接者和外围贷方/借方。
Conclusion: 结果强调角色聚类在金融网络分析中的灵活性和实用价值，有助于理解复杂市场结构中的机构行为。

papers.title: Minimax and Bayes Optimal Best-Arm Identification
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates minimax and Bayes optimal strategies for fixed-budget best-arm identification. We consider an adaptive procedure consisting of a sampling phase followed by a recommendation phase, and we design an adaptive experiment within this framework to efficiently identify the best arm, defined as the one with the highest expected outcome. In our proposed strategy, the sampling phase consists of two stages. The first stage is a pilot phase, in which we allocate samples uniformly across arms to eliminate clearly suboptimal arms and to estimate outcome variances. Before entering the second stage, we solve a Gaussian minimax game, which yields a sampling policy and a decision rule. In the second stage, samples are allocated according to this policy. After the sampling phase, the procedure enters the recommendation phase, where we select an arm using the decision rule. We prove that this single strategy is simultaneously asymptotically minimax and Bayes optimal for the simple regret, and we establish upper bounds that coincide exactly with our lower bounds, including the constant terms. The lower bounds hold against every adaptive experiment and for every fixed number of arms, and the strategy attains them without knowing the outcome distributions or the prior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了固定预算下最佳臂识别问题的极小极大和贝叶斯最优策略。提出一个两阶段自适应实验：先均匀采样淘汰次优臂并估计方差，再通过解高斯极小极大博弈获得采样策略和决策规则，第二阶段按该策略分配样本，最后基于决策规则推荐臂。证明该策略在简单遗憾上同时渐近极小极大和贝叶斯最优，且上下界常数项一致。
Motivation: 现有固定预算最佳臂识别方法通常只针对极小极大或贝叶斯准则之一优化，缺乏同时达到两种最优且不依赖分布知识的统一策略。
Method: 提出两阶段自适应实验：第一阶段均匀采样作为试点，淘汰明显次优臂并估计方差；第二阶段基于第一阶段解出的高斯极小极大博弈的采样策略和决策规则分配样本，最后推荐臂。
Result: 理论证明了所提策略在简单遗憾上同时渐近极小极大和贝叶斯最优，且上下界常数项精确匹配。下界对任意自适应实验和任意固定臂数成立，策略无需知道结果分布或先验。
Conclusion: 该工作表明存在单一策略可同时达到极小极大和贝叶斯最优，为固定预算最佳臂识别提供了理论最优的统一框架。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Video Scene Parsing:Advances, Challenges, and Prospects
papers.abstract_en: Video Scene Parsing (VSP) studies dense video understanding, where every pixel in each frame must be segmented, each region must be named, and each object identity must remain coherent over time. This survey reviews recent progress in VSP across five tasks, spanning Video Semantic Segmentation (VSS), Video Instance Segmentation (VIS), Video Panoptic Segmentation (VPS), Video Tracking \& Segmentation (VTS), and Open-Vocabulary Video Segmentation (OVVS). We organize the literature as one architectural arc, running from hand-crafted motion and appearance cues through fully convolutional, attention-based and query-based designs to recent foundation-model approaches, and we trace how each family models temporal context, preserves identity, and balances accuracy against efficiency. We then compare the datasets, metrics and benchmark trends that shape current evaluation. Beyond cataloguing methods, we foreground the design trade-offs and recurring failure modes that cut across the field, namely temporal flicker, occlusion-induced identity switches, long-tail categories, and the annotation--capacity--latency tension. We close with open directions towards robust, efficient and open-world VSP systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了视频场景解析（VSP）的五大任务（视频语义分割、视频实例分割、视频全景分割、视频跟踪分割、开放词汇视频分割），梳理了从手工特征到基础模型的技术演进，并分析了数据集、评价指标、关键设计权衡及失败模式（如时序闪烁、遮挡导致的身份切换、长尾类别等）。
Motivation: 视频场景解析领域发展迅速但缺乏系统性综述，现有工作分散于不同子任务，亟需统一框架来梳理进展、比较方法并指出共同挑战。
Method: 按架构演进组织文献：从手工运动/外观特征→全卷积网络→注意力机制和查询式设计→基础模型方法；同时对比各方法在时序建模、身份保持与效率间的权衡。
Result: 总结了各子任务在常用基准上的性能趋势，并指出时序闪烁、身份切换、长尾类别以及标注-能力-延迟矛盾是贯穿领域的共性挑战。
Conclusion: 未来方向是构建鲁棒、高效且面向开放世界的视频场景解析系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Honesty in Causal Forests: When It Helps and When It Hurts
papers.abstract_en: Causal forests estimate how treatment effects vary across individuals, guiding personalized interventions in areas like marketing, operations, and public policy. A standard practice is honest estimation: dividing the data into two samples, one to define subgroups and another to estimate treatment effects within them. This is intended to reduce overfitting and is the default in many software packages. But is it the right choice? We show that honest estimation can reduce the accuracy of estimates of individual treatment effects, especially when effect heterogeneity is substantial and datasets are large enough to detect it. The reason is a bias-variance trade-off: honesty lowers the risk of overfitting but increases the risk of underfitting by limiting the data available to detect and model heterogeneity. Across more than 7,000 benchmark datasets, we find that the cost of using honesty by default can be as high as requiring 27% more data to match the performance of models trained without it. Honesty is best understood as a form of regularization. Whether to adopt it should depend on the goals of the application and its empirical performance, not on reflexive default use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了因果森林（causal forests）中诚实估计（honest estimation）的利弊。诚实估计将数据分为两个样本，一个用于定义子组，另一个用于估计处理效应，旨在减少过拟合。然而，作者通过超过7000个基准数据集的实验发现，当效应异质性显著且数据集足够大时，诚实估计会降低个体处理效应估计的准确性，因为它增加了欠拟合风险。诚实估计本质上是一种正则化，是否采用应基于应用目标和实证表现，而非默认使用。
Motivation: 因果森林中诚实估计是默认做法，但其是否总是最优尚不清楚。作者旨在揭示诚实估计何时有害，以指导实践者合理使用。
Method: 通过理论分析和超过7000个基准数据集的实验，比较诚实估计与非诚实估计在个体处理效应估计上的表现，并分析偏差-方差权衡。
Result: 诚实估计可能要求额外27%的数据才能达到非诚实估计的性能，尤其在效应异质性大、数据充足时，其欠拟合成本超过过拟合风险。
Conclusion: 诚实估计应视为一种正则化方法，是否采用需根据具体应用和实证性能决定，而非默认使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SLAC: Safe and Efficient Real-Robot Reinforcement Learning via Unsupervised Simulation Pre-Training
papers.abstract_en: Building capable household and industrial robots requires mastering the control of versatile, high-degree-of-freedom (DoF) systems such as mobile manipulators. While reinforcement learning (RL) holds promise for autonomously acquiring robot control policies, scaling it to high-DoF embodiments remains challenging. Direct RL in the real world demands both safe exploration and high sample efficiency, which are difficult to achieve in practice. Sim-to-real RL, on the other hand, is often brittle due to the reality gap. This paper introduces SLAC, a method that renders real-world RL feasible for complex embodiments by leveraging a low-fidelity simulator to pretrain a task-agnostic latent action space. SLAC trains this latent action space via a customized unsupervised skill discovery method designed to promote temporal abstraction, disentanglement, and safety, thereby facilitating efficient downstream learning. Once a latent action space is learned, SLAC uses it as the action interface for a novel off-policy RL algorithm to autonomously learn downstream tasks through real-world interactions. We evaluate SLAC against existing methods on a suite of bimanual mobile manipulation tasks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, SLAC learns contact-rich whole-body tasks in under an hour of real-world interactions, without relying on any demonstrations or hand-crafted behavior priors. More information and robot videos at robo-rl.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SLAC方法，通过低保真模拟器预训练任务无关的潜在动作空间，使真实世界强化学习对高自由度机器人（如双手机器人）变得可行。该方法结合了无监督技能发现与离线策略RL，在双手机器人操作任务上达到SOTA，且能在不到一小时的现实交互中学习接触丰富的全身任务，无需演示或手工先验。
Motivation: 真实世界强化学习受限于安全探索和样本效率，而仿真到现实迁移因现实差距而脆弱，难以应用于高自由度机器人系统。
Method: SLAC利用低保真模拟器通过定制无监督技能发现方法预训练一个潜在动作空间，该空间促进时间抽象、解耦和安全性；然后将其作为离线策略RL算法的动作接口，在真实世界中自主学习下游任务。
Result: 在一系列双手机器人操作任务上，SLAC达到现有最优性能，且能在不到一小时的现实交互中学习接触丰富的全身任务，无需演示或手工行为先验。
Conclusion: SLAC通过预训练潜在动作空间，有效桥接了仿真与现实的差距，使真实世界RL在复杂机器人上变得高效且安全。

papers.title: AuditVotes: Elevating Provable Defense for GNNs with Efficient Augmentation and Conditional Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: Despite advancements in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), adaptive attacks continue to challenge their robustness. Certified robustness via randomized smoothing offers provable guarantees but suffers from a severe accuracy-robustness trade-off, limiting its practical use. To bridge this gap, we introduce AuditVotes, the first framework that simultaneously achieves high clean accuracy and strong certified robustness. AuditVotes seamlessly integrates two novel components into the randomized smoothing pipeline: (1) graph rewiring augmentation, which denoises randomized graphs to recover data quality, and (2) conditional smoothing, which filters low-confidence votes to ensure prediction consistency. We establish a novel theoretical result, proving that certified robustness is preserved under arbitrary filtering functions. Designed for inductive learning, our framework generalizes to unseen nodes and applies broadly to other smoothing schemes, including de-randomized smoothing for graphs and Gaussian smoothing for images. Extensive experiments show AuditVotes delivers substantial gains: on Cora-ML under 20-edge attacks, it improves clean accuracy by 437.1% and certified accuracy by 409.3%, while maintaining comparable runtime to vanilla smoothing. As a widely applicable and efficient plug-in, AuditVotes offers higher accuracy and stronger guarantees, enabling the practical and certifiably robust GNNs in security-sensitive domains.

papers.title: MAnchors: Memorization-Based Acceleration of Anchors via Rule Reuse and Transformation
papers.abstract_en: Anchors is a popular local model-agnostic explanation technique whose applicability is limited by its computational inefficiency. To address this limitation, we propose a memorization-based framework that accelerates Anchors while preserving explanation fidelity and interpretability. Our approach leverages the iterative nature of Anchors' algorithm which gradually refines an explanation until it is precise enough for a given input by storing and reusing intermediate results obtained during prior explanations. Specifically, we maintain a memory of low-precision, high-coverage rules and introduce a rule transformation framework to adapt them to new inputs: the horizontal transformation adapts a pre-trained explanation to the current input by replacing features, and the vertical transformation refines the general explanation until it is precise enough for the input. We evaluate our method across tabular, text, and image datasets, demonstrating that it significantly reduces explanation generation time while maintaining fidelity and interpretability, thereby enabling the practical adoption of Anchors in time-sensitive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anchors是一种局部模型无关的解释方法，但计算效率低。本文提出基于记忆的加速框架，通过存储和重用之前解释中的中间结果（低精度高覆盖规则），并引入水平变换和垂直变换来适应新输入，从而在保持保真度和可解释性的同时大幅缩短解释生成时间。在表格、文本和图像数据集上的实验证实了其效率提升。
Motivation: Anchors解释方法计算开销大，限制了在时间敏感场景中的实际应用。
Method: 维护一个记忆库存储低精度高覆盖的规则，通过水平变换（替换特征）将预训练解释适应新输入，再通过垂直变换逐步细化直到满足精度要求。
Result: 在表格、文本和图像数据集上，显著减少了解释生成时间，同时保持了保真度和可解释性。
Conclusion: 该框架使Anchors能够高效应用于时间敏感任务，扩展了其实用性。

papers.title: Rethinking the Global Knowledge of CLIP in Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent works modify CLIP to perform open-vocabulary semantic segmentation in a training-free manner (TF-OVSS). In vanilla CLIP, patch-wise image representations mainly encode homogeneous image-level properties, which hinders the application of CLIP to the dense prediction task. Previous TF-OVSS works sacrifice globality to enhance the locality of CLIP features, by making each patch mainly attend to itself or its neighboring patches within a narrow local window. With their modifications,the ability of CLIP to aggregate global context information is largely weakened. Differently, in this paper, we rethink the global knowledge encoded by CLIP and propose GCLIP to answer how to extract and utilize beneficial global knowledge of CLIP for TF-OVSS. As the representation of each patch is finally determined by the attention weights and the Value embeddings, we propose to reshape the last-block attention and Value embeddings to aggregate useful global context into final features. Firstly, we aim to equip the last-block attention with image-level properties while not introducing homogeneous attention patterns across patches. To realize the goal, we fuse the attention from the global-token emerging blocks with the Query-Query attention. Secondly, we aim to make Value embeddings of the last-block attention module more semantically correlated. To realize this, we design a novel channel suppression strategy.Extensive experiments on five standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-arts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考CLIP中的全局知识，提出一种无需训练的开放词汇语义分割方法GCLIP，通过重塑最后块的注意力权重和Value嵌入来聚合有益的全局上下文，避免牺牲全局性，在五个标准基准上持续超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有的无需训练开放词汇语义分割（TF-OVSS）方法通过限制每个patch的注意力到自身或邻域来增强局部性，但严重削弱了CLIP的全局上下文聚合能力。本文旨在提取并利用CLIP编码的有益全局知识，同时保持patch的区分性。
Method: 提出GCLIP，包含两个关键设计：(1) 将全局token出现块的注意力与Query-Query注意力融合，使最后块注意力具备图像级属性但避免同质化；(2) 设计通道抑制策略，使最后块注意力模块的Value嵌入在语义上更相关。
Result: 在五个标准基准（如Pascal VOC、COCO等）上，GCLIP一致优于先前的无需训练开放词汇语义分割方法。
Conclusion: 本文证明无需训练即可有效利用CLIP的全局知识进行开放词汇语义分割，且全局性的保持对性能至关重要。

papers.title: CTC: The Composite Task Challenge for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The critical role of division of labor (DOL) in enhancing cooperation is well-recognized in real-world applications. Consequently, many cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) methods have incorporated DOL mechanisms to improve cooperation among agents. However, the lack of benchmark tasks specifically designed to evaluate and promote DOL and cooperation has limited the effective development and deployment of such mechanisms in cooperative MARL. This gap between current cooperative MARL methods and practical applications underscores the need for evaluation tasks that explicitly require DOL and cooperation. To address this gap, we propose the Composite Tasks Challenge (CTC), a suite of tasks explicitly designed to require both DOL and cooperation for successful task completion. The CTC tasks are constructed based on two core design principles: 1) DOL is a necessary condition for task success; 2) Failure in any atomic subtask results in failure of the overall task. The first principle emphasizes the necessity of DOL, while the second enforces the importance of cooperation, making both components essential for success in CTC tasks. We evaluate nine representative cooperative MARL methods on the proposed CTC tasks. Experimental results show that all methods consistently achieve zero test winning rates across all CTC tasks, highlighting the challenge of CTC tasks and the limitations of current methods. To facilitate future research, we also introduce a guiding solution that achieves non-zero test winning rates on all tasks, thereby demonstrating the solvability of the CTC tasks. However, the performance of this guiding solution remains suboptimal, further underscoring the value of CTC tasks as a challenging and meaningful testbed for advancing cooperative MARL research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出复合任务挑战（CTC），一套专门设计用于评估和促进多智能体强化学习中的分工与合作能力的基准任务。CTC任务基于两个核心设计原则：分工是任务成功的必要条件，且任何原子子任务的失败都会导致整体任务失败。实验结果表明，九种代表性合作MARL方法在所有CTC任务上的测试胜率均为零，凸显了当前方法的局限性。作者还提供了一个引导性解决方案，在所有任务上取得非零胜率，但性能仍不理想，表明CTC任务具有挑战性和价值。
Motivation: 现有合作MARL方法虽然引入了分工机制，但缺乏专门设计来评估和促进分工与合作的基准任务，导致方法开发和部署受限。
Method: 提出复合任务挑战（CTC），基于两个设计原则构建：分工是任务成功的必要条件，且任何原子子任务失败会导致整体任务失败。
Result: 九种代表性合作MARL方法在所有CTC任务上的测试胜率均为零；一个引导性解决方案获得非零胜率但性能次优。
Conclusion: CTC任务为合作MARL研究提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，当前方法尚无法有效解决，未来需要更好的分工与合作机制。

papers.title: Derivation of effective gradient flow equations and dynamical truncation of training data in Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: We derive explicit equations governing the cumulative biases and weights in Deep Learning with ReLU activation function, based on gradient descent for the Euclidean loss in the input layer, and under the assumption that the weights are, in a precise sense, adapted to the coordinate system distinguished by the activations. We show that gradient descent corresponds to a dynamical process in the input layer, whereby clusters of data are progressively reduced in complexity ("truncated") at an exponential rate that increases with the number of data points that have already been truncated. We provide a detailed discussion of several types of solutions to the gradient flow equations. A main motivation for this work is to shed light on the interpretability question in supervised learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推导了深度学习中ReLU激活函数下累积偏置和权重的显式方程，基于输入层欧氏损失的梯度下降，并假设权重适应激活区分的坐标系。研究表明梯度下降对应于输入层中数据聚类以指数速率被逐步截断的动态过程，截断速率随已截断数据点数量增加而增大。详细讨论了梯度流方程的几类解，主要动机是阐明监督学习中的可解释性问题。
Motivation: 当前深度学习模型的可解释性不足，尤其是梯度下降过程中训练数据的动态行为尚未被充分理解。本文旨在从微分方程角度揭示数据在训练中的演化机制。
Method: 基于ReLU激活函数和欧氏损失，在假设权重适应激活坐标系的前提下，推导梯度下降对应的累积偏置和权重的有效梯度流方程。分析表明该过程等价于输入层数据聚类的指数速率截断。
Result: 推导出显式的梯度流方程，证明数据聚类以指数速率被截断，且截断速率与已截断数据点数量成正比。讨论了多类解的结构。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解监督学习中梯度下降的数据处理机制提供了理论框架，有助于增强深度学习模型的可解释性，但仅限于ReLU激活和特定假设下的情形。

papers.title: AutoSpec: Automated Generation of Neural Network Specifications
papers.abstract_en: The increasing adoption of neural networks in learning-augmented systems highlights the growing need for model safety and robustness, especially in safety-critical domains. While recent advances in neural network verification offer formal guarantees on worst-case behavior, existing approaches require users to manually define model specifications, an error-prone, incomplete, and time-consuming process. In this paper, we present AutoSpec, the first comprehensive framework for automatically generating and evaluating neural network specifications for learning-augmented systems. AutoSpec introduces a tree-based algorithm that adaptively partitions the input space to generate specification sets aligned with model behavior, as well as a statistical certification framework that provides rigorous accuracy guarantees for each specification. We also propose a principled evaluation framework that defines interpretable metrics for specification accuracy and coverage, establishing a benchmark for future research. Experiments across four diverse applications show that AutoSpec outperforms both manually defined specifications and existing baseline algorithms, improving the F1 score by up to 53% over human-defined specifications and 73% over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoSpec 是首个自动生成和评估神经网络规范的框架，用于学习增强系统。它采用基于树的算法自适应划分输入空间，生成与模型行为一致的规范集，并配以统计认证框架提供准确性保证。在四个应用上，AutoSpec 相比人工定义规范和基线，F1 分数提升最高达 53% 和 73%。
Motivation: 现有神经网络验证依赖手动定义规范，过程易错、不完整且耗时。AutoSpec 旨在自动化这一流程，提升规范生成的效率与可靠性。
Method: 提出基于树的输入空间划分算法生成规范集，以及统计认证框架为每个规范提供严格的准确性保证。同时定义了可解释的评估指标（准确性、覆盖率），建立基准。
Result: 在四个不同应用上，AutoSpec 的 F1 分数比人工定义规范提升最高 53%，比最强基线提升最高 73%。
Conclusion: 自动生成规范能显著提升学习增强系统的安全性与鲁棒性验证效率，且所提评估框架为后续研究提供了标准。

papers.title: Instability in Complex Oscillator Networks: Limitations and Potentials of Network Measures and Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: A central question of network science is how functional properties of systems emerge from their structure. For networked dynamical systems, structure is typically captured through network measures. We investigate the relationship between these measures and stability metrics across non-linear and linear oscillators, as well as real-world power grid topologies and dynamics. We find that this relationship is highly sensitive to the underlying ensemble: minor changes in the networks considered, such as going from mean degree 6 to mean degree 8, can invert the correlation between a network measure and stability. We also investigate network measures as inputs for machine learning, as well as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) as predictors of stability. Both GNNs and the non-linear combination of many network measures can accurately predict stability within a given ensemble, yet both can fail when the ensemble changes. We conclude that neither approach reliably identifies the underlying structural causes of instability.

TL;DR: 本文系统考察了网络度量与耦合振荡器系统稳定性之间的关系，发现这种关系高度依赖于网络系综的细微变化（如平均度从6变为8会逆转相关性）。研究还测试了基于网络度量的机器学习模型和图神经网络（GNN）作为稳定性预测器的效果：在单一系综内表现良好，但更换系综后性能急剧下降。论文结论认为，无论传统网络度量还是学习模型，都无法可靠地识别不稳定性的结构根源。
Motivation: 网络科学的核心问题是系统功能如何从结构中涌现，但现有网络度量与动力系统稳定性之间的关联缺乏系统性验证，且跨系综泛化能力未知。
Method: 通过线性与非线性振荡器模型以及真实电网拓扑，计算多种网络度量（如度、聚类系数、特征向量中心性）与稳定性的相关性；同时训练基于网络度量的回归模型和图神经网络（GNN）预测稳定性。
Result: 网络度量-稳定性相关性对系综很敏感（例如平均度6与8的结果相反）；GNN与非线性度量组合在单个系综内预测准确，但系综变化时两者均失效。
Conclusion: 论文强调，无论是传统网络度量还是机器学习方法，都无法可靠识别不稳定性的结构成因，提示研究者需要更谨慎地解释结构-稳定性关系。

papers.title: Why do CNNs excel at feature extraction? A mathematical explanation
papers.abstract_en: Over the past decade deep learning has revolutionized the field of computer vision, with convolutional neural network models proving to be very effective for image classification benchmarks. However, a fundamental theoretical questions remain answered: why can they solve discrete image classification tasks that involve feature extraction? We address this question in this paper by introducing a novel mathematical model for image classification, based on feature extraction, that can be used to generate images resembling real-world datasets. We show that convolutional neural network classifiers can solve these image classification tasks with zero error. In our proof, we construct piecewise linear functions that detect the presence of features, and show that they can be realized by a convolutional network.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于特征提取的图像分类数学模型，并证明卷积神经网络（CNN）能够在这些任务上实现零错误分类。通过构造检测特征的逐段线性函数，作者展示了这些函数可由卷积网络实现。
Motivation: 深度学习在计算机视觉中取得巨大成功，但缺乏理论解释：为何CNN能有效解决涉及特征提取的离散图像分类任务？
Method: 引入一个基于特征提取的图像分类数学模型，该模型可生成类似真实世界的数据集。构造逐段线性函数来检测特征，并证明这些函数可被卷积网络实现。
Result: 证明CNN分类器能在该模型生成的分类任务上实现零错误。
Conclusion: 该工作为CNN在图像分类中的特征提取能力提供了数学解释，但仅针对特定构造模型，尚未推广到真实复杂场景。

papers.title: Learn to Memorize: Scalable Continual Learning in Semiparametric Models with Mixture-of-Neighbors Induction Memory
papers.abstract_en: Semiparametric language models (LMs) have shown promise in various Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. However, they utilize non-parametric memory as static storage, which lacks learning capability and remains disconnected from the internal information flow of the parametric models, limiting scalability and efficiency. Based on recent interpretability theories of LMs, we reconceptualize the non-parametric memory represented by $k$NN-LM as a learnable Mixture-of-Neighbors Induction Memory (MoNIM), which synergizes the induction capabilities of attention heads with the memorization strength of feed-forward networks (FFN). By integrating into the model's information flow, MoNIM functions as an FFN-like bypass layer within the Transformer architecture, enabling effective learning of new knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNIM is a retentive and scalable continual learner in both data- and model-wise, enhancing the scalability and continual learning performance of semiparametric LMs.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), pages 28517-28531, Vienna, Austria. Association for Computational Linguistics, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新概念化半参数语言模型中的非参数记忆，提出可学习的Mixture-of-Neighbors Induction Memory (MoNIM)，将其作为Transformer中类似FFN的旁路层，融合注意力头的归纳能力和前馈网络的记忆能力，实现有效的新知识学习。实验表明MoNIM在数据和模型维度上均具有良好的记忆性和可扩展性，提升了半参数语言模型的持续学习性能。
Motivation: 现有半参数语言模型（如kNN-LM）的非参数记忆作为静态存储，缺乏学习能力且与参数模型信息流脱节，限制了可扩展性和效率。
Method: 基于语言模型的可解释性理论，将kNN-LM的非参数记忆重新设计为可学习的Mixture-of-Neighbors Induction Memory (MoNIM)，作为Transformer中的FFN-like旁路层，集成到模型信息流中。
Result: 大量实验表明MoNIM在数据和模型维度上均具有记忆性和可扩展性，提升了半参数语言模型的持续学习性能，具体结果摘要未给出数值。
Conclusion: MoNIM能有效学习新知识，增强半参数语言模型的可扩展性和持续学习能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Intentional Electromagnetic Interference Attacks on Facial Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Attacks on general computer vision algorithms are often relegated to the digital domain, with the optimization performed purely in the digital world and then translated to physical mediums for implementation. In the field of biometrics, including facial recognition, physical presentation attacks targeting biometric sensors are dominant and present significant opportunity and risk. This paper highlights a critical vulnerability in the physical-to-digital pipeline of biometric sensors and provides a standardized approach for testing facial recognition system robustness against hardware attacks, going beyond and potentially complementing presentation attacks (as defined in ISO/IEC 30107 standard series). Specifically, in this work we (a) demonstrate that intentional electromagnetic interference is possible to be conducted with commonly accessible radio frequency (RF) equipment, (b) assess the robustness of state-of-the-art face recognition methods against RF-based attacks, and (c) provide a dataset composed of face images captured with and without electromagnetic interference to serve as a new benchmark for testing modern face matchers against RF-sourced interference.
papers.comment: To be published in IEEE/IAPR IJCB (International Joint Conference on Biometrics) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了利用常见射频设备发出的电磁干扰可攻击人脸识别系统的物理-数字管道，评估了多种最先进人脸识别方法对此类攻击的鲁棒性，并发布了一个包含干扰前后人脸图像的数据集作为新基准。
Motivation: 现有针对人脸识别的攻击多集中在数字域或物理演示攻击，而硬件层面的电磁干扰攻击尚未被系统研究，存在安全漏洞。
Method: 使用常见射频设备产生电磁干扰，在物理域干扰摄像头传感器，从而影响人脸图像采集；收集干扰前后的人脸图像数据集，并测试多种SOTA人脸识别方法的匹配性能。
Result: 实验表明常用射频设备可成功实施电磁干扰攻击，且SOTA人脸识别方法对此类攻击表现出脆弱性。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了生物识别传感器物理-数字管道中的关键安全漏洞，并提供了一个标准化测试框架和数据集，有助于未来研究RF攻击的防御。

papers.title: An Auto-Scaling Approach for Serverless Environments Based on a Multi-Expert Consensus Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Serverless computing provides automatic resource management and pay-per-use execution, but effective autoscaling remains challenging because of dynamic workloads, cold-start latency, and dependencies among functions. We present a dependency-aware autoscaling framework that integrates graph-based bottleneck identification, short-term workload forecasting, multi-model consensus, and cost-aware scaling control. Serverless applications are represented as directed dependency graphs, and structurally important functions are identified using weighted degree centrality. Resource demand is predicted using lightweight MLP, LSTM, and CNN models. Their outputs are combined through a performance-weighted probabilistic ensemble inspired by Bayesian model averaging. The controller further incorporates cold-start awareness and cost comparison to select among scale-up, scale-down, and hold actions. Experiments using real workload traces show that supervised forecasting substantially outperforms unsupervised clustering for autoscaling decision generation. The proposed ensemble achieves 99.88 percent prediction accuracy and reduces prediction error compared with representative hybrid forecasting methods. Evaluations across multiple cloud pricing models also demonstrate consistent infrastructure cost reductions while maintaining performance targets. The results show that combining dependency analysis, multi-expert forecasting, and cost-aware control provides a robust and practical solution for serverless autoscaling.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多专家共识机制的服务器无服务器环境自动扩展方法，通过依赖图、瓶颈识别、短期工作负载预测、多模型集成和成本感知控制来实现。实验表明监督预测优于无监督聚类，集成模型达到99.88%预测准确率，并在多个云定价模型下降低成本。
Motivation: 服务器无服务器计算面临动态工作负载、冷启动延迟和函数间依赖等挑战，现有自动扩展方法效果有限。
Method: 将无服务器应用表示为有向依赖图，使用加权度中心性识别关键函数；采用MLP、LSTM、CNN进行资源需求预测，通过性能加权概率集成（类似贝叶斯模型平均）融合输出；控制器结合冷启动感知和成本比较选择扩缩容动作。
Result: 在真实工作负载轨迹上，监督预测显著优于无监督聚类；集成模型达到99.88%预测准确率，预测误差低于代表性混合方法；在多个云定价模型下实现一致的基础设施成本降低。
Conclusion: 结合依赖分析、多专家预测和成本感知控制为服务器无服务器自动扩展提供了稳健实用的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Driven AutoML for Cross-Lingual Handwritten OCR: Closed-Loop Neural Architecture Search with GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4
papers.abstract_en: We present a fully automated closed-loop AutoML framework that uses GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4 as autonomous neural architecture designers for cross-lingual handwritten optical character recognition. Each large language model independently generates, trains, evaluates, and iteratively refines neural network architectures using performance feedback from previous trials. The framework is evaluated on Arabic, Persian, and English handwriting datasets through 270 independent experiments. It consistently discovers accurate and computationally efficient models without manual architecture design, domain-specific preprocessing, or hyperparameter tuning. The generated models achieve mean test accuracies above 93 percent, a best accuracy of 98.1 percent, and inference latency between 41 and 44 milliseconds. The results demonstrate that large language models can function as effective AutoML agents for neural architecture search, enabling scalable, script-adaptive, and reproducible handwriting recognition across languages.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 10 figures, and 2 tables. Published in the 2025 15th International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE)
papers.journal_ref: 2025 15th International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE), IEEE, 2025, Article No. 11273810
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个完全自动化的闭环AutoML框架，利用GPT-5、GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4作为自主神经网络架构设计器，用于跨语言手写光学字符识别。每个大语言模型独立生成、训练、评估并迭代优化神经网络架构，无需人工设计、领域特定预处理或超参数调优。在阿拉伯语、波斯语和英语手写数据集上通过270次独立实验，生成的模型平均测试准确率超过93%，最高准确率达98.1%，推理延迟在41到44毫秒之间。
Motivation: 手写OCR的神经网络架构设计通常依赖人工专家知识和繁琐的调参，跨语言场景下更难自动化。现有AutoML方法在架构搜索空间和可扩展性上存在局限，大语言模型的推理能力未被充分用于自主神经网络设计。
Method: 采用闭环AutoML框架，将GPT-5、GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4作为架构搜索主体：每个LLM独立生成模型代码、训练并评估性能，根据反馈（准确率、效率）自动修改架构，迭代多次。无需手动干预或预设搜索空间。
Result: 在三个手写数据集（阿拉伯语、波斯语、英语）上，平均测试准确率>93%，最佳准确率98.1%，推理延迟41-44毫秒。与传统方法相比，自动发现的模型在准确率和计算效率上均有竞争力。
Conclusion: 大语言模型可作为有效的AutoML代理进行神经架构搜索，实现可扩展、脚本自适应且可复现的跨语言手写识别，无需人工设计特征或架构。

summary_sections.result: 在三个手写数据集（阿拉伯语、波斯语、英语）上，平均测试准确率>93%，最佳准确率98.1%，推理延迟41-44毫秒。与传统方法相比，自动发现的模型在准确率和计算效率上均有竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 大语言模型可作为有效的AutoML代理进行神经架构搜索，实现可扩展、脚本自适应且可复现的跨语言手写识别，无需人工设计特征或架构。

papers.title: Fast and Scalable Caputo Fractional Gradient Descent via Perturbation-Preserving Memory Compression
papers.abstract_en: Fractional gradient descent (FGD) incorporates long-range memory through Caputo-type operators and has been shown to improve stability in ill-conditioned and nonconvex optimization problems. Despite these advantages, its practical use remains limited, mainly due to the high computational cost of evaluating history-dependent convolutions, which scales quadratically with the number of iterations. In this paper, we focus on making Caputo-based optimization computationally viable without sacrificing its intrinsic memory structure. We begin by expressing the fractional descent direction as a discrete convolution over past gradients, which provides a unified view of the method. Based on this formulation, we introduce two complementary mechanisms to reduce the cost of the memory term. The first uses a sum-of-exponentials (SOE) approximation of the power-law kernel, leading to efficient recursive updates. The second approach, newly proposed in this paper as dyadic hierarchical discrete convolution (DHDC), compresses the gradient history through a multiscale aggregation strategy. Rather than treating these approximations as purely numerical accelerations, we interpret them as perturbations of the ideal Caputo operator. This viewpoint allows us to analyze how the compressed memory affects the optimization dynamics. Under standard $μ$-strong convexity and $L$-smoothness assumptions, we show that the resulting method still exhibits monotone descent and linear convergence, provided that the approximation error remains controlled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Caputo分数阶梯度下降（FGD）中历史依赖卷积的高计算成本（与迭代次数二次增长）问题，提出了两种互补的压缩机制：指数和（SOE）近似实现递归更新，以及新提出的二进层次离散卷积（DHDC）多尺度聚合策略。将近似视为对理想Caputo算子的扰动，并在μ强凸和L光滑假设下证明压缩后的方法仍保持单调下降和线性收敛，只要近似误差可控。
Motivation: 分数阶梯度下降虽能改善病态和非凸问题的稳定性，但因计算历史依赖卷积的成本随迭代次数二次增长而难以实用。
Method: 将分数阶下降方向表示为过去梯度的离散卷积；然后采用两种方法降低记忆项成本：1) 幂律核的指数和（SOE）近似实现递归更新；2) 新提出的二进层次离散卷积（DHDC）通过多尺度聚合压缩梯度历史。将近似视为对理想Caputo算子的扰动。
Result: 在μ强凸和L光滑假设下，压缩后的方法仍具有单调下降和线性收敛性质，前提是近似误差可控。
Conclusion: 论文表明通过合理的记忆压缩，可使Caputo分数阶优化在保持记忆结构的同时变得计算可行，且理论保证收敛性。

papers.title: VarRate: Training-Free Variable-Rate KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) inference. Two leading training-free families are both structurally limited: token-selection methods (SnapKV, Ada-KV) score importance from an observation window and evict low-scoring tokens, but eviction is irreversible -- so when the importance signal degrades under query-agnostic reuse, accuracy collapses by 11-15 points; uniform low-rank coding keeps every token but spends equal rank everywhere, wasting budget. We observe that both failures share one cure: rank should be allocated, not evicted. We present VarRate, a training-free KV codec that assigns each token a variable low-rank budget by its query salience, keeping every token at a nonzero rank. Comparable adaptive-rank codecs reach this allocation only through training; VarRate requires none. Because no token is dropped, it degrades by only 3.5-5.5 points where query-aware selection collapses. At a matched 20% budget on LongBench (16 tasks), VarRate stays within 0.8 points of the uncompressed model on both Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B. Averaged over the two, it is the strongest matched-memory compressor. It significantly beats its uniform-rank ablation on both models. Against KVzip, a method purpose-built for query-agnostic reuse, it is accuracy-equivalent in three of four settings and within a point overall, at about one-eighth the prefill overhead.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 24 tables. Includes appendix with additional experiments and analyses
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VarRate是一种无需训练的变速率KV缓存压缩方法，通过为每个令牌分配可变的低秩预算（基于查询显著性）来保留所有令牌，从而避免不可逆的令牌驱逐导致的精度下降。在LongBench基准测试中，20%预算下与未压缩模型的性能差距在0.8分以内，优于匹配内存的现有方法，且预处理开销约为KVzip的八分之一。
Motivation: 现有的无训练KV缓存压缩方法（如令牌选择方法SnapKV、Ada-KV）因不可逆的驱逐导致精度大幅下降（11-15分），而均匀低秩编码浪费预算。核心问题在于应分配秩而非驱逐令牌。
Method: 提出VarRate，一种无需训练的低秩编解码器，根据查询显著性（query salience）为每个令牌分配可变的低秩预算，确保所有令牌保持非零秩，从而实现无驱逐的压缩。
Result: 在LongBench（16任务）上，20%预算下仅比未压缩模型低0.8分（Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B）；击败均匀秩消融；与KVzip精度相当但预填充开销低约八分之一。在查询感知选择崩溃的场景中，仅下降3.5-5.5分。
Conclusion: VarRate通过可变秩分配实现无驱逐压缩，在无需训练的情况下达到与训练方法相当的性能，尤其适用于长上下文LLM推理中的高精度和低内存需求。
