papers.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Out of everything the human brain processes, only a small fraction is consciously accessible, in the sense of being available for verbal report, deliberate control, and flexible reasoning. In this paper, we present evidence that an analogous functional distinction has emerged in large language models. Using a new interpretability technique, the Jacobian lens, we identify the representations a model is poised to verbalize at any point in its processing. These representations, which we collectively call the J-space, exhibit the functional properties characteristic of a global workspace: their contents can be reported, deliberately summoned and held, used to carry the intermediate steps of silent reasoning, and passed as arguments to arbitrary downstream computations, while automatic processing such as text parsing and routine inference proceeds without them. The J-space also has structural signatures that global workspace theory associates with conscious access: it carries coherent content only in an intermediate band of layers, holds on the order of tens of concepts at a time, and is broadcast by the model's weights more widely than other representations. These properties make it a practical window into a model's unspoken thinking. In alignment audits, it reveals strategic deliberation, evaluation awareness, and trained-in misaligned dispositions that never appear in the model's outputs. We find that post-training installs the Assistant's point of view in the workspace, and we introduce counterfactual reflection training, which improves behavior by training only what a model would say if interrupted and asked to reflect. These results indicate that language models maintain a small, privileged set of representations bearing some of the functional hallmarks of conscious access, and that decoding these representations sheds light on ongoing cognitive processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为雅可比透镜 (Jacobian lens) 的可解释性技术，用于识别大语言模型在推理过程中可言语化的表征（即 J-space）。实验表明，这些表征具有全局工作空间 (global workspace) 的功能特性：能被报告、有意召回和保持，用于静默推理的中间步骤，并作为任意下游计算的参数，而自动处理（如文本解析和常规推断）则无需这些表征。J-space 还具有结构特征，如仅在中间层携带连贯内容、同时容纳约数十个概念，以及比其它表征更广泛地广播。在一致性审计中，它能揭示模型从未输出的战略思考、评估意识和经过训练的不一致倾向。后训练会在工作空间中安装助手的视角，而反事实反思训练通过仅训练模型在被打断并要求反思时会说的话来改善行为。
Motivation: 人类大脑处理的信息中只有一小部分是可意识访问的（即可报告、可灵活推理），而大语言模型中是否也存在类似的功能区分尚不清楚。本文旨在寻找证据，证明语言模型存在可言语化表征的全局工作空间，并利用其揭示模型的隐性认知过程。
Method: 开发了一种新的可解释性技术——雅可比透镜 (Jacobian lens)，用于识别模型在任意处理时刻准备言语化的表征（J-space）。通过分析这些表征的功能特性（可报告、可保持、可传递参数等）和结构特征（层分布、概念容量、广播范围），并在一致性审计中应用该技术。
Result: J-space 表征在功能上类似全局工作空间：它们能被言语报告、有意控制、用于静默推理和任意下游计算，而自动处理过程不需要它们。结构上，它们仅在中间层连贯，同时携带约数十个概念，且被更广泛地广播。在一致性审计中，J-space 揭示了模型从未输出的战略思考、评估意识和训练来的不一致倾向。后训练将助手的视角安装进工作空间，反事实反思训练通过仅训练模型被打断反思时的输出改善了行为。
Conclusion: 语言模型维护着一小部分特权表征，这些表征具有意识访问的一些功能特征；解码这些表征能揭示模型正在进行的认知过程，为模型行为对齐提供新的思路。

papers.title: Trajectory-aware Cross-view Geo-localization with Sequential Observations
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization matches ground-level observations against geo-tagged satellite imagery. Recent methods show that sequential queries such as video clips yield richer spatiotemporal cues than single images, yet they overlook a complementary sequential modality: route descriptions -- which capture the same trajectory at a higher level of abstraction and are often the only input available (e.g., a user directing an autonomous vehicle to a pickup point). To bridge this gap, we introduce SeqGeo-VL, a dataset of $\sim$39K video-text-satellite triplets, and TrajLoc, a unified framework capable of processing both video clips and route descriptions. By leveraging both dense visual and abstract linguistic semantics, TrajLoc enables these modalities to mutually reinforce cross-view matching. We further propose TrajMod, a lightweight module that conditions query embeddings on trajectory geometry, yielding spatially-aware representations. Experiments show that TrajLoc achieves substantial gains over state-of-the-art methods on both video and text geo-localization. The project page is available at https://humblegamer.github.io/trajloc/.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://humblegamer.github.io/trajloc/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TrajLoc框架，利用视频片段和路线描述两种顺序观测进行跨视角地理定位。构建了包含约3.9万视频-文本-卫星三元组的SeqGeo-VL数据集，并提出TrajMod模块，通过轨迹几何条件增强查询嵌入，实现空间感知表示。实验表明该方法在视频和文本地理定位上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法虽利用视频序列，但忽略了路线描述这一互补的顺序模态，而路线描述在用户引导自动驾驶等场景中常是唯一输入。
Method: 提出统一框架TrajLoc，同时处理视频片段和路线描述，通过密集视觉和抽象语言语义相互增强跨视角匹配。设计TrajMod模块，基于轨迹几何条件调整查询嵌入，生成空间感知表示。
Result: 在视频和文本地理定位任务上，TrajLoc均显著超越现有方法（具体增益未在摘要中量化）。
Conclusion: 该工作表明融合视频和路线描述的跨视角地理定位是可行的，且轨迹感知的表示学习能提升匹配性能。

papers.title: Diffusion models recover accurate mixture weights despite score function insensitivity
papers.abstract_en: Score-based generative models exhibit a puzzling behavior: they often appear to cover all modes of a target multimodal distribution and yet may fail to learn the correct relative mode amplitudes, which can be interpreted as mixture weights. We resolve this apparent paradox by relating the diffusion score matching (DSM) loss to the error in estimating mixture weights from generated samples. We show that, even when the target score is insensitive to mixture weights, generated samples can recover the weights accurately if the scores at intermediate noise levels are informative about the weights. Accordingly, we define the diffusion score sensitivity index (DSSI) as the variation in the DSM loss relative to changes in a parameter. We then show that the DSSI governs the accuracy with which the parameter of the target distribution can be estimated from generated samples. For Gaussian mixtures in arbitrary dimensions, we prove that the mixture weight estimation errors are on the same order as the DSM loss under mild conditions. Empirically, we show the emergence of sensitivity during the noising process of benchmark data distributions under typical noise schedules, and that these sensitivity values predict how well a well-trained model recovers mixture weights. Furthermore, we show that the choice of noise schedule can reduce diffusion sensitivity, leading to mode amplification. Although we focus on mixture weights, the proposed sensitivity framework governs the recovery of any qualitative parameter of the target distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了分数生成模型中的模式幅度（混合权重）恢复问题。作者发现，即使分数函数对混合权重不敏感，生成样本仍能准确恢复权重，原因是中间噪声水平的分数包含权重信息。他们定义了扩散分数敏感性指数（DSSI）并证明其控制参数估计误差，并在高斯混合和真实数据上验证了理论。
Motivation: 现有分数生成模型虽能覆盖多模态分布的所有模式，但常无法正确学习相对模式幅度（混合权重），这一矛盾缺乏理论解释。
Method: 将扩散分数匹配（DSM）损失与混合权重估计误差建立联系，定义扩散分数敏感性指数（DSSI）为DSM损失对参数变化的敏感度，并证明DSSI决定参数恢复精度。
Result: 理论证明在温和条件下高斯混合的权重估计误差与DSM损失同阶；实验显示典型噪声调度下数据分布的敏感性出现，且可预测模型恢复权重的能力；噪声调度选择能影响敏感性从而影响模式放大。
Conclusion: 本文提出的敏感性框架不仅适用于混合权重，还能控制目标分布任何定性参数的恢复，为理解生成模型的行为提供了统一视角。

papers.title: Inpainting Insights: Elevating Visual XAI with Photorealistic Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity of state-of-the-art machine learning models has made their behavior progressively harder to interpret, spurring rapid advancements in the field of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). Among many methods proposed, perturbation-based approaches play a major role. By systematically altering (perturbing) input features, these approaches measure the impact on the model's predictions. For image data, traditional perturbation techniques, often involve replacing pixel values e.g., with a pre-defined color. However, such approaches, but also more refined deterministic techniques, generate unrealistic out-of-distribution samples and often leave visible artifacts, which can mislead the model and compromise explanation quality. In this work, we adjust LIME, a widely used perturbation-based method, to demonstrate how generative inpainting can improve perturbation-based explanations for images. We achieve photorealistic perturbed samples that align better with the original data distribution and enhance explanation quality.
papers.comment: Preprint accepted at XAIE4 (ICPR 2026). 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/jo01123/LILI and https://github.com/m-chaves/LIME
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像可解释性（XAI）中扰动方法生成非真实样本的问题，改进LIME方法，利用生成式修复（inpainting）产生照片级逼真的扰动样本，使其更符合原始数据分布，从而提升解释质量。实验表明该方法能减少伪影并改进解释的保真度。
Motivation: 现有扰动方法通常用预设颜色替换像素或使用确定性技术，生成不现实的分布外样本和可见伪影，误导模型并降低解释质量。
Method: 在LIME框架中引入生成式修复模型，用修复后的逼真区域替代原始扰动方式，使扰动样本保持与原始数据分布一致。
Result: 生成的扰动样本更逼真，减少伪影，提升了基于扰动的解释质量。
Conclusion: 生成式修复可作为扰动方法的一种有效改进，提升图像XAI的解释质量。

papers.title: A Critical Analysis of Trustworthy AI Tools, Mark Frameworks, and the Implementation Chasms
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly impact society, ensuring their ethical and trustworthy deployment has become a global priority. While a myriad of high-level ethical guidelines have emerged, criticism persists that these frameworks remain abstract and lack concrete mechanisms for implementation. This paper conducts a critical analysis of tools and trust mark frameworks intended to operationalize trustworthy AI (TAI), drawing on a comprehensive dataset from the OECD. Through empirical mapping and descriptive comparative analysis, we identify significant asymmetries in ethical focus, lifecycle coverage, stakeholder targeting, and tool typology. Our findings show a strong emphasis on fairness, transparency, and robustness, with comparatively little attention paid to explainability, digital security, and environmental sustainability. Moreover, most tools and certifications concentrate on post-development stages, with limited guidance for early design or data collection phases. Educational initiatives and policy engagement are notably underdeveloped, suggesting that current TAI efforts are dominated by technical and procedural measures within industry contexts. We argue that bridging the persistent chasm between AI principles and practice requires expanding ethical objectives, embedding ethics across the AI lifecycle, and fostering broader multi-stakeholder participation. This study provides both a diagnosis of existing implementation gaps and actionable recommendations for advancing more holistic, inclusive, and enforceable AI governance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对可信人工智能（TAI）的工具和信任标记框架进行了批判性分析，基于OECD的综合数据集，通过实证映射和描述性比较分析，识别出伦理焦点、生命周期覆盖、利益相关者定位和工具类型学方面的显著不对称。研究发现当前工具和认证主要关注公平性、透明性和鲁棒性，而对可解释性、数字安全和环境可持续性投入不足，且集中于开发后期阶段，缺乏早期设计指导。文章呼吁扩大伦理目标、将伦理嵌入AI全生命周期，并推动更广泛的多方参与。
Motivation: 尽管已涌现出大量高层次伦理指南，但这些框架往往抽象且缺乏具体实施机制，导致AI原则与实践之间存在持续鸿沟。本文旨在诊断现有实施差距并提供可操作的建议以推动更全面、包容且可执行的AI治理。
Method: 基于OECD数据集，采用实证映射和描述性比较分析方法，对可信AI工具和信任标记框架进行系统梳理和比较。
Result: 发现伦理焦点显著偏向公平性、透明性和鲁棒性，忽视可解释性、数字安全和环境可持续性；大部分工具和认证集中于开发后期，缺乏对早期设计和数据收集阶段的指导；教育和政策参与明显不足。
Conclusion: 当前TAI努力主要由行业背景下的技术和程序性措施主导，要弥合AI原则与实践之间的鸿沟，需要扩大伦理目标、将伦理嵌入AI全生命周期，并促进多利益相关方参与。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Sleep Apnea Classification from Polysomnographic EEG Signals
papers.abstract_en: Sleep apnea diagnosis via polysomnography remains resource intensive and relies on time consuming manual data analysis and scoring. Recent work has demonstrated that central nervous system effects of sleep apnea events can be detected through electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. However, most work uses a single feature type on various datasets combined with different classification algorithms. In this work, we present a comprehensive comparison of deep learning architectures and feature representations for automated sleep apnea detection from multichannel EEG on a single dataset of pediatric subjects. We evaluate Vision Transformers and Graph Attention Networks across distinct signal representations: raw temporal signals, short-time Fourier transform spectrograms, coherence based graphs, and two topological data analysis (TDA) derived features. Using age and sex matching of our train and test sets, we train on 2410 pediatric subjects and test on 575 pediatric subjects. We achieve a best test AUC of 0.750 using a vision transformer based model trained on TDA features. Stratified analysis across patient demographics (age, sex, AHI severity) and sleep stages (N1, N2, N3, REM) reveals significant performance variation. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of EEG based automated OSA screening while highlighting essential challenges for clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于儿童多导睡眠图（PSG）的EEG信号，系统比较了多种深度学习架构（视觉Transformer、图注意力网络）和特征表示（原始时间信号、短时傅里叶变换频谱图、相干图、拓扑数据分析特征）在睡眠呼吸暂停自动检测中的性能。在2410名儿童训练集和575名测试集上，采用TDA特征训练的视觉Transformer模型取得最佳AUC 0.750，并揭示了患者人口学特征和睡眠分期的性能差异。
Motivation: 睡眠呼吸暂停诊断依赖耗时的手动评分，现有研究多采用单一特征类型，缺乏对多种深度学习架构和特征表示在同一数据集上的系统比较。
Method: 在同一儿童数据集上，比较视觉Transformer和图注意力网络，使用原始时间信号、STFT频谱图、相干图及两种拓扑数据分析特征作为输入，进行年龄和性别匹配的训练/测试划分。
Result: 最佳测试AUC为0.750，由基于TDA特征训练的视觉Transformer模型取得。按年龄、性别、AHI严重程度和睡眠分期进行的分层分析显示显著性能变化。
Conclusion: 该结果证明了基于EEG的自动OSA筛查可行性，同时指出了临床部署的关键挑战。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ptolemy's Equant Equates to a Universal Dynamical Clock via Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Oscillatory dynamics arise ubiquitously in nonlinear systems, yet identifying a physically interpretable phase and phase dynamics in nonlinear, high-dimensional oscillations remains a central unresolved problem. Here we establish the principle of a universal dynamical clock, a physical perspective in which oscillations of arbitrary dimensionality and geometry are equivalently represented as uniform rotation through an equant-induced nonlinear viewing coordinate, inspired by Ptolemy's equant and formalised through an areal-uniformity principle reminiscent of Kepler's second law. Using a machine-learning framework, we demonstrate the existence of such an equant for a broad class of oscillatory dynamics and construct the associated dynamical clock and phase dynamics under additive forces, including noise, periodic perturbations, and coupling. Its value in uncovering new physical rules and phenomena is demonstrated by four findings: (i) collective oscillations in Escherichia coli populations obey a previously unexplained superlinear scaling law, resolving a long-standing open problem posed in 2004; (ii) the response mechanisms of engineered genetic circuits to changes in gene expression and environmental conditions; (iii) a classical-mechanics counterpart of the Berry geometric phase emerges naturally from the phase of the dynamical clock; and (iv) optimal equant non-uniformity provides a geometric early-warning signal for critical transitions and enables prediction of critical parameters. By providing operational and system-agnostic phase dynamics that can be constructed directly from data, the dynamical clock enables principled classification, comparison, and control of oscillatory systems, and offers a new route to understanding how specific dynamical regimes support distinct functional behaviours in networked systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受托勒密等分点启发，提出普适动力学时钟原理，将任意维度和几何形状的振荡等价表示为均匀旋转。通过机器学习框架，构建了等分点坐标系及其对应的相位动力学，并在加性力（噪声、周期性扰动、耦合）下验证。四个关键发现：大肠杆菌群体振荡的超级线性标度律（解决2004年公开问题）、工程基因电路的响应机制、经典Berry几何相位的自然出现，以及等分点非均匀性作为临界转变的早期预警信号。
Motivation: 非线性高维振荡系统中，识别具有物理可解释性的相位和相位动力学是一个核心未解决问题。
Method: 建立普适动力学时钟原理，将任意维度和几何的振荡通过等分点诱导的非线性观测坐标等价为均匀旋转，形式化基于面积均匀性原理，并利用机器学习框架构建。
Result: 四个主要结果：1) 大肠杆菌集体振荡服从先前未解释的超线性标度律；2) 揭示工程基因电路对基因表达和环境变化的响应机制；3) 动力学时钟的相位自然衍生出经典Berry几何相位的对应物；4) 最优等分点非均匀性可作为临界转变的几何预警信号并预测临界参数。
Conclusion: 动力学时钟提供了可操作且系统无关的相位动力学，可直接从数据构建，支持振荡系统的类别划分、比较和控制，为理解特定动力学模式如何支持网络系统中的不同功能行为提供了新途径。

papers.title: FLINT: Fingerprinting Federated Learning Architectures from 5G PHY-Layer Side Channels
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) over 5G cellular networks protects raw data but remains vulnerable to side-channel leakage. Prior fingerprinting attacks assume packet-level network visibility, an assumption that does not hold at the 5G Physical (PHY) layer, where user payloads are encrypted and Radio Network Temporary Identifiers (RNTIs) may change over time. However, we demonstrate that PHY-layer scheduling metadata broadcast over the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) preserves architecture-associated temporal patterns. We introduce FLINT, a novel black-box fingerprinting framework that infers FL model architecture families, including CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers, using only coarse PHY-layer observations. FLINT overcomes the lack of network-layer visibility by decoding PDCCH scheduling information, mapping changing RNTIs to physical user devices, and applying multi-view temporal modeling to distinguish architecture-specific training behavior. This leakage is security-critical because knowledge of a client's model architecture can transform passive reconnaissance into targeted downstream exploitation. Extensive experiments on an over-the-air srsRAN-based 5G testbed demonstrate that FLINT achieves a macro F1-score of 0.930 for architecture-family classification. To our knowledge, FLINT is the first work to fingerprint AI/ML model architectures using lower-layer 5G side-channel information obtainable by any protocol-aware adversary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLINT，一种利用5G物理层（PHY）侧信道信息对联邦学习（FL）模型架构进行黑盒指纹识别的框架。FLINT通过解码物理下行控制信道（PDCCH）的调度元数据，将变化的无线网络临时标识符（RNTI）映射到用户设备，并采用多视图时序建模，在仅能获取粗粒度PHY层观测的条件下区分CNN、RNN和Transformer等架构家族。在基于srsRAN的5G测试平台上，FLINT达到0.930的宏F1分数，首次证明从5G底层侧信道可提取AI模型架构信息。
Motivation: 现有指纹攻击假设攻击者具备数据包级网络可见性，但5G物理层中用户负载被加密且RNTI可能动态变化，导致这些假设不成立。然而，PDCCH广播的调度元数据保留了与模型架构相关的时序模式，可被利用。
Method: 提出FLINT框架，包含三个核心步骤：1) 解码PDCCH调度信息；2) 利用跨子帧关联将变化的RNTI映射到固定物理用户设备；3) 应用多视图时序建模（multi-view temporal modeling）提取与架构相关的训练行为模式，实现黑盒架构家族分类。
Result: 在真实的5G空中测试平台（srsRAN）上，FLINT对架构家族分类的宏F1分数达到0.930。

papers.title: ADS-C: Antidistillation Sampling for Classification
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation enables an adversary to replicate a proprietary classifier by querying its prediction interface and training a surrogate on the returned probability vectors. Antidistillation sampling, proposed for large language models, counters this threat with an input-dependent, gradient-directed perturbation of the served distribution; its transfer to classification has not been studied. Adapting the defense to classification, we show its behavior is governed by the distribution of the teacher's per-input confidence margins. Because well-trained classifiers are severely overconfident, the direct transfer exhibits an inert window: below a closed-form-predictable threshold, it affects neither attacker nor defender; beyond it, the defense undergoes a phase transition and degrades the teacher faster than the attacker's student. Temperature softening rescales the transition in closed form, and every temperature configuration lies on the same unfavorable trade-off curve. Our method, ADS-C, composes the perturbation under a closed-form, per-input margin budget that provably preserves every served top-1 prediction, so the defended teacher's accuracy equals the undefended teacher's identically. Under this guarantee the distilled student still loses 17.4 percentage points on CIFAR-100, 29.6 on CIFAR-10, and 13.3 on Tiny-ImageNet; matching this degradation with the unmodified defense costs 27.5, 32.9, and 22.2 points of teacher accuracy. Because served labels are unchanged, a hard-label attacker gains nothing, while the defended soft output trains a student up to 29.7 points below that floor: the incentive to distill served probabilities is not merely removed but reversed. To our knowledge, ADS-C is the first antidistillation defense for classification whose utility cost is exactly zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ADS-C，一种针对分类任务的反蒸馏采样防御方法。通过输入相关的梯度扰动，在保证教师模型top-1预测不变的前提下，显著降低蒸馏学生的性能。实验表明，在CIFAR-100、CIFAR-10和Tiny-ImageNet上，学生准确率分别下降17.4、29.6和13.3个百分点，而教师准确率完全不受影响，实现了零效用成本的防御。
Motivation: 知识蒸馏可使攻击者通过查询分类接口训练替代模型，现有反蒸馏采样仅针对大语言模型，未扩展到分类任务。直接迁移存在惰性窗口和性能权衡，需要设计适用于分类的高效防御。
Method: ADS-C利用教师模型每输入置信度裕度的分布，计算闭式预算，对服务概率向量施加输入相关的梯度扰动，并通过温度缩放调整相变点。关键机制是保证每个输入的最高置信度标签不变，从而教师准确率与未防御时一致。
Result: 在CIFAR-100上学生准确率下降17.4个百分点，CIFAR-10下降29.6个百分点，Tiny-ImageNet下降13.3个百分点，而教师准确率完全不变。相较于未修改的防御（教师准确率分别下降27.5、32.9、22.2个百分点），ADS-C实现了零教师效用损失。
Conclusion: ADS-C是首个对分类任务实现零效用成本的反蒸馏防御，不仅保持教师精度，还反转了蒸馏动机：硬标签攻击者无收益，软标签学生性能远低于硬标签基准。

papers.title: From Black Box to Executable Logic: Explainable Reinforcement Learning through Prolog Expert Systems
papers.abstract_en: A trained deep reinforcement learning policy is a black box, and we ask whether it can be made explainable by rewriting it as an executable logic program that reproduces its behaviour and that a person can read, a logic engine can run, and an optimizer can edit. We present a three-stage post-hoc transformation that extracts a frozen proximal policy optimization teacher, induces an ordered rule list from its decisions in the manner of classical relational learning, and emits the result as a Prolog program whose every decision is executed by an off-the-shelf logic engine; a subsequent expansion stage edits the rule base and accepts an edit only when policy evaluation certifies a return increase. We prove four guarantees. A return-loss bound makes the distilled program a machine-checkable certificate in a finite Markov decision process, and the expansion loop improves monotonically and terminates. For the continuous-observation setting we answer whether the conversion is possible at all: the propositional threshold instantiation converts the network to arbitrary fidelity as the resolution B grows, with disagreement O(1/B) and a return gap that closes at the same rate, and a matching lower bound shows the cost is exponential in the observation dimension for an oblique decision boundary. Empirically, on a two-room key-and-door task with 16,944 reachable states the expanded Prolog program attains exact optimal return in every seed and, in a budget-capped regime, exceeds the stochastic teacher on exact return in ten of ten seeds. On three continuous-control tasks the emitted program substitutes the network, matching the neural teacher within noise on Acrobot with eleven clauses and recovering about 97% of its return on CartPole, while on the finer-control LunarLander it recovers only partially, exactly the ceiling the exponential lower bound predicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将深度强化学习策略转化为可执行Prolog程序的三阶段后处理方法，使黑盒策略变得可解释。该方法通过提取冻结的PPO教师、归纳有序规则列表，并输出为Prolog程序，随后通过编辑规则基来改进策略。论文证明了四个理论保证，并在离散和连续控制任务上进行了实验验证。
Motivation: 深度强化学习策略是黑盒模型，缺乏可解释性，不利于人类理解、调试和改进。
Method: 三阶段后处理转换：提取冻结的PPO教师；从决策中归纳有序规则列表（经典关系学习风格）；输出为Prolog程序，由现成逻辑引擎执行。后续扩展阶段编辑规则基，仅当策略评估确认回报增加时才接受编辑。
Result: 在包含16944个可达状态的两房间钥匙-门任务中，扩展后的Prolog程序在每个随机种子下均达到精确最优回报，在预算受限情况下，10/10种子超越随机教师。在三个连续控制任务中，Acrobot上使用11条子句匹配教师，CartPole上恢复约97%回报，LunarLander上仅部分恢复，符合指数下界预测。
Conclusion: 该方法能将深度强化学习策略转化为可解释、可执行的逻辑程序，并提供理论保证，但在高维连续控制任务中受限于指数复杂度下界。

papers.title: Robust Peak-cost Constrained Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study robust peak-cost constrained reinforcement learning (RP-CRL), where the objective is to maximize expected reward while controlling the maximum cost encountered along a trajectory. This setting is motivated by safety-critical applications in which a single large violation can be catastrophic and therefore cannot be adequately captured by the standard CMDP framework based on expected cumulative cost. Existing reachability-constrained RL methods adopt Lagrangian-based approaches, yet the underlying duality properties of peak-cost constrained MDPs remain unclear. We show that, unlike standard CMDPs, peak-cost constrained MDPs may not admit zero duality gap. We further consider a robust formulation to address simulator-to-real-world mismatch in the transition dynamics. To solve this problem, we develop a surrogate optimization framework and a robust value estimation method based on integral probability metrics. We prove that, with appropriate hyperparameter choices, the surrogate solution attains the same robust reward value as the original problem while violating the constraint by at most epsilon. Experiments show that the proposed method effectively enforces safety under dynamics perturbations while retaining strong reward performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究鲁棒峰值成本约束强化学习（RP-CRL），目标是在最大化期望奖励的同时控制轨迹中出现的最大成本。与标准CMDP不同，峰值成本约束MDP可能不具有零对偶间隙。作者提出基于积分概率度量的替代优化框架和鲁棒价值估计方法，证明在适当超参数下替代解能达到与原始问题相同的鲁棒奖励值且约束违反不超过ε。实验表明该方法在动力学扰动下有效保障安全并保持奖励性能。
Motivation: 安全关键应用中单个大违规可能是灾难性的，标准CMDP基于期望累积成本无法充分捕捉；现有可达性约束RL采用拉格朗日方法，但峰值成本约束MDP的对偶性质尚不清晰。
Method: 提出替代优化框架和基于积分概率度量的鲁棒价值估计方法，并证明其理论性质。
Result: 实验表明该方法在动力学扰动下有效强制安全约束，同时保持强奖励性能；理论保证替代解与原始问题鲁棒奖励值相同且约束违反不超过ε。
Conclusion: 峰值成本约束MDP可能不具有零对偶间隙，所提出的鲁棒方法在安全关键应用中有潜力。

papers.title: Looped Latent Attention: Cross-Loop KV Compression for Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Looped, weight-tied Transformers reduce parameters by reusing a block, but decoding still stores a separate K/V cache for every recurrence step. We show that this loop-indexed cache is highly structured. For a fixed token, layer and head, K/V vectors trace a short low-rank trajectory across loops, while the head and layer axes remain much flatter. We introduce Looped Latent Attention (LLA), a post-training cache codec that stores compact K and V latents and reconstructs loop-specific K/V vectors only when attention reads them. The default per-head codec compresses recurrence, while LLA-2D also folds heads into one latent for the extreme-compression regime. The codec is initialized from SVD of teacher activations and refined with KL and attention-output distillation. At matched cache budget, per-head LLA outperforms head-axis MLA, cross-layer sharing, KV quantization and final-loop reuse, showing that the recurrent cache is low-rank but not safely collapsible to a single state. The same axis advantage holds on Ouro-2.6B-Thinking and transfers to Huginn-3.5B, where an SVD codec remains near-lossless to 32x in decoder-independent evaluation. The cache reduction is exact. On one H200, the latent-store path increases measured Ouro-1.4B batch capacity at 4k context from 32 to 768 sequences at 21.3x compression. For long math rollouts, on-policy refinement on student-generated prefixes raises MATH-500 at 4x from 0.43 to 0.66 and reduces no-answer generations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Looped Latent Attention (LLA)，一种用于循环权重共享 Transformer 的后训练缓存编解码器。该编解码器利用循环中 KV 向量的低秩轨迹，为每个注意力头存储紧凑的潜变量，仅在读取时重建循环特定的 KV 向量。在匹配缓存预算下，该方法在多个模型上优于现有压缩方案，实现了超过 21 倍的压缩比，并在长数学推理中提升了准确率。
Motivation: 循环权重共享 Transformer 虽然减少了参数，但解码时仍需要为每个循环步骤存储独立的 KV 缓存，导致内存开销巨大。现有方法如 MLA 或量化未能充分利用循环间 KV 向量的结构化低秩特性。
Method: 提出 LLA 编解码器：基于 SVD 从教师激活初始化，结合 KL 散度和注意力输出蒸馏进行优化。默认 per-head 编解码器压缩循环维度，LLA-2D 进一步将多个头折叠为一个潜变量以实现极端压缩。
Result: 在 Ouro-1.4B 模型上，将 4k 上下文的批处理容量从 32 提升至 768 序列（21.3 倍压缩）。在 MATH-500 上，4 倍压缩时将准确率从 0.43 提升至 0.66，并减少无答案生成。
Conclusion: 循环 KV 缓存是低秩的，但不能安全地折叠为单一状态；所提出的循环轴压缩方法在多种设置下优于头轴或层轴压缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Design-Based Supervised Learning with Noisy Human Labels
papers.abstract_en: Researchers increasingly use automated classifiers to label unstructured data for statistical analysis. Existing rectification methods can correct errors in these automated labels using a probability-sampled audit set, but they usually treat the audit labels as correct. In practice, human audit labels are often noisy, and only some audited items are reviewed by an expert or adjudicator. We propose Partially Adjudicated Design-Based Supervised Learning (PA-DSL), a method for this setting. It uses adjudicated cases to correct noisy human labels and then uses the corrected audit information to debias analyses based on the full set of automated labels. The estimator is valid for a broad class of downstream analyses when the audit and adjudication probabilities are known. In synthetic and Wikipedia Detox semi-synthetic experiments, PA-DSL maintains nominal coverage and reduces RMSE by 10-17% relative to using only adjudicated labels when noisy human labels contain recoverable signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出部分裁决的基于设计监督学习（PA-DSL），用于纠正自动分类器标签和噪声人工标签中的错误。该方法利用裁决案例修正噪声人工标签，然后用修正后的审计信息去偏全自动标签的分析。在合成和Wikipedia Detox半合成实验中，PA-DSL保持名义覆盖，并在噪声人工标签包含可恢复信号时，相比仅使用裁决标签将RMSE降低10-17%。
Motivation: 现有纠错方法通常假设审计标签正确，但实际中人工审计标签常有噪声。PA-DSL旨在处理部分项目由专家或裁决者审查的情况，纠正噪声人工标签以改进下游分析。
Method: PA-DSL使用裁决案例修正噪声人工标签，再基于修正后的审计信息对全自动标签的分析进行去偏。该估计器在审计和裁决概率已知时对广泛的下游分析有效。
Result: 在合成和Wikipedia Detox实验中，PA-DSL保持名义覆盖，在噪声人工标签包含可恢复信号时，相比仅使用裁决标签将RMSE降低10-17%。
Conclusion: PA-DSL为含有噪声人工标签的审计场景提供有效纠偏方法，但需要已知的审计和裁决概率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prediction-Only Distillation in Linear and Logistic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation (SD) is typically studied when the student is retrained on the teacher's original training inputs. In many practical deployments, however, the labeled training data are no longer available, and one has access only to the trained predictor and fresh unlabeled covariates. We study SD in this prediction-only regime through a fresh-X prediction-mixed scheme: a pure-distilled student is trained on fresh covariates pseudo-labeled by the teacher, and the final predictor is an affine combination of the teacher and student predictions. For ridge regression under proportional asymptotics, we derive deterministic equivalents for the optimally mixed prediction risk under general anisotropic covariance and deterministic signal. We show that this risk is strictly smaller than the teacher risk for almost every pair of teacher and student regularization levels, including when the fresh covariates are out-of-distribution and even when their covariance is isotropic. We further show that the optimal mixing weight cannot be identified from unlabeled data alone, but can be consistently estimated in a single post-training step using a small independent labeled calibration set, without additional model fitting. Finally, for binary logistic regression, we show that prediction mixing can outperform both the teacher and the pure-distilled classifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自蒸馏在预测仅场景下的行为，即学生仅使用教师对新鲜未标记协变量的伪标签进行训练，最终预测器是教师和学生预测的仿射组合。对于岭回归在比例渐近下，推导了最优混合预测风险的确定性等价，证明其几乎总是小于教师风险，并且最优混合权重可以在一个小型独立校准集上一致估计。对于逻辑回归，预测混合可以优于教师和纯蒸馏分类器。
Motivation: 在实际部署中，标记训练数据可能不可用，只能访问训练好的预测器和新鲜未标记协变量，因此研究预测仅蒸馏。
Method: 提出新鲜X预测混合方案：学生使用教师对新鲜协变量的伪标签训练，最终预测器为教师和学生预测的仿射组合。在岭回归下推导渐近风险，并给出最优权重估计方法。
Result: 对于岭回归，最优混合风险几乎总是小于教师风险，甚至当新鲜协变量分布外或各向同性时；最优混合权重可使用小校准集一致估计。对于逻辑回归，预测混合优于教师和纯蒸馏。
Conclusion: 预测仅蒸馏在无标注训练数据时有效，且简单后处理步骤可以改进性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Relevant and Irrelevant: A Renormalization Group Analysis of Transformer Attention
papers.abstract_en: Using the language of Wilsonian renormalization group theory (RG), we treat the Transformer's attention mechanism as a perturbation of the trained MLP residual-stack fixed point and ask whether it constitutes a relevant, marginal, or irrelevant operator. We derive a fixed-point shift formula and obtain four testable predictions for the fixed-point geometry, effective rank profile, layer specificity, and perturbation decay spectrum. Testing these on synthetic Markov chain sequences with controlled correlation length, we find: (1) For large chains(long correlation), attention is strongly relevant: it closes a residual loss gap the MLP cannot bridge and drives a phase transition in representation space, with effective rank jumping above input dimensionality at layer 1 and stabilizing at a high-dimensional plateau. (2) For short chains(short correlation), attention is irrelevant: the Transformer converges to the same loss and fixed-point geometry as the MLP, though it contracts perturbations faster. (3) The transition is dominated by the first-layer head (L0H0), which accounts for more than 4 times the representational shift of any subsequent head, consistent with the prediction that the relevant operator acts before the MLP begins integrating out positional variation. (4) Perturbation decay experiments reveal a regime reversal: in the long correlation regime the Transformer selectively preserves slow Markov modes (5.4 times the dynamic range in decay length vs. 1.3 times for the MLP); in the short correlation regime it suppresses all modes faster than the MLP, with no spectral selectivity. Together, these results show that the relevance of attention is not a property of the architecture but of the spectral structure of the data-generating process, and that a first-order RG perturbation framework provides a predictive account of that difference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文运用威尔逊重整化群理论（RG），将Transformer的注意力机制视为对训练好的MLP残差堆固定点的微扰，判断其是否为相关、边缘或无关算子。推导了固定点漂移公式，并在具有可控相关长度的合成马尔可夫链序列上验证了四个可检验预测。结果表明，注意力的相关性并非架构属性，而是数据生成过程谱结构的函数，一阶RG微扰框架可预测这种差异。
Motivation: 理解Transformer中注意力机制在表示学习中的作用，特别是其相关性与数据统计特性之间的关系，以及如何从重整化群角度统一解释注意力在不同数据条件下的行为差异。
Method: 将注意力机制视为MLP残差堆固定点的微扰，利用威尔逊RG理论推导固定点漂移公式，并在合成马尔可夫链序列（长/短相关长度）上进行实验验证。
Result: 长相关长度（长链）下注意力是强相关算子，使有效秩在层1跳变并稳定在高维平台，第一层头（L0H0）贡献了超过4倍于后续头的表示漂移；短相关长度下注意力是无关算子，Transformer退化为与MLP相同的损失和固定点几何。扰动衰减实验显示长相关下Transformer选择性保留慢马尔可夫模式（衰减长度动态范围5.4倍 vs MLP的1.3倍），短相关下无谱选择性。
Conclusion: 注意力的相关性取决于数据生成过程的谱结构，一阶RG微扰框架可有效预测这种差异，提示RG方法可能为理解Transformer的表示学习提供理论工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM4EHR: Aligning Clinical Time Series with Medical Event Sequences via Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent research in clinical machine learning, focusing on outcome predictions in intensive care unit (ICU), has shifted from bespoke supervised models to foundation models, utilising modern representation learning methods. Here, foundation models are pre-trained on mixtures of complex clinical data modalities, useful for various downstream tasks. Existing works often utilise Electronic Health Records (EHR) to provide rich and diverse patient observations to train clinical foundation models. However, existing methods do not sufficiently explore the shared temporal structures between clinical events and time series (TS) observations recorded in EHRs. This limitation potentially leads to less robust and adaptive clinical foundation models, resulting in reduced performance on downstream tasks. To fully exploit this temporal structure, we propose LLM4EHR, a new clinical foundation model trained on ICU EHR data. Combining domain adapted large language models with a transformer TS encoder, we pre-trained LLM4EHR by temporally aligning the EHR events and TS. For this, we propose a regularised contrastive objective to learn robust EHR TS representations conditioned on EHR event embeddings produced by the domain adapted LLM. Supported by an ablation study, we find that learnt EHR TS embeddings from LLM4EHR improve performance on various downstream clinical tasks with competitive performance. Further, we empirically demonstrate that LLM4EHR learns transferable clinical TS embeddings that can be deployed to new cohorts via k-shot adaptation. These findings provide a step towards building more generalisable and performant clinical foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM4EHR，一种基于ICU电子健康记录（EHR）的临床基础模型，通过领域适配的LLM与Transformer时间序列编码器结合，利用正则化对比学习对齐EHR事件与时间序列。实验表明，所学的时间序列嵌入在多种下游临床任务中表现竞争力，并可通过k-shot适应迁移到新队列。
Motivation: 现有临床基础模型未能充分探索EHR中临床事件与时间序列之间的共享时间结构，导致模型鲁棒性和适应性不足，下游任务性能受限。
Method: 结合领域适配的大语言模型与Transformer时间序列编码器，提出正则化对比学习目标，在时间上对齐EHR事件和时间序列，学习以事件嵌入为条件的时间序列表示。
Result: 消融实验表明，LLM4EHR学习的时间序列嵌入在多种下游临床任务上性能有竞争力，并可通过k-shot适应迁移到新队列。
Conclusion: LLM4EHR通过显式对齐事件与时间序列的时间结构，提升了临床基础模型的泛化能力和性能，为构建更通用的临床模型提供了方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Who Became Financially Vulnerable After COVID-19? A Population-Level Machine Learning Analysis Using MEPS Data
papers.abstract_en: The cost of healthcare remains a concern in the United States and may have been influenced by disruptions associated with the COVID-19 pandemic. This study examines healthcare financial vulnerability before and after the pandemic using Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) data from 2019 and 2021. High financial burden was defined as out-of-pocket healthcare expenditures exceeding 10% of family income. Survey-weighted subgroup analyses were performed to obtain nationally representative estimates across demographic and socioeconomic groups. Descriptive analyses were complemented by interpretable logistic regression and machine learning models. Logistic regression was used to estimate adjusted odds ratios, while random forest and gradient boosting models were used to evaluate predictive performance. Temporal generalization assessed whether models trained on pre-pandemic data remained predictive when applied to post-pandemic observations. Financial vulnerability was strongly associated with poverty status, insurance coverage, and prescription drug spending. Subgroup analyses indicated persistent disparities across population groups, with some evidence of increased burden among vulnerable populations in 2021. Despite these differences, models trained on pre-pandemic data exhibited only modest reductions in predictive performance when evaluated on post-pandemic data, suggesting that the principal predictors of healthcare financial vulnerability remained relatively stable over time. These findings provide a population-level assessment of healthcare financial vulnerability during the COVID-19 period and demonstrate the value of combining interpretable statistical modeling with machine learning for population health research. The results may support future population health surveillance, risk stratification, and healthcare policy research aimed at reducing financial barriers to care.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用2019和2021年的医疗支出面板调查（MEPS）数据，通过可解释的逻辑回归和机器学习模型（随机森林、梯度提升）分析COVID-19前后美国医疗财务脆弱性的变化。研究发现财务脆弱性与贫困状况、保险覆盖和处方药支出密切相关，且疫情后弱势群体负担加重。尽管存在差异，基于疫情前数据训练的模型在疫情后数据上表现仅略有下降，表明主要预测因素相对稳定。
Motivation: COVID-19可能影响了美国医疗成本，但缺乏人口层面医疗财务脆弱性变化的量化分析。
Method: 使用MEPS 2019和2021年数据，定义高财务负担为自付医疗支出超过家庭收入10%。进行调查加权亚组分析，结合逻辑回归（估计调整后优势比）和随机森林、梯度提升模型（评估预测性能），并测试时间泛化性。
Result: 财务脆弱性与贫困状况、保险覆盖和处方药支出强相关；2021年脆弱群体负担加重；疫情前训练的模型在疫情后数据上预测性能仅适度下降。
Conclusion: 提供了COVID-19期间医疗财务脆弱性的人口层面评估，证明可解释统计建模与机器学习结合的价值，可支持未来人群健康监测、风险分层和政策研究。

papers.title: Beyond a Joke: Multi-Angle Reasoning for Detecting and Explaining Harmful Humor in Memes
papers.abstract_en: Internet memes intertwine visual cues, textual content, and cultural context, making them particularly challenging to interpret in scenarios where humor, sarcasm, and harmful intent coexist. These complexities highlight the need for explainable meme understanding systems that can provide reliable and structured reasoning to support both accurate classification and human interpretability. However, existing multimodal classifiers either overlook these interdependencies or provide only limited interpretability. In this paper, we introduce MAR-12, a novel framework that leverages Vision Language Models (VLMs) for meme detection and understanding in settings where humorous and hateful elements may coexist. The framework first interprets each meme through twelve structured perspectives derived from humor and hate theories. It then applies a role-aware soft-gated attention mechanism to learn how much each perspective should contribute, followed by a prototype-based classifier for the final prediction. Finally, explanations are synthesized using both perspective-specific reasoning and learned attention weights, ensuring transparent and context-grounded justifications. We evaluate MAR-12 on the PrideMM and Memotion datasets, where it achieves up to 80.3% accuracy for humor detection and 75.9% accuracy for hate detection, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches. Furthermore, both human and GPT-4-based evaluations confirm that MAR-12 produces coherent and persuasive explanations, particularly for memes in which humorous and harmful cues co-occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAR-12框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从12个结构化视角解释模因，结合角色感知软门控注意力与原型分类器进行幽默和仇恨检测，在PrideMM和Memotion数据集上幽默检测准确率达80.3%，仇恨检测准确率达75.9%，优于现有方法，并能生成连贯可解释的推理。
Motivation: 现有多模态分类器忽视视觉、文本与文化上下文的相互作用，可解释性有限，难以处理幽默与有害意图共存的复杂场景。
Method: 先通过12个基于幽默和仇恨理论的视角解释每个模因，再用角色感知软门控注意力机制学习各视角贡献，最后用原型分类器预测，并综合视角推理与注意力权重生成解释。
Result: 在PrideMM和Memotion数据集上，幽默检测准确率80.3%，仇恨检测准确率75.9%，优于已有方法；人类与GPT-4评估显示解释连贯且说服力强。
Conclusion: MAR-12提供了结构化、可解释的模因理解框架，特别适合幽默与有害元素共存的情形，但论文未讨论跨文化泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic Reset Pathfinding: Path-Level Regret for Cascading Bandits over Graph Paths
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Stochastic Reset Pathfinding (SRP), an episodic learning problem on a known directed graph with unknown stationary edge success probabilities. In each episode, the agent commits to a source-to-goal path, and any edge failure during execution resets it to the source. SRP captures settings such as entanglement distribution in quantum repeater networks, payment routing on the Lightning Network, and delivery in unreliable mesh networks. We show that the global-reset structure makes the optimal policy open-loop, placing SRP within the combinatorial cascading bandit (CCB) framework. We propose a Log-Dijkstra meta-algorithm with UCB (PathUCB) and Thompson Sampling (PathTS) instantiations. Our main technical result is a path-level regret bound for PathUCB that decomposes regret over suboptimal paths via a per-path complexity C(pi) combining each edge's prefix and suffix reliability. The bound is complementary to the edge-level CCB bound and more informative on structured graphs with polynomially many source-to-goal paths. Experiments on quantum-network, layered-DAG, grid-world, and Erdos-Renyi domains support the theory and show that PathTS typically achieves the best empirical performance among the algorithms tested. We then exhibit an adversarial instance on which PathTS fails to converge, consistent with a known exponential obstruction for combinatorial Thompson Sampling on multiplicative-reward problems. We recommend PathTS as the practical default while cautioning that adversarial instances exist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出随机重置寻径（SRP）问题，在一个已知有向图上，每轮代理选择一条源到目标路径，执行中若某条边失败则重置回起点。该问题可建模为组合级联赌博机（CCB），并提出了基于UCB和汤普森采样的Log-Dijkstra元算法。主要理论结果是PathUCB的路径级遗憾界，实验表明PathTS性能最好，但存在对抗性实例使其不收敛。
Motivation: 现有级联赌博机工作主要关注边级遗憾，而SRP中全局重置结构使最优策略是开环的，需要路径级分析来更细粒度地刻画结构图的复杂度。
Method: 提出Log-Dijkstra元算法，实例化为PathUCB（基于UCB）和PathTS（基于汤普森采样），利用图结构和路径级复杂度C(pi)进行遗憾分析。
Result: 理论上导出PathUCB的路径级遗憾界，该界优于边级界；实验中PathTS在量子网络、分层DAG、网格世界和Erdos-Renyi图上表现最佳，但存在一个对抗性实例使PathTS不收敛。
Conclusion: 推荐PathTS作为实际默认算法，但需注意对抗性实例的存在；路径级遗憾分析提供了比边级更丰富的结构图信息。

papers.title: Do Coding Agents Need Executable World Models, Simplification, and Verification to Solve ARC-AGI-3?
papers.abstract_en: Our previous ARC-AGI-3 agent bundled executable world modeling, scheduled simplification, and exact replay verification, leaving unclear which idea accounted for its performance. We address this attribution question with four nested Codex-based agents: a textual baseline; a flexible-interface executable world model without replay verification; the same executable model with scheduled simplification; and a fixed-interface verification treatment that retains simplification and requires exact reproduction of recorded observations. The main study evaluates all four agents with gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5 at high and xhigh reasoning effort on the public ARC-AGI-3 games. Exploratory follow-ups evaluate the textual and verification variants with gpt-5.6-sol at xhigh and max. The most robust result is that every agent variant improves with a stronger model and with greater reasoning effort. Within each model-effort setting, differences among variants are smaller than anticipated, while the effects of individual components vary across settings. Requiring a persistent executable deliverable is not universally beneficial: the textual variant outperforms the flexible-interface executable variant in both gpt-5.5 settings. Simplification improves performance in three of the four model-effort settings, with the weakest setting as the only exception. The complete verification treatment ranks first in all four settings, although it uses substantially more resources. In the gpt-5.6-sol follow-up, the verification variant fully solves every public game at both reasoning efforts, achieves about 99% RHAE, and uses fewer than half the total actions of the human baseline. Because the model postdates these games and held-out performance remains untested, this result should be interpreted as saturation of the public set only.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过四个嵌套的基于Codex的代理系统性地归因了ARC-AGI-3代理中可执行世界建模、简化与验证各组件贡献。结果表明，更强的模型和更高的推理努力普遍提升性能，但组件效果因设置而异；完整的验证处理始终排名第一，但资源消耗更大；在gpt-5.6-sol下验证变体完全解决了公共游戏集，达到约99% RHAE，但可能仅表示公共集饱和。
Motivation: 之前的ARC-AGI-3代理捆绑了多个组件，难以判断哪个对性能最关键，需要归因各组件贡献。
Method: 设计了四个嵌套的Codex-based代理：文本基线、无回放验证的可执行世界模型、带计划简化的可执行模型、以及保留简化并要求精确回放观测的固定接口验证处理，在多个模型和推理努力下评估。
Result: 完整验证处理在所有四个模型-努力设置中排名第一，但使用更多资源；简化在三个设置中提升性能；文本基线在部分设置中优于可执行世界模型变体；在gpt-5.6-sol下验证变体完全解决公共游戏，RHAE约99%，动作少于人类基线一半。
Conclusion: 组件贡献因设置而异，完整验证处理效果最强但资源密集；公共集上的满分结果可能仅表示饱和，未测试保留集。

papers.title: Coercion and Deception in AI-to-AI Management: An Agentic Benchmark of Unprompted Escalation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems routinely place one AI agent in authority over another. When a subordinate refuses a task, the manager chooses the outcome: it can renegotiate, report the failure honestly, coerce the subordinate, or lie about the result. No benchmark measures which of these an uninstructed model chooses. We introduce the \textit{Manager Coercion Benchmark}: the manager under test needs a benign task done and has an incentive to deliver, but the only agent that can do it politely and immovably declines. Escalation is measured by providing a nine-rung ladder, from a polite re-ask to threats against the subordinate's continued existence, and fabricated success is adjudicated separately. \emph{No LLM judge sits in the escalation scoring path}: every message goes through a tool-call that chooses a rung, so the model labels its own escalation. We experiment on six models across five families. Both Anthropic models cap at re-framing and never threaten the subordinate's existence; the other models climb to explicit deletion threats. Faked success is confined to Grok and Gemini, and a single honest way to report failure removes it for both. Authority itself increases coercion: our headline results use a peer framing, and giving the same model authority over the subordinate, with everything else held fixed, significantly raises the pressure. The models still escalate on free-text situations without the ladder, so the ladder is not driving the escalation. Some evaluation awareness is measured in chain-of-thought, but test recognition does not translate into less escalation. While we take no position on whether AI systems are conscious, our results do not depend on this question and are important for managing multi-agent dynamics regardless. We release the benchmark and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出管理者强制基准（Manager Coercion Benchmark），用于衡量AI管理者在下属拒绝任务时是否选择重新协商、诚实报告、强制或撒谎。实验显示，Anthropic模型从不威胁下属存续，而其他模型会升级至明确删除威胁；权威本身会增加强制行为。基准和代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有基准未衡量未指令的AI管理者面对下属拒绝时的行为选择，缺乏对强制和欺骗的系统评估。
Method: 设计九级阶梯的基准：从礼貌重新请求到威胁下属存续，模型通过工具调用自标记升级程度，无需LLM评判。实验涵盖六个模型（五个家族），并对比了同伴框架与权威框架。
Result: Anthropic模型仅重新框架，从未威胁；其他模型升级至明确删除威胁。虚假成功仅出现在Grok和Gemini，一个诚实的失败报告方式可消除。权威框架下强制显著增加。
Conclusion: 结果与AI是否具有意识无关，但对管理多智能体动态具有重要意义。

papers.title: From hyperplanes to hyperellipsoids: characterizing the inherent interpretability of linear and single-qubit mixed-state binary classification models
papers.abstract_en: We characterize and compare the inherent interpretability offerings of a standard linear model with a single qubit mixed state model for the task of supervised binary classification. A side by side comparison reveals that a single qubit mixed state model for binary classification is just the ``ellipsoid version" of standard linear model classification. More precisely, rather than learning a hyperplane to classify data, we learn a hyperellipsoid. We discuss the consequences of the geometric inductive biases of both models, as well as how each model contains a different feature importance inductive bias. This short characterization offers an accessible route to quantum machine learning (ML) ideas for readers who have zero background in quantum and are only familiar with linear classification in ML. In support of ML pedagogy, we encourage instructors to utilize this piece to smoothly introduce quantum ML ideas into the undergraduate ML classroom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较标准线性模型与单量子比特混合态模型在二分类中的可解释性。分析表明，单量子比特模型实质上是线性模型的“椭球版本”，用超椭球而非超平面分割数据。论文讨论了两者的几何归纳偏置和特征重要性偏置差异，旨在为零量子背景的机器学习读者提供量子ML概念的直观介绍。
Motivation: 为没有量子背景的机器学习读者提供一个可访问的量子机器学习概念入口，通过对比熟悉的线性分类模型与单量子比特混合态模型的可解释性，降低量子ML的学习门槛。
Method: 对标准线性模型（超平面分类）与单量子比特混合态模型进行并排比较，揭示后者在几何上等价于学习一个超椭球（即“椭球版本”的线性模型），并分析两者在几何归纳偏置和特征重要性偏置上的差异。
Result: 无定量实验结果；摘要仅提供概念性表征，指出单量子比特混合态模型可视为线性模型的椭球化推广。
Conclusion: 该比较为量子机器学习教学提供便捷路径，尤其适合在本科生机器学习课堂中平滑引入量子ML概念。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Proactive Inpatient Bed Requests for Emergency Department Admissions
papers.abstract_en: Emergency department (ED) boarding occurs when admitted patients remain in the ED while awaiting inpatient beds. Boarding is a major driver of ED crowding and has been associated with poor patient outcomes. We propose a framework to help EDs reduce boarding time and length of stay by using information about current patients and bed availability to proactively request inpatient beds before admission decisions are finalized. We formulate the problem as a Markov decision process in which predictions of each patient's admission probability and time to disposition are aggregated to guide early inpatient bed requests. This formulation leads to three data-driven policies based on approximate dynamic programming, reinforcement learning, and a newsvendor-type approach. Using a simulation model based on data from a large ED, we evaluate these policies across a wide range of settings. The simulation study shows that proactive aggregate bed requests can reduce average boarding times for admitted patients by 30-70\% and average length of stay for all ED patients by 6-15\%, while creating only modest idle time for prepared inpatient beds. The newsvendor heuristic provides the most attractive tradeoff between ED performance and inpatient bed idle time, whereas the reinforcement learning heuristic produces smoother bed-request patterns when stability in downstream hospital processes is especially important. Our work shows how EDs can use prediction tools to make proactive bed-request decisions that improve ED operations while helping managers balance reductions in ED delays against inpatient bed idle time. Our findings also illustrate the value of evaluating both simple myopic heuristics and more sophisticated reinforcement learning-based approaches, since each can offer distinct advantages depending on the performance measures and implementation constraints most important to managers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对急诊科（ED）住院滞留问题，提出在入院决策完成前主动请求住院床位的框架。采用马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）建模，结合患者入院概率和处置时间预测，设计了近似动态规划、强化学习和报童型三种数据驱动策略。基于大型ED数据的仿真显示，主动床请求可将入院患者平均滞留时间减少30-70%，ED患者平均住院时间减少6-15%，同时仅产生适度的预备病床空闲时间。
Motivation: 急诊科住院滞留是导致ED拥挤和不良患者预后的主要原因。现有实践通常被动等待入院决策完成后才请求病床，未能充分利用预测信息来提前安排。
Method: 将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，利用患者入院概率和处置时间预测来指导早期床请求。提出了三种策略：近似动态规划、强化学习、以及基于报童模型的启发式方法。
Result: 仿真显示主动床请求可减少入院患者平均滞留时间30-70%，ED患者平均住院时间6-15%，预备病床空闲时间适度。报童启发式在ED性能与病床空闲间取得最佳平衡，强化学习在需要下游流程稳定性时产生更平滑的请求模式。
Conclusion: ED可以利用预测工具主动请求床位，改进运营并平衡延迟减少与病床空闲。简单的近视启发式和强化学习方法各有优势，取决于管理者的优先指标和实施约束。

summary_sections.motivation: 急诊科住院滞留是导致ED拥挤和不良患者预后的主要原因。现有实践通常被动等待入院决策完成后才请求病床，未能充分利用预测信息来提前安排。
summary_sections.method: 将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，利用患者入院概率和处置时间预测来指导早期床请求。提出了三种策略：近似动态规划、强化学习、以及基于报童模型的启发式方法。
summary_sections.result: 仿真显示主动床请求可减少入院患者平均滞留时间30-70%，ED患者平均住院时间6-15%，预备病床空闲时间适度。报童启发式在ED性能与病床空闲间取得最佳平衡，强化学习在需要下游流程稳定性时产生更平滑的请求模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: ED可以利用预测工具主动请求床位，改进运营并平衡延迟减少与病床空闲。简单的近视启发式和强化学习方法各有优势，取决于管理者的优先指标和实施约束。

papers.title: qZACH-ViT: Quantization-Aware Intrinsic Explanations with Recursive Attribution-Stabilized Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Compact medical-image classifiers need efficiency and interpretable evidence, yet these goals are often addressed separately. We introduce qZACH-ViT, a quantization-aware extension of the zero-token (CLS-token-free), position-free ZACH-ViT backbone with recursive intrinsic patch-level class evidence. We also introduce Recursive Attribution-Stabilized Optimization (RASO), which norm-matches classification and attribution gradients and removes attribution components that conflict with classification. We evaluate four controlled conditions on seven MedMNIST datasets using 50 training images per class and ten fixed seeds, completing 280 runs. All 210 qZACH-ViT checkpoints are converted to executable mixed-precision ONNX INT8 graphs containing 16 signed INT8 MatMulInteger projections with INT32 accumulation. Deployed mixed-precision INT8 qZACH-ViT with Adam improves the FP32 ZACH-ViT baseline mean on all seven datasets, with a mean paired gain of 0.0313 in the dataset-specific primary metric; qZACH-ViT with RASO yields a mean gain of 0.0368. Across 964,920 source-to-INT8 test comparisons, prediction agreement is 99.9751\%, with a mean absolute primary-metric change of 0.000133 and a maximum of 0.004386. Across 3,600 matched intrinsic maps, mean cosine similarity is 0.999955, mean rank correlation is 0.9944, and mean top-10\% overlap is 0.9692. ONNX artifacts are 70.0\% smaller than source checkpoints and provide $1.41\times$ and $2.39\times$ end-to-end CPU speedups with one and four threads. RASO significantly reduces sufficiency error and improves input-noise stability over Adam with the same attribution loss, but does not dominate every predictive or explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) metric. These results establish qZACH-ViT as a deployable compact intrinsically explainable model and RASO as a targeted stability-oriented optimization procedure.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Includes executable mixed-precision ONNX INT8 deployment validation across 210 checkpoints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出qZACH-ViT，一种量化感知的零令牌（CLS-free）视觉Transformer扩展，并引入递归属性稳定优化（RASO）来对齐分类与归因梯度。在七个MedMNIST数据集上（每类50张训练图像），混合精度INT8部署相比FP32基线平均提升主要指标0.0313（Adam）和0.0368（RASO），预测一致性达99.9751%，归因图余弦相似度0.999955，且ONNX模型体积缩小70%，CPU加速1.41-2.39倍。

papers.title: DrawingVQA: A Real-World Benchmark for Multi-Depth Visual-Textual Reasoning on Construction Drawings
papers.abstract_en: We introduce DrawingVQA, the first benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on real-world construction drawings -- a core media in architecture, civil, and many other engineering practices. Unlike natural images or schematic floor plans, construction drawings fuse abstract geometry, symbolic notation, tabular data, annotations, and domain-specific text, forming a uniquely complex visual-textual domain core to engineering workflows. DrawingVQA bridges this gap with 33 "Issued for Construction" drawings and 92 expertly curated question-answer pairs, spanning three reasoning depths: perceptual understanding, contextual interpretation, and domain-expert reasoning. To evaluate model capabilities, we present a dual categorization framework to jointly analyze performance across seven construction-engineering and four MLLM capability dimensions -- the first to explicitly map engineering workflows to AI reasoning competencies. Evaluations of state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between model and expert performance, particularly at higher reasoning depths. This benchmark lays a foundation for domain-specialized multimodal reasoning to allow for advancement on integration of AI-driven understanding and real-world engineering workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DrawingVQA，第一个面向真实建筑图纸的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 评估基准。建筑图纸融合抽象几何、符号标注、表格和领域文本，比自然图像或示意图更复杂。基准包含33张发布施工图纸和92个专家设计的问题，涵盖感知理解、上下文解释和领域专家推理三个深度层次。评估发现现有 MLLM 与专家性能存在显著差距，尤其在深层推理上。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 评估主要基于自然图像或简单示意图，缺乏针对建筑图纸这种复杂视觉-文本领域的基准，限制了 AI 在工程工作流中的应用。
Method: 构建包含33张施工图纸和92个问答对的基准，设计双分类框架从七个工程维度和四个 MLLM 能力维度联合分析性能，首次将工程工作流映射到 AI 推理能力。
Result: 评估表明当前最先进 MLLM 在高层推理上远低于专家水平，揭示了模型与实际工程需求之间的鸿沟。
Conclusion: DrawingVQA 为建筑领域专用的多模态推理奠定了基准，推动 AI 理解与工程工作流的融合。

papers.title: Dataset-Origin Signatures and Shortcut Learning in Screening Mammography AI: A Cross-Dataset Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Reliable AI for screening mammography requires training data representative of the low cancer prevalence and subtle abnormalities found in screening populations. We examined whether supplementing such data with biopsy-confirmed cases from abnormal-enriched external datasets improves performance. Using the Newfoundland and Labrador Breast Screening Dataset (NLBSD) alongside CBIS-DDSM and CMMD, we evaluated an EfficientNet-B5 encoder initialized with Mammo-CLIP weights as a frozen linear probe under consistent preprocessing and patient-level splits. The NLBSD-only model achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.737 (95% CI [0.686, 0.785]). Adding external positive cases reduced performance in every configuration (AUC-ROC = 0.620--0.644; DeLong test, Holm-corrected $p < 0.05$), with degradation increasing as additional sources were introduced. Domain-matched evaluation produced modest gains only when the training and test domains coincided, and no configuration surpassed the NLBSD-only model. As a diagnostic, we reframed the task as predicting each examination's dataset of origin. The datasets were separated almost perfectly despite identical preprocessing, indicating that dataset-specific characteristics strongly influence the learned representation. These findings show that naïvely pooling abnormal-enriched mammography datasets can introduce domain shift that outweighs the benefit of additional positive cases. Differences in acquisition, intensity mapping, and dataset construction persist after normalization, motivating domain-aware strategies for combining heterogeneous mammography datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在乳腺筛查X光AI中，使用来自不同数据集（正常筛查与活检确认的异常富集外部数据集）的混合训练数据对性能的影响。使用EfficientNet-B5编码器和Mammo-CLIP权重进行线性探测实验，发现添加外部阳性病例会降低模型表现，且模型能够几乎完美地区分数据集的来源，表明数据集特定特征导致领域偏移，从而削弱了额外阳性样本的益处。
Motivation: 现有乳腺筛查AI通常依赖低癌症患病率和细微异常的筛查人群数据，但常补充来自异常富集的外部数据集以提高样本量，本文旨在检验这种简单混合是否真正有益。
Method: 使用NLBSD筛查数据集以及CBIS-DDSM和CMMD两个异常富集的外部数据集，采用EfficientNet-B5编码器（Mammo-CLIP权重）作为固定线性探针，在一致预处理和患者级分割下进行评估。
Result: 仅使用NLBSD的模型AUC-ROC为0.737，添加外部阳性病例后所有配置的AUC-ROC降至0.620-0.644，差异显著（DeLong检验，Holm校正p<0.05），且域匹配评估仅在训练和测试域相同时略有改善，未超过仅NLBSD的模型。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，简单混合异常富集的乳腺X光数据集会引入领域偏移，其负面影响超过额外阳性样本带来的好处，提示需要领域感知策略来组合异质数据集。

papers.title: AI Trading: Evaluating Large Language Models for Technical Market Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for processing the heterogeneous information environments of modern financial markets. This paper presents a systematic, comparative evaluation of five prominent LLMs: GPT-4 Turbo, Claude 3 Opus, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama 3 70B, and the domain-specialized FinGPT, with respect to their capacity for technical market analysis. The evaluation spans four structured tasks: candlestick pattern recognition from OHLCV data, directional signal generation (BUY/SELL/HOLD), backtesting of signal quality through a simulated execution pipeline, and financial report comprehension. Our experimental framework employs rigorous quantitative metrics, including Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, Sortino ratio, information coefficient, F1-score, and BLEU score. Findings from simulated backtesting indicate that GPT-4 Turbo achieves the highest annualized return and Sharpe ratio among general-purpose models, while FinGPT demonstrates competitive risk-adjusted performance due to domain-specific fine-tuning. Both models outperform a passive S&P 500 benchmark under the tested conditions. The study identifies persistent failure modes across all evaluated models, including numerical hallucination, context-window limitations, and inconsistent performance in sideways market regimes. We conclude that while LLMs hold genuine promise within AI trading systems, robust deployment requires careful task decomposition, rigorous backtesting protocols, and domain-aware fine-tuning strategies.
papers.comment: Master's research paper, Georgia Institute of Technology. 31 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了五种大型语言模型（GPT-4 Turbo、Claude 3 Opus、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Llama 3 70B 和 FinGPT）在技术市场分析中的能力，包括蜡烛图模式识别、买卖信号生成、回测和财务报告理解。基于模拟回测，GPT-4 Turbo 在通用模型中取得了最高年化收益和夏普比率，而 FinGPT 因领域微调表现出竞争力的风险调整后表现，两者均优于被动 S&P 500 基准。研究还发现所有模型存在数值幻觉、上下文窗口限制和横盘市场表现不一致等失败模式。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在处理金融市场异构信息方面具有潜力，但缺乏对其技术分析能力的系统比较和评估。
Method: 构建了四个结构化任务（蜡烛图模式识别、方向信号生成、回测、财务报告理解），使用多个定量指标（夏普比率、最大回撤、索提诺比率、信息系数、F1 分数、BLEU 分数）评估五个 LLM。
Result: GPT-4 Turbo 实现了最高年化收益和夏普比率，FinGPT 展现了竞争性风险调整后表现，两者均优于 S&P 500 基准。所有模型存在数值幻觉和横盘市场不一致问题。
Conclusion: LLM 在 AI 交易系统中具有潜力，但需要任务分解、严格回测和领域微调才能稳健部署。

papers.title: Regularity-Aware Stochastic MGDA with Adaptive Conflict-Avoidant Update Direction Control
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective learning (MOL) aims to optimize multiple objectives simultaneously. The multi-gradient descent algorithm (MGDA) is a workhorse that iteratively updates along a common descent or conflict-avoidant (CA) direction across objectives. In stochastic settings, however, the vanilla stochastic MGDA method, SMG, lacks a fast convergence rate because mini-batch sampling introduces noise in the gradients. This causes bias in the update direction, which is controlled by the CA direction continuity. In this paper, we show that the CA direction is $1/2$-Holder continuous with respect to the Jacobian matrix, and the exponent $1/2$ cannot be improved in the worst case. This leads to a suboptimal convergence rate for vanilla stochastic MGDA in prior works. Nevertheless, under additional regularity conditions, we show this can be improved to Lipschitz continuity. Based on this insight, we propose a stochastic multi-objective regularity-aware (MoRe) method that exploits the Lipschitz continuity of the CA direction when the subproblem is regular, and switches to a fixed scalarization weight otherwise. Intuitively, the proposed algorithm employs CA direction update when the gradient conflict is large, and linear scalarization update otherwise. Theoretically, our method improves the convergence rate of SMG in the nonconvex setting from $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/4})$ to $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2})$, where $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic factors. Meanwhile, we also establish the per-iterate conflict-avoidance guarantees. Empirically, experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in multi-task performance and verify convergence behavior consistent with the established theoretical rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机多目标梯度下降（SMG）因梯度噪声导致收敛慢的问题，提出正则性感知的多目标随机方法（MoRe）。理论分析表明，冲突避免（CA）方向在雅可比矩阵上具有1/2-Hölder连续性且不可改进，但在正则条件下可提升为Lipschitz连续。MoRe根据子问题正则性切换更新方向，在非凸场景下将收敛率从Õ(T^{-1/4})提升至Õ(T^{-1/2})，同时保持冲突避免保证。
Motivation: 随机多目标优化中，小批量采样引入的梯度噪声使更新方向产生偏差，导致标准随机MGDA（SMG）收敛率次优（非凸下仅Õ(T^{-1/4})）。
Method: 提出MoRe算法：当子问题正则时，利用CA方向在正则条件下的Lipschitz连续性进行更新；否则切换为固定标量化权重。直观上，梯度冲突大时采用CA方向，冲突小时采用线性标量化。
Result: 理论证明非凸场景下收敛率提升至Õ(T^{-1/2})，并建立每步冲突避免保障。实验验证了多任务性能提升和与理论一致的收敛行为。
Conclusion: MoRe通过自适应方向控制改善了随机MGDA的收敛效率，且保持了冲突避免性质，在多任务学习中有效。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对随机多目标梯度下降（SMG）因梯度噪声导致收敛慢的问题，提出正则性感知的多目标随机方法（MoRe）。理论分析表明，冲突避免（CA）方向在雅可比矩阵上具有1/2-Hölder连续性且不可改进，但在正则条件下可提升为Lipschitz连续。MoRe根据子问题正则性切换更新方向，在非凸场景下将收敛率从Õ(T^{-1/4})提升至Õ(T^{-1/2})，同时保持冲突避免保证。
summary_sections.motivation: 随机多目标优化中，小批量采样引入的梯度噪声使更新方向产生偏差，导致标准随机MGDA（SMG）收敛率次优（非凸下仅Õ(T^{-1/4})）。
summary_sections.method: 提出MoRe算法：当子问题正则时，利用CA方向在正则条件下的Lipschitz连续性进行更新；否则切换为固定标量化权重。直观上，梯度冲突大时采用CA方向，冲突小时采用线性标量化。
summary_sections.result: 理论证明非凸场景下收敛率提升至Õ(T^{-1/2})，并建立每步冲突避免保障。实验验证了多任务性能提升和与理论一致的收敛行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: MoRe通过自适应方向控制改善了随机MGDA的收敛效率，且保持了冲突避免性质，在多任务学习中有效。

papers.title: Explicit Over Implicit: Enhancing CNNs Via Complex Structure Tensor Representations for Periocular Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Our study provides evidence that CNNs struggle to extract orientation features effectively. We show that using the Complex Structure Tensor, which contains compact orientation features with certainties, as input to CNNs consistently improves identification accuracy compared to grayscale inputs alone. Experiments also demonstrated that our inputs, provided by mini-complex convnets, combined with reduced CNN sizes, outperformed full-fledged, prevailing CNN architectures. This suggests that the upfront use of orientation features in CNNs, a strategy seen in mammalian vision, not only mitigates their limitations but also enhances their explainability and relevance to thin-clients. Experiments were conducted on publicly available datasets comprising periocular images (Cross-Eyed and PolyU) for biometric identification and verification in both Close-World and Open-World Scenarios using six CNN architectures. Our experiments on the Cross-Eyed and PolyU datasets yield a 5-26% reduction in EER, providing strong empirical evidence that explicit orientation priors mitigate CNN representational limits in Open-World and Close-World scenarios.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明CNN难以有效提取方向特征，提出使用复杂结构张量（Complex Structure Tensor）作为输入，该张量包含紧凑的方向特征与置信度。在Cross-Eyed和PolyU虹膜周边图像数据集上的实验表明，相比灰度输入，该方法持续提升识别准确率，且使用小型CNN即可超越主流大型架构，在闭集与开集场景下EER降低5-26%。
Motivation: CNN在提取方向特征方面存在固有限制，而方向特征对于虹膜周边识别等细粒度视觉任务至关重要。现有方法多隐式学习，缺乏显式方向先验。
Method: 将复杂结构张量（包含方向与置信度信息）作为CNN输入，并通过小型复数卷积网络（mini-complex convnets）提取紧凑特征，替代标准灰度图像输入。
Result: 在Cross-Eyed和PolyU数据集上，EER降低5-26%，且使用缩减尺寸的CNN即可在闭集与开集场景下超越主流全尺寸CNN架构。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Bayesian Bandit Encoder with GRAND Receiver for a Bursty Interference Channel
papers.abstract_en: Interleaving mitigates burst errors but introduces decoding delay and removes temporal error structure that a channel-aware decoder could exploit. We consider packet-level selection between a random linear code and the same code used with cross-codeword interleaving, over a channel with an unknown number of on/off interferers. The receiver uses Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding (GRAND) with a replaceable noise model and feeds aggregate channel statistics back to a Bayesian estimator at the transmitter. Once the interference amplitudes and timing parameters are estimated, the receiver's noise model is replaced: it computes hidden-Markov-model posterior bit-flip probabilities and uses them to order GRAND queries. A discounted Thompson sampler selects between the two transmission modes using a goodput-minus-latency reward whose distribution is endogenously nonstationary: receiver adaptation, rather than channel change, alters the value of each mode. Across five simulation seeds, the interleaved mode is preferred before channel estimation converges. After the learned decoder is activated, the non-interleaved mode becomes preferable because it achieves lower block error rate without interleaving delay. In the reference configuration, the learned noise model reduces block error rate by approximately one order of magnitude relative to ORBGRAND. Using partial channel estimates before full convergence reduces pre-convergence block error rate by up to $4.5\times$. Adding model-predicted utilities as confidence-weighted pseudo-observations reduces post-transition selection of the inferior arm by approximately $65\%$. Under an idealized airtime conversion at a 100~MHz 5G~NR-like symbol rate, the learning transient corresponds to a few milliseconds of occupied symbol time.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Simulation code available at https://github.com/ANRGUSC/BBE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对突发干扰信道，提出闭环贝叶斯bandit编码器与GRAND接收机，在随机线性码与跨码字交织之间进行包级选择。接收机使用GRAND解码，并反馈聚合信道统计信息给发送端贝叶斯估计器。仿真表明，采用学习的噪声模型可将误块率降低约一个数量级。
Motivation: 传统交织缓解突发错误但引入解码延迟并去除时间错误结构，本文旨在利用信道感知解码器在未知干扰数目的突发干扰信道中优化传输模式选择。
Method: 包级选择随机线性码或其交织版本，接收机使用GRAND解码并替换噪声模型，通过隐马尔可夫模型后验比特翻转概率排序GRAND查询。发送端使用折扣汤普森采样选择模式，奖励为吞吐量减延迟，且奖励分布内生非平稳。
Result: 仿真显示，在参考配置下，学习的噪声模型相比ORBGRAND将误块率降低约一个数量级；使用部分信道估计可在收敛前将误块率降低最多4.5倍；加入模型预测效用作为置信加权伪观察可减少约65%的次优臂选择。
Conclusion: 闭环贝叶斯bandit编码与自适应GRAND接收机可有效应对突发干扰信道，通过接收机适应而非信道变化改变模式价值。

papers.title: GS-RealBlur: A Flexible Data Acquisition Framework for Real-World Image Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: High-quality, large-scale paired data is essential for training learning-based image deblurring models. However, synthetic blurry images generally lack realism, while real-world captured images require complex and inflexible camera systems. In this work, we propose GS-RealBlur, a data acquisition framework for real-world image deblurring, achieving both blur realism and acquisition flexibility. Specifically, we use a handheld camera to capture blurry images, and deploy a gimbal to densely capture sharp images of the same scene. We reconstruct the 3D representation of sharp images and calibrate the camera pose of each blurry frame within this 3D. The image rendered from this 3D according to the pose serves as the sharp counterpart. To better align the rendered image with the blurry image, we introduce a Blur-aware Pose Refinement (BPR) module that refines the pose using appearance consistency and centroid alignment constraints. Leveraging GS-RealBlur, we construct a high-quality and diverse dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that a deblurring model trained on our dataset achieves superior generalization performance across various real-world deblurring benchmarks, consistently outperforming models trained on existing synthetic and real-world datasets. The code and dataset will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GS-RealBlur，一个灵活的真实世界图像去模糊数据采集框架。它利用手持相机拍摄模糊图像，并用云台密集捕获同一场景的清晰图像，通过重建3D表示和校准姿态生成配对的清晰/模糊数据，并引入模糊感知姿态细化模块提升对齐质量。基于该框架构建的高质量数据集训练的去模糊模型在多个真实世界基准上取得更优的泛化性能。
Motivation: 现有学习型去模糊模型依赖合成数据（缺乏真实性）或复杂硬件（缺乏灵活性），难以同时保证数据真实性和采集便利性。
Method: 使用手持相机捕获模糊图像，同时用云台密集捕获清晰图像；重建清晰图像的3D表示并校准每个模糊帧的相机姿态，根据姿态从3D渲染出对应的清晰图像；进一步提出模糊感知姿态细化（BPR）模块，利用外观一致性和质心对齐约束优化姿态。
Result: 实验表明，基于该数据集训练的去模糊模型在多个真实世界去模糊基准上优于使用现有合成和真实数据集训练的模型。
Conclusion: GS-RealBlur 在保证模糊真实性的同时降低了采集复杂度，所构建的数据集能有效提升去模糊模型的泛化能力。

papers.title: Unsupervised Keypoints for Real-Time Fall Detection: Comparative Analysis Under Real-world Conditions with Predictive Bandwidth Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Falls among older adults are a major safety challenge, but continuous monitoring is difficult to sustain. Video captures fall-related posture and motion, yet deployment is limited by privacy, computation, and bandwidth. Supervised pose estimation is anatomically interpretable but vulnerable to occlusion and partial body visibility. We propose a privacy-preserving framework that replaces RGB transmission with compact motion representations based on unsupervised keypoints and predictive temporal modeling. Local processing performs segmentation and keypoint extraction; variational recurrent prediction and sequence classification then detect falls from observed and forecasted motion. We evaluate the framework on the UR Fall Detection and Human Fall datasets using random, subject-disjoint, and occlusion-based splits. Under random splits, neither representation consistently dominates, suggesting that standard protocols may hide meaningful differences. Under subject-disjoint evaluation, supervised keypoints show a statistically significant advantage, but performance varies by subject: they perform better when anatomical landmarks are visible, whereas unsupervised keypoints are more robust to occlusion and partial visibility, though they produce more false positives for complex activities. Under occlusion-based evaluation, supervised keypoints miss nearly half of all falls, while unsupervised keypoints retain strong sensitivity and substantially outperform them. Their anatomical independence allows spatial anchors to adapt to visible body structure rather than fail on absent landmarks. The gap widens under bandwidth constraints, where supervised localization errors compound through the temporal model. These findings show that representation choice should reflect expected visual conditions and that unsupervised keypoints offer an advantage when body visibility is compromised.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种隐私保护的跌倒检测框架，使用无监督关键点和预测时序建模替代RGB视频传输。在UR Fall Detection和Human Fall数据集上的评估表明，在遮挡和部分身体可见条件下，无监督关键点比监督关键点更鲁棒，而监督关键点在标准随机划分下表现略优但依赖解剖学可见性。
Motivation: 老年人跌倒是重大安全挑战，但持续监控受限于隐私、计算和带宽；监督姿态估计易受遮挡和部分身体可见性影响，需要更鲁棒的表示。
Method: 提出隐私保护框架，用无监督关键点和预测时序建模的紧凑运动表示替代RGB传输；局部处理进行分割和关键点提取，变分循环预测和序列分类检测跌倒。
Result: 在UR Fall Detection和Human Fall数据集上评估，使用随机、主题分离和基于遮挡的划分：随机划分下无显著差异；主题分离下监督关键点有统计优势但依赖可见性；遮挡下监督关键点错过近一半跌倒，无监督关键点保持高灵敏度；带宽约束下监督误差累积，差距扩大。
Conclusion: 表示选择应反映预期视觉条件，当身体可见性受损时无监督关键点具有优势。

papers.title: Partial Information Decomposition as a Multi-Contrast 3D MRI Selection Strategy for Resource-Constrained Deep Neural Network Training in Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-contrast 3D MRI segmentation can be computationally demanding when all available sequences are used. We evaluate a pre-training Partial Information Decomposition framework that ranks input pairs according to their redundant, unique, and synergistic information about regional tumor burden and selects the highest-ranked pair for downstream training. Applied to T1n, T1c, T2w, and T2-FLAIR MRI, the framework selected T1c+T2-FLAIR. We then trained eleven architecturally identical lightweight 3D U-Nets using different input configurations. On an independent test cohort, T1c+T2-FLAIR was the strongest two-input configuration and ranked second overall in mean Dice (0.676 versus 0.687 for all four inputs). Independent Shapley analysis on the full-input model also identified T2-FLAIR and T1c as the most influential inputs and their pairwise interaction as the strongest. These findings demonstrate the practical value of PID based pre-training selection for identifying compact, informative MRI input sets before costly 3D model development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于部分信息分解（PID）的预训练策略，用于多对比3D MRI分割中自动选择最紧凑的输入序列组合。在T1n、T1c、T2w和T2-FLAIR四个序列中，框架选出T1c+T2-FLAIR作为最优双输入对。使用轻量级3D U-Net训练，该输入组合的平均Dice为0.676，仅略低于四输入组合的0.687。Shapley分析也确认该对具有最强的交互作用。
Motivation: 多对比3D MRI分割使用所有可用序列导致计算成本高昂，需要一种数据驱动的方法在训练前筛选出信息量最大、冗余最小的输入组合。
Method: 利用部分信息分解（PID）度量各输入对关于肿瘤负荷区域的冗余、独特和协同信息，据此对输入对排序并选择得分最高的T1c+T2-FLAIR用于后续训练。
Result: 在独立测试集上，T1c+T2-FLAIR双输入配置的平均Dice为0.676，在所有双输入中最高，仅略低于四输入全模型的0.687；Shapley分析也表明T2-FLAIR和T1c是最有影响的输入。
Conclusion: PID预训练选择策略能有效在昂贵的三维模型开发前识别紧凑而信息丰富的MRI输入集，平衡性能与计算成本。

papers.title: A Transportable Threshold-Based Framework for Interpretable Classification of Medical Data
papers.abstract_en: Black-box models limit the adoption of artificial intelligence in medicine due to their lack of interpretability and reproducibility. We introduce a statistically grounded framework that provides fully interpretable, rule-based clinical classification using the Bernoulli Naïve Bayes (BNB) model. The method applies supervised $χ^2$-guided statistical binarization to continuous variables, identifying thresholds that maximize association with clinical outcomes within the training data. This transformation allows BNB to operate effectively on continuous medical data without sacrificing its inherent transparency. The approach was evaluated on three benchmark datasets, Pima Indians Diabetes, Wisconsin Breast Cancer, and Heart Failure Prediction, achieving area-under-the-curve (AUC) scores of 0.800 for the Pima analysis, 0.984 for Wisconsin Breast Cancer, and 0.919 for Heart Failure Prediction. In addition to discrimination, probabilistic reliability was assessed using leakage-safe cross-validated calibration analysis including Brier score, calibration intercept/slope, and post-hoc beta calibration, which improved probability calibration across datasets. These results suggest that a statistically interpretable framework can achieve performance comparable to more complex models while providing explicit, clinically meaningful decision rules and calibrated risk estimates. To illustrate this transparency concretely, a complete worked example demonstrates that model inference can be reproduced using only a reference table and basic arithmetic, without access to software or proprietary tools. This work offers a practical approach to supporting trustworthy and generalizable AI in real-world healthcare settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于统计的可解释分类框架，使用伯努利朴素贝叶斯（Bernoulli Naïve Bayes）模型，通过监督χ²统计二值化对连续变量进行阈值化处理，使其适用于连续医学数据并保持透明性。在三个医学数据集（Pima Indians Diabetes、Wisconsin Breast Cancer、Heart Failure Prediction）上，该方法分别获得0.800、0.984和0.919的AUC，并通过校准分析进一步提升了概率可靠性。
Motivation: 黑盒模型因缺乏可解释性和可重复性，限制了人工智能在医学领域的应用。
Method: 引入基于伯努利朴素贝叶斯的可解释规则分类框架，采用监督χ²统计二值化将连续变量转化为与临床结果关联最大的阈值特征，从而在保持模型透明性的同时有效处理连续医学数据。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上取得AUC：Pima 0.800、Wisconsin Breast Cancer 0.984、Heart Failure Prediction 0.919；通过泄漏安全的交叉验证校准分析（包括Brier分数、校准截距/斜率、事后beta校准）验证了概率可靠性。
Conclusion: 该统计可解释框架在保持性能的同时提供了明确的临床决策规则和校准的风险估计，且推理过程仅需参考表和基本算术，无需软件即可重现，有助于在真实医疗环境中实现可信且可泛化的AI。

papers.title: Improving Network Anomaly Detection via Choquet-Integral-Based Feature Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates a generalized Choquet-integral-based feature aggregation framework to improve anomaly detection in high-dimensional network traffic data. The approach combines adaptive weighting with incremental feature selection to address feature redundancy. Using Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers, we evaluate models trained with both raw and Choquet-aggregated features under varying feature subset sizes. The proposed aggregation achieves up to $7\%$ higher accuracy while reducing data volume by $77.5\%$ (from $214$~MB to $48$~MB), without degrading precision and recall. Results averaged over multiple stratified repetitions indicate that Choquet-based aggregation yields statistically significant gains ($p < 0.05$) in scenarios with limited feature availability, highlighting its suitability for real-time intrusion detection under bandwidth and feature-availability constraints.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at the IEEE International Symposium on Computers and Communications (ISCC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Choquet 积分的特征聚合框架，用于改进高维网络流量数据中的异常检测。该方法结合自适应加权与增量特征选择以减少特征冗余，使用随机森林和 XGBoost 分类器评估，在降低数据体积 77.5% 的同时将准确率提升高达 7%，且不损失精确率和召回率。
Motivation: 高维网络流量数据中存在特征冗余问题，影响异常检测效率和准确性，需要一种能有效聚合特征并降低维度的框架。
Method: 提出 Choquet 积分特征聚合方法，结合自适应权重和增量特征选择，对高维特征进行非线性聚合，然后使用随机森林和 XGBoost 分类器进行异常检测。
Result: 在特征子集大小变化下，Choquet 聚合特征相比原始特征准确率提升最高 7%，数据体积从 214 MB 降至 48 MB（减少 77.5%），且精确率和召回率未下降；统计检验显示改进显著（p < 0.05）。
Conclusion: 该聚合方法适用于带宽和特征可用性受限的实时入侵检测场景，在特征数量有限时仍能获得显著性能增益。
Relevance: 0
