papers.title: Precise but Uncoupled: Reviewer Precision Does Not Guarantee Critique Uptake in Multi-Agent Math Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Many math- and science-oriented agent systems use hierarchical designs with specialized reviewer roles, assuming that a dedicated review stage should help turn wrong candidates into correct ones. We test this assumption on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems using matched gpt-oss-120b actors. Collaboration adds little on the easiest tiers, but from tier 4 onward the gains open sharply; in this harder regime, broadcast-style peer discussion reaches higher final accuracy than a planner-executor-reviewer pipeline (PER). We ask whether this gap is explained by reviewer quality or by whether critique changes the next answer the protocol carries forward. It is not explained by reviewer precision alone: PER's reviewer is more precise than broadcast's (0.861 vs. 0.644), yet evaluator-verified useful critique is much less likely to change the next candidate and produces lower reviewer-guided repair. These results show that reviewer detection quality and critique uptake are empirically separable. Within matched PER interventions, forcing explicit acknowledgment lowers final accuracy, while embedding reviewer guidance directly in the solver's working context partially improves follow-through without closing the gap. Overall, reviewer-centric evaluation can overstate system quality: a protocol may spot errors well yet still fail to solve more problems if it does not act on those critiques.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 20 figures, 25 tables. Public release website: https://huggingface.co/spaces/AgentsSci/scientific-agent-protocol-traces-site
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试了数学推理多智能体系统中专门评审阶段有助于修正答案的假设。在4,181个Omni-MATH问题上，广播式讨论在较难层级上比规划-执行-评审流水线（PER）获得更高准确率。PER的评审员更精确（0.861 vs 0.644），但其有用的批评较少改变下一个候选答案，导致评审引导修复效果更差。结果说明评审检测质量与批评采纳是可分离的，评审员中心评估可能高估系统整体质量。
Motivation: 许多面向数学和科学的智能体系统采用层次化设计，假设专门的评审阶段能帮助将错误候选转为正确候选。该假设在数学推理中是否成立尚不清楚。
Method: 使用4,181个带有验证器标注的Omni-MATH问题，匹配gpt-oss-120b执行者，比较广播式同行讨论与规划-执行-评审流水线（PER）的性能，并分析评审员精确性和批评采纳对最终答案的影响。
Result: 在较难层级（tier 4起），广播式讨论的最终准确率显著高于PER。PER的评审员精确率更高（0.861 vs 0.644），但经验证有用的批评更少改变下一个候选，且评审引导修复效果更低。在PER中强制显式确认降低最终准确率，而将评审指导嵌入求解者工作上下文部分改善跟进但仍未消除差距。
Conclusion: 评审员中心的评估可能高估系统质量：协议可能很好地发现错误，但若不对批评采取行动则仍无法解决更多问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large Language Models as Unified Multimodal Learners for Clinical Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health records combine free-text clinical narratives with structured measurements such as vital signs, laboratory values, and comorbidities. Yet most clinical prediction systems still rely on task-specific fusion architectures, pairing dedicated encoders for each modality with learned combination mechanisms that must be re-engineered for every new task and clinical setting. We propose a simpler alternative: convert all patient data, regardless of modality, into a single natural language sequence and fine-tune a pretrained language model end-to-end, with no architectural modification for fusion. We evaluate this approach across three clinically distinct prediction tasks: in-hospital mortality on MIMIC-III, graft failure prediction using longitudinal data from a German transplant center, and emergency triage classification from ambulance records - comparing encoder-based (ModernBERT) and decoder-based (Llama 3.1, Gemma, DeepSeek-R1-Qwen, Qwen3) fine-tuning against established multimodal baselines and, for graft failure, a gradient boosting model currently used in clinical practice for post-transplant patient management. Across all three tasks, unified textual serialization matches or exceeds task-specific multimodal baselines, and outperforms the clinically deployed gradient boosting system on graft failure prediction. These results indicate that a single serialization-based paradigm, without bespoke fusion architectures, is sufficient for multimodal clinical prediction - substantially reducing system complexity while matching or exceeding specialized designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将电子健康记录中的多模态数据（自由文本和结构化测量）统一转换为自然语言序列，然后用预训练语言模型进行端到端微调，无需特定的融合架构。在三个临床预测任务（MIMIC-III住院死亡率、移植肾失败预测、急诊分诊）上，该方法匹配或超过了专门的多模态基线，并优于临床部署的梯度提升模型。
Motivation: 现有临床预测系统依赖针对每个任务设计的融合架构，需要为每个新任务重新设计，复杂度高。
Method: 将所有患者数据（包括文本和数值）转换为单一自然语言序列，然后对预训练语言模型（如ModernBERT, Llama 3.1等）进行端到端微调，不修改模型架构。
Result: 在MIMIC-III住院死亡率、移植肾失败预测和急诊分诊三个任务上，该方法匹配或超过了任务特定的多模态基线，并在移植肾失败预测中优于临床使用的梯度提升系统。
Conclusion: 单一序列化范式足以进行多模态临床预测，无需定制融合架构，降低了系统复杂度且性能不逊于专门设计。

papers.title: On the Impact of Entropy-based Features
papers.abstract_en: Network anomaly detection is increasingly challenging due to the growing diversity and variability of traffic patterns, which are not always well captured by traditional statistical features. In this work, we explore the use of entropy as an additional feature to support supervised network traffic classification. The main idea is to use entropy to represent variability in selected traffic attributes, complementing conventional descriptors rather than replacing them. We integrate the entropy-based feature into a standard machine learning pipeline and evaluate its impact through a direct comparison between models trained with and without this feature. Experiments conducted on a public intrusion detection dataset show consistent improvements in classification performance, while the additional computational cost remains low. The analysis of confusion matrices indicates a reduction in misclassifications, especially in traffic scenarios with higher variability. Overall, the results suggest that entropy-based features offer a simple and practical way to enhance existing anomaly detection pipelines. This approach is particularly attractive in settings where lightweight feature engineering and interpretability are important, making entropy a useful complement to commonly used traffic features.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at the IEEE International Symposium on Computers and Communications (ISCC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索将熵作为额外特征用于监督式网络流量分类，以捕捉传统统计特征难以表示的流量变异性。在公开入侵检测数据集上，加入熵特征后分类性能一致提升，且计算开销低。混淆矩阵分析显示误分类减少，尤其在高变异性场景中。
Motivation: 传统统计特征难以充分捕捉网络流量的多样性和变异性，导致异常检测性能受限。熵能表示流量属性的变异性，有望作为补充特征。
Method: 将熵特征集成到标准机器学习流水线中，通过对比有无该特征的模型性能来评估其影响。
Result: 在公开入侵检测数据集上，加入熵特征后分类性能一致提升，计算开销增加很小；混淆矩阵分析显示误分类减少，尤其在高变异性流量场景中。
Conclusion: 熵特征是一种简单实用的方式，可在轻量特征工程和可解释性重要的场景中增强现有异常检测流水线，适合作为常用流量特征的补充。

papers.title: Reasoning-Guided Part-Level Visual Grounding via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) ground whole objects well from free-form language queries, but they struggle when the query names a part rather than the object. We trace this to a missing object-part hierarchy, since parts are localized in the same single step used for objects. We propose Object-Part Hierarchical Reflective Grounding (OP-HRG), a coarse-to-fine reasoning-guided grounding strategy that first localizes the parent object and then the part within it. A self-check then reflects on the result, with an extension to re-encode the predicted crop to inspect the region it is correcting. We introduce a part-aware GRPO framework to train our pipeline with stage-wise rewards. A 4B model trained this way outperforms 7B grounding LLMs and SAM3 across PascalPart, PartImageNet, and InstructPart, and transfers to reasoning segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出目标-部分层次反射性定位（OP-HRG），一种由粗到细的推理引导定位策略，先定位父物体再定位其部分，并通过自我检查机制和部分感知的GRPO框架进行训练。4B模型在PascalPart、PartImageNet和InstructPart上超越了7B定位LLM和SAM3，并能迁移至推理分割任务。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能很好地根据自由形式查询定位整体物体，但当查询指定物体部分时表现不佳，原因是缺乏物体-部分层次结构，部分与物体在同一单步中定位。
Method: 提出OP-HRG，首先定位父物体，然后在父物体内定位部分；通过自我检查反思结果，并扩展为重新编码预测裁剪以检查区域。采用部分感知的GRPO框架，结合阶段奖励训练整个流程。
Result: 4B模型在PascalPart、PartImageNet和InstructPart上优于7B定位LLM和SAM3，并能迁移至推理分割。
Conclusion: 所提出的层次化定位和部分感知训练有效提升了部分级别的视觉定位性能，并展示了向推理分割的迁移能力。

papers.title: AnovaX: A Local, Multi-Agent Voice Assistant with LLM Planning, Typed Executors, and Adaptive Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Desktop voice assistants are still dominated by cloud pipelines that ship raw audio off the machine and expose a fixed set of skills. We describe AnovaX, a small local-first assistant that runs entirely on the user's computer and treats the desktop itself as its action surface. A single Python process wires together a wake-word gate, a speech pipeline, an LLM planner (Gemini) that emits a JSON plan of tool calls, a whitelist-and-denylist safety layer, a multi-agent orchestrator that translates each plan into typed child agents on a bounded thread pool, and an adaptive recovery loop that takes over whenever a core step fails. Every tool corresponds to a specialized agent class (AppAgent, TypingAgent, BrowserAgent and six others) with its own timeout, retry policy, and shared-resource locks. A recursive MetaAgent lets the planner delegate a sub-goal back to itself, capped at two levels of nesting. The recovery loop uses a compact ReAct-style prompt and hides Gemini's latency behind speculative execution of read-only tools. A companion Flask server exposes a phone-friendly remote over the local WiFi, mirrors every agent lifecycle event to the phone in real time, and streams the laptop's screen back over MJPEG so the user can watch remote commands land as they run. The point of the project is less to compete with Siri or Alexa than to show that a legible, few-thousand-line assistant is enough to open apps, type into them, run searches, coordinate concurrent actions, recover from single-step failures, and be driven entirely from a phone in another room -- without the LLM ever touching the keyboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnovaX 是一个完全在本地运行的桌面语音助手，通过单一 Python 进程集成唤醒词、语音流水线、LLM 规划器（Gemini）、安全层、多智能体编排器和自适应恢复循环。工具调用对应专门的智能体类（如 AppAgent、TypingAgent、BrowserAgent 等），支持递归元智能体和推测执行。配套 Flask 服务器提供手机远程控制和屏幕流。整个系统仅数千行代码，无需云依赖。
Motivation: 当前桌面语音助手大多依赖云流水线，传输原始音频并提供固定技能集，缺乏本地化、可扩展和透明的替代方案。
Method: 采用 LLM 规划器生成 JSON 工具调用计划，通过多智能体编排器将计划转化为带超时、重试和资源锁的 typed child agents，并利用自适应恢复循环（ReAct 风格提示）处理失败步骤，同时使用推测执行隐藏延迟。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称系统能够打开应用、输入文本、运行搜索、协调并发操作、从单步失败中恢复，并完全通过手机远程驱动。
Conclusion: 项目旨在展示一个可读的、数千行的本地助手足以完成常规桌面任务，无需 LLM 直接接触键盘，且可作为云助手的轻量替代。

papers.title: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Point-Cloud Segmentation on the Generalized Few-Shot Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Generalized few-shot 3D point-cloud segmentation (GFS-PCS) asks a model to segment a scene into many base classes seen at training time and a set of novel classes. The state of the art reaches novel classes by reconciling a dense but noisy 3D vision-language prior with the few-shot support, but it pays for this with base 3D labels, per-episode training, and the support annotations themselves. We ask how far the same reconciliation can go with none of these: no training, no 3D labels, and not even the few-shot support. We pair a frozen 3D vision-language model (RegionPLC) as a dense prior with a frozen promptable concept segmenter (SAM3), prompted by the bare novel class names and lifted from posed RGB views, and reconcile the two by cross-view consistency: a point becomes novel only when enough of the views that see it agree. On the ScanNet200 GFS-PCS benchmark this fully training-free, open-vocabulary pipeline improves novel mIoU by +2.6 over the training-free dense prior while holding base accuracy within 0.5, and recovers a third (33%) of the novel-class gap to the trained state of the art that uses far more supervision. We further show that injecting the few-shot support into the pipeline, as a fusion gate and as a prototypical dense classifier, adds nothing over consistency alone and in fact degrades it through the classifier, which is why the method needs no support at all. On the harder ScanNet++ benchmark, where the dense prior is far weaker on novel classes, the same pipeline nearly doubles novel mIoU (+15.7, from 16.2 to 31.9) at a 1.7 base cost, lifting the harmonic mean from 21.5 to 31.1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对广义小样本3D点云分割（GFS-PCS）任务，提出一种完全无需训练的开词汇流水线，无需任何3D标签、support标注或训练。方法通过冻结的RegionPLC（密集3D视觉语言先验）和SAM3（可提示概念分割器），利用跨视角一致性来决定点是否属于新类。在ScanNet200上，该方法在new mIoU上比无训练密集先验提升2.6点，保持了base精度；在ScanNet++上new mIoU从16.2提升至31.9，调和均值从21.5升至31.1。
Motivation: 现有GFS-PCS方法依赖大量监督（base类标签、每episode训练、support标注），本文探索能否在零训练、零3D标签甚至无support标注的情况下实现相近性能。
Method: 将冻结的RegionPLC（密集先验）与冻结的SAM3（可提示分割器）配对，通过跨视图一致性融合：仅当多数可见视图一致时，点被标记为新类，无需任何训练或标注。
Result: 在ScanNet200基准上，方法在new mIoU上比无训练密集先验提升+2.6，base精度损失<0.5，恢复了33%的新类差距；在ScanNet++上new mIoU从16.2提升至31.9（+15.7），base mIoU下降1.7，调和均值从21.5升至31.1。
Conclusion: 一致性融合本身已足够有效，注入few-shot support（作为融合门控或原型分类器）不带来提升，甚至通过分类器降低性能，因此方法完全无需support。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Crucially, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that annotates trajectory clips with natural languages describing scene state transitions, providing rich and precise conditioning for action learning. During post-training, we aim to align these capabilities with robot embodiments and imperative instructions that humans naturally use to prompt robots. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong scaling behavior. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increased data scales and model sizes during pre-training. This scaling behavior directly transfers to post-training, where a stronger pre-training model yields better out-of-the-box real-robot performance in unseen environments. Furthermore, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 serves as a strong robot foundation policy that can be efficiently fine-tuned on complex, dexterous tasks with high data efficiency. Across multiple simulation benchmarks, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, it establishes a new state-of-the-art with a 57.6% success rate on RoboCasa365, surpassing the previous best of 46.6%. Furthermore, it achieves an average score of 20.07 on RoboDojo, significantly outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (13.07). Code and model checkpoints will be released. Project page: https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Xiaomi-Robotics-1，一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型，通过超过10万小时的真实世界操作轨迹（使用UMI设备采集）进行预训练，并开发可扩展的自动标注管道用自然语言描述场景状态转换。后训练阶段对齐机器人本体和人类指令。模型在多个模拟基准上超越先前SOTA，例如RoboCasa365上成功率57.6%（之前最好46.6%），RoboDojo上平均得分20.07（之前13.07），且呈现数据规模和模型大小的正向缩放行为。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在真实世界移动操作任务中泛化能力有限，且依赖大量人工标注。本文旨在通过大规模真实轨迹和自动语言标注训练一个强基础模型，使其能零样本执行多样化指令并高效适应新任务。
Method: 两阶段训练：预训练阶段使用UMI设备采集超过10万小时真实操作轨迹，并设计自动标注管道将轨迹片段标注为自然语言描述的场景状态转换；后训练阶段将预训练能力对齐到具体机器人本体和人类常用的指令形式。
Result: 在RoboCasa365上达到57.6%成功率（超过之前最好46.6%），在RoboDojo上平均得分20.07（超过之前最好13.07）。实验显示预训练阶段性能随数据量和模型大小提升，并且该缩放行为直接转移到后训练阶段。
Conclusion: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 可作为强鲁棒的机器人基础策略，支持零样本部署和高效微调。摘要强调其缩放行为和对齐训练的有效性，代码和模型将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lazy Arithmetic using Systolic Arrays for Closing the Verification Gap on Embedded Systems
authors: Martin Brain (City St George University of London)
papers.abstract_en: Complex algorithms such as deep neural networks are increasingly being deployed on embedded, resource constrained platforms. However, existing hardware and software schemes for implementing these models on the edge fall short, particularly for safety-critical applications such as medical devices. First, hardware such as GPUs, NPUs and TPUs are designed for throughput rather than correctness of computation of security, and are as such susceptible to fault injection attacks. Second, software schemes designed for porting algorithms onto edge devices -- such as quantization schemes -- are either static and sound (non-optimal power consumption), or dynamic yet unsound (non-optimal for safety-critical applications). To address both these needs we propose a both wholly new approach to real-time, dynamic and sound quantization, as well as the hardware to support it. First we developed a sound, real-time adaptive-precision quantization approach utilizing left-to-right arithmetic to pass the most significant bits (MSB) first, and dynamically adjust precision online while performing sensitivity analysis to quantify and manage the risk of decision-boundary crossings. Next, we propose a novel hardware approach utilizing systolic arrays to perform left-to-right arithmetic to generate the MSB first. Together this provides a wholly novel scheme for enabling not only resource-efficient neural networks and artificial intelligence at the edge, but broadly sound and resource-efficient high-precision mathematics on hardware that ensures resilience to bit flip attacks on the most critical bits. This is presented herein as work-in-progress, with software implementations completed and hardware in-progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对嵌入式安全关键系统上部署深度学习模型时面临的硬件易受故障注入攻击、量化方案要么静态低效要么动态不可靠的问题，提出了一种全新的实时动态可量化方案。该方案采用从左到右的算术（left-to-right arithmetic）优先传递最高有效位，并结合在线敏感度分析动态调整精度，同时设计了基于脉动阵列（systolic arrays）的硬件架构来支持左到右算术。这是一个进行中的工作，软件实现已完成，硬件仍在开发中。
Motivation: 现有嵌入式硬件（如GPU、NPU、TPU）优先吞吐量而非安全性，易受故障注入攻击；现有量化方案要么静态且可靠但功耗非最优，要么动态但不可靠，不适合安全关键应用。
Method: 提出一种实时的、自适应的、可靠的量化方法，使用从左到右算术优先计算最高有效位，通过在线敏感度分析动态调整精度并量化决策边界交叉的风险。同时提出基于脉动阵列的硬件架构来执行左到右算术。
Result: 作为进行中的工作，软件实现已完成，硬件实现仍在进行，尚未报告具体实验指标。
Conclusion: 该工作倡导一种全新的软硬件协同方案，以实现资源高效且安全可靠的嵌入式人工智能和高精度数学计算，尤其强调对位翻转攻击的弹性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking the Readout: Unlocking Video Backbones for AI-Generated Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated videos (AIGVs) typically contain subtle temporal artifacts that arise from inter-frame inconsistencies rather than within individual frames. A detector that captures such artifacts should therefore benefit from video pretrained backbones over image only ones. In practice, however, video backbones with standard global readouts often fail to outperform strong image pretrained probes on AIGV benchmarks. We attribute this gap to excessive spatiotemporal aggregation in the readout. Video pretrained backbones tend to compress each frame into a single global descriptor. This compression suppresses local patch level temporal dynamics and discards inter patch relations, which are precisely the cues that AIGV detection most reliably depends on. Based on this, we propose Velocity Gated Patch Velocity Profiling (V-PVP), a lightweight readout that replaces only the aggregation layer with two parallel streams over the patch velocity field, adding only about $0.5$M trainable parameters. V-PVP serves as a general plug-and-play module that consistently improves performance across diverse video backbones under both end-to-end fine-tuning and linear probing settings. Our method reaches \textbf{95.28} AUC on AIGVDBench while keeping the backbone fully frozen. papers.title: Generative Compilation: On-the-Fly Compiler Feedback as AI Generates Code
papers.abstract_en: Languages with rich static semantics, such as Rust, provide stronger guarantees for AI-generated code, but their strictness makes generation more difficult. Off-the-shelf compilers can provide useful feedback post-generation, but does not guide intermediate generation steps, such as those during autoregressive LLM decoding. Constrained decoding intervenes earlier by rejecting invalid tokens during sampling, but requires white-box model access and costly reimplementation for semantic constraints. We introduce generative compilation, the first approach to obtaining compiler feedback on partial programs during generation. The core technical device is a sealor: a lightweight, mostly syntax-guided transformation that converts partial programs into complete ones that standard compilers can diagnose. It is designed such that possible-to-complete partial programs are never rejected, while preserving enough code context to catch genuine dead ends early. We construct such a sealor on a core Rust-like calculus and prove that it satisfies these properties, all mechanized in Lean. We extend it to the first partial-program checker for real Rust. We evaluate our method on challenging repository-level Rust coding tasks, across both frontier black-box and open-weight models. We show that generative compilation reduces non-compiling outputs and improves functional correctness, relative to standard post-generation feedback. It does so by detecting a broad range of errors close to their source and early during generation, thereby reducing errors cascades and enabling focused diagnostics. More broadly, generative compilation is a step toward making compilers a first-class citizen of AI-assisted programming active during generation, rather than a separate post-generation check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式编译（generative compilation），通过在代码生成过程中实时获取编译器反馈来改进AI代码生成。核心是设计了一种名为sealor的轻量级变换，将部分程序转换为标准编译器可诊断的完整程序，并证明其在类Rust核心演算中的性质。该工作在真实的Rust语言上实现了首个部分程序检查器，实验表明能减少非编译输出并提升功能正确性。
Motivation: 现有方法仅在代码生成后使用编译器反馈，无法在自回归解码的中间步骤指导生成；约束解码需要白盒模型访问且语义约束实现成本高。
Method: 提出sealor变换，将部分程序转换为可编译器诊断的完整程序，基于语法指导并保留足够上下文，确保可能完成的部分程序不被拒绝。在类Rust演算中形式化证明，并扩展到真实Rust。
Result: 在仓库级Rust编程任务上，相比标准后生成反馈，生成式编译减少非编译输出并提升功能正确性，能提前检测错误、减少级联。
Conclusion: 生成式编译使编译器成为AI辅助编程中的一等公民，在生成过程中实时提供反馈，而不仅仅是事后检查。

papers.title: LLM-as-a-Judge Scores Are Unreliable Optimization Signals in Closed-Loop Table Recognition
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge is widely used to provide feedback and selection signals in closedloop regeneration, but this use remains insufficiently validated. We study it in table recognition, where deterministic TEDS evaluation provides a controlled testbed, using FinTabNet and OmniDocBench. Three findings emerge. First, judge signals were weak on both datasets: scores frequently tied, rankings were not reproducible, and no tested judge score policy, whether selecting among candidates or accepting revisions under a conservative score margin, improved on the first output on both datasets. Iteration produced better candidates, but the judge recovered them at most partially on one dataset and not at all on the other. Second, severe losses occurred even without specific judge feedback, supporting target-preservation failure under unconstrained regeneration as a proximate mechanism. Third, a structure-preserving instruction reduced the severe-loss rate, significantly on FinTabNet and directionally on OmniDocBench, but produced no improvement, and in an exploratory 2x2 analysis this protection was not stably observed when judge feedback was retained. These results do not dispute the value of LLMs as evaluators, but show that the tested reference-free judge signals were too weak and unstable to drive candidate selection in this setup, and that evaluation-style evidence alone was insufficient to establish closed-loop optimization utility. Iterative refinement requires, at minimum, a verification signal that deterministically detects structural change, rather than judge scores alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在闭环表格识别任务中，使用LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）提供优化信号的可靠性。通过FinTabNet和OmniDocBench数据集，发现裁判信号存在分数频繁打平、排名不可重复等问题，无法在两种数据集上持续改进初始输出。迭代能产生更好候选，但裁判最多只能在部分数据集上部分恢复。结构保持指令可降低严重损失率，但并未带来整体改进。结果表明，无参考的裁判信号不足以驱动候选选择，闭环优化需要能确定性检测结构变化的验证信号。
Motivation: LLM作为裁判被广泛用于闭环再生中的反馈和选择信号，但其有效性缺乏充分验证。本文以表格识别为测试平台，利用确定性TEDS评估提供受控实验环境，旨在检验裁判信号在闭环优化中的实际效果。
Method: 在表格识别中，使用FinTabNet和OmniDocBench数据集，对比多种裁判信号策略（如候选选择、基于保守分数阈值的接受修订），并测试结构保持指令的影响。通过闭环迭代再生实验，分析裁判信号的强度、可重复性及对候选选择的驱动能力。
Result: 裁判信号在两种数据集上均表现薄弱：分数频繁打平，排名不可重复，所有策略均未能在两数据集上一致优于首次输出。迭代产生的更好候选仅在一数据集上被部分恢复。结构保持指令降低了严重损失率（FinTabNet显著，OmniDocBench有趋势），但未带来改进，且在保留裁判反馈时保护效果不稳定。
Conclusion: 无参考的裁判信号太弱且不稳定，不足以驱动候选选择；仅凭评估性证据不足以保证闭环优化效用。迭代优化至少需要能确定性检测结构变化的验证信号，而非仅依赖裁判分数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Faithful Autoformalization of Natural Language Assertions
papers.abstract_en: Formal contracts are essential for software testing and verification, yet writing them remains labor-intensive and error-prone. LLMs offer a promising path toward autoformalization: synthesizing executable assertions from natural-language specifications and thereby bridging the gap between informal developer intent and formal executable specifications. We present Monty: an autoformalization framework for assertions that tackles the challenges of expectations of validity of assertions and ambiguity in natural-language. Our techniques are based on filtering formalizations using a novel conformance score metric and validity scores obtained from testing the code against formalized assertions. We evaluate our approach on 541 assertion-generation tasks derived from 22 collection-like Java classes, and show that our technique produces the ground truth more reliably (improving upto 20 points in precision on average) than when using LLMs naively to translate assertions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Monty 框架，用于从自然语言规范自动合成可执行断言（autoformalization），解决断言的有效性期望和自然语言歧义问题。通过新颖的一致性评分（conformance score）和基于测试的效度评分来过滤形式化结果。在 22 个 Java 集合类的 541 个断言生成任务上评估，显示该方法在精度上比直接使用 LLM 翻译提高了最多 20 个百分点。
Motivation: 形式化合约对软件测试和验证至关重要，但手动编写费时且易错。LLM 提供自动形式化的可能，但面临断言有效性期望和自然语言歧义的挑战。
Method: 提出 Monty 框架，结合一致性评分（conformance score）和从代码测试获得的效度评分（validity score）来过滤 LLM 生成的断言形式化。
Result: 在 541 个断言生成任务上，该方法比直接使用 LLM 翻译在精度上平均提升最高 20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该技术能更可靠地生成正确的形式化断言，但未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energetics and Stochastics of Extreme Waves Breaking over a Symmetrical Breakwater
papers.abstract_en: Rogue wave formation and enhancement over coastal areas have been documented over the last decade. This seems to contradict the observed low rogue wave (RW) probability near the surf zone. Without considering wave breaking, RW amplification is expected in this regime. To address this gap, we consider fully nonlinear effects of wave breaking through the proxy of height-to-depth ratio, spatial changes on the wavenumber through the WKB approximation, and slope-corrected refraction mild-slope equations on the energetics of irregular wave fields travelling over a breakwater. By increasing the significant wave height towards the breaking limit, the kinetic energy grows faster than the variance of the surface elevation due to nonlinearity. Thus, the kurtosis decays, albeit not to the point of getting sub-Gaussian statistics. We thereby resolve the apparent paradox of the occurrence probability of RW increase at the beginning of shoaling but subsequently decrease when wave breaking becomes dominant. Motivated by these theoretical developments, we experimentally probe inhomogeneous wave fields nearing the wave-breaking regime. We conduct unidirectional irregular wave experiments in a 30 m long wave flume, generating broad-banded waves over a symmetric submerged breakwater featuring a bottom slope of 1/5, allowing detailed characterization of spectral evolution and the persistence of elevated excess kurtosis even near the breaking limit for this steep slope. We thereby confirm that the excess kurtosis can still be large if the bottom slope is steep, and its maximum value is at least 4 times larger than in other ocean processes, occurring atop the breakwater and about half of its deep water peak wavelength distance after the shoal. As these conditions are typical near shorelines, this understanding is key to coastal areas.
papers.comment: This submission was intended as a replacement of article 2502.00400 and any subsequent updates will appear there
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过理论分析和实验研究，探讨了极端波浪在对称防波堤上破碎的能学和随机特性。研究发现，波浪破碎通过高度-深度比代理导致动能增长快于波面方差，从而使峰度下降，但陡坡条件下超额峰度仍可达到其他海洋过程的4倍，解释了近岸区域极端波概率先升后降的悖论。
Motivation: 观测显示近岸区域极端波概率较低，与不考虑破碎时的理论增强相矛盾，需考虑波破碎的非线性效应来解释这一悖论。
Method: 采用高度-深度比作为波破碎代理，结合WKB近似和缓坡方程分析不规则波场能学，并在30米水槽中进行单向不规则波实验，生成宽带波在1/5底坡对称防波堤上传播。
Result: 随着有效波高接近破碎极限，动能增长快于波面方差，峰度下降但仍高于高斯统计；实验证实陡坡上超额峰度可达其他海洋过程的4倍，出现在防波堤顶部及浅化后约一半深水波长距离处。
Conclusion: 该研究解决了极端波概率在浅化初期增加、破碎主导后减少的悖论，并表明陡坡条件下波浪破碎并未完全抑制峰度，对海岸区域极端波风险评估具有重要意义。

papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
papers.abstract_en: While UMAP is widely used for exploring high-dimensional data, typical workflows focus on its lower-dimensional embedding, largely overlooking the rich k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graph that UMAP constructs internally. This graph encodes the data manifold in its original high-dimensional space, before the distortion that UMAP's 2D projection introduces. We demonstrate the untapped potential of this internal representation, showing how standard graph algorithms applied to this graph enhance data sensemaking: (1) PageRank identifies representative data points, (2) k-core decomposition reveals dense core regions versus sparse periphery, and (3) clustering coefficient detects tight-knit neighborhoods with highly-similar data points. Through quantitative and qualitative evaluation on MNIST and Fashion MNIST, we show that these graph-based analyses are not only practical but also competitive with or complementary to purpose-built methods (e.g., k-medoids for exemplar selection, HDBSCAN for density-based clustering).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，UMAP在降维过程中内部构建的k近邻图（kNN graph）蕴含了高维空间的数据流形信息，但通常被忽略。作者展示了在此kNN图上应用标准图算法（PageRank、k-core分解、聚类系数）可以增强数据理解：PageRank识别代表性数据点，k-core揭示核心与外围区域，聚类系数检测紧密邻域。在MNIST和Fashion MNIST上的定量与定性评估表明，这些图分析方法与专用方法（如k-medoids、HDBSCAN）相比具有竞争力或互补性。
Motivation: 典型UMAP工作流只关注低维嵌入，忽视了内部kNN图所编码的原始高维流形信息，错失了利用该图进行数据探索的机会。
Method: 将标准图算法应用于UMAP的kNN图：PageRank用于识别代表性数据点，k-core分解用于检测密度核心与稀疏边缘，聚类系数用于发现高度相似的数据点构成的紧密邻域。
Result: 在MNIST和Fashion MNIST上，基于图的分析方法在示例选择（与k-medoids竞争）和密度聚类（与HDBSCAN互补）等任务中表现良好，验证了其实际效用。
Conclusion: UMAP的内部kNN图是一个未被充分利用的资源，应用简单的图算法即可获得有意义的洞察，且与专用方法相比不逊色。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HiLSVA: Design and Evaluation of a Human-in-the-Loop Agentic System for Scientific Visualization
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents enable natural language interaction for scientific visualization (SciVis). Still, prior systems have essentially prioritized autonomy over human analytical control, thereby limiting transparency and human oversight. We present HiLSVA, a human-in-the-loop agentic system that supports mixed-initiative SciVis workflows. HiLSVA integrates a plan-first multi-agent architecture with explicit human oversight, stepwise provenance tracking, and learn-at-test-time adaptation from user feedback. The system supports fluid handoff between humans and agents through both natural language and direct manipulation of visualizations, while sandboxed execution ensures safe, reproducible workflows. In doing so, HiLSVA reframes agentic SciVis as a collaborative process that augments, rather than replaces, human analytical reasoning. We evaluate HiLSVA through representative case studies and a controlled user study with twelve participants of varying expertise across multiple autonomy settings. Results show that mixed-initiative interaction improves task completion, user control, and workflow transparency across different levels of user expertise, while revealing a tradeoff between execution efficiency and human oversight. These findings highlight the importance of human-centered design in agentic SciVis and guide the development of future collaborative visualization systems. We encourage readers to explore our demo video, case studies, and source code at https://hilsva.github.io/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiLSVA，一个人机协同的代理系统，用于科学可视化工作流。系统采用计划优先的多智能体架构，支持人类监督、逐步溯源和测试时自适应学习，通过自然语言和可视化直接操作实现人机交接，并在沙盒中执行以确保安全。用户研究显示混合主动交互提高了任务完成度、用户控制和工作流透明度，但执行效率与人类监督之间存在权衡。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理系统在科学可视化中优先追求自主性，缺乏透明度和人类监督，限制了人类分析控制。
Method: 集成计划优先的多智能体架构与显式人类监督、逐步溯源和测试时自适应反馈学习，支持自然语言和可视化直接操作，采用沙盒执行确保可复现。
Result: 通过代表性案例研究和12名不同专业水平参与者的受控用户研究，表明混合主动交互在不同用户水平上均提升任务完成度、用户控制和工作流透明度，但执行效率与人类监督存在权衡。
Conclusion: 强调了以人为中心的设计在代理科学可视化中的重要性，为未来协作可视化系统开发提供指导。

papers.title: NAMESAKES: Probing Identity Memorization in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models generate realistic likenesses of some individuals when prompted with their names, raising privacy concerns. However, distinguishing whether a generated face is memorized or fabricated currently requires ground-truth photos, access to training data, or white-box access to model internals, limiting applicability. We introduce a fully black-box behavioral probe that distinguishes between memorized and unrecognized names, while requiring no reference photos or prior knowledge of training data. To benchmark this task, we present the NAMESAKES dataset of over one thousand names and faces of public figures spanning a wide range of fame levels, along with perturbed, less famous names. Experiments on state-of-the-art T2I models show that our probe substantially predicts identity memorization and separates memorized from unrecognized names, with further insights into differences across model families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种黑盒行为探测方法，用于区分文本到图像模型生成的面向是记忆的（memorized）还是编造的（fabricated），无需真实照片或训练数据。作者构建了NAMESAKES数据集，包含上千个知名人物的名称与面部，以及经过扰动的较不知名名称。实验表明该方法能有效预测身份记忆，并区分记忆与未识别的名称，且揭示了不同模型族之间的差异。
Motivation: 现有方法区分生成的面孔是否被记忆需要真实照片、训练数据或白盒访问模型内部，限制了实用性。需要一种黑盒方法仅通过行为探测来判断模型是否记忆了特定身份。
Method: 提出完全黑盒的行为探测方法，无需参考照片或训练数据知识，仅通过模型对名称的生成行为来区分记忆与未识别的名称。同时构建NAMESAKES数据集，包含一千多个不同知名度水平的公众人物名称与面部，以及经过扰动的较不知名名称以进行基准测试。
Result: 在多个最新文本到图像模型上的实验表明，该方法能有效预测身份记忆，并能清晰区分记忆与未识别的名称。此外，发现不同模型族之间存在记忆行为差异。
Conclusion: 该方法为评估文本到图像模型中的隐私风险提供了黑盒工具，无需访问训练数据或模型内部。作者强调该方法具有普适性，但可能受限于数据集中的知名度范围。

papers.title: Factorized Neural Operators Decompose Dynamic and Persistent Responses
papers.abstract_en: Physical systems often exhibit heterogeneous mechanisms, where rapidly evolving dynamics coexist with persistent structures. Capturing such multiscale physical behavior remains challenging for existing neural operators, which typically rely on single dominant inductive bias and therefore couple distinct physical responses into a shared representation. We introduce the Unified Green's Function Framework across domains and propose the Factorized Neural Operators (FaNO), which decompose spectral representations into equivariant-inspired dynamic responses and invariant-inspired persistent responses, leading to better interpretability and generalization. Mechanistically, we show that the two operator branches spontaneously specialize into distinct physical roles that remain consistent across scales and domains: the equivariant-inspired branch captures rapidly varying transient dynamics, whereas the invariant-inspired branch extracts coherent persistent structures. This factorized mechanism of FaNO consistently improves prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency and cross-scale generalization across physical systems and domains. In particular, it maintains consistent predictions under long-horizon autoregressive rollout, cross-resolution extrapolation and physical-regime shifts. These findings suggest that scalable physical modeling may benefit from moving beyond single-inductive-bias formulations toward factorized operator representations that better reflect the heterogeneous organization of physical systems, accelerating the reliable deployment of machine learning for scientific computing and discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因子化神经算子（FaNO），将谱表示分解为等变启发的动态响应和不变启发的持久响应，分别捕捉快速演变的瞬态动力学和连贯的持久结构。该分解提升了预测精度、参数效率和跨尺度泛化能力，在长期自回归滚动、跨分辨率外推和物理区域变化下保持一致性。
Motivation: 现有神经算子通常依赖单一主导归纳偏置，耦合了不同物理响应，难以捕捉多尺度物理行为。
Method: 提出统一格林函数框架，并设计因子化神经算子（FaNO），将谱表示分解为等变启发的动态响应和不变启发的持久响应，两分支自动专司不同物理角色。
Result: FaNO一致地提升了预测精度、参数效率和跨尺度泛化，在长期自回归滚动、跨分辨率外推和物理区域变化下保持一致性。
Conclusion: 超越单一归纳偏置的因子化算子表示能更好地反映物理系统的异质组织，加速科学计算与发现的可靠部署。

papers.title: CloudDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Scene Completion in the Point Cloud Domain
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dense 3D scenes from sparse LiDAR point clouds (LiDAR scene completion) is a fundamental challenge in autonomous driving, where diffusion models offer a promising solution. However, existing approaches rely on object-level autoencoders that collapse into unstable global representations at outdoor scale, and suffer from ground truth data corrupted by odometry drift that systematically degrades supervision quality. Furthermore, multi-step diffusion inference incurs prohibitive latency for real-time deployment. We present CloudDiffusion, addressing these issues with three independent components. First, a multi-token Gaussian VAE with cross-attention pooling provides stable scene-scale LiDAR compression as a standalone reconstruction module, avoiding the global-pooling and codebook-collapse failure modes of prior point-cloud autoencoders. Second, an anchor-based ICP ground truth refinement pipeline eliminates drift-induced noise from training supervision, reducing our single-step x0 diffusion teacher's squared Chamfer distance by approximately 16x on SemanticKITTI seq. 08 (0.396 to 0.024 m^2) with no model change (partly aided by the denser, more compact refined references). Third, the same teacher completes scenes in a single x0 step, operating directly in coordinate space, not in the VAE latent. It runs in near real time at 209ms/frame, 65-138x lower inference latency than iterative diffusion baselines. Our results indicate that data quality dominates model design in this regime, and suggest that multi-token latent spaces could serve as a stable first stage for future latent diffusion-based scene completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CloudDiffusion，针对稀疏 LiDAR 点云场景补全问题，包含三个独立组件：多 token 高斯 VAE 提供稳定压缩，基于锚点的 ICP 真实标签精炼降低噪声，单步 x0 扩散实现近实时推理（209ms/帧）。实验表明数据质量比模型设计更重要，并建议多 token 潜空间可作为未来潜扩散场景补全的稳定第一阶段。
Motivation: 现有方法在户外尺度下使用对象级自编码器会导致全局表示不稳定，且真实标签被里程计漂移噪声污染，多步扩散推理延迟高，无法实时部署。
Method: 提出 CloudDiffusion，包括：(1) 多 token 高斯 VAE 与交叉注意力池化，避免全局池化和码本崩溃；(2) 基于锚点的 ICP 地面真值精炼流程，消除漂移噪声；(3) 单步 x0 扩散教师，直接在坐标空间操作，不依赖 VAE 潜空间。
Result: 在 SemanticKITTI seq. 08 上，单步 x0 扩散教师的平方 Chamfer 距离从 0.396 降至 0.024 m^2（约 16 倍提升）；推理延迟 209ms/帧，比迭代扩散基线低 65-138 倍。
Conclusion: 结果表明数据质量主导模型设计，多 token 潜空间可作为未来潜扩散场景补全的稳定第一阶段。

papers.title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
papers.abstract_en: While ubiquitous wearable sensors capture a wealth of behavioral and physiological information, effectively transforming these signals into personalized health insights is challenging. Specifically, converting low-level sensor data into representations capable of characterizing higher-level states is difficult due to high phenotypic diversity and variation in individual baseline health, physiology, and lifestyle factors. Moreover, collecting wearable data paired with health outcome annotations is laborious and expensive, and retrospective annotation remains practically unfeasible, contributing to a scarcity of data with high-quality labels. To overcome these limitations, we propose a foundation model for wearable health that is pretrained on more than one trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals drawn from a large cohort of five million participants. We demonstrate that the joint scaling of model capacity and pretraining data volume leads to systematic improvements in performance, as evaluated on a diverse set of 35 health prediction tasks, spanning cardiovascular, metabolic, sleep, and mental health, as well as lifestyle choices and demographic factors. We find that this population scale representation unlocks label-efficient few-shot learning and generative capabilities for robust daily metric estimation. To further leverage this learned representation, we deploy a classroom of LLM agents to autonomously search the space of downstream predictive heads built on the model embeddings, showing broad performance improvements that increase with LLM model capacity. Finally, we show how integrating these downstream predictors into a Personal Health Agent can support model responses that are more relevant, contextually aware, and safe, and we validate this via 1,860 ratings from a cohort of clinicians.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于基础模型的可穿戴健康数据通用框架，该模型使用超过一万亿分钟的无标签传感器信号在五百万参与者的大规模队列上进行预训练。在心血管、代谢、睡眠、心理健康等35项健康预测任务上，模型容量和数据规模的联合缩放带来了系统性性能提升，并支持少样本学习和生成能力。进一步，作者部署了LLM智能体自动搜索下游预测头，并集成到个人健康代理中，经1860名临床医生评分验证了其相关性和安全性。
Motivation: 将低级别传感器信号转化为个性化健康洞察面临表型多样性高、个体基线差异大、带标签数据稀缺等挑战，亟需一种能高效利用大规模无标签数据的基础模型。
Method: 提出一个基础模型，预训练于超过一万亿分钟的无标签可穿戴传感器信号（来自五百万参与者），通过联合缩放模型容量和数据规模提升性能；利用LLM智能体自动搜索下游预测头，并集成到个人健康代理中。
Result: 在35项涵盖心血管、代谢、睡眠、心理健康及生活方式等预测任务上，模型性能随规模扩展而提升，并展示了标签高效的少样本学习和生成能力；临床医生评分表明个人健康代理的响应更相关、更具上下文意识且更安全。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个基于基础模型的可穿戴健康数据通用框架，该模型使用超过一万亿分钟的无标签传感器信号在五百万参与者的大规模队列上进行预训练。在心血管、代谢、睡眠、心理健康等35项健康预测任务上，模型容量和数据规模的联合缩放带来了系统性性能提升，并支持少样本学习和生成能力。进一步，作者部署了LLM智能体自动搜索下游预测头，并集成到个人健康代理中，经1860名临床医生评分验证了其相关性和安全性。

papers.title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems
papers.abstract_en: Robust explanations are increasingly required for user trust in enterprise NLP, yet pre-deployment validation is difficult in the common case of black-box deployment (API-only access) where representation-based explainers are infeasible and existing studies provide limited guidance on whether explanations remain stable under real user noise, especially when organizations migrate from encoder classifiers to decoder LLMs. To close this gap, we propose a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level explanations based on leave-one-out occlusion, and operationalize explanation robustness with top-token flip rate under realistic perturbations (swap, deletion, shuffling, and back-translation) at multiple severity levels. Using this protocol, we conduct a systematic cross-architecture comparison across three benchmark datasets and six models spanning encoder and decoder families (BERT, RoBERTa, Qwen 7B/14B, Llama 8B/70B; 64,800 cases). We find that decoder LLMs produce substantially more stable explanations than encoder baselines (73% lower flip rates on average), and that stability improves with model scale (44% gain from 7B to 70B). Finally, we relate robustness improvements to inference cost, yielding a practical cost-robustness tradeoff curve that supports model and explanation selection prior to deployment in compliance-sensitive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业NLP系统中用户信任所需的鲁棒解释问题，提出基于leave-one-out遮挡的统一黑盒鲁棒性评估框架，通过top-token翻转率衡量在真实扰动下的解释稳定性。在三个基准数据集和六个模型（BERT、RoBERTa、Qwen 7B/14B、Llama 8B/70B）上系统比较，发现解码器LLM的解释稳定性显著优于编码器基线，且随规模增大而提高，并给出成本-鲁棒性权衡曲线。
Motivation: 企业NLP领域需要鲁棒解释以建立用户信任，但在黑盒部署（仅API）中，基于表示的解释器不可行，且现有研究对真实用户噪声下的解释稳定性缺乏指导，特别是从编码器分类器迁移到解码器LLM时。
Method: 提出统一的黑盒鲁棒性评估框架，基于leave-one-out遮挡生成token级解释，定义top-token翻转率在多种扰动（替换、删除、打乱、回译）和多个严重程度下的鲁棒性度量。
Result: 解码器LLM的解释翻转率比编码器基线平均低73%，模型规模从7B到70B稳定性提升44%。基于64,800个案例的系统比较。
Conclusion: 该框架提供预部署前的成本-鲁棒性权衡曲线，支持合规敏感应用中的模型和解释选择。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Mural Restoration via a Unified Hybrid Mask-Aware Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Ancient murals are valuable cultural artifacts, but many have suffered severe degradation due to environmental exposure, material aging, and human activity. Restoring these artworks is challenging because it requires both reconstructing large missing structures and preserving authentic, undamaged regions. We present the Hybrid Mask-Aware Transformer (HMAT), a unified framework for high-fidelity mural restoration that addresses both structural completion and authentic-region preservation. HMAT integrates Mask-Aware Dynamic Filtering for robust local texture modeling with a Transformer bottleneck for long-range structural inference, enabling recovery of continuous line patterns and coherent mural structures under irregular damage. To handle diverse degradation morphologies, we introduce a mask-conditional style fusion module that adapts the generative process according to the shape and extent of missing regions. We also propose a fidelity-oriented training objective that combines hole-normalized reconstruction, discriminator feature matching, and high-receptive-field perceptual supervision to improve damaged-region fidelity, texture consistency, and boundary quality. In addition, we analyze a Teacher-Forcing Decoder with hard-gated skip connections as a feature-space boundary-conditioning strategy. Experiments show that HMAT matches or outperforms representative convolutional, transformer-based, and edge-guided inpainting baselines, with especially strong gains in perceptual realism and severe-mask settings. Ablation studies further identify the proposed objective, MADF-based mask-aware encoding, and mask-conditioned synthesis as the main contributors to restoration quality. These results demonstrate that HMAT provides an effective and competitive solution for cultural heritage mural restoration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对古代壁画的复杂退化问题，提出统一框架Hybrid Mask-Aware Transformer (HMAT)，通过Mask-Aware动态滤波、Transformer瓶颈和掩码条件风格融合，同时实现结构补全与真实区域保持。实验在多种退化形态下达到或优于现有卷积/Transformer/边缘引导方法。
Motivation: 古代壁画因环境、老化和人为破坏严重退化，现有方法难以同时处理大面积缺失结构补全和未损坏区域保真。
Method: 提出HMAT框架，包含Mask-Aware动态滤波（MADF）进行局部纹理建模、Transformer瓶颈捕捉长程结构、掩码条件风格融合适应不同缺失形状，以及面向保真的训练目标（洞归一化重建、判别器特征匹配、高感受野感知损失）。还分析了带硬门控跳跃连接的教师强制解码器作为特征空间边界条件策略。
Result: 在感知真实性和严重掩码场景下表现突出，消融实验确认MADF编码、掩码条件合成和所提目标函数是主要贡献因素。
Conclusion: HMAT为文化遗产壁画修复提供了有效且具竞争力的方案。

papers.title: SciVisAgentBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems to translate natural-language intent into executable scientific visualization (SciVis) tasks. Despite rapid progress, the community lacks a principled and reproducible benchmark for evaluating these emerging SciVis agents in realistic, multi-step analysis settings. We present SciVisAgentBench, a comprehensive and extensible benchmark for evaluating scientific data analysis and visualization agents. Our benchmark is grounded in a structured taxonomy spanning four dimensions: application domain, data type, complexity level, and visualization operation. It currently comprises 108 expert-crafted cases covering diverse SciVis scenarios. To enable reliable assessment, we introduce a multimodal outcome-centric evaluation pipeline that combines LLM-based judging with deterministic evaluators, including image-based metrics, code checkers, rule-based verifiers, and case-specific evaluators. We also conduct a validity study with 12 SciVis experts to examine the agreement between human and LLM judges. Using this framework, we evaluate representative SciVis agents and general-purpose coding agents to establish initial baselines and reveal capability gaps. SciVisAgentBench is designed as a living benchmark to support systematic comparison, diagnose failure modes, and drive progress in agentic SciVis. The benchmark is available at https://scivisagentbench.github.io/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SciVisAgentBench，一个用于评估科学数据分析和可视化智能体（SciVis agents）的综合可扩展基准。该基准基于结构化分类法，涵盖四个维度：应用领域、数据类型、复杂度和可视化操作，包含108个专家构建的案例。采用结合大语言模型评判和确定性评估器的多模态结果导向评估管线，并通过12位SciVis专家进行有效性验证。评估了代表性SciVis智能体和通用编程智能体，建立初始基线并揭示能力差距。
Motivation: 当前缺乏一个原则性且可复现的基准来评估新兴的SciVis智能体在真实多步分析场景中的能力。
Method: 构建了涵盖四个维度的结构化分类法，设计了108个专家策划的案例；引入多模态结果导向评估管线，结合LLM评判、图像指标、代码检查器、规则验证器和案例特定评估器；并通过专家研究验证人类与LLM评判的一致性。
Result: 评估了代表性SciVis智能体和通用编程智能体，建立了初始基线并揭示了能力差距。
Conclusion: SciVisAgentBench旨在作为一个持续更新的基准，支持系统比较、诊断失败模式并推动智能体SciVis的进展。

papers.title: CompDiff: Hierarchical Compositional Diffusion for Fair and Zero-Shot Intersectional Medical Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are increasingly used to augment medical imaging datasets for fairer AI, yet a key assumption often goes unexamined: that generators produce equally high-quality images across demographic groups. Models trained on imbalanced data inherit these imbalances, degrading synthesis for rare subgroups and struggling with intersections absent from training: the imbalanced generator problem. Remedies such as loss reweighting operate at the optimization level and provide limited benefit when training signal is scarce or absent. We propose CompDiff, a hierarchical compositional diffusion framework that addresses this at the representation level. A dedicated Hierarchical Conditioner Network (HCN) decomposes demographic conditioning into single-attribute, pairwise, and composed representations, producing a demographic token concatenated with CLIP embeddings as cross-attention context. This structured factorization encourages parameter sharing across subgroups and supports compositional generalization to rare or unseen intersections. On chest X-rays (MIMIC-CXR) and fundus images (FairGenMed), CompDiff compares favorably against standard fine-tuning and FairDiffusion across image quality (FID 64.3 vs. 75.1), subgroup equity (ES-FID), and zero-shot intersectional generalization (up to 21% FID improvement on held-out intersections). Downstream classifiers trained on CompDiff data show improved AUROC and reduced demographic bias, suggesting that the architectural design of demographic conditioning is an important and underexplored factor in fair medical image generation. Code: https://github.com/mahmoudibrahim98/CompDiff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CompDiff，一种分层组合扩散框架，用于解决医学图像生成中的不平衡生成器问题。通过分层条件网络(HCN)分解人口统计条件，实现参数共享和组合泛化，在胸片和眼底图像上提升图像质量、亚组公平性和零样本交叉泛化性能。
Motivation: 现有生成模型在分布不平衡数据上训练会继承偏差，导致稀有亚组和未见交叉组合的合成质量低下，而损失重加权等优化层面方法在信号稀缺时效果有限。
Method: 提出CompDiff框架，核心是分层条件网络(HCN)将人口统计条件分解为单属性、成对和组合表示，生成人口统计token与CLIP嵌入拼接作为交叉注意上下文，支持参数共享和组合泛化。
Result: 在MIMIC-CXR和FairGenMed上，CompDiff相比标准微调和FairDiffusion在FID（64.3 vs 75.1）、亚组公平性（ES-FID）和零样本交叉泛化（最多21% FID改进）上更优，下游分类器AUROC提升且偏差降低。
Conclusion: 人口统计条件的架构设计是公平医学图像生成中重要且未充分探索的因素。

papers.title: The AI Fiction Paradox
papers.abstract_en: AI development has a fiction dependency problem. Developers have treated large corpora of modern books, including fiction, as valuable enough to accept substantial cost and legal risk, yet current models still struggle to generate compelling long-form fiction. I term this the "AI-Fiction Paradox," and it is particularly startling because training data strongly shapes model output. This paper offers a theoretically precise account of why fiction resists AI generation by identifying three distinct challenges for current systems. First, fiction depends on what I call narrative causation, a form of plot logic where events must feel both surprising in the moment and retrospectively inevitable. Standard autoregressive generation commits to prose sequentially, creating a practical obstacle to coordinating local surprise with retrospective inevitability across a long narrative. Second, I identify an informational revaluation challenge: fiction repeatedly requires the significance of earlier details to be reinterpreted in light of later developments, a form of long-range reasoning that current systems perform unreliably. Third, drawing on over seven years of collaborative research on sentiment arcs, I argue that fiction that moves us requires multi-scale emotional architecture, the orchestration of sentiment at word, sentence, scene, and arc levels simultaneously. Together, these three challenges help explain both why developers have sought large modern book corpora and why compelling long-form fiction remains so difficult to replicate. The analysis also raises urgent questions about what happens when these challenges are overcome. Fiction concentrates unusually powerful cognitive and emotional patterns for modeling human behavior, and mastery of these patterns by AI systems would represent not just a creative achievement but a potent vehicle for human manipulation at scale.
papers.comment: 15 pages, Presented at the MFS Cultural AI Conference, Purdue University, September 18, 2025. Accepted for publication as a collection of essays for a special issue of MFS Modern Fiction Studies on Cultural AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“AI-小说悖论”：开发者耗费巨资和风险收集现代小说语料，但当前模型仍难以生成引人入胜的长篇虚构作品。论文从理论上识别了三个核心挑战：叙事因果（事件需同时令人惊讶且事后不可避免）、信息重估（早期细节须根据后续发展重新解读）、以及多尺度情感架构（在词、句、场景、弧线层面同时协调情感）。分析还指出，一旦这些挑战被克服，AI将获得强大的认知和情感模式，可能被用于大规模操纵人类行为。
Motivation: 尽管大量现代小说被用作训练数据，当前AI在生成长篇虚构作品方面表现不佳，这一矛盾亟待理论解释。
Method: 通过理论分析，识别并阐述了三个阻碍AI生成长篇小说的关键挑战：叙事因果、信息重估和多尺度情感架构。
Result: 论文指出这三个挑战共同解释了为何开发者在求助于大型现代小说语料库时，长篇虚构作品的生成仍然困难重重。
Conclusion: 一旦这些挑战被克服，AI系统对小说中认知与情感模式的掌握不仅代表创造性成就，更可能成为大规模操纵人类的工具。

summary_sections.conclusion: 一旦这些挑战被克服，AI系统对小说中认知与情感模式的掌握不仅代表创造性成就，更可能成为大规模操纵人类的工具。

papers.title: Coverage Guarantees for Pseudo-Calibrated Conformal Prediction under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) offers distribution-free marginal coverage guarantees under an exchangeability assumption, but these guarantees can fail if the data distribution shifts. We analyze the use of pseudo-calibration as a tool to counter this performance loss under a bounded label-conditional covariate shift model. Using tools from domain adaptation, we derive a lower bound on target coverage in terms of the source-domain loss of the classifier and a Wasserstein measure of the shift. Using this result, we provide a method to design pseudo-calibrated sets that inflate the conformal threshold by a slack parameter to keep target coverage above a prescribed level. Finally, we propose a source-tuned pseudo-calibration algorithm that interpolates between hard pseudo-labels and randomized labels as a function of classifier uncertainty. Numerical experiments show that our bounds qualitatively track pseudo-calibration behavior and that the source-tuned scheme mitigates coverage degradation under distribution shift while maintaining nontrivial prediction set sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析在标签条件协变量偏移下，伪校准（pseudo-calibration）如何帮助共形预测（conformal prediction）维持覆盖保证。通过域适应工具推导出目标覆盖的下界，并提出源调谐伪校准算法（source-tuned pseudo-calibration），该算法根据分类器不确定性在硬伪标签和随机标签之间插值。实验表明该方法能缓解覆盖退化并保持预测集大小。
Motivation: 共形预测在数据分布偏移下，原有的交换性假设被破坏，导致边际覆盖保证失效，需要应对标签条件协变量偏移下的性能损失。
Method: 利用域适应理论，推导出目标覆盖的下界，该下界以源域分类器损失和Wasserstein距离度量偏移程度。基于此，设计通过松弛参数（slack parameter）膨胀共形阈值以维持目标覆盖在预设水平之上的方法，并提出源调谐伪校准算法。
Result: 数值实验表明，推导的界限能够定性跟踪伪校准行为，且源调谐方案在分布偏移下减轻覆盖退化，同时保持非平凡的预测集大小。
Conclusion: 伪校准结合源调谐方法可有效应对分布偏移对共形预测覆盖保证的破坏，为实际部署提供了理论支持和实用算法。

papers.title: Gabor Fields: Orientation-Selective Level-of-Detail for Volume Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian-based representations have enabled efficient physically-based volume rendering at a fraction of the memory cost of regular, discrete, voxel-based distributions. However, several remaining issues hamper their widespread use. One of the advantages of classic voxel grids is the ease of constructing hierarchical representations by either storing volumetric mipmaps or selectively pruning branches of an already hierarchical voxel grid. Such strategies reduce rendering time and eliminate aliasing when lower levels of detail are required. Constructing similar strategies for Gaussian-based volumes is not trivial. Straightforward solutions, such as prefiltering or computing mipmap-style representations, lead to increased memory requirements or expensive re-fitting of each level separately. Additionally, such solutions do not guarantee a smooth transition between different hierarchy levels. To address these limitations, we propose Gabor Fields, an orientation-selective mixture of Gabor kernels that enables continuous frequency filtering at no cost. The frequency content of the asset is reduced by selectively pruning primitives, directly benefiting rendering performance. Beyond filtering, we demonstrate that stochastically sampling from different frequencies and orientations at each ray recursion enables masking substantial portions of the volume, accelerating ray traversal time in single- and multiple-scattering settings. Furthermore, inspired by procedural volumes, we present an application for efficient design and rendering of procedural clouds as Gabor-noise-modulated Gaussians.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gabor Fields，一种基于 Gabor 核的方向选择性混合表示，用于体渲染中的连续频率滤波和层次细节（LOD）管理。该方法通过选择性修剪基元减少频率内容，并利用随机采样加速单次和多次散射中的光线追踪。此外，还展示了将过程化云建模为 Gabor 噪声调制高斯体的应用。与传统高斯体表示相比，Gabor Fields 无需昂贵重拟合即可实现平滑的 LOD 过渡，且内存开销低。
Motivation: 高斯体表示在体渲染中节省内存，但缺乏类似体素网格的层次表示能力，难以实现高效的 LOD 和抗锯齿。现有预滤波或 mipmap 方案导致内存增加或需要逐层重拟合，且无法保证层次间平滑过渡。
Method: 提出 Gabor Fields，即混合 Gabor 核，每个核具有方向选择性和频率选择性。通过选择性修剪基元降低频率内容，并在光线递归时从不同频率和方向随机采样，从而遮挡体积大部分区域，加速光线遍历。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在不增加内存开销的前提下实现连续频率滤波，并显著加速单次和多次散射中的光线遍历时间。以过程化云为例展示了实际应用效果。
Conclusion: Gabor Fields 为高斯体渲染提供了一种无需额外重拟合的层次细节方案，兼顾效率与质量，尤其适用于方向性纹理和过程化体积。

papers.title: Bifocal Attention: Harmonizing Geometric and Spectral Positional Embeddings for Algorithmic Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) have become the standard for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to their ability to encode relative positions through geometric rotation. However, we identify a significant limitation we term ''Spectral Rigidity'': standard RoPE utilizes a fixed geometric decay ($θ^{-i}$) optimized for local syntactic coherence, which fails to capture the long-range, periodic structures inherent in recursive logic and algorithmic reasoning. This results in a ''Structure Gap'', where models trained on shallow reasoning chains fail to extrapolate to deeper recursive steps. In this work, we introduce Bifocal Attention, an architectural paradigm that decouples positional encoding into two distinct modalities: Geometric Eyes (Standard RoPE) for precise token-level manipulation, and Spectral Eyes (Learnable Harmonic Operators) for tracking long-range recursive depth. We propose a novel training protocol, Spectral Evolution, which initializes positional frequencies as static geometric parameters but allows them to evolve via gradient descent into a harmonic basis optimized for the specific algorithmic topology of the task.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出标准旋转位置编码（RoPE）存在频谱刚性（Spectral Rigidity）问题，即固定几何衰减无法捕捉递归逻辑和算法推理所需的长程周期结构，导致结构差距（Structure Gap）。为此，提出双焦点注意力（Bifocal Attention），将位置编码解耦为几何眼（标准RoPE）用于精确词级操作，以及频谱眼（可学习谐波算子）用于跟踪长程递归深度，并设计了频谱演化（Spectral Evolution）训练协议。
Motivation: 标准RoPE的固定几何衰减优化用于局部句法连贯性，但无法处理递归推理中长程、周期性的结构，导致模型在深度递归步骤上外推失败。
Method: 提出Bifocal Attention架构，包含两种位置编码模态：几何眼（标准RoPE）和频谱眼（可学习谐波算子）；并引入Spectral Evolution训练协议，初始化位置频率为静态几何参数，通过梯度下降优化为适应任务算法拓扑的谐波基。
Result: 论文在概念层面提出新框架，但摘要未提供具体实验结果或定量比较。
Conclusion: 双焦点注意力通过解耦几何与频谱位置编码，有望提升模型在算法推理和递归任务上的泛化能力，但局限性和实际效果尚需实验验证。

papers.title: On the Role of Depth in Surgical Vision Foundation Models: An Empirical Study of RGB-D Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models (VFMs) have emerged as powerful tools for surgical scene understanding. However, current approaches predominantly rely on unimodal RGB pre-training, overlooking the complex 3D geometry inherent to surgical environments. Although several architectures support multimodal or geometry-aware inputs in general computer vision, the benefits of incorporating depth information in surgical settings remain underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study comparing eight ViT-based VFMs that differ in pre-training domain, learning objective, and input modality (RGB vs. RGB-D). For pre-training, we use a curated dataset of 1.4 million robotic surgical images paired with depth maps generated from an off-the-shelf network. We evaluate these models under both frozen-backbone and end-to-end fine-tuning protocols across eight surgical datasets spanning object detection, segmentation, depth estimation, and pose estimation. Our experiments yield several consistent findings. Models incorporating explicit geometric tokenization, such as MultiMAE, substantially outperform unimodal baselines across all tasks. Notably, geometric-aware pre-training enables remarkable data efficiency: models fine-tuned on just 25% of labeled data consistently surpass RGB-only models trained on the full dataset. Importantly, these gains require no architectural or runtime changes at inference; depth is used only during pre-training, making adoption straightforward. These findings suggest that multimodal pre-training offers a viable path towards building more capable surgical vision systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实证研究比较了八种基于ViT的视觉基础模型（VFM），这些模型在预训练领域、学习目标和输入模态（RGB vs RGB-D）上有所不同。研究使用140万张机器人手术图像和深度图进行预训练，在8个手术数据集上评估下游任务（目标检测、分割、深度估计、姿态估计）。结果表明，显式几何标记化模型（如MultiMAE）在所有任务上显著优于单模态基线，且几何感知预训练在仅使用25%标注数据时即可超越全数据训练的RGB模型，且推理时无需深度输入。
Motivation: 当前手术视觉基础模型主要依赖单模态RGB预训练，忽略了手术环境固有的复杂3D几何信息。虽然通用视觉中已有支持多模态或几何感知输入的架构，但深度信息在手术场景中的益处仍未被充分探索。
Method: 使用140万张机器人手术图像及由现成网络生成的深度图，对八种不同预训练域、学习目标和输入模态（RGB vs RGB-D）的ViT基础模型进行预训练，并在八个手术数据集上采用冻结骨干和端到端微调两种协议评估。
Result: 显式几何标记化模型（如MultiMAE）在所有任务上大幅优于单模态基线；仅用25%标注数据微调的几何感知模型持续超越使用全部数据训练的RGB模型，且精度提升无需推理时的深度输入或架构改动。
Conclusion: 多模态预训练（利用深度但仅用于预训练）是构建更强大手术视觉系统的可行路径，能带来显著的数据效率和性能提升。

papers.title: Time-varying Mixing Matrix Design for Energy-efficient Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: We consider the design of mixing matrices to minimize the operation cost for decentralized federated learning (DFL) in wireless networks, with focus on minimizing the maximum per-node energy consumption. As a critical hyperparameter for DFL, the mixing matrix controls both the convergence rate and the needs of agent-to-agent communications, and has thus been studied extensively. However, existing designs mostly focused on minimizing the communication time, leaving open the minimization of per-node energy consumption that is critical for energy-constrained devices. This work addresses this gap through a theoretically-justified solution for mixing matrix design that aims at minimizing the maximum per-node energy consumption until convergence, while taking into account the broadcast nature of wireless communications. Based on a novel convergence theorem that allows arbitrarily time-varying mixing matrices, we propose a multi-phase design framework that activates time-varying communication topologies under optimized budgets to trade off the per-iteration energy consumption and the convergence rate while balancing the energy consumption across nodes. Our evaluations based on real data have validated the efficacy of the proposed solution in combining the low energy consumption of sparse mixing matrices and the fast convergence of dense mixing matrices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无线网络中能量受限的去中心化联邦学习（DFL）问题，提出一种时变混合矩阵设计方法，以最小化最大单节点能耗为目标。基于允许任意时变混合矩阵的新型收敛定理，设计多阶段框架，通过激活时变通信拓扑并在优化预算下平衡每轮能耗与收敛速度。基于真实数据的评估表明该方法能结合稀疏混合矩阵的低能耗与密集混合矩阵的快速收敛。
Motivation: 现有混合矩阵设计大多以最小化通信时间为目标，忽略了能量受限设备的关键需求——最小化单节点能耗，且未考虑无线广播特性。
Method: 提出一个多阶段设计框架，基于允许任意时变混合矩阵的收敛定理，激活时变通信拓扑并在优化预算下动态调整，以权衡每轮能耗与收敛速度，同时实现节点间能耗均衡。
Result: 基于真实数据的评估验证了所提方案在结合稀疏混合矩阵的低能耗与密集混合矩阵的快速收敛方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 所提时变混合矩阵设计方法能有效降低DFL中最大单节点能耗，为能量受限无线网络中的联邦学习提供了理论依据与实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SloMo-Fast: Slow-Momentum and Fast-Adaptive Teachers for Source-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) is crucial for deploying models in real-world applications with unseen, evolving target domains. Existing CTTA methods, however, often rely on source data or prototypes, limiting their applicability in privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained settings. Although several methods attempt to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, they often fail to preserve long-term domain-specific knowledge across many domain shifts. Moreover, their relatively slow adaptation rates during domain transitions can cause error accumulation, allowing mistakes to propagate before effective adaptation occurs. To address these challenges, we propose SloMo-Fast, a source-free, dual-teacher CTTA framework designed for enhanced quick adaptability and generalization. It includes two complementary teachers: the Slow-Teacher, which exhibits slow forgetting and retains long-term knowledge of previously encountered domains to ensure robust generalization, and the Fast-Teacher rapidly adapts to new domains while accumulating and integrating knowledge across them. This framework preserves knowledge of past domains and adapts efficiently to new ones. Our extensive experiments show that SloMo-Fast consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across Cyclic Test-Time Adaptation (Cyclic-TTA), a CTTA benchmark that simulates recurring domain shifts, along with ten other CTTA settings, highlighting its ability to both adapt and generalize across evolving, revisited domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SloMo-Fast，一种无源数据（source-free）的双教师持续测试时适应（CTTA）框架，旨在解决灾难性遗忘和快速适应之间的权衡。Slow-Teacher 以慢遗忘方式保留长期领域知识，Fast-Teacher 快速适应新领域并跨领域积累知识。实验表明，该方法在 Cyclic-TTA 等 11 个 CTTA 基准上一致超越现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 CTTA 方法常依赖源数据或原型，不适用于隐私敏感和资源受限场景；同时难以在多次域转移中保留长期知识，且适应速度慢导致错误累积。
Method: 提出无源双教师框架：Slow-Teacher 缓慢遗忘并保留先前域的长期知识，Fast-Teacher 快速适应新域并在域间整合知识，两者互补以提升泛化性。
Result: 在 Cyclic-TTA 及另外 10 种 CTTA 设置上，SloMo-Fast 均一致优于现有方法，展现出对动态演化和重复出现的域的适应与泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该框架在无源数据条件下有效平衡了长期记忆保持与快速适应，为 CTTA 提供了实用解决方案。

papers.title: Hybrid coupling with operator inference and the overlapping Schwarz alternating method
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel hybrid approach for coupling subdomain-local non-intrusive Operator Inference (OpInf) reduced order models (ROMs) with each other and with subdomain-local high-fidelity full order models (FOMs) with using the overlapping Schwarz alternating method (O-SAM). The proposed methodology addresses significant challenges in multiscale modeling and simulation, particularly the long runtime and complex mesh generation requirements associated with traditional high-fidelity simulations. By leveraging the flexibility of O-SAM, we enable the seamless integration of disparate models, meshes, and time integration schemes, enhancing computational efficiency while maintaining high accuracy. Our approach is demonstrated through a series of numerical experiments on complex three-dimensional (3D) solid dynamics problems, showcasing speedups of up to 106x compared to conventional FOM-FOM couplings. This work paves the way for more efficient simulation workflows in engineering applications, with potential extensions to a wide range of partial differential equations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合耦合方法，通过算子推理（OpInf）降阶模型与重叠Schwarz交替方法（O-SAM）结合，实现子域间不同保真度模型的灵活耦合。在三维固体动力学问题中，该方法相比传统全阶模型耦合获得了高达106倍的加速。
Motivation: 多尺度模拟中传统高保真仿真运行时间长且网格生成复杂，现有耦合方法缺乏灵活性，难以整合不同模型、网格和时间积分方案。
Method: 采用非侵入式算子推理构建子域局部降阶模型，并利用重叠Schwarz交替方法实现降阶模型之间以及降阶模型与全阶模型的耦合，支持异质模型、网格和时间步长。
Result: 在复杂三维固体动力学问题上，该方法实现了高达106倍的加速比，同时保持高精度。
Conclusion: 该混合耦合方法为工程应用中更高效的仿真工作流铺平了道路，可推广至多种偏微分方程问题。

papers.title: Comparative Field Deployment of Reinforcement Learning and Model Predictive Control for Residential HVAC
papers.abstract_en: Model Predictive Control (MPC) has demonstrated significant performance improvements over today's control methods for residential Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC), but deploying MPC often requires substantial engineering effort. Reinforcement Learning (RL) may offer comparable performance with easier deployment, but its practical application for residential HVAC remains largely undemonstrated, leaving open questions related to occupant comfort and data requirements. To investigate these issues, we deployed one MPC variant and one model-based RL variant for one month each in an occupied house in a cold climate. The controllers adjusted an air-to-air heat pump's thermostat temperature setpoint based on measurements of the indoor temperature and the electric power used for heating. Relative to constant-setpoint operation, MPC saved 18.1\% (95\% confidence interval: 4.4 to 30.9\%) of weather-normalized heat pump energy and RL saved 20.9\% (2.6 to 38.3\%). MPC maintained acceptable occupant comfort. RL kept the house cooler, particularly during an initial adaptation phase, leading to three reports of occupant discomfort. The two algorithms had similar data requirements. We estimate that for a fresh deployment in another house, RL would take about one-third less engineering effort than MPC. While RL reduces deployment effort, it faces difficulties related to safe controller initialization and to mismatches between the modeled and true state and action spaces.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Under review for Applied Energy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在真实住宅中部署了模型预测控制 (MPC) 和基于模型的强化学习 (RL) 各一个月，用于控制空气源热泵的恒温器设定点。与恒定设定点相比，MPC 节省了 18.1% 的天气归一化热泵能耗，RL 节省了 20.9%，但 RL 在初期适应阶段导致室内温度偏低，引发了三次居住者不适报告。
Motivation: MPC 在住宅 HVAC 中节能效果显著但部署工程量大，RL 可能降低部署难度，但其实际应用中的居住舒适度和数据需求等问题尚未充分验证。
Method: 在寒冷气候的有人居住房屋中，分别部署 MPC 和基于模型的 RL 各一个月，控制器根据室内温度和供暖电功率调整空气源热泵的恒温器温度设定点。
Result: 相对恒定设定点运行，MPC 节省天气归一化热泵能耗 18.1%（95% CI: 4.4–30.9%），RL 节省 20.9%（95% CI: 2.6–38.3%）。MPC 维持了可接受的居住舒适度，RL 导致房屋偏冷，出现三次不适报告。两种算法数据需求相似，RL 部署工程时间减少约三分之一。
Conclusion: RL 能实现与 MPC 相当的节能效果且部署更省力，但面临安全初始化和模型与真实状态/动作空间不匹配等挑战。

papers.title: A Bit of Freedom Goes a Long Way: Classical and Quantum Algorithms for Reinforcement Learning under a Generative Model
papers.abstract_en: We propose novel classical and quantum online algorithms for learning finite- and infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). Our algorithms are based on a hybrid online-offline reinforcement learning model wherein the agent can, from time to time, freely interact with the environment in a generative sampling fashion, i.e., by having access to a "simulator". By employing known classical and new quantum algorithms for approximating optimal policies under a generative model within our learning algorithms, we show that it is possible to avoid several paradigms from RL like "optimism in the face of uncertainty" and "posterior sampling" and instead compute and use optimal policies directly, which yields better regret bounds compared to previous works. Our quantum algorithms obtain regret bounds which only a $\operatorname{poly}\log{T}$ dependence on the number of time steps $T$, thus breaking the $O(\sqrt{T})$ classical barrier. Our infinite-horizon discounted regret bound is brand new, while in the finite- and infinite-horizon undiscounted settings, our results match the time dependence of some prior quantum works, but with improved dependence on other parameters like state space size $S$ and action space size $A$.
papers.comment: 31 pages. v3: main text completely restructured and simplified, results for compact spaces have been dropped (to be included elsewhere), fixed a bug on optimal policies for finite-horizon MDPs which weakened a bit one result, expanded the new RL model by including a tunable budget parameter, new results on infinite-horizon discounted MDPs, improved regrets overall
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出新的经典与量子在线算法，用于学习有限和无限时域的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。算法基于混合在线-离线强化学习模型，代理可以偶尔通过生成采样（模拟器）自由交互。通过使用已知经典和新的量子算法在生成模型下近似最优策略，避免了“面对不确定性时的乐观”和“后验采样”等范式，直接计算并使用最优策略，获得比先前工作更优的遗憾界。量子算法获得仅依赖时间步数T的多项式对数因子，打破了O(√T)的经典壁垒。无限时域折扣遗憾界是全新的，有限和无限时域无折扣设置下，时间依赖性与一些先前量子工作匹配，但在状态空间大小S和动作空间大小A等参数上依赖更优。
Motivation: 强化学习中，面对不确定性时的乐观和后验采样等经典范式可能导致次优遗憾界。本文希望利用生成模型（模拟器）的离线数据，避免这些范式，直接计算最优策略以改进学习效率。
Method: 提出一种混合在线-离线RL模型，代理可定期以生成采样方式自由交互。将经典和新的量子算法应用于生成模型下的最优策略逼近，并将它们嵌入在线学习框架中，从而直接使用最优策略进行决策。
Result: 量子算法获得仅poly log T的遗憾依赖，突破经典O(√T)下界。无限时域折扣遗憾界是全新的；在有限和无限时域无折扣设置中，时间依赖性与以往量子工作相同，但在S和A参数上更优。
Conclusion: 利用生成模型和量子算法可以显著提升强化学习的遗憾界，避免传统范式，为RL提供新途径。

papers.title: A Scaffolded GenAI Lab in Early Undergraduate CS: A Mixed-Methods, Multi-Course Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Background and Context. Generative AI (GenAI) tools are increasingly used in programming courses, but we have limited evidence about how brief instruction can foster responsible, learning-oriented use. Objectives. We evaluate "AI-Lab", a scaffolded GenAI literacy intervention, asking how students' self-reported GenAI usage and their openness and comfort using GenAI for conceptual, debugging, and homework tasks change after participation. Methods. Across two semesters in three CS courses and one first-year engineering course at a U.S. university, we deployed the "AI-Lab" (pre-lab orientation, in-class critique of GenAI outputs, and a required homework reflection), collecting paired pre/post surveys (Perception N=831; Usage N=826) and six post-intervention focus groups; primary inferential analyses used the three CS courses (N=778 and 773, respectively). We analyzed survey shifts with paired non-parametric tests and focus groups via thematic analysis. Findings. Openness increased for conceptual questions and homework help, and comfort increased for conceptual, debugging, and homework scenarios; self-reported frequency of GenAI use for homework and projects remained stable, while self-reported use for debugging increased. Focus group participants described adopting more iterative prompting strategies, becoming more skeptical of correctness, and articulating clearer boundaries around integrity and dependence. Implications. A short, structured intervention can shift students' reported comfort with and willingness to use GenAI and influence the strategies they describe for engaging with it without increasing overall self-reported use on graded work. These results motivate future work triangulating surveys with behavioral traces and learning measures.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 18 tables; v2 substantially refined qualitative analysis and discussion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文评估了一项名为“AI-Lab”的脚手架式生成式AI素养干预，该干预包括课前指导、课堂批判性分析和课后反思。在两个学期的三门CS课程和一门工程课程中，通过前后问卷调查（N≈800）和焦点小组收集数据，发现学生的开放性和舒适度在概念性、调试和作业任务上有所提升，自报使用频率总体稳定，但调试使用增加。焦点小组显示学生采用了更迭代的提示策略，对正确性更怀疑，并明确了学术诚信界限。研究认为简短的干预可以改变学生态度和策略而不增加总体使用。
Motivation: 生成式AI工具在编程课程中广泛应用，但缺乏关于简短指导如何促进负责任、以学习为导向使用的证据。
Method: 在两个学期的三门CS课程和一门第一年工程课程中部署“AI-Lab”干预（课前指导、课堂批判分析GenAI输出、课后反思），收集配对前后调查（感知N=831，使用N=826）和六个干预后焦点小组，主要分析CS课程数据（N=778/773），采用配对非参数检验和主题分析。
Result: 学生开放性和舒适度在概念性问题、调试和作业任务上显著增加；自报使用频率在作业和项目上稳定，调试使用增加；焦点小组描述更迭代的提示策略、对正确性的怀疑以及更明确的诚信界限。
Conclusion: 简短的结构化干预可以改变学生对GenAI的舒适度、意愿和使用策略，而不增加总体自报使用，未来工作需结合行为痕迹和学习测量。

papers.title: Holistic Fusion: Task- and Setup-Agnostic Robot Localization and State Estimation with Factor Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Seamless operation of mobile robots in challenging environments requires low-latency local motion estimation and accurate global localization. While most sensor-fusion approaches are designed for specific scenarios, this work introduces a flexible open-source solution for task- and setup-agnostic multimodal sensor fusion distinguished by its generality and usability. Holistic Fusion formulates sensor fusion as a combined estimation problem of i) the local and global robot state and ii) a (theoretically unlimited) number of dynamic variables, including automatic alignment of reference frames; this formulation fits countless real-world applications without conceptual modifications, offering a comprehensive solution beyond hard-coded/task-specific approaches. The proposed factor-graph formulation enables direct fusion of an arbitrary number of absolute, local, and landmark measurements expressed with respect to different frames by explicitly including them as states in the optimization and modeling their evolution as random walks. Moreover, local smoothness and consistency receive particular attention to prevent estimation jumps. Holistic Fusion enables low-latency and smooth online state estimation on typical robot hardware while simultaneously providing low-drift global localization at the IMU measurement rate. The efficacy of this released framework [1] is demonstrated in five real-world scenarios on three robotic platforms with distinct task requirements, highlighting the advantages of fusing multiple absolute measurement types [2]. TL;DR: Holistic Fusion 提出一种通用的、任务与传感器配置无关的多模态传感器融合方法，基于因子图（factor graph）将局部与全局机器人状态以及任意数量的动态变量（包括参考帧自动对齐）联合优化。该方法能够直接融合任意数量的绝对、局部和地标测量，同时保持局部平滑性和一致性，在典型机器人硬件上实现低延迟且平滑的在线状态估计。在三个机器人平台、五种实际场景中验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有传感器融合方法通常针对特定场景设计，缺乏通用性和灵活性，难以适应多样化的任务和传感器配置。
Method: 提出因子图公式，将绝对、局部和地标测量（涉及不同参考帧）直接作为优化状态，并建模为随机游走；同时特别关注局部平滑性和一致性，避免估计跳变。
Result: 在典型机器人硬件上实现低延迟、平滑的在线估计，并提供 IMU 测量率下的低漂移全局定位；在五个真实场景、三个机器人平台上展示了融合多种绝对测量的优势。
Conclusion: 该框架具有高度通用性和易用性，代码已开源，可广泛应用于各种机器人定位与状态估计任务。

papers.title: Shoaling of Finite-Amplitude Rogue Waves
papers.abstract_en: Rogue wave formation and enhancement over coastal areas have been documented over the last decade. However, this recent knowledge is in apparent contradiction with the established observation of sub-Gaussian wave statistics near shallow water. Current theories and experiments describe the rogue wave amplification near shallow water regimes, but only for small-amplitude waves, and thus, not accounting for wave-breaking processes. To address this gap, we perform experiments to probe inhomogeneous wave fields nearing the wave-breaking regime. We also show that by increasing the significant wave height towards the breaking limit, the kinetic energy grows faster than the variance of the surface elevation due to nonlinearity, providing a physical explanation why the occurrence of rogue wave first increases in shallower waters and suddenly decreases further shorewards.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验研究接近波浪破碎极限的非均匀波场，发现在浅水区域，随着有效波高接近破碎极限，动能增长快于表面高程方差，从而解释了异常波在浅水区先增加后减少的现象。
Motivation: 现有理论和实验仅针对小振幅波描述浅水区异常波放大，未考虑波浪破碎过程，与浅水区次高斯波统计的观测相矛盾。
Method: 进行实验，测量接近波浪破碎极限的非均匀波场，分析动能与表面高程方差的关系。
Result: 发现当有效波高增大至破碎极限时，动能增长率超过表面高程方差增长率，为异常波先增后减提供物理解释。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了有限振幅效应在浅水区异常波演化中的关键作用，但仅限于实验条件，未涉及实际海洋环境。

papers.title: Pretrained Event Classification Model for High Energy Physics Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a foundation model for event classification in high-energy physics, built on a Graph Neural Network architecture and trained on 120 million simulated proton-proton collision events spanning 12 distinct physics processes. The model is pretrained to learn a general and robust representation of collision data using challenging multiclass and multilabel classification tasks. Its performance is evaluated across seven event classification tasks, which include new physics processes not encountered during pretraining as well as ATLAS Open Data to demonstrate generalizability across different simulation frameworks, from Delphes fast simulation to full ATLAS detector simulation. Fine-tuning the pretrained model significantly improves classification performance, particularly in scenarios with limited training data, demonstrating gains in both accuracy and computational efficiency. To investigate the underlying mechanisms behind these performance improvements, we employ a representational similarity evaluation framework based on Centered Kernel Alignment. This analysis reveals that encoder-stage representations of the fine-tuned model remain similar to those of the baseline, while intermediate graph processing layers diverge substantially, indicating that fine-tuning preserves general-purpose encoders while developing fundamentally different message-passing pathways to arrive at superior task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于图神经网络的高能物理事件分类基础模型，在1.2亿模拟质子-质子碰撞事件上预训练，涵盖12种物理过程。通过多类和多标签分类任务学习通用碰撞数据表征。在7个事件分类任务上评估，包括未见的新物理过程和ATLAS开放数据，证明其跨模拟框架的泛化能力。微调显著提升性能，尤其在数据稀缺场景下准确率和计算效率均获益。利用Centered Kernel Alignment分析表明，微调保留了编码器层表征，但中间图处理层发生显著分化。
Motivation: 高能物理分析通常需要为每个新物理信号从头训练事件分类模型，缺乏通用预训练基础模型。现有工作缺乏跨过程、跨模拟框架的系统评估。
Method: 构建图神经网络架构，在120 million模拟碰撞事件上进行多任务预训练（多类分类+多标签分类）。随后在下游任务上微调，无需额外架构修改。采用Centered Kernel Alignment分析表征相似性。
Result: 微调预训练模型在7个任务上显著提升分类性能，尤其在数据量有限时增益明显。跨模拟框架（Delphes到完整ATLAS）均表现良好。表征分析揭示编码层保持稳定，中间图处理层发生实质性变化。
Conclusion: 该预训练模型可作为高能物理事件分类的基础特征提取器，微调能高效适应新任务，其机制在于微调重新定向中间信息传递路径而非改变通用编码器。
